jobs.title: AI Platform Administrator
jobs.excerpt: By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful.
jobs.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

AI Platform Administrator

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Feature, connector, app, and agent governance

  • Maintain the allowlist of approved connectors, apps, plugins, and extensions across all three platforms, and route every new request through security review and the standard IT governance process before enablement.
  • Administer Claude connectors and the organizational Skills catalog, including version control, ownership assignment, and retirement of superseded Skills.
  • Administer ChatGPT Enterprise workspace settings, including plugin and app availability, action and approval controls, custom GPT policy, and Workspace Agents settings — which are disabled by default and require explicit risk review before enablement, particularly where agents would publish using personal or shared connections.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 Copilot controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center, including agent enablement, blocking, and assignment through integrated apps, connector availability, and coordination with the Power Platform team on Copilot Studio publishing and environment policy.
  • Maintain a reviewed inventory of agents, custom GPTs, and Skills in each tenant on a scheduled cadence, so that capabilities introduced through vendor app updates or self-service authoring do not bypass review.
  • Configure sharing and visibility defaults, including Claude project visibility and restriction of public projects, ChatGPT workspace sharing policy, and Copilot agent sharing scope.
  • Administer grounding and search data sources — Claude Enterprise Search, ChatGPT connectors, and Copilot connectors — only where the data owner has provided documented approval and source-level permissions are verified.
  • Execute phased feature rollout — core capabilities, then intelligence features, then integrations, then automation and agents — so that governance posture is reassessed at each stage rather than after the fact.
  • Coordinate with End User Computing on managed deployment of desktop, browser, and Office add-in clients, including MDM packaging and extension controls.

Level 2 triage and support operations

  • Serve as the designated Level 2 escalation point for all incidents and service requests relating to Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot routed from the Service Desk (Level 1), owning queue triage, prioritization, and adherence to published service levels.
  • Triage access and authentication failures and partner with IAM to resolve them, including federation and assertion errors, provisioning and group-membership gaps, entitlement and seat-type mismatches, and orphaned or duplicated accounts; own the platform-side diagnosis and escalate the provisioning or identity-side fix to the accountable team.
  • Troubleshoot Claude Code client issues, including enterprise authentication, re-authentication after account or client changes, client version updates, migration from API key–based access to enterprise seats, and terminal and operating-system dependencies across Windows, macOS, and Linux/WSL.
  • Troubleshoot ChatGPT Enterprise desktop, Office add-in, and developer tooling issues, including workspace and seat scoping, plugin and connector authorization, and role-based access to restricted capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 Copilot issues, including license and eligibility checks, agent availability, grounding and indexing behavior across SharePoint and Exchange content, add-in availability in Office clients, and permission-inherited results.
  • Resolve connector and integration authorization failures, file upload and format issues, error conditions, and content-filtering outcomes, distinguishing product behavior from configuration defects and from user expectation gaps.
  • Reproduce, document, and escalate confirmed platform defects to Anthropic, OpenAI, or Microsoft support with complete diagnostics; track escalations to closure and communicate status to requesters and stakeholders.
  • Author and maintain the support knowledge base, Level 1 triage scripts, known-error records, and per-platform runbooks so that routine volume is resolved at first contact rather than escalated.
  • Maintain the Level 1 / Level 2 / vendor escalation model, coverage rotation, and escalation matrix for each platform; contribute to problem management, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.
  • Support major-incident communications for platform availability events, including user-facing status updates and coordination with the Service Desk.

Governance, compliance, and audit

  • Monitor audit and activity logging across platforms and support the flow of log data into enterprise security monitoring — Claude audit logs, the ChatGPT Enterprise compliance logs platform, and Microsoft Purview audit for Copilot and agent activity.
  • Administer data retention settings in line with Sedgwick records management, Legal, and Privacy requirements, and document the approved retention position for each platform.
  • Support authorized use of vendor compliance APIs and organization data export for data loss prevention, eDiscovery, and regulatory requests, acting only on validated requests from Legal, Privacy, or Information Security.
  • Maintain the evidence set required for third-party risk, security, and privacy reviews, including certification artifacts, data processing agreements, and any business associate agreement obligations, and track vendor control changes that affect Sedgwick’s approved posture.
  • Enforce acceptable use and data-handling standards, including restrictions on entering confidential, regulated, claimant, employee, or production data into any AI platform outside approved controls, and escalate suspected violations.
  • Maintain a documented configuration baseline per platform and route changes through enterprise change control, with rollback considerations captured for privileged or high-impact changes.
  • Support internal and external audit requests with documented configuration, entitlement, and change evidence.

Adoption analytics and reporting

  • Produce recurring adoption reporting from each platform’s native analytics — Claude usage and Claude Code analytics, ChatGPT workspace analytics and usage exports, and Copilot usage reporting and analytics — including weekly active users as a percentage of provisioned seats, activity per user, and feature adoption.
  • Consolidate platform metrics into a single cross-platform adoption view so that leadership can compare uptake and support burden on a consistent basis.
  • Administer periodic user surveys capturing self-reported time saved, tasks augmented, and satisfaction, and pair quantitative results with qualitative examples from team leads.
  • Deliver monthly operational reporting and quarterly business review inputs to AI Technology leadership.
  • Track support volume, ticket aging, first-contact resolution, and recurring failure themes by platform, and convert findings into configuration or enablement actions.

Enablement and change management support


  • Support all-staff introductory sessions, department-level enablement built around real workflows, and recurring office hours during initial rollout and for each new team onboarded.
  • Maintain clear guidance on which platform to use for which task, so that overlapping capabilities do not create user confusion or duplicated licensing.
  • Operate the internal support and community channel, maintain the self-service resource hub, and curate a library of approved prompts, Skills, GPTs, and agents with the AI Center of Excellence.
  • Enable and support the champion network with early access, advanced guidance, and demonstration material.
  • Integrate AI tooling onboarding into standard new hire orientation and, where applicable, package training into trackable LMS courses to monitor enablement coverage.
  • Deliver a brief retrospective at each rollout phase covering emerging use cases, remaining barriers, and changes required for the next phase.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Travel as required.

Remote role, open to any U.S. State.


QUALIFICATIONS


Education & Licensing

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


Experience

Five (5) or more years administering enterprise SaaS platforms in a regulated or large-enterprise environment, including at least two years as a named Level 2 escalation owner.


Skills & Knowledge

  • Hands-on administration experience in a Microsoft 365 tenant, including the Microsoft 365 admin center, licensing and service plan assignment, and integrated app or add-in governance.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise single sign-on and SCIM provisioning concepts sufficient to triage access failures accurately and partner effectively with IAM, without owning identity provider configuration.
  • Demonstrated experience applying least-privilege principles to platform settings and integrations, and operating within formal change control.
  • Working experience in an ITSM platform (ServiceNow preferred) across incident, request, problem, and knowledge management, operating to defined service levels.
  • Ability to interpret audit logs and administrative analytics, use REST APIs for administrative tasks, and write or adapt basic scripts (PowerShell or Python).
  • Command-line and terminal proficiency sufficient to support developer tooling installation and authentication across Windows, macOS, and Linux/WSL.
  • Strong technical writing skills, with a track record of producing runbooks, knowledge articles, and operating policies that reduce escalation volume.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across Information Security, IAM, Legal, Privacy, and business stakeholders, and to communicate technical constraints to non-technical audiences.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.


Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines

Physical: Computer keyboarding, travel as required

Auditory/Visual: Hearing, vision and talking

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Vice President, Data Strategy & Governance is a senior executive accountable for defining, advancing, and operationalizing the enterprise data strategy. This leader drives the full lifecycle of data governance — from policy design and sensitive data management to technology enablement, data quality, and regulatory compliance. Serving as a strategic advisor to executive stakeholders across all business units and technology functions, the VP partners closely with Cybersecurity,
Enterprise Architecture, and line-of-business leaders cultivate a data-rich, AI-ready environment grounded in trust, quality, and accountability.
The VP is a visionary organizational builder who attracts and develops world-class talent, shapes data culture, and influences enterprise-wide change. This individual would need to partner across business and technology leaders to drive a product mindset and promote adoption to realize business outcomes. This leader will promote a data product operating model by embedding accountability for data quality, metadata, lineage, access, and data lifecycle management across the enterprise. This leader brings deep command of applied data governance practices, data protection strategies, emerging ML/AI-based governance tools, and the legislative landscape governing personal and sensitive data. Their work directly enables the organization's digital and analytics ambitions while fortifying its cyber-breach resistance posture.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Initiatives & Program Outcomes

  • Establish and own the enterprise data strategy, translating organizational goals into a continuously evolving roadmap of data capabilities spanning people, process, technology, and budget.
  • Lead portfolio governance of enterprise data programs, ensuring initiatives are prioritized, resourced, and delivering measurable business outcomes aligned to financial and strategic objectives.
  • Partner with the Chief Data & Analytics Officer and executive peers to articulate the value of data assets, influence investment decisions, and embed data thinking into enterprise planning cycles.
  • Drive enterprise-scale data science and AI readiness by ensuring foundational data infrastructure, lineage, quality, and accessibility meet the demands of advanced analytics and generative AI use cases.
  • Develop and maintain a data product mindset across the organization — enabling reusable, trusted, and well-documented data assets that accelerate time-to-insight across business units.

Team Building & Organizational Development

  • Build, lead, and continuously develop a high-performing, world-class team of experts spanning sensitive data governance, data lineage and mapping, data enrichment, data quality, data democratization, and program management.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning; champion data literacy initiatives that upskill the broader organization and democratize access to trusted data.
  • Act as a Culture Shaper and Talent Builder — recruiting diverse, senior talent, establishing clear career pathways, and mentoring future data leaders across the enterprise.
  • Operate as a cross-functional influencer and collaborator, building strong relationships across Technology, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and business unit stakeholders to drive data governance adoption at scale.
  • Define team operating models, performance metrics, and OKRs that demonstrate the strategic and financial impact of the data governance function.

Technology Implementations & Tools

  • Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of enterprise data governance platforms, data catalog and marketplace solutions, data quality tooling, and metadata management systems.
  • Modernize data scanning, automated tagging, and labeling capabilities to improve governance efficiency, enable proactive data classification, and strengthen data loss prevention (DLP) outcomes.
  • Partner with Security Architecture and Enterprise Architecture to design and deploy solutions that deliver integrated data governance and data security at scale — on-premises and across cloud environments.
  • Invest in and operationalize innovative ML/AI-based approaches for data governance, including automated lineage discovery, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy techniques.
  • Maintain awareness of the evolving data governance technology landscape; drive a buy/build/partner strategy that balances innovation with cost discipline and commercial accountability.

Data Governance Process Improvements

  • Operate and continuously enhance enterprise data governance capabilities — including metadata management, data lineage, data quality standards, master data management, and access governance — through a structured and measurable capability roadmap.
  • Define, publish, and enforce enterprise data policies, standards, and controls ensuring consistent, compliant, and high-quality data usage across all business domains.
  • Champion data democratization by enabling self-service data access models backed by robust governance guardrails, role-based access controls, and data marketplace infrastructure.
  • Establish data stewardship programs and data domain ownership models that distribute accountability for data quality and governance across the enterprise.
  • Drive continuous improvement of data anonymization, de-identification, and synthetic data capabilities to enable broader analytics use while protecting sensitive information.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Lead the enterprise Data Risk Assessment program, identifying, measuring, and managing data security risks across applications, platforms, and business and technology initiatives.
  • Ensure the organization's data practices comply with applicable data privacy regulations and industry standards, including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and other relevant legislation governing personal and sensitive data.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Cybersecurity to proactively identify regulatory changes, assess their data governance implications, and implement controls before compliance deadlines.
  • Strengthen data protection strategy and execution — including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and access control frameworks — to improve cyber-breach resistance.
  • Provide executive reporting and Board-level transparency on data governance risk posture, compliance status, and program maturity metrics on a recurring basis.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Requirements

Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership experience in data governance, data management, or data strategy roles within large, complex, matrixed corporate environments.
  • 10+ years of hands-on data governance experience, including both on-premises and cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling data governance programs from concept through enterprise adoption, with measurable improvements in data quality, compliance, and business outcomes.
  • Proven experience managing and delivering large, multi-workstream programs — including strategic initiatives, technology implementations, and organizational transformation — on time and within budget.
  • Prior hands-on experience and/or leadership responsibility for technical data governance tools, including data catalogs, data lineage platforms, data marketplace systems, and data quality frameworks.
  • Relevant experience in consumer goods, healthcare, financial services, or technology industries strongly preferred.

Technical & Domain Knowledge

  • Deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, data quality processes, and enterprise data modeling.
  • Relevant experience with data protection strategies, including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and role-based access control design.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity assessment methodologies and data security controls, with experience partnering with CISO and Security/Enterprise Architecture functions.
  • Familiarity with ML/AI-based data governance approaches, including automated metadata tagging, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy.
  • Strong command of data privacy regulations including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and related legislative frameworks.
  • Champion and drive a product mindset across the enterprise data and analytics, treat data as a strategic asset and managing data products through their full lifecycle to maximize business value, adoption, quality and reuse.

Leadership & Influence

  • A visionary Culture Shaper, Talent Builder, Results Driver, Systems Thinker, and Accountability Partner who engages and aligns the broad enterprise toward common data goals.
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; able to translate complex data concepts into clear, compelling narratives for C-suite, Board, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong evidence of the ability to introduce emerging technologies and develop analytics-based capabilities while maintaining cost awareness and commercial strategy.
  • Proven ability to drive enterprise-wide change in matrixed organizations through influence, coalition-building, and stakeholder management without direct authority.

Leadership Competencies

Culture Shaper

Actively builds an inclusive, high-trust data culture. Champions data literacy, promotes ethical data use, and sets behavioral expectations that reinforce accountability and transparency.

Talent Builder

Recruits, develops, and retains diverse, world-class talent. Creates clear career pathways, coaches emerging leaders, and builds bench strength across the data governance organization.

Results Driver

Sets ambitious goals and holds self and team accountable. Translates strategy into executable plans, tracks progress with rigor, and delivers measurable financial and operational impact.

Systems Thinker

Understands interconnections across data, technology, process, and people. Designs holistic governance frameworks that scale and anticipate second-order effects on the enterprise.

Influential Collaborator

Builds trust and credibility across business and technology functions. Uses data to persuade, aligns diverse stakeholders around shared priorities, and navigates complex political dynamics with integrity.

Strategic Innovator

Brings intellectual curiosity and market awareness. Proactively identifies emerging technologies and governance practices, translating external trends into competitive organizational advantage.

Education

  • Advanced degree (Master's or higher) in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Law, Cybersecurity, or a related field required.
  • Ph.D. in a relevant discipline or an MBA is a significant additional asset.
  • Dual degrees combining technical and business or legal disciplines are highly valued.
  • Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, CIPP, CISM, CISSP, or cloud data platform certifications) are a plus.

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations.   • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)

  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: About WonderlyWonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue.
jobs.description:
About Wonderly

Wonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue. We serve the home service industry ($1.3T), and can consistently double a new customer’s revenue within 90 days. We make all of our AI and software completely free - and only get paid when our customers make real money. We’re here helping real small businesses make a life, pay for their children’s college tuition, and live the American dream.

Pre-AI SaaS sold tools. AI companies claim they sell outcomes - task done, call answered, lead booked, ticket resolved - but calls or leads aren’t the outcomes that ultimately matter. Revenue is what ultimately matters, and today, none of the AI companies actually promise revenue. Wonderly changes that.

Our 70-person team (mostly in PDE) spent over a year building in stealth; our thesis is that - if you actually want to control the end result (revenue) of a business and deploy AI fast/cheaply, you can’t just build the sexy part (agents), you must also build the unsexy parts and own everything end to end: the system of record layer and the application layer. We built from scratch every software a home service business needs - replacing ServiceTitan, Squarespace, Ringcentral, Jobber, Square, Hubspot, and a dozen others applications. And we built every agent necessary - AI marketing, AI receptionist, AI voice, AI sales outreach, AI sales coaching, AI follow-ups, AI 3D design, AI finance, AI quoting, AI collections, and more - all embedded inside our own system with native data access. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready Agents to our customers in under 24 hours with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

We are the most outcome driven business model in the business because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents actually work in driving the end result - revenue. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve our customers’ revenue by 5-20%.

Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months to build (we are at least 2 years ahead of anyone else in the space). We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $1.3T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion), and all that money gets pumped into Wonderly.

About the Hiring Manager

Hey, I’m Bishop, Head of Operations at Wonderly.

I’m extreme, direct, and care a lot about getting to the truth. I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.

I work best with people who are high-agency, low-ego, and can handle intensity without needing a perfect playbook.

The Role

You’ll run the day-to-day of our inside sales team, the front line of how our contractors win jobs.

Our team works the leads we generate for our contractor customers, qualifies them fast, and books onsite appointments on the contractor’s behalf. Every lead that goes cold is money our customers lose, and money we lose. Your job is to make sure the team behind those bookings is staffed, trained, and performing every day.

That means:

  • Managing the team: schedules, coverage, weekend rotation, attendance

  • Hiring and onboarding new reps, and getting them productive fast

  • Listening to calls and coaching reps on what to fix

  • Tracking the numbers that matter (speed to lead, contact rate, booking rate, show rate) and acting when they slip

  • Handling performance issues directly, including the hard conversations

  • Keeping the process documented so the team doesn’t depend on any one person

  • Flagging what’s broken in the process so we can fix it, not just work around it

What Makes This Role Different

Most ops manager roles inherit a team that’s already built and a playbook that’s already set.

Here, the team is growing and the playbook is still being written. You’ll shape how the team is run, not just keep it running. If you see a better way to do coverage, coaching, or onboarding, you say it Monday and we’re testing it Wednesday.

You’ll work directly with me and Victoria, who leads Sales Operations, and you’ll see exactly how your decisions affect our customers’ revenue.

Backgrounds That Tend to Work

People from these backgrounds tend to thrive:

  • Running an inside sales or appointment-setting team

  • Team lead or sales floor manager who coached reps every day

  • Sales ops or support ops at a fast-growing company where you managed people, not just dashboards

  • Home services or remodeling companies where you ran the team that booked in-home appointments

Backgrounds we care less about:

  • Managers who have never sold or booked on the phone themselves

  • Ops or reporting roles with no people to manage

  • Account management or customer success with no team of your own

What matters more than the resume:

  • You’ve managed a team and been responsible for its numbers

  • You can listen to a call and know exactly what the rep should have done differently

  • You can have a hard conversation, say what needs to be said, and move on

  • You notice when something’s slipping before it shows up in the numbers

  • You’re organized, and you keep the team organized without being told twice

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and fast changes

Expectations

  • 60–70 hour weeks

  • Coverage that matches when leads come in, including some weekends

  • Real ownership of the team within your first 2 weeks

  • You own the team’s numbers and we’ll review them together regularly

  • The scope evolves constantly. As the team grows, so does the role.

Compensation

Total compensation: $130,000–$250,000 (base + equity)

Remote (US & Canada)

Wonderly is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and given equal opportunities. We do not discriminate based on gender identity, race, ancestry, disability, religion, sexual orientation, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We welcome and encourage all qualified candidates to apply for our job openings.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager, Professional Services to join our team. This is a Remote (US Remote - Central Time Zone preferred) role, reporting to the Manager, Professional Services. In this role, you will lead high-impact, enterprise-level customer deployments of the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform from kickoff through project closure. You will act as the primary trusted advisor and central point of contact during deployment, orchestrating technical resources and cross-functional teams to deliver seamless, secure business outcomes.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Take full accountability for the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of concurrent, complex customer deployments, covering planning, execution, governance, risk management, and formal project sign-off
  • Lead multiple concurrent customer engagements spanning Zero Trust deployments, legacy security tool migrations, architecture assessments, and ongoing optimization programs
  • Define, track, and report on deployment success criteria, metrics, milestones, and timelines to ensure projects stay on schedule, within scope, and aligned to business outcomes
  • Develop and maintain rigorous project documentation, including project charters, schedules, RAID logs, resource allocations, and regular status reports
  • Partner closely with internal specialists and customer stakeholders to proactively identify roadblocks, manage escalations, drive operational enablement, and champion AI-driven project management tools

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, navigating dynamic and evolving environments with confidence, viewing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, operating with high dynamic range to move seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving hard problems delivers the biggest impact for customers.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Direct experience managing large-scale deployments of Zero Trust architecture, SASE, or enterprise cloud security platforms (e.g., ZIA, ZPA, ZDX)
  • Hands-on proficiency with Professional Services Automation (PSA) and work management platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet
  • Proven track record leading complex enterprise digital transformations, including experience integrating predictive analytics, generative AI, or workflow automation into PMO reporting

jobs.excerpt: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know?
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

The Salesforce Developer is the builder-orchestrator; the person who turns solution designs into working, production-quality software, increasingly by specifying, directing, and rigorously verifying AI-generated code, not only by hand-writing every line. You will write Apex, build Lightning Web Components, design Flows, implement integrations, and deliver the features and enhancements that power Illumina’s Commercial and Services organizations on the Salesforce platform, working fluently with AI coding assistants while remaining fully accountable for the correctness, security, and quality of everything you ship.

You are responsible for the majority of hands-on delivery on the team, increasingly by directing and verifying AI-generated code, not only writing it by hand. You will work from solution designs provided by Solution Architects, under technical direction set by the Technical Architect, and in close collaboration with Test Automation Engineers who validate your work. You will produce clean, well-tested, secure code that meets Illumina’s engineering standards and scales to support a global organization, whether you typed it or an AI agent produced it, you own it.

This role operates within an Agile Scrum delivery model. You will participate in sprint planning and grooming alongside Product Owners, Solution Architects, Technical Architects, and TAEs. You will collaborate with TAEs to define test strategy for your features; quality is a shared responsibility, built into every sprint, not a handoff at the end. As the Salesforce platform evolves with AI capabilities like Agentforce and Data Cloud (Data 360), you will build and implement these solutions alongside the rest of the engineering team. As AI takes on more first-pass implementation, your leverage shifts upstream, to clear specifications, strong tests, and disciplined review, and your judgment about what “good” looks like becomes the most valuable thing you bring.

Responsibilities

Software Development

  • Write production-quality Apex code; classes, triggers, batch processes, queueable jobs, and scheduled Apex. Follow the team’s architectural patterns (trigger handler frameworks, service/domain/selector layers) and coding standards defined by the Technical Architect.
  • Build Lightning Web Components (LWC); custom UI components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript within the LWC framework. Implement wire services, imperative Apex calls, event handling, and Lightning Message Service. Follow SLDS design patterns and accessibility standards.
  • Design and build Flows; record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and autolaunched flows. Make appropriate decisions about when to use declarative automation vs. Apex based on the team’s established guidelines.
  • Implement integrations; REST/SOAP API callouts, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and named credentials. Build error handling, retry logic, and logging into integration implementations. Work with middleware where required.
  • Implement Agentforce solutions; build custom Apex actions for agents, configure Prompt Builder templates, write Agent Script for deterministic control, and implement Trust Layer guardrails as directed by solution designs.
  • Implement Data Cloud (Data 360) configurations; data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, calculated insights, and activations based on solution designs and architectural direction.
  • Configure Salesforce platform features; objects, fields, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets, sharing rules, and other declarative elements as part of feature delivery.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Work in agentic, spec-driven workflows: write a clear specification and acceptance criteria, delegate first-pass implementation to AI coding assistants, then review, correct, test, and own the result.
  • Engineer the context AI tools need to be useful and safe: maintain rules/standards files, ground agents in the org’s metadata via the Salesforce DX MCP, and supply relevant examples and data.
  • Verify AI-generated code with the same rigor as peer code, checking intent, security (CRUD/FLS, SOQL injection), governor-limit safety, hallucinated APIs, and adherence to team patterns. Treat verification as first-class engineering.
  • Use AI coding assistants (such as Cursor and Agentforce Vibes, plus conversational tools like Claude or ChatGPT Enterprise where approved) to accelerate development, refactoring, debugging, test writing, and documentation, and share effective prompts and patterns with the team.
  • Follow Illumina’s rules for safe use of AI tools on regulated health data: respect data boundaries, never expose PHI/PII or secrets, and understand the IP and authorship implications of AI-generated code.

Code Quality & Testing

  • Write comprehensive unit tests for all Apex code; positive, negative, and bulk scenarios. Achieve meaningful test coverage beyond the 75% minimum. Use test data factories and proper mocking techniques.
  • Participate in code reviews; both as a reviewer and as a contributor receiving feedback. Provide constructive, educative feedback to peers. Address code review feedback promptly and thoughtfully.
  • Follow the team’s coding standards, security practices, and architectural patterns. Write code that is clean, maintainable, well-documented, and aligned with the Technical Architect’s direction.
  • Write secure code; enforce CRUD/FLS checks, prevent SOQL injection, protect against XSS/CSRF, and implement appropriate data access controls. Follow the team’s secure coding guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Test Automation Engineers to define test strategy for your features during sprint planning. Ensure your implementations are testable and that acceptance criteria are met before handoff.
  • Identify and reduce technical debt in the areas you work in. Refactor legacy code when opportunities arise during feature delivery. Advocate for technical improvements during sprint planning.
  • Verify AI-generated code as rigorously as hand-written code; ensure unit tests meaningfully cover AI-produced implementations, where subtle logic errors and hallucinated APIs tend to hide.

DevOps & Deployment

  • Use Git (GitHub) for version control; branching, committing, creating pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. Follow the team’s branching strategy and PR workflows.
  • Deploy code and metadata using the team’s CI/CD pipeline (AutoRabit, DevOps Center, Salesforce CLI). Troubleshoot deployment failures and resolve metadata conflicts.
  • Manage sandbox environments for development and testing. Maintain environment hygiene and coordinate with TAEs on test data and environment needs.
  • Support release activities; pre-deployment validation, smoke testing, and post-deployment verification. Participate in release planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Participate actively in Agile Scrum ceremonies; sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects to understand solution designs and ask clarifying questions before implementation begins. Raise concerns about feasibility, complexity, or alternative approaches early.
  • Work under the technical direction of the Technical Architect; following established patterns, participating in design discussions, and seeking guidance on complex implementation decisions.
  • Collaborate with Test Automation Engineers throughout the sprint; not just at handoff. Share early builds, discuss test scenarios, and work together to ensure features are delivered with quality.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and risks proactively. Escalate technical challenges early rather than struggling in isolation.
  • Support production issues; troubleshoot, diagnose, and fix defects in production. Participate in incident response and post-incident reviews. Learn from production issues to improve future implementations.

Growth & Continuous Learning

  • Invest in continuous learning; new Salesforce platform features, Agentforce capabilities, Data Cloud, and evolving development practices. Use Trailhead, documentation, and self-directed learning to stay current.
  • Leverage AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Agentforce Vibes, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar) to accelerate development. Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and adherence to team standards.
  • Share knowledge with the team; through documentation, brown bags, code review discussions, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
  • Pursue relevant Salesforce certifications to deepen platform expertise and validate skills.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 8+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, LWC, Flows, and/or platform configuration).
  • Experience writing Apex code; classes, triggers, unit tests, and SOQL/SOSL queries. Understanding of governor limits and bulkification patterns.
  • Experience building Lightning Web Components or equivalent modern JavaScript-based UI components.
  • Experience with Salesforce declarative automation; Flows, validation rules, and platform configuration.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for Salesforce deployments.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum delivery models.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (REST APIs, Platform Events) is preferred.
  • Experience with ServiceMax, Conga CPQ/CLM, Data Cloud, or Agentforce is a plus.
  • Experience with regulated environments (HIPAA, FDA, SOX) is preferred.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Foundation & Platform - Salesforce Administrator

Platform App Builder.

  • Certifications (Preferred): Development & Specialization - Platform Developer I,

Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud (Data 360) Consultant.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Technical

  • Proficiency in Apex development; object-oriented programming, trigger patterns, SOQL/SOSL queries, DML operations, governor limits, and bulkification.
  • Proficiency in Lightning Web Components; HTML, CSS, JavaScript, wire services, imperative Apex, event handling, and SLDS.
  • Understanding of Salesforce declarative automation; Flows (record-triggered, screen, autolaunched), validation rules, and the order of execution.
  • Understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS), and multi-tenant architecture constraints.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns; REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and named credentials.
  • Familiarity with DevOps tooling; Git/GitHub, AutoRabit or Salesforce CLI for deployments, and CI/CD pipeline concepts.
  • Awareness of Agentforce and Data Cloud (Data 360) concepts; willingness to learn and implement these evolving platform capabilities.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices; CRUD/FLS checks, SOQL injection prevention, and XSS/CSRF protection.
  • Fluency with AI-augmented engineering: agentic and spec-driven workflows, context and prompt engineering (rules files, Salesforce DX MCP, grounding), and critical verification of AI-generated code, using assistants such as Cursor, Agentforce Vibes, Claude, or ChatGPT Enterprise.

Professional

  • Builder mindset; takes pride in writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code. Cares about craft, not just getting it done.
  • Collaborative; works effectively with SAs, TAs, TAEs, POs, and fellow engineers. Treats quality as a shared responsibility. Assumes positive intent.
  • Communicative; articulates progress, blockers, and technical tradeoffs clearly. Asks questions rather than making assumptions. Documents work for the team’s benefit.
  • Growth-oriented; invests in learning new platform capabilities, accepts feedback constructively, and actively seeks to improve. Uses AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining critical evaluation.
  • Accountable; delivers on commitments. Takes ownership of their work quality. Transparent about challenges and timelines.
  • Detail-oriented; thorough in implementation and testing. Considers edge cases, error handling, and downstream impacts.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent related work experience.

jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

As a UI/UX Researcher & Designer at Intelerad, you will play a meaningful role in shaping how clinicians and healthcare professionals interact with our medical imaging products. You will independently own research and design for one or more product areas, partnering with product managers, developers, and end users to turn complex clinical needs and business goals into intuitive, high-quality experiences, from early discovery through to successful release. You will bring a balanced skillset, grounding design decisions in rigorous user research, translating insight into compelling, usable interfaces, and helping raise the quality of UX practice across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Research

  • Independently plan and lead qualitative and quantitative UX research across the product lifecycle, using field studies, direct observation, interviews, workflow and task analysis, usability testing, and surveys to identify opportunities, validate assumptions, and shape product direction.

  • Set research priorities and methodologies for your product area in partnership with product management; recruit participants and moderate sessions with clinicians and other end users.

  • Synthesize research data into personas, journey maps, and actionable insights, and translate findings into design and product recommendations that influence roadmap decisions.

  • Own and evolve our research repository so findings stay discoverable and continue to inform current and future work.

Design

  • Lead the design of intuitive interfaces from concept to release, grounded in a strong understanding of user goals, clinical workflows, and product requirements, delivering screen layouts, interaction patterns, and UI elements that meet usability and business standards.

  • Own design work end-to-end: produce wireframes, storyboards, functional prototypes, and detailed specifications that clearly communicate intent to developers, QA, and technical writers.

  • Drive the creation and adoption of design standards that ensure consistency across the product suite, and guide developers through UI design decisions and trade-offs during implementation.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Build trust with users through deep empathy, active listening, and strong facilitation, enabling a thorough understanding of their goals, workflows, and challenges.

  • Present design and research findings clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to product leadership, and lead design and research critique sessions to ensure alignment and quality.

  • Mentor and provide feedback to less experienced designers and researchers, sharing methods and best practices across the team.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), User Experience (UX) Design, Interaction Design, Human Factors / Ergonomics, Psychology, Graphic Design, or equivalent experience.

  • Proficiency in industry-standard design tools, including Figma and/or Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, or equivalent).

  • Strong knowledge of HCI principles and design best practices.

  • Proven ability to communicate design rationale and research findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience prototyping with HTML and CSS or similar front-end tools.

  • Experience in healthcare IT or complex enterprise software; experience conducting research with clinical or healthcare users.

About the Team

Reddit's Ads ML Efficiency team is focused on making machine learning workloads faster, more scalable, and more cost-efficient, enabling our Ads ML teams to develop, launch, and scale increasingly sophisticated models.

This role sits at the intersection of ML workloads, execution systems, and engineering leverage. The engineer will partner closely with ranking teams, serving owners, and ML Platform to identify important bottlenecks, implement targeted improvements, and connect execution and systems improvements to measurable end-to-end outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end performance optimization initiatives for high-impact production ML workloads, from bottleneck identification and implementation through validation and production rollout.
  • Profile and diagnose ML performance bottlenecks across model execution, frameworks, runtimes, memory, CPU/GPU utilization, and infrastructure using rigorous benchmarking and measurement.
  • Design and implement performance improvements involving inference execution, runtime behavior, batching, memory management, precision, compiler integration, custom operators, kernels, or other relevant techniques.
  • Improve ML training and serving efficiency and scalability, optimizing latency, throughput, hardware utilization, and cost while maintaining model quality and production reliability.
  • Support faster and safer model launches through performance benchmarking, load testing, regression detection, and launch-readiness improvements.
  • Partner with model engineers and platform teams to identify high-leverage opportunities, integrate optimizations safely, and validate measurable end-to-end impact.
  • Build reusable performance capabilities, including benchmarks, tooling, optimization patterns, and engineering guidance that accelerate future model development and deployment.
  • Contribute to technical direction and mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration, code reviews, performance debugging, and knowledge sharing.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on ML performance engineering experience: Demonstrated ability to diagnose and implement meaningful performance improvements in production or production-relevant ML workloads.
  • Deep expertise in at least one ML performance area, such as inference execution, ML runtimes, compiler integration, GPU/kernel optimization, memory systems, or training execution.
  • Strong profiling and benchmarking skills: Ability to identify bottlenecks systematically, establish reliable baselines, and validate measurable end-to-end improvements.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: Experience implementing, debugging, testing, and maintaining performance-sensitive systems, with proficiency in Python and relevant systems programming technologies.
  • ML systems understanding: Familiarity with production ML frameworks and the performance trade-offs across model execution, runtime, memory, hardware, and infrastructure.
  • Production engineering judgment: Ability to balance performance improvements with numerical correctness, model quality, reliability, maintainability, and safe rollout.
  • Good customer and platform instincts: can solve concrete bottlenecks while keeping maintainability, adoption, and future reuse in mind.
  • Strong communication: able to explain tradeoffs clearly to engineers and partner teams.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience optimizing large-scale inference or training workloads, particularly in recommendation systems, ranking, search, or retrieval.
  • Experience with PyTorch, including performance optimization using technologies such as Dynamo, Inductor, AOTI, torch.export, or custom operators.
  • Experience with inference runtimes, GPU execution, or performance technologies such as TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, CUDA, Triton, LLVM/MLIR, or equivalent systems.
  • Experience with hardware-aware optimization, including batching, memory management, operator fusion, mixed precision, quantization, or accelerator efficiency.
  • Experience with distributed-training performance, including GPU utilization, communication, data loading, memory efficiency, or training step-time optimization.
  • Experience building performance benchmarks, profiling tools, regression detection, launch-readiness capabilities, or cost observability toolings for ML workloads.
  • Experience working across ML modeling, serving, and platform infrastructure teams.

Specialized compiler internals or custom CUDA/Triton kernel development are valuable but not required. We value demonstrated performance engineering depth, sound technical judgment, and measurable workload impact over familiarity with any particular tool or framework.
