Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

About Grafana Labs:

There are more than 700,000 active installations of Grafana around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a SpaceX launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps companies including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay manage their observability strategies with full-stack offerings that can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud, or self-managed with Grafana Enterprise Stack. The Grafana stack has grown to include more open-source projects, including Grafana Loki (for logs) and Grafana Tempo (for traces) and Grafana Mimir (for metrics).

Description of Duties

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Writer to create documentation and learning content that helps people adopt and master Grafana’s observability products. You’ll work with engineers, product managers, and the Grafana writing team to produce content for a range of products and audiences, from first-time users to experienced practitioners. Because our products and priorities evolve, we’re looking for someone who learns new technical domains quickly.

AI is part of how this team works. We use AI-assisted workflows and tools throughout the content lifecycle, from research and drafting to review, validation, and maintenance. You’ll use these tools every day and help the team get better at using them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, research, write, and maintain documentation and learning content (concepts, tasks, tutorials, references, and in-product learning) that supports adoption and long-term product mastery.
  • Use AI tools and workflows to work faster and at a higher quality: drafting, structuring, technical validation, consistency checks, and keeping content current. You apply human judgment to everything AI produces and take responsibility for its accuracy.
  • Contribute to the team’s shared AI workflows and skills, and look for ways to improve and automate how we create and maintain content as tools and models evolve.
  • Partner with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, interview subject matter experts, and turn complex technical detail into clear, accurate content.
  • Test what you document. Run the software, follow your own procedures, and flag product and UX gaps you find along the way.
  • Let data guide your priorities. We have strong docs and learning analytics. You’ll use them, along with user feedback, to find content gaps, prioritize your work, and show the impact of what you ship.
  • Work with the documentation manager and other writers to improve information architecture, voice, and consistency across our docs, and to make information easy to find for both people and AI-driven search and assistants.
  • Manage several projects at once, using judgment to prioritize and communicate clearly when the plan changes.
  • Mentor teammates and share practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

Requirements

What experience would make someone be successful in this role?

  • Experience writing or documenting enterprise or developer-facing software, with a portfolio or writing samples that show technical depth.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and models in your writing workflow (such as LLM assistants, agentic coding tools, or custom prompts and skills), and the ability to explain how you evaluate and verify their output.
  • Experience working with docs-as-code: command-line Git, GitHub (pull requests and reviews), Markdown, and common IDEs.
  • Comfort working in technical environments. You can set up, run, and troubleshoot software yourself to verify what you write (for example, command line, containers, or Kubernetes, or a willingness to learn quickly).
  • Experience collaborating with engineers and product managers to get accurate technical information.
  • Experience working remotely and asynchronously on a distributed team.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Curiosity about AI as a craft. You treat AI workflows as a professional skill. You experiment, share what works, and know where AI helps and where it doesn’t.
  • Technical credibility. You care about accuracy, you learn new technical domains quickly, and you ask questions until you understand them.
  • Strong judgment and editing skills. You can tell good content from plausible-sounding content, and you hold the line on quality.
  • Ownership. You manage multiple projects and work well both independently and collaboratively.
  • Clarity. You write concisely and plainly for readers of all experience levels.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

About the Role

The CEO of doit Holdings will build and own our regulated investment platform in Malaysia, and will serve as the Securities Commission's named Responsible Person for it. doit Holdings is applying to the SC for registration as a Recognized Market Operator running an e-Services Platform, through which users will invest in listed securities and unit trusts offered by licensed partners. The role covers the registration itself, building the operating company behind it, and running the business once it is live.

What you will be doing

  • Own the registration end to end, from pre-application consultation with the SC through submission, conditional approval and launch.

  • Act as the Responsible Person, the SC's named contact for the platform, and sign the system and operational readiness declaration before the platform may operate.

  • Build the operating company across technology, security, compliance and operations.

  • Own the partner relationships with the licensed intermediaries and fund managers whose products the platform carries, including the written allocation of anti-money laundering monitoring responsibility.

  • Own P&L, customer growth, revenue, unit economics and operating performance.

  • Run the platform so that it operates in an orderly, fair and transparent manner, with fair and transparent fees and an applied rulebook.

  • Keep the board properly informed and support it in discharging its oversight duties.

What you will need

  • Strong experience building or running a regulated financial services or fintech business, with at least 10 years of professional experience.

  • At least 5 years in financial services, capital markets or regulated financial technology, and at least 3 at senior management level with functional or P&L ownership.

  • At least 3 years of direct exposure to capital market intermediation, distribution or market operation.

  • Prior direct dealings with a financial regulator in a named or accountable capacity.

  • A degree or professional qualification from an institution recognised by the government of Malaysia, and able to meet the SC's fit and proper criteria.

  • Available full-time. The Responsible Person must be appointed on a full-time basis and cannot hold another executive role.

  • Experience of unit trust distribution or online broking in Malaysia, or of launching under a regulator's conditional approval, is useful.

  • Hands-on operating style. Able to read the guidelines, review the onboarding flow and drive the regulatory and commercial work personally.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Introductory conversation

2. Deep-dive interview on the regulatory and commercial plan

3. Group leadership / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. We build and operate systems that support Grafana’s business operations and customer experience, working closely with product teams and internal business partners.

The Usage squad works on billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and cloud marketplace integrations. Our software helps customers understand their consumption and costs, and helps internal teams operate accurate, reliable billing processes.

We are looking for a Staff Fullstack Engineer with strong backend experience who enjoys making complex business systems reliable, understandable and easier to operate. You will help deliver new capabilities while improving existing services, reducing repetitive manual work and addressing edge cases that affect customers and internal stakeholders.

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role within the AppCore Usage squad. You will lead complex technical work, contribute directly to implementation and share ownership with the squad’s other Staff and Senior engineers. Your primary focus will be Usage’s systems and outcomes, collaborating with adjacent teams when the work requires it.

Our ownership includes application code, data stores, deployment configuration and the cloud infrastructure supporting our services. You should be comfortable following a problem across those boundaries and making improvements with the appropriate platform teams.

We are remote-first and global. For this role, we prefer candidates in NASA’s Eastern Time zone to provide more overlap with our EMEA colleagues.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your initial focus will be approximately 75% backend and 25% frontend. This balance will evolve with the squad’s priorities. You should be comfortable delivering across the stack, from business logic and APIs through to the interfaces customers and internal teams use.

  • Design, build and operate backend services and APIs supporting billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and marketplace workflows.
  • Build and maintain backend services primarily in Go, with Node.js also present in our stack, and contribute to TypeScript/React applications to deliver complete features.
  • Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery.
  • Identify recurring manual tasks and replace them with maintainable automation, clear operational workflows and appropriate controls.
  • Maintain and evolve the infrastructure supporting our services, including Kubernetes workloads, scheduled jobs, cloud resources and deployment configuration.
  • Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe across environments.
  • Investigate production issues across application code, databases and infrastructure, including resource exhaustion, failed jobs, slow queries and replication delays.
  • Plan and execute service deployments, database changes and infrastructure migrations, including validation, monitoring and recovery plans.
  • Build and maintain integrations with cloud marketplaces and external business systems where required by the squad’s work.
  • Deliver projects from understanding requirements and proposing an approach through implementation, testing, rollout and production support.
  • Make changes traceable and testable, supporting audit requirements and clear explanations of system behaviour.
  • Collaborate with product management, Support, DealOps, GTM, infrastructure teams and adjacent AppCore squads to clarify requirements and resolve dependencies.
  • Share technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring and practical improvements.
  • Participate in the squad’s on-call rotation after onboarding. Improve dashboards, alert quality, runbooks and recovery procedures, and follow through on incident findings.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You enjoy engineering work where correctness, reliability and business impact matter. You find value in improving an established system, removing a recurring operational problem or making a billing workflow easier to understand and support.

You take ownership from understanding the problem through delivery and production support. You can turn an ambiguous request into manageable increments, make sound trade-offs and follow through without needing each step prescribed. You ask useful questions, seek feedback and raise uncertainty or blockers early.

You adapt as priorities change, learn unfamiliar systems and technologies, and contribute where the squad needs you. You bring a strong backend specialty while remaining willing and able to work on frontend features and supporting infrastructure.

You reason about how a service behaves in production: how it is deployed, where its data lives, what happens when dependencies fail, and how the team detects and recovers from problems.

You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. In a distributed team, you make decisions, progress and risks visible so colleagues can contribute across time zones. You work independently while staying connected to the squad.

As a Staff engineer, you bring technical depth and sound judgment while remaining close to implementation. You collaborate constructively with other experienced engineers, welcome different perspectives and help the squad reach decisions and move forward.

We embrace thoughtful use of AI-assisted development. We value engineers who use these tools to support exploration, implementation, testing and documentation while taking responsibility for the quality and correctness of the result.

ABOUT XSOLLA

Xsolla is a global video game commerce company headquartered in Los Angeles. It helps developers from indie to AAA fund, distribute, market and monetize their games, and acts as merchant of record for 1,500+ developers worldwide. For more information, visit .

Required

    Experience

    • 5+ years of commercial software development, with senior-level production experience across backend and frontend

    • dApps that you shipped to production and maintained

      • Web3 libraries and wallets

      • viem and wagmi in production: clients and transports, contract reads and writes with typed ABIs, event subscriptions, wagmi hooks and connectors, caching and invalidation of on-chain state

      • How wallet signers work: EOAs, browser and embedded wallets, smart accounts; personal_sign (EIP-191) and typed data (EIP-712); the EIP-1193 provider; network switching

      • Hands-on experience with smart wallets: UserOperations, gas sponsored via paymasters, signature validation for contract accounts (ERC-1271)

        • Backend

        • Go and TypeScript (Node.js) for production services

        • Processing on-chain events: idempotency, reorg handling, retries

        • Asynchronous messaging and event-driven design (Kafka, RabbitMQ or NATS): delivery guarantees, ordering, reprocessing

        • Relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching (Redis)

        • Designing REST and gRPC APIs: versioning, backward compatibility

          • Frontend

          • React and TypeScript: rendering model, state management, performance

          • Web security fundamentals: XSS, CSRF, CSP, safe handling of signatures and keys in the browser

            • Smart contracts

            • Reading and understanding Solidity contracts and the EVM (storage, gas, call semantics, proxy upgrade patterns, access control) well enough to integrate with them safely and review changes

            • Common contract vulnerability classes (reentrancy, front-running / MEV, oracle manipulation, signature replay) and how they affect the off-chain side

              • Operations

              • Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) at the level of deploying and debugging your own services

              • Observability (we use Datadog; experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / Graylog or OpenTelemetry also counts): metrics, logs, tracing and alerting for services and contracts; diagnosing incidents in production

                • Engineering practices

                • Testing: unit, integration, E2E

                • Git, CI/CD (GitLab CI or similar)

                  • AI-assisted engineering

                  • Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) for development and review, including configuring them for a repository

                    • English

                    • Spoken English at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

    • zkSync / ZK Stack and the specifics of the zk-rollup stack

    • Designing, writing and testing smart contracts in Solidity with Foundry; deploying and upgrading them safely

    • Building ERC-4337 infrastructure yourself (bundlers, paymasters); EIP-6963, EIP-5792

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Collections Specialist (m/f/d)

We are looking for a diligent a Collections & Debt Recovery Specialist to help us maximise collections returns by understanding the customer’s circumstances and ensuring that all actions achieve the best outcome for iwoca and our clients.

The role

We are seeking an experienced Collections Specialist who will be required to work within a fast-paced, customer focused environment, providing great customer service while maintaining the team’s excellent track record.

  • Case handling a high volume portfolio of customer accounts in arrears through to completion with varying and unique circumstances

  • Handling inbound and initiating outbound telephone calls, letters and emails with the greatest level of care, accuracy and customer service skills

  • Building relationships with customers through regular contact to validate, understand and resolve breaches of agreements with customers

  • Negotiate, implement and monitor feasible repayment solutions that take into account the customer's circumstances while balancing the best interests of the business

  • Work with a wide range of teams within the company to understand, strategise and implement the most appropriate course of action for each account

  • Working closely with Collections Management and the Head of Collections to review and develop recovery strategies

  • Instructing, liaising and monitoring third parties such as debt collection agencies and Paralegals to ensure the best outcome is achieved

  • Ensuring compliance with all appropriate legislation regulatory body guidelines

  • Adhering to our company policies and procedures

  • Upholding iwoca’s company reputation at all times

  • Updating databases and systems in order to keep an accurate record of activities, observations and outcomes within the recovery process

The requirements

Essential:

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

  • A level of German, C1 that allows you to feel comfortable talking to clients, negotiate arrangements and handle tense situations

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Ideally you'll have:

  • Nice to have 1 year debt recovery experience, ideally in the commercial/business sector

  • Empathy, forbearance and professionalism

  • Strong communication skills, accuracy and confidence

  • The ability to deal with a variety of challenges, innovate and think on your feet

  • Business acumen, entrepreneurial spirit with real enthusiasm for helping SMEs. Experience within the finance industry is advantageous.

The salary

We expect to pay from 34.000 € — 46.000 € for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a brilliant place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset.

  • 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

  • One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

  • Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

  • iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

  • Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

  • Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

  • A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts.

  • ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Associate - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle - translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Associate to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace, we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Location: UK, central Europe, and Latin America

As the platform rebuilds around LLM-driven capabilities, the successful candidate will be responsible for defining not just how features look, but how complex data and AI experiences should function. The primary focus is transforming dense, aggregated trend data into clear, intuitive, and actionable insights.

This position joins a close-knit Frontend & UX team reporting directly to the Frontend Lead. The role is 100% remote and open to candidates based between US Central Time (UTC−6) and Central European Time (UTC+1). Candidates must be available during core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (2:00 PM–5:00 PM UK / 3:00 PM–6:00 PM CET).

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Product Design: Own features from initial framing to final launch, partnering closely with engineering leadership to deliver written proposals, user flows, prototypes, and Figma specifications.
  • Problem Identification & Solution Design: Independently identify user pain points through customer calls, interviews, user feedback, and usage data to build compelling product proposals.
  • AI & LLM Experience Design: Define user interactions for AI features (chat, automated reports, inline summaries), establish standards for insight attribution and uncertainty handling, and help refine the voice and structure of AI-generated content.
  • Design System Management: Own the principles and Figma library for the design system, partnering with frontend engineers to align with the React component library and establish robust data visualization and AI UX patterns.
  • UX Quality & Feedback Loops: Co-own product metrics, user feedback tracking, and quality evaluation rubrics for LLM outputs alongside the Frontend Lead.

Note: This position focuses strictly on product/UI/UX design. It does not involve writing production code, managing brand/marketing assets, or overseeing back-end API integrations.

Requirements

  • Qualifications
    • Experience: 3+ years of product design experience, ideally owning features end-to-end within a B2B or SaaS platform.
    • Product Thinking: Strong strategic perspective with a proven ability to define what to build and why, backed by a portfolio demonstrating strong problem-framing abilities.
    • Domain Focus: Experience designing data-heavy products, such as dashboards, analytics platforms, or reporting tools.
    • Design Systems: Proven track record of working within and contributing to scalable design component libraries.
    • Tools & AI Integration: High proficiency in Figma, with active integration of AI tools into day-to-day design workflows and a strong curiosity regarding LLM product experiences.
    • Communication: Excellent written English skills, capable of producing clear proposals and documentation in an asynchronous remote environment.
    • Schedule: Location within UTC−6 to UTC+1, with full availability during core collaboration hours (9:00 AM–12:00 PM EST).
  • Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
    • Experience as the founding or primary designer on a product team.
    • Hands-on experience building or evolving design systems adopted by engineering teams.
    • Direct experience designing AI features or creating evaluation rubrics for LLM output quality.
    • Expertise in advanced data visualization patterns.
    • Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food & beverage, or marketing intelligence platforms.
    • Capability to build rapid functional prototypes using AI-assisted tools to evaluate live outputs.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package tailored to experience.
  • Collaborative, high-impact environment with direct influence on core product direction.
  • Opportunity to work closely alongside senior design leadership.
  • Flexible starting timeline (target start date in January, with early onboarding available).

﻿

Interview Process

  1. Initial Video Screening: A brief introductory video conversation to discuss background, expectations, and role fit.
  2. Personality Assessment: An online assessment to evaluate working style and team dynamics.
  3. Design Leadership Interview: A 30-minute introductory chat with the Lead Designer.
  4. Screen-Recorded Case Study: A flexible, practical exercise (details currently being finalized) to demonstrate hands-on design methodology and execution.
  5. Final Interview: A concluding conversation with key stakeholders to review results and align on next steps.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The two markets sit at different stages of maturity, and the role spans both. In one, you'll be establishing foundations — infrastructure, modelling standards, and a roadmap to bring capability up to the level of our other markets. In the other, you'll be supporting a more mature practice as it advances model architecture and builds a more integrated approach to credit decisioning and portfolio valuation.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Own the data science strategy and roadmap for Mexico and Brazil — what we build, in what order, and to what standard.

  • Remain hands-on, building and shipping models alongside the team.

  • Establish modelling standards, infrastructure, and delivery practices where they don't yet exist, and raise the bar where they do.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data scientists across two markets and a wide range of experience levels.

  • Partner with credit leadership as a peer — understanding business objectives and translating them into modelling, impact measurement, valuation input, and P&L analysis.

  • Bring structure and discipline to how the work runs: clear priorities, visible progress, and reliable delivery.

  • Contribute to methodologies that can be adopted across the wider Tilt data science organisation.

Why You're a Great Fit

  • You've led a team of Data Scientists before, ideally across different regions.

  • You're still a builder. You've stayed close to the modelling work and want to keep it that way.

  • Strong applied machine learning and modelling craft, with a clear view of what good looks like and the ability to raise a team to meet it.

  • Sufficient understanding of credit and underwriting to contribute meaningfully to credit conversations. Direct experience in lending, credit, or payments is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace, with a track record in high-growth or small-company environments.

  • A strong bias toward delivery, and the judgement to know when to stop exploring and start shipping.

  • You connect data science to measurable business outcomes and communicate technical ideas clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Location & Language

Based in Brazil, Mexico, or the US. Fluent English required. Portuguese is an advantage; Spanish is welcome.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.excerpt: About WonderlyWonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue.
jobs.description:
About Wonderly

Wonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue. We serve the home service industry ($1.3T), and can consistently double a new customer’s revenue within 90 days. We make all of our AI and software completely free - and only get paid when our customers make real money. We’re here helping real small businesses make a life, pay for their children’s college tuition, and live the American dream.

Pre-AI SaaS sold tools. AI companies claim they sell outcomes - task done, call answered, lead booked, ticket resolved - but calls or leads aren’t the outcomes that ultimately matter. Revenue is what ultimately matters, and today, none of the AI companies actually promise revenue. Wonderly changes that.

Our 70-person team (mostly in PDE) spent over a year building in stealth; our thesis is that - if you actually want to control the end result (revenue) of a business and deploy AI fast/cheaply, you can’t just build the sexy part (agents), you must also build the unsexy parts and own everything end to end: the system of record layer and the application layer. We built from scratch every software a home service business needs - replacing ServiceTitan, Squarespace, Ringcentral, Jobber, Square, Hubspot, and a dozen others applications. And we built every agent necessary - AI marketing, AI receptionist, AI voice, AI sales outreach, AI sales coaching, AI follow-ups, AI 3D design, AI finance, AI quoting, AI collections, and more - all embedded inside our own system with native data access. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready Agents to our customers in under 24 hours with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

We are the most outcome driven business model in the business because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents actually work in driving the end result - revenue. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve our customers’ revenue by 5-20%.

Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months to build (we are at least 2 years ahead of anyone else in the space). We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $1.3T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion), and all that money gets pumped into Wonderly.

About the Hiring Manager

Hey, I’m Victoria. I lead Sales Operations here at Wonderly.

I’ve built phone teams at four different companies now, and the thing I’ve learned is that the resume tells you almost nothing. What actually predicts it: if you’re quick, if you take feedback without getting weird about it, and if you care whether the lead actually gets handled right.

I’m hiring people who already know home services and are hungry to get on the phone and win. People I can put in front of a lead and trust to qualify them, book the meeting, and never let one slip through the cracks.

The Role

We’re looking for experienced home improvement callers. You call homeowner leads, qualify them, book in-home appointments, and work the ones that didn’t sell, every day.

We generate leads for home services contractors and only make money when those leads turn into closed jobs. Our calling team is the step in between: we call the lead, qualify it, and book the onsite so the contractor just has to show up and close.

Day to day:

  • Calling new leads fast and qualifying them

  • Booking in-home appointments on our contractors’ calendars

  • Working unsold and cancelled appointments to get them back on the calendar

  • Logging every call and outcome so nothing slips

What Makes This Role Different

At most companies, you book appointments for one sales team, and the playbook is set.

Here, you’d book for hundreds of contractors, and if you see a better way to call, qualify, or follow up, you say it Monday and we’re testing it Wednesday. You’d be one of the first experienced callers on a team that’s still being built, and the people who prove it first are the ones who lead it as it grows.

Backgrounds That Tend to Work

People from these backgrounds tend to thrive:

  • Inside sales reps and appointment setters in remodeling or home services

  • Customer service reps or schedulers at HVAC, plumbing, or roofing companies who book jobs over the phone

  • Lead coordinators or intake specialists who qualify and route incoming homeowner leads

Backgrounds we care less about:

  • Call center agents with no home services experience

  • B2B or SaaS SDRs who have never talked to homeowners

  • Callers at lead-gen agencies who passed leads along but never booked the appointment

What matters more than the resume:

  • You know remodeling and home services well enough to talk to homeowners about their project

  • You’ve booked homeowner appointments at real volume

  • You can get a homeowner from “just looking” to a booked appointment without being pushy

  • You follow up until it’s a yes or a clear no

  • You keep clean notes so the next person knows exactly where the lead stands

  • You care whether your appointments actually show up and close, not just how many you book

  • You treat every lead like it’s yours. If one slips, you own it.

  • You move fast, because you know a lead goes cold in minutes

  • A bad call doesn’t throw off the next one

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and fast changes

Expectations

  • 60–70 hour weeks

  • Coverage that matches when leads come in, including some weekends

  • Real ownership of your calls and bookings within your first 2 weeks

  • The process changes fast. What we tell you Monday might be rewritten by Thursday because the numbers told us to.

Compensation

$70,000–$120,000 (base + on-target earnings)

Equity in Wonderly

Remote (US & Canada)

Wonderly is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and given equal opportunities. We do not discriminate based on gender identity, race, ancestry, disability, religion, sexual orientation, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We welcome and encourage all qualified candidates to apply for our job openings.

jobs.description:
CEO Advisor | Proven CEO Experience Required | $182K+ OTE | Remote

How To MANAGE a Small Law Firm (HTM)

You've built it, fixed it, and owned every number. Now do it again — inside the businesses that need you most.

Compensation: $110,000 base + uncapped performance compensation, with $182,000+ in total earnings potential.

Location: 100% remote. Candidates must reside in AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, PA, TX, VA, or WA. Due to state registration requirements, we can only employ candidates in these states.

The Opportunity

This isn't a board seat or a role where you hand over a strategy deck and walk away. You'll work directly with small law firm owners, typically running businesses with $1M–$5M in annual revenue, helping them improve profitability, strengthen operations, solve problems, and grow.

We're looking for someone who has actually run a business as its CEO, made the tough decisions, owned the P&L, and been accountable for the results. You'll use that experience to help business owners identify what's holding them back, implement practical solutions, and follow through until the numbers improve.

If you've led a company through significant growth and know what it takes to build a stronger business, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Drive growth and execution: Help owners turn opportunities into actionable plans and measurable results.
  • Diagnose and solve problems: Identify revenue opportunities, profitability issues, and operational inefficiencies.
  • Improve financial performance: Help owners make better decisions about pricing, margins, cash flow, expenses, and hiring.
  • Create accountability: Establish priorities, challenge assumptions, and hold owners accountable for executing their plans.
  • Build stronger businesses: Implement the systems and processes needed for sustainable growth and profitability.

What You Must Bring

  • Actual CEO experience: At least eight years of hands-on business operating experience, including experience serving as the actual CEO of a company with full P&L responsibility.
  • A proven scaling track record: You've personally led a business from approximately $500K to $10M+ in annual revenue.
  • Company-wide accountability: You've been responsible for the overall financial and operational performance of a business, not just a department or function.
  • Owner-facing leadership: You're comfortable working directly with business owners, challenging their assumptions, coaching them through difficult decisions, and holding them accountable.
  • A hands-on mindset: You don't just recommend solutions. You help implement them and stay accountable for results.
  • Strong business instincts: You can identify root causes, understand financial drivers, and translate complex issues into practical action plans.

Important: You do not need to have owned the company you scaled. However, you must have served as its actual operating CEO and personally led its growth. Experience as a consultant, coach, advisor, fractional executive, or department leader does not substitute for this requirement.

Be prepared to identify the company, its annual revenue when you took over and when you left, your P&L responsibilities, and the decisions you personally made to drive growth. We are looking for actual annual company revenue, not pipeline, valuation, capital raised, or revenue you influenced while advising another business.

This Role Is Not for You If…

  • You've never served as the actual CEO of a business you've personally led through significant growth.
  • Your experience is primarily consulting, coaching, advising, or fractional executive work.
  • You've managed a department but haven't been accountable for the overall business P&L.
  • Your accomplishments are primarily sales quotas, pipeline, or ARR rather than company-wide operating results.
  • You prefer strategy without hands-on execution.
  • You're looking for a side gig. This is a full-time commitment.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $110,000 base salary
  • $182,000+ total earnings potential with uncapped, performance-based compensation.
  • Full-time W-2 employment.
  • 100% remote within the eligible states listed above.
  • Benefits package and unlimited PTO.

HTM provides client acquisition and business development support so you can focus on advising clients and driving results.

Why HTM?

How To MANAGE a Small Law Firm helps attorneys build stronger businesses behind their legal practices. Many law firm owners are excellent attorneys but need help with the business side — from profitability and cash flow to hiring, operations, and growth.

As a CEO Advisor, you'll bring your real-world operating experience to owners who need it, helping them make better decisions and build more profitable businesses.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Apply with your resume and make your operating track record clear. Tell us which company you led, its annual revenue when you took over and when you left, and the decisions you made to drive growth.

We're looking for someone who has actually run a business — and can help other business owners do the same.

Salary: $110,000 – $182,000 / year

About Pave Bank:

Pave Bank is the world’s first programmable business bank. Built by the founders behind Monzo and BigPay, we are redefining global business banking by integrating programmable financial infrastructure with world-class client experiences.

About the Role:

As a Senior Trader at Pave Bank, you'll play a key role in executing multi-asset trading strategies and managing the bank's FX and digital asset exposures, liquidity, and treasury operations across global markets. Working across G20 and emerging-market FX, fixed income, derivatives, and digital assets/stablecoins, you'll help optimise trade execution, manage risk, and strengthen the bank's network of liquidity providers and OTC counterparties.

Beyond day-to-day trading, you'll have the opportunity to build and improve trading and treasury workflows, leveraging AI tools and automation to enhance efficiency, market analysis, and decision-making. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong financial market expertise with a proactive, technology-driven mindset and thrives at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets.

Key Responsibilities

High-Impact Execution

  • Execute multi-asset trades across FX, digital assets, and fixed income across global corridors with high precision, speed, and strict risk discipline.

  • Build and manage the firm's OTC book, actively sourcing the next high-value trading opportunities for the desk.

  • Devise and implement execution strategies for the desk to maximise risk-adjusted returns.

Treasury & Risk Management

  • Manage real-time FX and digital asset exposures within defined limits, running smart hedging and inventory positioning across 30+ currencies.

  • Own intraday and end-of-day treasury operations across banks, OTC desks, exchanges, and digital wallets — maximising capital efficiency and driving idle funds to capture yield.

Partner & Counterparty Strategy

  • Help manage and expand our network of liquidity providers and OTC counterparties.

  • Onboard partners, benchmark pricing performance, and eliminate single points of failure across active trading corridors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate directly with Operations, Compliance, Finance, and Commercial teams on settlement flows, transaction monitoring, and business development.

AI, Tooling & Process Innovation

  • Champion the use of AI tools and automation to streamline daily desk reporting, market analysis, and treasury forecasts, cutting out manual friction wherever it lives.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in FX, OTC execution, treasury, or liquidity management at a buy-side/sell-side institution, bank, broker, crypto firm, or fintech.

  • Platform Mastery: Advanced proficiency using industry-standard trading software and financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg Terminal).

  • Multi-Asset Knowledge: A solid grasp of global financial markets, including FX (G20 & EM), fixed income products, derivatives, and digital assets. Hands-on experience trading digital assets is a major plus.

  • AI Mindset: Active familiarity with AI tools and automation methods to optimise personal workflows, solve complex operational challenges, and scale desk capacity.

  • Technical & Quantitative Skills: Highly numerate with advanced Excel capabilities. Experience with SQL, Python, or building custom trading/treasury tools is a major bonus.

  • Decisive & Risk-Disciplined: Strong risk fundamentals with the confidence to make quick, well-calibrated decisions in live, fast-moving markets.

  • Communicator & Builder: Clear, confident communication style to lead partner discussions. A strong bias toward action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where execution speed is critical.

If you read through this description and don't check off every single box, but you have a strong foundation in market dynamics, a passion for digital assets, and a deep appetite to build — apply anyway. We care much more about your drive, your adaptability, and your capacity to learn than a 100% match on a checklist.

    • Patient access or patient experience.

    • Nursing or medical administration.

    • Pharmacy support.

JOB SUMMARY

    We are seeking an analytical, execution-oriented Finance Manager, Revenue Operations & FP&A to own the processes, systems, and analytics that make Point B’s revenue predictable and our performance visible. Roughly 70% of the role is Revenue Operations: pipeline governance, forecasting operations, Salesforce, and account-planning infrastructure. The remaining 30% is FP&A: annual planning, forecasting, cost planning, and variance analysis.

    Point B’s revenue is won through relationships, delivered by consultants on client assignments, and grown through long-term client partnerships. Revenue performance therefore depends on pipeline quality, how quickly sold work becomes staffed assignments, and consultant utilization, not subscription metrics. The successful candidate develops recommendations, executes agreed priorities, and partners closely with market and practice leaders, Business Development, Marketing, Finance, Accounting, Resource Management, and Delivery Operations to create one shared source of truth from opportunity to revenue.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Revenue Operations Responsibilities

    • Own Point B’s pipeline management process, cadence, and reporting, including recurring pipeline reviews with market, practice, and business development leadership.

    • Own the pipeline-based bookings and revenue forecast in partnership with the Business Apps team and Finance, translating open opportunities into expected bookings and revenue timing so leadership can see how pipeline converts into staffed work.

    • Coach sellers and practice leaders on pipeline hygiene, including stage, probability, close date, estimated start date, and engagement value, to improve forecast accuracy.

    • Monitor bookings, pipeline coverage against revenue targets, win rates, and conversion trends, and flag risks and opportunities to leadership.

    • Build and maintain Salesforce dashboards, reports, and account-level views that give sellers and leaders self-service visibility into client metrics such as YTD revenue, bookings, open pipeline, and active assignments.

    • Maintain alignment between Salesforce and downstream financial and resourcing data so that pipeline, bookings, and revenue reconcile.

    • Own the tools, process, reporting, and enablement for account planning and key-client management.

    • Streamline the opportunity-to-assignment lifecycle, including opportunity management, proposal development, SOWs and contracting, handoffs to staffing and delivery, and account expansion.

    • Maintain leadership KPIs and analytics on utilization, bill rates, margins, and client performance, combining Salesforce with financial and resourcing data.

    FP&A Responsibilities

    • Manage annual planning data, models, process, and deliverables, partnering with market and practice leaders and Resource Management on revenue, headcount, role-based utilization, and capacity assumptions and targets.

    • Incorporate the pipeline forecast into monthly and quarterly financial forecasts, compare them to actuals, explain variances, and recommend actions.

    • Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis on key drivers such as bookings, utilization, bill rates, and headcount to show leadership the range of potential outcomes.

    • Support G&A and operating cost budgeting, including aligning cost plans to revenue scenarios and tracking actions against plan.

    • Support pricing governance and business performance reviews.

    • Streamline recurring FP&A processes and work with IT and Business Apps to automate reporting where possible.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related field

    • 5-7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, FP&A, Business Unit Finance, or Consulting Operations, with hands-on exposure to both revenue operations and financial planning

    • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, including forecasting, scenario analysis, and variance analysis

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial and operational information simply to executives

    • Experience managing cross-functional initiatives and process improvements

    • A hands-on, detail-oriented approach that balances accuracy with urgency

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Experience with Salesforce CRM, including reports, dashboards, data governance, sales process design, and configuration; Salesforce Administrator certification a plus

    • Experience with Power BI, including data models, DAX, and report development; Tableau or other BI experience also considered

    • Experience in professional services, management consulting, technology consulting, or another project-based services organization, including working knowledge of utilization, bill rates, staffing-driven revenue, and professional services automation (PSA) or resource management systems
