jobs.description:
Remote | Canada | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $15–$35 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if the medical knowledge and clinical skills you're developing could help improve how artificial intelligence understands complex healthcare information, evaluates medical scenarios, and delivers more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting medical students, residents, and advanced healthcare trainees with opportunities to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

We're seeking individuals currently pursuing medical education or completing supervised clinical training in General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant pathways.

This opportunity is designed for candidates who can apply their academic knowledge, clinical training, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This is not a traditional clinical position. You will not provide direct patient care, diagnose actual patients, or make treatment decisions for real patients. Instead, you'll assess medical scenarios, evaluate clinical reasoning, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Previous AI experience is not required. We're looking for candidates with a strong foundation in medical knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in applying their education to emerging healthcare technology.

Areas of Medical Education & Clinical Training

We're seeking qualified students and trainees in the following five areas:

1. General Practice:

Medical students in their third or fourth year, medical interns, or residents pursuing a broad foundation in general medical practice.

Ideal candidates have education or clinical exposure in:

  • General patient assessment and clinical evaluation.
  • Recognition and management principles for common medical conditions.
  • Preventive medicine and general healthcare practices.
  • Medical history review and interpretation of clinical findings.
  • Fundamental diagnostic reasoning and evidence-based medical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or demonstrated interest in family medicine.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Primary care across different age groups and patient populations.
  • Evaluation of acute and chronic medical conditions.
  • Preventive care, wellness, and health screenings.
  • Differential diagnosis and general treatment planning principles.
  • Interpretation of medical histories, clinical findings, and evidence-based guidelines.

3. Internal Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or an interest in internal medicine.

Relevant knowledge and experience may include:

  • Adult medicine and management principles for common or complex conditions.
  • Interpretation of laboratory results and diagnostic findings.
  • Recognition of multisystem diseases and related complications.
  • Development and evaluation of differential diagnoses.
  • Evidence-based approaches to clinical assessment and medical management.

4. Nurse Practitioner (NP)

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Nurse Practitioner educational program, particularly those completing advanced coursework or supervised clinical training.

Ideal candidates have education or experience in:

  • Advanced health assessment and patient evaluation.
  • Pathophysiology, pharmacology, and clinical management principles.
  • Diagnostic reasoning and interpretation of medical findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment planning and healthcare practices.
  • Patient education, preventive care, and healthcare quality standards.

Candidates pursuing Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) or Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPCNP) pathways are especially encouraged to apply.

5. Physician Assistant (PA) / Physician Associate

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Physician Assistant or Physician Associate program, preferably in the clinical phase of training.

Relevant educational and clinical experience may include:

  • Patient assessment, medical history review, and physical examination.
  • Clinical rotations in primary care, internal medicine, or family medicine.
  • Differential diagnosis and interpretation of diagnostic findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment and patient management principles.
  • Medical documentation and evaluation of clinical scenarios.

What You'll Do

As a Medical AI Evaluator, you'll apply your medical education and clinical training to assess how accurately AI systems interpret healthcare information and reason through medical scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-Generated Medical Content: Review AI-generated healthcare information for factual accuracy, completeness, clinical relevance, and consistency with established medical knowledge and guidelines.
  • Assess Clinical Reasoning: Evaluate AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment-related explanations to determine whether conclusions are medically sound and supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Identify Medical Inaccuracies: Recognize factual errors, unsupported assumptions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns in AI-generated responses.
  • Conduct Medical Research and Verification: Validate information using credible sources, including peer-reviewed medical literature, clinical practice guidelines, and established healthcare resources.
  • Review Clinical Scenarios: Analyze hypothetical patient cases, symptoms, medical histories, laboratory findings, and diagnostic information to evaluate AI-generated interpretations.
  • Provide Evidence-Based Feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify inaccuracies, and recommend appropriate corrections supported by medical evidence and clinical standards.
  • Apply Evaluation Standards: Consistently follow project-specific scoring rubrics, annotation instructions, and quality assurance guidelines.
  • Complete Assigned Evaluations: Perform independent evaluation tasks using designated online platforms, including DataCompute, while meeting established deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Maintain Confidentiality and Professional Standards: Protect sensitive project information and comply with applicable privacy, ethical, and data security requirements.

Compensation & Project Structure

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on educational background, clinical training, relevant experience, geographic location, and assignment complexity.

Specialty & Experience Level

General Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Family Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Internal Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Nurse Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$20/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$28/hr

Physician Assistant

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$23/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$30/hr

Eligibility Requirements

  • Second-year medical students must be enrolled at a top medical school
  • Third-year students and above: open to all qualifying programs
  • Relevant specialty or study track required (see list above)

Final compensation is subject to client approval, project requirements, and geographic eligibility.

This is a freelance, task-based opportunity intended for individuals interested in applying their medical knowledge to AI evaluation projects while continuing their education or clinical training.

Assignments are distributed based on project needs and availability. Workloads may be irregular or intermittent, and specific hours or future assignments are not guaranteed.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Medical Education in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning skills gained through your coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training to contribute to advanced AI evaluation projects.

Help Improve Healthcare AI Accuracy

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more reliable and medically informed AI systems.

Explore Emerging Healthcare Technology

Gain exposure to AI evaluation, medical content assessment, and evidence-based research while expanding your experience beyond traditional clinical settings.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads based on project availability.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for candidates who can think critically, recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify errors, and explain their conclusions using credible medical evidence.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-Based Independent Contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States
  • Additional Markets Under Consideration: United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified applicants may be required to complete a medical knowledge or clinical reasoning assessment before selection.

Specific assignments, schedules, and workloads will be communicated as they become available.

Bring Your Medical Knowledge to the Future of AI

Whether you're completing medical school, advancing through residency, or pursuing Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant training, this is an opportunity to apply your developing clinical expertise to emerging healthcare technology.

At Volga Partners, we value candidates who demonstrate strong medical knowledge, thoughtful clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate complex information using evidence-based principles.

Join us in helping shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess the following qualifications:

  • Medical or Advanced Healthcare Education: Current enrollment in the third or fourth year of a recognized medical degree program, an eligible medical internship or residency, or an advanced NP or PA educational program with relevant clinical training.
  • Relevant Clinical Focus: Academic coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training related to General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner practice, or Physician Assistant practice.
  • Foundational Medical Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and clinical concepts relevant to their area of training.
  • Clinical Reasoning and Evaluation: Ability to assess medical scenarios, interpret clinical information, and distinguish evidence-based reasoning from inaccurate or unsupported conclusions.
  • Research and Evidence Verification: Ability to research medical literature, interpret clinical guidelines, and validate findings using authoritative healthcare resources.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
  • Written Communication: Excellent written English skills, with the ability to clearly explain clinical findings, document evaluations, and support conclusions with credible evidence.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort working with computers, web-based platforms, digital documentation, and online research tools.
  • Independent Work and Accountability: Ability to follow detailed instructions, complete assignments independently, and consistently meet established quality requirements.
  • Project-Based Availability: Willingness to participate in a remote, freelance engagement where assignments and schedules are determined by project needs.

Independent medical licensure and previous employment as a licensed physician, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant are not required for eligible student-level evaluation assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience or qualifications may strengthen a candidate's application:

  • Clinical rotations, clerkships, internships, or supervised training in general practice, family medicine, internal medicine, or primary care.
  • Enrollment in the clinical phase of an accredited or recognized medical, NP, or PA educational program.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical case studies, laboratory results, or diagnostic documentation.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based medicine, differential diagnosis, and established clinical practice guidelines.
  • Participation in medical research, literature reviews, clinical case presentations, or healthcare-related academic projects.
  • Exposure to healthcare quality assurance, medical documentation review, or clinical evaluation.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, or medical informatics.

Previous AI evaluation experience is beneficial but not required.

jobs.description:
Remote Litigation Paralegal to support a busy and growing litigation practice. This position will work closely with attorneys through all phases of litigation, including case management, discovery, motion practice, depositions, trial preparation, and court filings. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment while delivering exceptional client service.

Candidates must have significant experience supporting matters in Federal Court. Residence in Florida or Texas is preferred, but qualified remote candidates from other locations will be considered.

Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Assist attorneys with case strategy, motion practice, pleadings, and other litigation-related filings.
  • Utilize existing case files, legal databases, and research resources to gather and develop information relevant to pending matters.
  • Draft discovery requests and responses, including Requests for Production, Interrogatories, Requests for Admission, Notices for Discovery and Inspection, and related documents.
  • Maintain and organize electronic case files and litigation materials.
  • Track litigation deadlines, court dates, discovery schedules, and filing requirements.
  • Coordinate depositions, mediations, hearings, arbitrations, and trial logistics.
  • Review, summarize, and organize deposition transcripts and testimony.
  • Prepare and organize exhibits for motions, depositions, discovery responses, hearings, arbitrations, and trial.
  • Prepare trial, hearing, arbitration, and mediation binders and notebooks.
  • Assist with drafting pleadings, motions, proposed orders, evidentiary objections, continuance applications, and other litigation documents.
  • Prepare and electronically file documents in state and federal courts while ensuring compliance with applicable court rules, procedures, and deadlines.
  • Prepare timelines, case chronologies, demonstrative exhibits, and witness materials.
  • Draft routine legal correspondence.
  • Review outgoing document productions, including redacting, Bates labeling, and quality control review.
  • Prepare litigation hold notices, preservation letters, subpoenas, and document requests.
  • Conduct legal research using LexisNexis and other legal research platforms.
  • Conduct factual investigations, public records research, and social media research to support litigation matters.
  • Review, summarize, and analyze records and case-related documents in support of litigation matters.
  • Communicate with clients, experts, vendors, court personnel, and opposing counsel as directed.
  • Assist attorneys with trial, arbitration, and hearing preparation, including exhibit management, witness coordination, and preparation of trial notebooks.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Qualifications:

· Paralegal Certificate preferred.

  • Federal litigation experience is required.
  • Experience supporting attorneys through all phases of litigation, including discovery, motion practice, depositions, trial preparation, and electronic court filings.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and filing documents in Federal Court and familiarity with federal court rules and procedures.
  • Experience with legal case management systems, document management platforms, e-discovery tools, and legal research platforms such as LexisNexis.

· NEOS experience preferred.

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and litigation support technology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze legal documents and identify inconsistencies or issues requiring attorney review.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet competing deadlines in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism while providing outstanding client service.
  • Candidates located in Florida or Texas are preferred.

O’Hagan Meyer is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.excerpt: As a Senior QA Engineer at Somnio Software, you’ll make sure our products work well and also feel right for the people who use them.
jobs.description:
As a Senior QA Engineer at Somnio Software, you’ll make sure our products work well and also feel right for the people who use them. You’ll join a fast-moving product team on a complex platform with lots of workflows, and your main focus will be exploratory and user-centric testing rather than running test cases.

Your role will be dynamic and impactful. You’ll dig deep into the product, think like a user and an admin, and give the team clear, actionable insights that directly shape the product experience. This is not a test automation role. We’re looking for someone with critical thinking, depth and their own point of view.

We’re searching for #curious and #proactive minds to help us #continue building world-class digital experiences with innovative and modern technologies.

Requirements

  • Run deep exploratory testing: take an area and go all the way into it, covering edge cases, friction points and inconsistencies.

  • Learn complex workflows and business rules well enough to think like an end user and like an admin.

  • Flag issues even when something “technically works” but the experience falls short, and defend your view with evidence.

  • Decide what to test in a product that changes all the time, focusing on the highest-impact areas instead of trying to cover everything.

  • Deliver actionable findings that state the problem, the impact on users, the evidence and a recommended priority, putting quality ahead of the number of bugs.

  • Mix exploratory testing, continuous validation and light regression as the product evolves.

  • Work directly with the client: ask questions, share progress, ask for feedback and be open about doubts or risks.

Our Perfect Match:

  • Solid senior-level experience in QA, with a strong focus on exploratory and user-centric testing.

  • Strong product sense and the ability to understand complex workflows, business rules and user goals.

  • Depth, curiosity and attention to detail: you’re not satisfied with surface-level testing.

  • A proactive attitude, your own opinions and the confidence to voice them with stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to work on your own in complex, changing products with little guidance.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (B2+ / C1) and comfort talking directly with clients.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in startups or high-velocity product environments.

  • Background in UX or usability testing.

  • Experience working with admin-heavy or B2B SaaS platforms.

Engagement details:

  • Part-time: 20 hours/week

  • 3-month project, with the opportunity to become an ongoing engagement based on performance

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Location: Remote from Anywhere in LATAM

Our Commitment to You:Work from anywhere - From the mountains or the city, you choose your ideal space
Flex Time - Because we trust your talent, not the clock.

Role Description

As the Executive Business Partner to Dropbox’s Chief Business Officer, you’ll create leverage through exceptional executive administration, judgment, and follow-through. You’ll own the details that help him and his team operate at its best: a strategic calendar, seamless travel, useful meetings, clear preparation, accurate communications, and thoughtful coordination across the Chief Business Officer’s team and the broader Dropbox leadership system.

This is a high-impact executive administration role in a fast-moving and evolving business. You’ll work closely with the CBO, his Chief of Staff, the Office of the CBO team, other executive admins, Chiefs of Staff, business partners, and senior cross-functional leaders. You’ll often need to make decisions with incomplete information, surface risks early, and keep work moving without creating unnecessary noise or rework.

This is an exceptional administration role where you’ll bring judgment and a point of view, but your primary responsibility is to make the executive and the operating system work better through accurate, proactive, collaborative execution. You’ll first learn the existing system, build trust, and develop pattern recognition — then you’ll bring best practices and your expertise to help reshape systems and make them work even better.

If you’re highly organized, calm under pressure, direct in your communication, persistent about follow through, and energized by making complex executive work feel simple, then this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own a complex calendar as a strategic operating tool, balancing executive priorities, customer and revenue commitments, leadership forums, preparation time, focus time, travel, and personal commitments
  • Support meeting prep by ensuring the right attendees, context, agendas, pre-reads, links, decision points, and follow-up actions are in place
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel end-to-end, including itineraries, ground transportation, hotel and meeting logistics, time-zone planning, contingency plans, and preparation or recovery time
  • Partner with the CBO’s Chief of Staff to maintain shared visibility into priorities, risks, requests, decisions, and follow-ups
  • Collaborate with other executive admins, Chiefs of Staff, business partners, and cross-functional leaders to resolve scheduling and operating needs without creating parallel processes or confusion
  • Support communication by tracking drafts, deadlines, approvals, distribution lists, links, and follow-through, ensuring that important messages are accurate and do not stall
  • Plan and execute executive meetings, offsites, and leadership events with strong attention to detail and a crisp focus on attendee experience, budget, and contingency planning
  • Maintain accurate administrative systems, including expenses, contacts, recurring meeting structures, action-item tracking, and relevant executive reference materials
  • Surface risks early, make recommendations, and own issues through resolution rather than simply completing the first task requested

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience supporting a senior executive, preferably a C-level executive or equivalent leader in a complex, fast-moving organization
  • Expertise managing a highly complex executive calendar across multiple time zones, competing priorities, recurring leadership forums, customer commitments, and protected personal or focus time
  • Experience planning complex domestic and international travel, including contingency planning and coordination across multiple travelers, hosts, vendors, and time zones
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate directly, concisely, and appropriately with senior leaders and cross-functional partners
  • Experience working with and/or for a senior Chief of Staff in tight, trusted partnership on systems- and process-based approaches to make order out of competing priorities
  • Proven ability to prioritize independently, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and escalate risks early with a recommendation
  • Demonstrated track record of accurate, detail-oriented execution across scheduling, events, communications, expenses, and follow-through
  • Experience working as part of an admin community and collaborating across executive offices rather than operating as an isolated support partner
  • Comfort working in a high-change environment where priorities shift quickly and the person must continuously re-plan without losing important details
  • High competency with workplace systems, including Slack, Gmail, Concur, Navan, Google Docs(and of course Dropbox!), as well as AI tooling for efficiency through human-machine partnership
  • Ability to work primarily on Eastern Time, with flexibility for occasional EMEA and APJ commitments and executive travel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a Chief Business Officer, Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, or another executive responsible for a broad, customer-facing organization
  • Experience working in technology, SaaS, or another business with complex customer, revenue, and cross-functional operating rhythms
  • Experience supporting executive customer engagements, leadership offsites, board-related preparation, or S-team-level events
  • Experience using AI responsibly to improve administrative workflows while personally validating accuracy, privacy, judgment, and final outputs
  • Project or program management experience that complements, but does not replace, strong executive administration fundamentals

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.

jobs.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to support our CEO as a trusted partner and operational extension. This role is for a seasoned, self-directed professional who operates with sound judgment and executive presence, and who moves work forward without needing to be asked. You'll manage time, priorities, and communication so the CEO and leadership team can stay focused on what drives the most impact. The best partners in this role know what's needed before it's requested, make confident decisions within their remit, and keep the CEO's attention for the things that truly require it.

Time and prioritization

  • Own the CEO's calendar with a clear understanding of business priorities, and make scheduling decisions independently rather than routing routine choices back for approval.
  • Protect focus time as a non-negotiable. When time is blocked, it stays blocked, and it is never converted into meetings without explicit direction.
  • Keep meeting load sustainable by challenging low-value requests, consolidating where possible, and maintaining a realistic daily rhythm that preserves energy and thinking time.
  • Design a lean, purposeful cadence of recurring touchpoints. Default to concise written updates over standing meetings, and reserve live time for topics that need the CEO's voice.

Judgment and decision-making

  • Operate with delegated authority. When the CEO says to go ahead, you decide, act, and inform afterward.
  • Bring recommendations instead of open questions. When input is truly needed, present a clear point of view, the options considered, and the tradeoffs, so the CEO can approve in seconds.
  • Know the CEO's preferences, standards, and priorities well enough to make the call he would make.

Scheduling, travel, and logistics

  • Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, agendas, and briefings end to end, with details resolved before they become questions.
  • Anticipate changes, resolve issues quickly and quietly, and ensure smooth transitions between engagements.

Preparation and follow-through

  • Prepare meeting briefs, background materials, and talking points that are concise, insightful, and ready to use as delivered.
  • Deliver finished work, not drafts that need rework. Presentation materials, speaker notes, and executive documents should reflect strong design sensibility and attention to brand, down to the final detail.
  • Track decisions and action items to ensure consistent follow-up and accountability across the organization.

Communication and relationship management

  • Draft and review internal communications that reflect the CEO's voice and intent with minimal editing.
  • Serve as a liaison between the CEO, executive team, board members, and external partners, exercising discretion and offering informed perspective, not just relaying messages.
  • Filter and prioritize inbound requests so the CEO sees what matters, when it matters.

Operational effectiveness

  • Introduce lightweight systems that improve follow-through, communication, and visibility.
  • Create structure that helps the CEO and leadership team move quickly without added complexity or added asks of the CEO.

Innovation and technology

  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to streamline workflows, summarize materials, and enhance decision-making.
  • Stay curious about new technology that can make executive operations smarter and faster.

Confidentiality and trust

  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization and maintain confidentiality at all times.

Who you are

  • A polished, composed executive partner with strong taste, sound judgment, and the confidence to hold and share a point of view.
  • Proactive by default. You anticipate needs, take the next step, and close loops without prompting.
  • Self-sufficient and decisive. You are comfortable making calls, managing ambiguity, and keeping momentum without frequent check-ins.
  • A skilled, efficient communicator who knows when to speak up and when to simply get it done.
  • Skilled at managing up: you guide the CEO's time and priorities diplomatically and hold boundaries that protect his effectiveness.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic support with hands-on execution.

Your skill-set

  • 10+ years as an Executive Assistant, including at least 3 years supporting a CEO
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal direction and to exercise judgment on behalf of a senior executive.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, plus calendaring, travel, and expense systems.
  • Strong design and presentation sensibility; experience producing executive-ready materials.
  • Experience coordinating board or executive-level materials a plus.
  • Comfortable with occasional after-hours support tied to travel or urgent priorities.

What’s in it for you

As a Pindropper, you join a rapidly growing company making technology more human with the power of voice. You will work alongside some of the best and brightest. We’re a passionate group committed to excellence - but that doesn’t stop us from enjoying the journey as a team with chess and poker tournaments, catered lunches and happy hours, wellness programming, and more.

Within 30 days, you'll

  • Learn the CEO's priorities, standards, communication style, and relationships.
  • Build trust through reliable follow-through and by taking early ownership of executive routines.

Within 60 days, you'll

  • Establish a clear rhythm and structure around scheduling, meetings, and communication.
  • Manage priorities and resolve conflicts independently, escalating only what truly requires the CEO.

Within 90 days, you'll

  • Fully own the CEO's operating cadence, anticipating needs before they surface.
  • Reduce the number of decisions and touchpoints the CEO needs to handle, while improving the quality of his time.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range
$120,000—$140,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (ERP Automation)
jobs.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

  • Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

  • Identify, analyze, and mitigate potential legal or financial risks in contracts
  • Ensure all parties adhere to terms, obligations, and deadlines
  • Manage contract renewals, amendments, and close-outs
  • Act as the primary point of contact, facilitating communication between internal departments and external partners
  • Maintain organized, secure physical and digital records of all contracts, correspondence, and documentation
  • Prepare and present contract status reports to senior management
  • Coordinating with various departments to ensure contract specifications are fulfilled
  • Assessing and managing potential risks and liabilities associated with contract terms
  • Identifying opportunities for improvement in existing contract processes and practices
  • Developing and implementing procedures and policies for contract management and administration
  • Reviewing and negotiating contractual details and terms with clients, suppliers or business partners
  • Collaborate with other department teams including HR, finance, sales and operations

  • Create and maintain relationships with suppliers and serve as the singular point of contact for matters concerning contracts

The Chief Data Officer is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise data strategy, ensuring data is treated as a strategic asset to drive decision-making, innovation, and business growth. Key Responsibilities

1. Data Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute enterprise-wide data strategy aligned with business objectives
  • Establish data as a core asset for competitive advantage and innovation
  • Advise executive leadership on data-driven opportunities and risks

2. Data Governance & Quality

  • Establish data governance frameworks, policies, and standards
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, lineage, and ownership across the organization
  • Implement master data management (MDM) practices

3. Data Architecture & Platforms

  • Oversee design and implementation of modern data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, lakehouse)
  • Ensure scalability, performance, and accessibility of data systems
  • Drive integration across enterprise systems

  • Lead advanced analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML initiatives
  • Enable self-service analytics and data democratization

  • Partner with security teams to safeguard sensitive data

  • Identify opportunities to monetize data and create new revenue streams
  • Optimize data usage across business units

jobs.description:
Own product launches end-to-end for Amazon brands.

$4000 month | Full-time | EU time zones

We're a growing Amazon business, and we do three things on Amazon: we grow existing sellers through PPC and catalogue management, we build brands from scratch for clients (from sourcing through to launch and ongoing management), and we launch our own Amazon brands.

We manage around 12 brands and need someone to keep operations moving as the business grows. You'll take ownership of brand-building delivery and client communication, freeing the founders from day-to-day coordination so they can focus on the wider business.

We're looking for an Operations Manager who can own brand-building operations, keep two connected pipelines moving, and make sure clients always know what's happening.

You understand Amazon and can coordinate sourcing, supply chain, catalogue, design and PPC. You don't need to have launched products yourself: the founders can teach the product side. The product lead provides product ideas; specialists own advertising, copy and growth strategy. You bring organisation, drive and follow-through.

In this role, you will:

📋 Run the new product pipeline: move ideas through sourcing and quotes, prioritise with supply chain, and ask the product lead for more ideas when needed

✏️ Run the client launch pipeline: coordinate each step from product selection to launch, with clear owners, deadlines and follow-ups

💡 Start with a daily 30-minute pulse check: review launch blockers, outstanding quotes, enough product ideas, and client/team Slack updates

💻 Work with supply chain to keep orders, stock and logistics on track, and build forecasts from real sales data as it becomes available

🔎 Clear blockers promptly, chase outstanding quotes, and help the team prioritise what needs to move next

📦 Coordinate catalogue, design and PPC specialists so their work is ready on time and nothing gets missed

🤝 Own the brand-building client journey, managing expectations and following up quickly on decisions and outstanding actions

📞 Spend around half your time on client communication, including clear updates at least twice a week for active sourcing-phase clients

📊 Keep trackers and regular reporting current; flag refund, stock or sales issues early, with a plan to address them

💡 Improve the systems you run through clearer SOPs, better ClickUp workflows, and AI or automation where it helps

📋 Run the weekly ops meeting and give the founders a concise report on progress, risks and next steps

🎓 Grow into wider business and agency operations, with the opportunity to build a team of one or two people

This is a full-time role working within UK/Western European time zone (GMT/BST), with core overlap with the founders who are based in Lisbon. Some flexibility is expected for early-morning supplier comms with China and afternoon/evening client comms with Europe and US clients.

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you need:

✅ A mover. Hyper-organised, hyper-focused, high-energy. Your default is to check ‘what’s happening with X? where are my gaps right now?’ on your own rhythm, without being prompted.

✅ Client-management maturity. You've held clients through difficult conversations — delays, cost overruns, bad news, scope arguments. You reset expectations without becoming defensive, deliver bad news professionally, and keep clients engaged when things aren't going their way.

✅ People-management reflex. You hold team members accountable without drama. You run meetings that produce decisions. You lead specialists through clear briefs and consistent follow-up — not just coordination.

✅ Strong AI fluency: you use AI tools confidently to improve workflows and work faster, while applying your own thinking and checking the output.

✅ 7+ years operations leadership in e-commerce, Amazon, or supply-chain-heavy business (you've run a function, not just executed in one)

✅ An understanding of Amazon, catalogue/listing workflows and the product-to-launch process; personally launching Amazon products is not required

✅ Excellent organisation and follow-through: you keep trackers current, spot gaps and make sure every action has an owner and a deadline

✅ Excellent written English (native or near-native - client-facing communication is a core part of this role)

✅ Systems thinker (you design and implement processes with discipline and are comfortable owning ClickUp, Notion, or Airtable as a daily operating tool)

✅ Strong prioritisation: you can manage multiple projects, follow up promptly and keep work moving in a fast-paced business

✅ Strong cross-team coordination: you hold people accountable, clarify responsibilities and work well with specialists

✅ Self-directed (you diagnose problems and act - you don't wait to be told what to do)

✅ Based in or overlapping with EU time zone (Western or Eastern Europe strongly preferred, UK working hours)

Brownie points for:

⭐ Direct Amazon FBA private label launch experience (your own brand or as an agency operator)

⭐ Commercial awareness: comfortable reading client contracts and revenue-share terms, able to flag when a scope change becomes a commercial issue.

⭐ Experience managing offshore teams (Philippines, India, Pakistan, Eastern Europe)

⭐ Experience working at a bootstrapped business or as a COO-of-one at a small company

⭐ Supply chain experience, including supplier negotiation, securing better deals, sourcing in China, freight or FBA logistics

⭐ Familiarity with Xero, Sellerboard, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon-specific tooling

⭐ Background that includes running both client-facing and internal operations functions

We’re looking for someone who gets things done and follows through. You take ownership, check for gaps without being asked, write plans down and keep work moving. Speed and sound judgement matter more than perfection.

You stay calm under pressure and handle launch delays or client challenges without becoming defensive or flustered.

Attention to detail matters: you notice when numbers don’t add up, listings have mistakes, or processes aren’t working properly.

Communication should be clear and structured - responses are concise, complete, and always move things forward with a clear next step.

In your first 30 days, you'll take over the workflow, keep clients updated, move products forward and flag problems with a plan. Near month end, you'll write a one-page plan for the next four weeks.

By 60 days, you'll be improving the systems you run, whether that means tightening the pipeline, adding an SOP, improving ClickUp or introducing a useful AI tool.

By 90 days, you'll own operations and client communication across around 12 brands in our brand-building programme. You'll raise issues early, establish regular reporting and begin forecasting from sales data, with the founders no longer needed for day-to-day coordination.

This role probably isn’t right if you:

  • Explain slowness as being “considered” or “thorough”. This role rewards speed with calibration, not deliberation.
  • Deliver plans verbally when writing was asked for.
  • Lean on AI to produce thinking you haven’t done yourself.
  • Treat tracker fields and structured data as optional admin.
  • Come from a large corporate ops environment where decisions moved slowly.
  • Look for a role with heavy structure already in place. You’ll be building it.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

💰 Starting base: $4,000/month, with on-track earnings of $6,000+/month once performance bonuses kick in

Target total compensation: $7,000-$8,000+/month within 12 months. Base reviewed every 6 months. Performance bonuses tied to successful Brand Builder launches and operational outcomes (specifics defined at offer stage).

Clear path to Operations Director within 12 months, with potential path to COO beyond that for the right person — with base increases to match.

Long-term upside opportunity tied to portfolio brand growth for the right candidate.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Deal Pricing is a dedicated global function that provides deal pricing expertise, financial insights, and deal support for negotiated users to Stripe's global Go-to-Market teams. We work to ensure deals create economic value for Stripe by establishing the deal commercial framework for a scaling sales organization, actively supporting large and strategic deals, and providing pricing insights and feedback to sales, finance, and product leaders. Deal Pricing frequently works with cross-functional business partners across Operations, Finance and Strategy, and Product. There is constant collaboration with Deal Pricing colleagues across all regions.

Rather than pricing individual deals, this Strategy and Operations (S&O) role acts as a central engine behind the global deal pricing team. You’ll serve as a "Chief of Staff" function to Deal Pricing leadership—owning the global operating model, driving cross-functional process excellence, managing our strategic operating rhythm, and codifying our commercial knowledge so Stripe can scale its GTM velocity.

What you’ll do

Strategic planning and operating rhythm

  • Drive strategy execution. Translate high-level annual goals into actionable quarterly OKRs, ensuring clear ownership and measurable progress.
  • Manage the operating cadence. Facilitate the team’s operating rhythm (MBRs, QBRs, and leadership syncs) to drive accountability, surface risks, and unblock cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strategic telemetry and insights. Collaborate with our tooling and analytics team to track functional performance, using data to inform pricing strategy, operational pivots, and executive decision-making.

Commercial governance and friction management

  • Optimize cross-functional SLAs. Act as the primary bridge between Sales velocity and risk-mitigation functions (Deal Strategy, Finance, Treasury). Define and enforce SLAs for deal pricing approvals to ensure global consistency.
  • Resolve bottlenecks. Proactively identify process friction, working with partner ops teams to redesign playbooks and clarify decision-making boundaries.

Knowledge infrastructure and sales enablement

  • Codify the "Deal pricing playbook." Build and maintain a single source of truth for deal pricing frameworks, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring documentation is version-controlled and highly discoverable.
  • Scale sales self-service. Partner with Sales Enablement to translate complex commercial policies into self-serve guides and playbooks, empowering Sales to execute simple deals independently.

Process and AI architecture

  • Systems roadmap. Act as a lead for our CRM and CPQ evolution, transforming manual, spreadsheet-based pricing into automated, scalable workflows.
  • Deploy AI for efficiency. Proactively identify and implement AI and LLM solutions to accelerate operations—including automating documentation, summarizing legacy contract terms, and extracting data from unstructured sales communications.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field.
  • 6–8+ years of experience in Business Operations (BizOps), Sales and Revenue Operations, Management Consulting, or a Chief of Staff role supporting a high-growth GTM team.
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., LLMs, advanced prompting techniques, AI-driven search/synthesis tools) to accelerate your work. While not a software engineer, you are “technically savvy.” You can navigate data structures and AI orchestration tools to build prototypes or initial solutions independently.
  • Proven experience translating high-level corporate strategy into operational execution frameworks (OKRs, KPIs)
  • Outstanding written communication skills. You must be able to write clear, structured, and highly professional playbooks and memos (critical for Stripe’s document-centric culture).
  • A track record of mapping complex, cross-functional processes, identifying root causes of friction, and redesigning workflows to improve cycle times.
  • Strong understanding of GTM tech stacks (Salesforce, CPQ, workflow automation) and how to write clear business requirement documents (BRDs) for technical teams.

Preferred qualifications

About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation likeFinanceBench, Lynx,SimpleSafetyTests,CopyrightCatcher,Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

At a glance

  • Engagement: Independent contractor, fully remote, asynchronous
  • Pay: $50-150/hr for task authoring, paid when the full task is submitted, plus a potential bonus for each accepted task. Strong performers move up within that range or onto productivity-based pay. The trial task is paid.
  • Commitment: 10+ hours per week
  • Start: Rolling, as soon as you pass the trial task
  • Location: Remote

The role

You'll design realistic finance tasks that a qualified professional could solve with the right knowledge and tools, and that today's AI models get wrong. Each task is built around a scenario we provide. You create the working documents someone in your role would actually handle, write the request, solve it yourself and define how the answer gets graded. Your work becomes evaluation and training data for frontier models.

You don't need an AI background. You do need to be the kind of finance professional who catches the number that ties out but shouldn't.

Areas we're hiring for

  • Treasury operations: cash positioning and liquidity management, daily cash operations and bank reconciliation, treasury analysis of accruals, exposures and discrepancies, and matching booked deals to counterparty confirmations and settlement records
  • Audit and assurance: external, internal or government audit, technology assurance, and SOX and ITGC controls testing, from evidence and walkthroughs through workpapers, exceptions, findings and remediation
  • Trading and portfolio operations: pre-trade compliance and clearance, execution trading from rebalance instructions, tickets and blotters, and reconciling positions, cash and holdings against instructions and constraints
  • Equity administration: stock plan administration (grants, vesting, approvals and plan availability), equity plan analysis (share reserves, outstanding awards and fair-market-value inputs), and corporate paralegal work on board consents and equity transaction documents

What you'll do

  • Build realistic evidence files from a provided scenario: bank statements and cash positions, deal confirmations and settlement records, trial balances and GL extracts, audit workpapers and control evidence, trade blotters and rebalance instructions, position and cash reconciliations, cap tables, grant records and board consents
  • Write clear task requests that state what the deliverable is and how uncertainty and justified assumptions should be handled
  • Solve each task end to end and document a reference solution with the reasoning behind every step
  • Write explicit scoring criteria that let two independent graders reach the same verdict, including acceptable alternative answers
  • Run tasks against current models, find where and why they fail, and adjust difficulty
  • Check your own and peers' tasks for ambiguity, errors, answers exposed in the materials and shortcuts that skip the intended reasoning
  • Incorporate reviewer feedback within agreed turnaround times and flag guideline gaps or edge cases you run into

Who we're looking for

Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in one or more of the four areas above: treasury operations, audit and assurance, trading and portfolio operations, or equity administration
  • Working command of the standards, controls and rules in your area (for example US GAAP or IFRS, PCAOB/AICPA auditing standards and SOX, treasury policies and bank controls, trade compliance and restricted-list rules, equity plan documents and fair-market-value requirements)
  • Strong spreadsheet skills, and the habit of tying every figure back to its source
  • Clear, precise writing in professional English
  • Ability to work independently and asynchronously against deadlines

Nice to have

  • CPA, CA, ACCA, CISA, CTP, CFA or CEP
  • Big Four, public company, bank, asset manager or fund experience
  • Experience with the systems used in your area, such as SAP Treasury or another treasury management system, Bloomberg, AIM or EMSX, or Carta or Shareworks
  • Prior experience writing or reviewing AI evaluation tasks, exam questions, case studies or training material
  • Familiarity with how AI models fail (hallucinated figures, confident arithmetic errors, misread documents)

Our standards

  • All tasks, documents and solutions are human-authored. LLM-generated content is not permitted.
  • Tasks and solutions must be original. Nothing may be copied from published or easily searchable sources.
  • Never use real client, employer or personal data. All scenarios are fictional.
  • Quality is judged on accuracy, rubric validity, difficulty and reviewer agreement, not volume.

How hiring works

  1. Short AI interview and resume review
  2. One paid trial task, scored against a fixed quality checklist
  3. Onboarding and your first project

We aim to make a decision within two weeks of your application.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, People Data Access & Governance
jobs.excerpt: About the teamAs a Senior Program Manager, People Data Access & Governance within the Business Operations & People Analytics organization, you’ll be part of a team at the center of one of Zillow’s most consequential investments: making people data more accessible, more intelligent, and more trustworthy, all at the same time.
jobs.description:
About the team

As a Senior Program Manager, People Data Access & Governance within the Business Operations & People Analytics organization, you’ll be part of a team at the center of one of Zillow’s most consequential investments: making people data more accessible, more intelligent, and more trustworthy, all at the same time. This team sits at the intersection of HR systems, cloud data infrastructure, and the rapidly evolving world of AI-powered workforce tools, and plays a critical role in shaping how leaders and partners across the company can engage with people data responsibly. The Senior Program Manager, People Data Access & Governance will own the program that holds all of that together.

About the role

The way organizations interact with people data is changing fundamentally. When AI can be pointed at a dataset and asked anything: from “what’s driving attrition in this org?” to “show me comp distribution by level”, traditional access models built around fixed reports and credentialed BI users are no longer sufficient. This role exists because Zillow is leaning into that future, and doing it thoughtfully requires someone who can hold the full picture: who should have access to what, through which interfaces, with what controls, and accountable to whom.


As Senior Program Manager, People Data Access & Governance, you’ll design and own the framework that governs access in how people data flows from source systems like Workday through cloud analytical environments like Databricks, and ultimately into the hands of HRBPs, people leaders, and AI-powered tools. You’ll navigate the spectrum from governed metric layers and curated data products all the way to back-end power user access, making principled decisions about what’s appropriate at each level. This is a governance design and program ownership role, one that requires the ability to translate policy into an operating model, build durable frameworks in genuine ambiguity, and earn trust across technical, legal, and people-focused stakeholders.


You Will Get To:

  • Design and own Zillow’s People Data Access & Governance program, including policies, access frameworks, data classification standards, and the principles that determine who can access what, through which interfaces, and under what conditions
  • Partner with HRBPs, People Analytics, Legal and Privacy, Security, and Product and Tech leaders to understand how people data is used in practice, and design governance that protects that data without creating friction that pushes teams toward ungoverned workarounds
  • Govern the full spectrum of people data access: from curated, governed metric layers and self-service analytics surfaces, to back-end power user access in Databricks; understanding the risk and accountability considerations that differ across each tier
  • Define how AI-powered tools, including large language model interfaces that allow natural language querying of workforce data, into the access governance model, and build the guardrails that make those tools safe to deploy at scale
  • Define the access governance framework for people data, including role-based access design, tiering principles, and the standards that govern when access is granted, modified, or revoked and partner with Security, HR Tech, and Data Engineering to translate that framework into implemented controls.
  • Serve as the primary decision-maker for people data access questions across the organization: fielding requests, making principled calls, and building scalable intake and escalation processes so governance doesn’t become a bottleneck
  • Identify and close gaps in how people data moves through Zillow’s data ecosystem, ensuring appropriate masking, permissioning, and audit mechanisms exist at every layer from source record to AI interface
  • Lead cross-functional working groups and drive alignment on data access standards, sensitivity classifications, and escalation paths across a complex, multi-stakeholder environment
  • Build the operational infrastructure of the program: intake workflows, periodic access reviews, exception handling, and reporting that gives leadership real visibility into the state of people data governance
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $130,100.00 - $207,900.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $123,700.00 - $197,500.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 8+ years of experience in data governance, HR technology, people analytics, or technical program management, with demonstrated ownership of a program or domain, not just project delivery
  • Familiarity with cloud-based analytical environments to partner with Data Engineering and Security about how access controls are implemented. Your core expertise is in governance design and policy, not technical configuration.
  • A clear mental model for how AI and LLM-based tools change the data governance equation; you understand that natural language interfaces to structured data require a fundamentally different access control philosophy than traditional BI, and you have a point of view on how to approach it
  • Experience governing sensitive data across its full lifecycle: classification, permissioning, access review cadences, audit trails, and exception handling, ideally with people or HR data specifically
  • Comfort operating in genuine ambiguity at scale; this role is building something that doesn’t fully exist yet, and you approach that with structured thinking, iterative momentum, and with ownership and autonomy rather than waiting for perfect clarity
  • Strong cross-functional partnership instincts: you know how to align InfoSec, Legal, HR, Data Engineering, and Product around a shared governance problem without letting any single stakeholder’s agenda define the outcome
  • A grounded, principled perspective on why people data governance matters; you treat this as work with real ethical and organizational stakes, and you can articulate that credibly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • HR domain fluency to deeply understand the sensitivity of what you’re governing, and a genuine point of view on why people data governance matters - your credibility comes from your governance instincts, design thinking, and program ownership track record

Preferred:

  • Experience with data privacy and compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, or similar) and how they apply to workforce data specifically
  • Familiarity with AI/ML governance considerations, including how model training data, inference inputs, and agentic workflows create distinct access and accountability questions that traditional governance frameworks weren’t designed to address
  • Background working with or alongside People Analytics or HRBP teams with an understanding of how workforce data is consumed for decision-making

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.
