Our client is a fast-growing AI infrastructure company that has built a state-of-the-art data curation platform used to train some of the most demanding deep learning models in the world. Their technology automatically curates and optimizes petabytes of training data — algorithms that are modality-agnostic and require no labels — to make model training dramatically faster and more efficient. Customers see results that speak for themselves: 7x–40x faster training, model performance equivalent to training on 10x more raw data, and smaller models (with less than half the parameters) that outperform larger ones and substantially cut deployment costs.

Backed by $57.5M raised across Seed and Series A, with investors including Microsoft, Amazon, Felicis, and AI luminaries like Geoff Hinton, Yann LeCun, and Jeff Dean, our client has built a lean team of ~60 people. This is a company already proving out results with real enterprise customers.

The Mission

Foundational models are only as good as the data they're trained on. Our client exists to close the gap between raw data and truly optimized training data — without requiring labels, without adding compute cost, and without forcing customers to compromise on model quality. Every strategic account this team lands is a chance to prove that better data curation, not just bigger models, is the unlock the industry has been missing.

The Opportunity

As Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales), this is a rare role at a company small enough that your fingerprints will be on every major account, and well-funded enough that the roadmap, the compensation, and the customer roster are all already real. You'll be one of the founding members of the post-sales technical org, working directly with strategic enterprise accounts to take them from signed contract to production deployment — and shaping the playbooks that the next wave of hires will use.

  • Design scalable, secure workflows spanning compute, storage, networking, and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, Azure, and on-prem Kubernetes

  • Strong Python proficiency (required) and AWS proficiency (required)

  • Experience building post-sales processes or playbooks from scratch

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes, and fast-moving environments — startup or high-ambiguity experience is a plus

  • A technical degree (CS or equivalent)

  • A demonstrated ability to translate messy, ambiguous customer requirements into clean, concrete architecture

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Visual
jobs.excerpt: Some problems are too important for ordinary thinking.
jobs.description:
Some problems are too important for ordinary thinking.

How do you change behavior at scale? Build trust when trust is hard to earn? Make something complicated feel simple? Get millions of people to see things differently—and do something about it?

These are the kinds of problems we work on at ICF Next. The stakes are high. The answers aren't obvious. And the work has to do more than look good.


We're looking for a Creative Director who loves that kind of challenge. Someone with a restless imagination, exceptional instincts and the ability to turn a difficult brief into an idea that feels inevitable once you've seen it.


Someone who knows great creative work doesn't happen by accident. It takes curiosity, conviction, craft and people who care enough to keep pushing.


About ICF & ICF Next

ICF is a global consulting and technology services company working on some of the most pressing challenges facing businesses, governments and communities. From energy and climate to public health, infrastructure and government, our teams bring deep expertise to problems that don't have easy answers.


ICF Next brings creativity into that equation.


We're writers, designers, strategists, technologists and creative thinkers working together to help organizations connect with people and move them to action.


We have the creative ambition of an agency and access to the expertise of a global consultancy. That combination gives us an unusual opportunity: to understand difficult problems from the inside, find the human story and create work that makes a difference in the real world.

There's no shortage of interesting briefs. The challenge is doing something extraordinary with them.


The Role

You'll lead creative across major client engagements, from the first conversation about a problem to the last detail of the finished work.

You'll find the idea that makes everything click. Set the visual direction. Push the thinking. Bring writers, designers, strategists and producers together around a shared ambition.


The work spans integrated campaigns, brand experiences, film, digital, social, experiential and whatever else the idea calls for.


You'll be expected to have a point of view, make decisions, challenge work that isn't good enough and know when to let a better idea win.


You'll also help shape the creative culture at ICF Next. Not through speeches about excellence, but through the work you make, the standards you set and the people you help develop.


What You'll Do

  • Find the idea. Get beneath the brief, ask better questions and turn complicated challenges into original, compelling creative concepts.
  • Set the standard. Bring a sharp eye, strong art direction and a deep respect for design, storytelling and execution. Care about the big idea and every detail that makes it work.
  • Make people care. Take subjects that can be technical, sensitive or difficult to explain and make them clear, relevant and human.
  • Think beyond the medium. Lead creative across digital, social, film, video, experiential, paid media, out-of-home and emerging platforms. Start with the idea, not the format.
  • Make the team better. Inspire, mentor and challenge creatives. Give useful feedback. Recognize talent. Create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers.
  • Stand behind the work. Present ideas with clarity and conviction. Build relationships with clients. Know how to push without making it personal, and how to protect a strong idea while making it stronger.
  • Get it made. Work across disciplines, manage competing priorities and navigate the realities of complex projects without losing sight of what made the idea worth pursuing.
  • Stay curious. Explore new tools, technologies and ways of working, including AI, without confusing what's new with what's good.

Who You Are

You came up through art direction or design, but you've never thought of yourself as just a visual person.


You think in ideas. You understand the power of an image, the precision of a line of copy and the way everything comes together to tell a story.


You have taste. You have opinions. You can explain both.


You know the difference between a clever execution and a genuinely good idea. You can spot what's missing, see what's possible and help a team get there.


You're comfortable leading a room, but you listen. You know how to sell an idea without overselling it. And you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves when the work needs you.


You've worked on difficult briefs, with demanding clients and tight deadlines. You've learned that constraints aren't an excuse for mediocre work.


Most importantly, you still get excited when something great comes together. You haven't lost the instinct to make it better.


What You Bring


Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of creative experience in an agency, design studio or comparable environment, including senior-level creative leadership.
  • A portfolio that shows exceptional conceptual thinking, art direction, design craft and integrated creative work.

Professional Skills

  • Experience leading creative teams and developing campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Strong visual storytelling, strategic thinking and presentation skills.
  • The ability to take ambitious ideas from concept through production while managing complex projects, stakeholders and deadlines.

Why ICF Next

The problems we work on aren't always easy to explain. They don't always come with glamorous briefs or obvious answers.


That's what makes them interesting.


You get to work with people who know their subjects inside out, tackle challenges that affect how people live and make decisions, and bring your creative instincts to places where they're genuinely needed.


There's room here for big ideas. For unexpected thinking. For the kind of work that makes you proud of what you do.


If you believe the hardest problems deserve the best creative minds, we'd like to meet you.


Show us your work. Show us how you think.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Doit

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

POSITION SUMMARY

Sprezzatura is seeking a Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer to support cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VA.gov Platform.

The Security Automation / Data Engineer will design, develop, and implement automation that improves how security compliance data is collected, assessed, measured, and reported across a large-scale digital platform. This role will help transform repeatable, manual security and compliance activities into sustainable, engineering-driven capabilities that provide greater visibility into security posture and reduce the operational burden associated with maintaining compliance.

Working alongside security, DevSecOps, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, this position will focus on automated evidence collection and controls assessment, security data integration, compliance measurement, vulnerability and remediation reporting, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) capabilities, and security posture dashboards.

The ideal candidate combines cybersecurity knowledge with strong automation and data engineering skills and is comfortable integrating information across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tools, APIs, and compliance systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated processes for collecting security and compliance evidence from authoritative system, infrastructure, configuration, and security data sources
  • Develop automation to support security control assessment and continuous monitoring, including OSCAL-based evidence collection and control-assessment capabilities
  • Build integrations and data pipelines that aggregate and normalize security information from multiple tools, platforms, and APIs
  • Develop security metrics and dashboards that provide near-real-time visibility into control posture, remediation status, vulnerabilities, and other security indicators
  • Automate recurring security and compliance reporting for security teams, engineering teams, program leadership, and government stakeholders
  • Develop capabilities for measuring security-control and security-tooling coverage across applications, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Automate vulnerability and remediation reporting to support prioritization, ownership, aging analysis, and tracking through closure
  • Support implementation and operation of an SBOM capability, including collection and analysis of software dependency and third-party component data
  • Integrate SBOM and software supply-chain information with vulnerability management and security reporting capabilities
  • Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to ensure security controls implemented within CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure generate usable, repeatable compliance evidence
  • Identify manual security and compliance processes that are candidates for automation and implement scalable solutions where feasible
  • Support the development of repeatable processes that enable product and engineering teams to demonstrate continued compliance with defined security standards
  • Ensure automated security evidence, metrics, and reporting are traceable, maintainable, and usable during ongoing compliance activities and independent controls assessments
  • Document automation, integrations, data sources, processes, and technical solutions to support long-term sustainment by the Platform Security team
  • Collaborate with security engineers, cybersecurity/RMF specialists, DevSecOps engineers, software engineers, product teams, and government stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of relevant experience.
  • Five (5) years of experience as a Cyber Security Engineer may be substituted in lieu of a degree
  • Experience developing automation using Python, JavaScript, or another scripting/programming language
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, cloud platforms, CI/CD systems, security tools, or other technical systems
  • Experience designing or developing automated workflows, data pipelines, dashboards, metrics, or reporting solutions
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including security controls, vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, and compliance
  • Experience working with modern software development and CI/CD practices
  • Ability to analyze security and technical data and translate it into meaningful metrics and actionable information
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across security, engineering, product, and program teams
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the background investigation and access required to support Department of Veterans Affairs systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting federal cybersecurity programs or systems operating under the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF)
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security controls
  • Experience with OSCAL or other machine-readable approaches to security compliance and control assessment
  • Experience automating security evidence collection, continuous monitoring, or compliance assessment
  • Experience with AWS security and configuration data, including services such as AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, or similar cloud-native security tooling
  • Experience integrating security capabilities into or extracting security data from GitHub Actions or other CI/CD platforms
  • Experience with SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), secrets detection, container scanning, or other application security tooling
  • Experience implementing or working with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) standards and tooling
  • Experience with software supply-chain security and dependency or third-party component risk analysis
  • Experience developing security posture, vulnerability management, or compliance dashboards
  • Familiarity with federal ATO processes, POA&Ms, control implementation evidence, and independent controls assessments
  • Experience working within large-scale cloud platforms or environments supporting multiple independent product and engineering teams

ABOUT THE WORK

The VA.gov Platform supports a large ecosystem of systems, components, and product teams operating within a shared ATO boundary. This effort is focused on improving the Platform's security posture while establishing sustainable approaches for maintaining and demonstrating compliance over time. This SOW specifically calls for moving toward a modern, engineering-first cybersecurity model and implementing automated solutions where appropriate so that security improvements are durable and scalable rather than one-time fixes.

This role will be a key contributor to that effort by building the automation and data capabilities that allow security requirements, implementation evidence, vulnerabilities, remediation progress, and overall security posture to be measured and understood continuously rather than assembled manually in preparation for an assessment or ATO renewal. That directly supports the SOW's goal of establishing processes that allow the steady-state Platform Security team to maintain compliance iteratively.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Standard Business hours are Monday through Friday. Occasional extended or weekend hours may be required based on operational needs. Must have reliable internet service that allows for effective telecommuting.  Travel may be required from time to time for customer meetings and industry events.

PAY RANGE

The base salary range for this position is $135,000 to $160,000 annually, depending on geographic work location, relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, security clearance, and contract requirements. Geographic salary ranges are determined in accordance with the company's compensation practices and represent a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting.

BENEFITS

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company match

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Sprezzatura participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Remote (US-based) · Independent contractor · ~15–20 hrs/week ongoing · Reports to the Senior Medical Director About ShapelyShapely is transforming the weight loss industry through an innovative physician-led approach that makes weight loss care affordable for everyone.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Remote (US-based) · Independent contractor · ~15–20 hrs/week ongoing · Reports to the Senior Medical Director

About Shapely

Shapely is transforming the weight loss industry through an innovative physician-led approach that makes weight loss care affordable for everyone. With evidence-based care, industry-leading support, and a seamless integrated app, we help thousands of patients across California, Florida, New York, and Texas access GLP-1 therapies and comprehensive weight management, all covered by insurance, including Medicare. Most of our patients are over 65.

Our care model is longitudinal and includes MDs/DOs, NPs, PAs, and RDNs. We bill fee-for-service and also participate in MIPS.

The role

You'll be the person who makes sure what we document supports what we bill, and that we're capturing everything we legitimately earn. This is a hands-on coding and auditing role reporting to the Senior Medical Director — not a policy, billing-clerk, or general compliance position.

You'll work in two modes. Prospectively, you'll help us assess which codes are safe to use for a given visit type as well as what documentation needs to be present to use teh coe compliantly. Retrospectively, you'll audit charts to confirm the documentation holds up with high accuracy, and turn opportunities for improvement into templates, workflow fixes, and education.

What you'll do

Audit

  • Conduct a baseline documentation audit (10–20 charts per billing provider) across encounters, and deliver a findings report with error rates by provider and service line

  • Run ongoing quarterly audits (10 charts per provider) plus focused service-line reviews.

  • Perform 100% pre-bill review during new-code rollouts until the error rate is under 5%

  • Place any provider above a 10% error rate on monthly review with targeted education until they're back under threshold

Code evaluation

  • Evaluate appropriateness of unused or underused codes for our care model and define the documentation each requires before we bill it

  • Write documentation guidance for our clinical staff and billing team.

MIPS

  • Assist with success with MIPS, including determining appropriate measures and ensuring our documentation exceeds requirements.

  • Provide suggestions on enhancing our templates to optimize accuracy and compliance with MIPS


Requirements

Required

  • CPC (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA)

  • CPMA strongly preferred, or equivalent demonstrated chart-audit experience

  • 5+ years coding outpatient E/M, with direct auditing experience

  • Strong knowledge of Medicare telehealth rules

  • Experience with MIPS reporting and quality-measure documentation

  • US-based, with strong Medicare experience

Nice to have

  • Obesity medicine, endocrinology, or primary care background

  • Prior work with OIG self-disclosure or payer audit response

  • Experience building documentation templates or clinician cheat-sheets

Position: Conveyancing Paralegal

About the Role:

We are seeking an adaptable, highly reliable Conveyancing Paralegal to join our UK based client as a dedicated, full-time remote team member based in South Africa or the Philippines.

Our UK based client is an established East London law firm handling approximately 100 residential conveyancing matters per month. To relieve pressure across the department, free up existing UK fee earners, and ensure seamless service, the firm is creating a flexible, "floating" offshore conveyancing resource.

In this role, you will act as an essential operational engine—supporting multiple fee earners, taking complete ownership of routine and post-completion work across the department, and stepping in to cover active caseloads during periods of high volume or annual leave under UK supervision. Whether assisting with initial searches, reviewing documents, or managing post-completion requirements, you will take work away from the team without creating additional management burden.

Key Responsibilities

Core Conveyancing Support & Departmental Workflow

  • Floating Fee-Earner Support: Move seamlessly across multiple fee earners' files, providing operational support where demand is highest across sales, purchases, re-mortgages, and transfers of equity.
  • Searches & File Setup: Order, track, and perform initial reviews of property search packages (local authority, environmental, drainage) and ensure onboarding compliance documents (KYC/AML, TA forms) are logged.
  • Legal Drafting: Prepare standard contracts, transfers of title (TR1), property questionnaires, and mortgage documentation under UK fee-earner guidance.

Department-Wide Post-Completion Ownership

  • End-to-End Post-Completion: Take complete ownership of post-completion duties across the entire firm, including preparing completion statements, drafting and submitting SDLT returns, and submitting Land Registry applications (AP1).
  • Requisition Management: Monitor and respond to Land Registry requisitions promptly, ensuring clear title registration without delays.

Caseload Coverage & Continuity

  • Active File Progressions: Substantially progress active conveyancing files under supervision, keeping matters moving when fee earners are away on leave or experiencing workload spikes.
  • Multi-Party Communication: Communicate clearly, professionally, and articulately with UK colleagues, estate agents, lenders, redemption departments, and opposing conveyancers.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • England & Wales Conveyancing Experience (Essential): Direct, practical experience handling residential conveyancing specifically under English and Welsh law. (General SA/PH legal qualifications without UK conveyancing experience will not be considered).
  • Full Process Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the complete UK conveyancing lifecycle—from file opening, search ordering, and contract drafting to exchange, completion, and post-completion.
  • Post-Completion Competence: Proven track record of independently handling AP1 Land Registry submissions, SDLT filings, and resolving requisitions.
  • Case Management Tech: Confident operating legal Case Management Systems (CMS) and keeping digital audit trails up to date.
  • Ego-Free & Adaptable Attitude: Zero hesitation towards administrative tasks; comfortable serving as a floating resource supporting multiple team members.
  • Professional Communication: Clear, articulate spoken and written English, suited for professional collaboration with UK legal teams and third parties.

What Success Looks Like

The firm's UK fee earners have significantly more time to focus on complex legal matters and firm growth; post-completion tasks are executed flawlessly on time; caseloads progress uninterrupted during staff absences; and the department operates smoothly without creating added management oversight for the Managing Directors.

jobs.title: Project Manager (ERP Automation)
jobs.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our team! In this role, you will provide technical leadership for Penn Mutual’s Brokerage and RIA Technology Team, helping shape the architecture and technical direction of its platforms and systems. You will lead complex initiatives, influence technical decisions across teams, and ensure solutions align with business needs and long-term technology strategy.


While remaining hands-on in engineering and solution delivery, you will expand your impact through architecture, technical standards, reusable patterns, mentoring, and cross-team technical leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and drive the technical direction and architecture for Penn Mutual’s Brokerage and RIA Technology Team and its associated platforms and systems.
  • Partner with product, engineering, architecture, business, cybersecurity, and platform leaders to develop technical roadmaps aligned with business priorities and long-term technology strategy.
  • Define architecture, reference patterns, engineering standards, and reusable capabilities for AWS serverless data integration across major platforms and multiple engineering teams.
  • Architect complex solutions spanning multiple applications, services, data sources, integrations, and technology platforms.
  • Lead major cross-team technical initiatives from initial analysis and solution design through implementation and operational adoption.
  • Establish and drive adoption of technical standards, reference implementations, and reusable components that improve consistency and scalability across engineering teams.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, ensuring significant technical decisions, trade-offs, dependencies, and risks are clearly documented.
  • Identify and address systemic technical risks, including dependencies, scalability constraints, security concerns, and operational weaknesses.
  • Resolve complex technical challenges that span systems, teams, applications, or organizational boundaries.
  • Balance near-term delivery priorities with long-term maintainability, modernization, reliability, and technical-debt reduction.
  • Influence product and technology roadmaps through technical expertise and a strong understanding of business priorities.
  • Mentor Senior Software Engineers and other engineers, helping develop technical leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead prototypes or proofs of concept for strategically significant capabilities.
  • Communicate technical direction, architectural decisions, and recommendations to engineering teams, architects, business leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Promote engineering excellence through automation, observability, testing, documentation, security, and operational discipline.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Nine or more years of relevant software development experience, including significant technical leadership responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex solutions spanning multiple systems, applications, platforms, or engineering teams.
  • Deep expertise in AWS serverless and cloud-native data architecture, including orchestration, messaging, APIs, security, networking, observability, resiliency, data governance, and infrastructure automation.
  • Deep knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, integration approaches, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and operational resilience.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, with the ability to contribute directly to solution design, development, prototyping, and technical reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and decisions across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Experience establishing and driving adoption of reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and platform capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve cross-team technical risks, dependencies, and complex technical challenges.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain architecture decisions, technical recommendations, and trade-offs to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and strengthen technical and engineering capabilities across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading architecture for cloud-native, enterprise integration, data platform, or distributed systems initiatives.
  • Experience with major cloud platforms and technologies, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, containerization, serverless computing, or managed data services.
  • Experience with architecture modeling, architecture decision records, reference architectures, and technology roadmap development.
  • Experience establishing enterprise architecture and engineering patterns using AWS services such as Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, EMR, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, S3, Athena, Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog, and DynamoDB, as well as infrastructure-as-code technologies.
  • Experience working in a regulated industry with security, audit, privacy, and data governance requirements.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, security, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical disciplines.

jobs.description:
Substation Engineering Lead (PE)

Position Description:

Vantage Point Solutions (VPS) is seeking a Substation Engineering Lead to provide technical leadership, project oversight, and client engagement for electric utility substation projects. In this role, you will work directly with utility clients to plan, design, and oversee construction of substation solutions that align with client goals and support reliable electric service.

Projects may include new substations, substation expansions, brownfield modifications, system improvement initiatives, grant-funded projects, and multi-year capital improvement programs. You will serve as a key link between utility personnel, contractors, field crews, and engineering teams, helping move projects from concept through commissioning.

The Substation Engineering Lead is responsible for the technical direction, design oversight, and professional engineering approval of substation projects. This role provides mentorship and leadership to engineers, manages project execution, and ensures projects are completed safely, with quality, on schedule, and within budget.

Successful candidates demonstrate strong leadership, sound engineering judgment, adaptability, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering exceptional service.

Why Vantage Point Solutions?

Vantage Point Solutions was founded in 2002 on the belief that people come first. Today, VPS is a customer focused, technology-driven engineering and consulting firm serving clients in the power, broadband, and financial industries. We are committed to delivering exceptional service while fostering a culture built on teamwork, accountability, respect, innovation, and professional growth. Our employees are empowered to make meaningful contributions to our clients, communities, and industries while building rewarding careers.

Technical Leadership & Project Management:

  • Lead and manage multiple substation projects simultaneously from planning through construction and commissioning.
  • Conduct quality assurance and quality control reviews throughout all phases of project delivery.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with local, state, and federal technical, regulatory, and safety standards.
  • Conduct quality assurance and quality control reviews throughout all phases of project delivery.
  • Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, and engineering cost estimates.
  • Stay current with applicable codes, standards, industry practices, and emerging technologies.

Engineering & Design:

  • Perform system-wide planning studies and system assessments related to substation capacity, reliability, and system performance, applying best practices and the latest technologies.
  • Develop, review, and approve (PE-seal) complete substation designs, including physical layouts, electrical design, grounding systems, equipment selection, bus configurations, structural steel, protection and control systems, relay schematics, wiring diagrams, SCADA integration, and bills of material to deliver full construction drawings (IFC) and bid packages (IFB).
  • Prepare equipment specifications, material specifications, and construction requirements in accordance with client and regulatory requirements.
  • Professionally seal for-construction substation designs, protection and controls, and grounding system designs.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with industry-standard software used for the design, planning, modeling, and analysis of substations, protection systems, and control systems.
  • Support permitting, regulatory compliance, and engineering documentation efforts.
  • Develop substation protection and control settings.

Client & Field Support:

  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, contractors, utility personnel, and internal team members.
  • Strengthens VPS’s reputation as a trusted partner for utilities and enterprise clients.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to utility clients and assist in developing best practices, infrastructure modernization, and operational direction.
  • Provide field engineering support during construction, commissioning, outage restoration, and emergency response activities.
  • Assist clients with day-to-day engineering questions, operational challenges, and strategic planning initiatives.
  • Assist clients in meeting regulatory reporting and compliance requirements for substation systems.

Team Leadership:

  • Mentor, train, and develop engineers and technical staff.
  • Develop a high-performing engineering team capable of executing complex, multi-faceted projects.
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence within the Power Engineering team.
  • Support management and customer relations staff with business development initiatives.
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, and professional development efforts.
  • Implement process improvements to enhance engineering efficiency, accuracy, and client satisfaction.

Required Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or Electrical Engineering Technology (BSEET) from an ABET-accredited institution, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license and ability to obtain licensure in other states through reciprocity within a reasonable timeframe.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in electric utility substation design and engineering.
  • Minimum of 2 years of engineering leadership experience with direct supervisory responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working with utility personnel, construction contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Strong knowledge of substation design, protection and controls, grounding systems, SCADA integration, and utility construction practices.
  • Thorough understanding of applicable engineering standards and codes, including NESC, IEEE, ANSI, and RUS requirements.
  • Working knowledge of OSHA requirements applicable to substations and the electric utility industry.
  • Broad understanding of electric utility operations, including transmission, substations, distribution systems, protection and control systems, SCADA, AMI, and OMS platforms.
  • Ability and willingness to perform field work, including walking on uneven or rough terrain, visiting active construction sites, and working in varying weather conditions.

Additional Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with clients, contractors, utility personnel, regulatory agencies, and internal team members.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound engineering judgment, and attention to detail.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to successfully pass background checks, driving record reviews, drug screening requirements, and client-specific screening processes as required.

Compensation and Benefits:

VPS offers a competitive compensation package along with comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and other benefits designed to support the well-being and success of our employees.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Vantage Point Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.”

Job Summary

The Director of Mobile Maintenance will lead the development, operation, and growth of a national mobile maintenance business. This leader will build a scalable service model that delivers reliable, high-quality maintenance across geographically dispersed client locations.

The role requires a strong operational background and demonstrated experience managing mobile technicians, leading distributed teams, and expanding a service business. The Director will own operational performance, financial results, workforce development, and service delivery while partnering with sales and sector leadership to identify opportunities and enter new markets.

Ability to travel regularly to support field teams, clients, and new market launches.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Lead daily mobile maintenance operations across multiple markets, ensuring safe, responsive, and consistent service delivery.
  • Establish standard operating procedures for preventive maintenance, reactive repairs, emergency response, and work order completion.
  • Develop staffing models, service territories, technician schedules, and routing strategies that improve coverage, productivity, and utilization.
  • Partner with the Command Center to coordinate dispatch, work prioritization, escalation, and client communication.
  • Establish clear accountability for service quality, response times, work order documentation, and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee fleet, tools, equipment, parts inventory, and technician readiness.

Business Development and National Expansion

  • Develop and execute a national growth plan, identifying priority markets, client opportunities, and the resources needed to expand.
  • Build a repeatable model for launching new markets, including staffing, service coverage, pricing, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with sales and Compass sector teams to develop opportunities with existing clients and new customers.
  • Support site assessments, scope development, estimating, proposals, and client presentations.
  • Evaluate opportunities to transition outsourced maintenance to self-performed mobile services.
  • Ensure new business is priced appropriately and supported by a practical, profitable delivery model.

Financial Management

  • Own the mobile maintenance operating budget, forecasts, and profit and loss performance.
  • Manage labor, overtime, travel, fleet, materials, and subcontractor costs.
  • Develop pricing and cost models that support competitive services and sustainable margins.
  • Monitor account and market profitability, identify performance gaps, and implement corrective actions.
  • Balance investment in growth with financial discipline and operational capacity.

Team Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain regional leaders, operations managers, and skilled mobile technicians.
  • Establish clear roles, performance expectations, training requirements, and career paths.
  • Build a culture of safety, accountability, technical excellence, and client service.
  • Develop leadership capacity to support expansion into additional markets.

Short Description

Technology and Continuous Improvement

  • Use technology and work management systems to improve field execution, reporting, and visibility.
  • Establish performance measures for technician utilization, response times, preventive maintenance completion, first-time fix rates, repeat calls, safety, and profitability.
  • Use operational data and client feedback to improve service delivery and identify additional maintenance needs.
  • Ensure accurate asset records, service histories, and field documentation.

Qualifications

  • Significant progressive experience in facilities maintenance, field service, or a related service business, including leadership of mobile maintenance operations across multiple markets.

  • Lead product initiatives from idea to launch — discovery, scoping, prioritization, and shipping with design and engineering

  • Define success metrics for your area and own the outcomes

  • Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous problem spaces; make tradeoffs grounded in customer reality, not internal opinion

  • Spend meaningful time on-site with US customers — senior living operators, care staff, and clinical leadership — and translate field observations into concrete product decisions

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to land features in market — shape positioning, enablement materials, and launch narratives so what we ship actually gets adopted

  • Run beta and adoption programs — recruit pilot customers, structure feedback loops, and drive feature uptake in the field

  • Build deep technical fluency in our computer-vision and AI stack — enough to scope feasibly, push back on engineering, and make the right build calls

  • Communicate clearly across teams, time zones, and the Copenhagen and US teams

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on B2B software

  • Track record of owning a product area end-to-end and shipping outcomes (not just features) — comfortable being the most senior PM in the room with customers and partners

  • Experience at a fast-moving growth-stage startup. You're comfortable with ambiguity, fast cycles, and owning outcomes without a playbook

  • Strong product thinking — discovery, prioritization, scoping, shipping

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfort spending significant time in the field — this is not a desk job

  • Ability to develop deep technical understanding of complex products (AI systems, data pipelines, or hardware-software systems)

  • Structured thinking and strong problem-solving ability

  • Based in the US, with the availability to travel domestically for customer visits

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, senior living, or another regulated, high-stakes industry

  • Experience working closely with sales and customer-facing teams

  • Experience operating in a distributed product org (especially across US and Europe)

Location & Travel

  • Our US office is in Boulder, Colorado. If you're based there or open to relocating, we'd love that.
