  • Required travel across the US to customer sites.

  • Occasional travel to our headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Why Join Teton

  • Competitive Salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

  • A role where you can make a significant impact on care delivery.

What It's Like Working at Teton

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. What a Typical Day Looks Like

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate with the marketing team through shared documents and written communication, ensuring deliverables remain on schedule.

In short: You’ll research, write, edit, and optimize content that strengthens the client’s marketing efforts and communicates its value to the right audiences.

Why This Role Stands Out

jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

EINSTIEGSGEHALT: 45.000–60.000 € BRUTTO-JAHRESGEHALT (ABHÄNGIG VON BERUFSERFAHRUNG UND QUALIFIKATION)

Als Growth Key Account Manager bist du unser Aushängeschild beim Kunden und Experte für unsere Software-Lösungen sowie Online-Marketing. Dein Ziel ist es, das Kundenportfolio stetig wachsen zu lassen und Klienten optimal zu beraten. So finden sie dank deiner Hilfe auch für komplexe Herausforderungen schnell zielführende Lösungen. Bewirb dich jetzt bei Digistore24 ‒ einem der Top-IT-Unternehmen Deutschlands ‒ und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Branche

Bitte beachte: Diese Position setzt fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse voraus.

👀 Du siehts die Stelle schon länger? Ja, das Team wächst stetig, wie unser Kundenstamm.

Über Digistore24?

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Technologieunternehmen und haben eine klare Vision: We shape the digital future.
UnsereMission? Menschen weltweit dabei zu unterstützen, ihr Wissen online zu teilen und sich damit ein eigenes, erfolgreiches Business aufzubauen. Mit unserer Platform ermöglichen wir Millionen von Menschen den Zugang zu wertvollem Wissen und geben ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, ihre Ziele wirklich zu erreichen.

Was uns besonders macht:Wir sind rund 200 hochmotivierte Mitarbeitende, die nicht auf Anweisungen warten, sondern ihren Alltag aktiv gestalten und jeden Tag neu verbessern - genau wie unsere Kunden.
Unser Team ist so vielfältig wie unsere Ideen: Menschen aus über 40 verschiedenen Ländern arbeiten bei uns gemeinsam an einer Vision. Was uns verbindet, sind unsere Werte, unser Antrieb und unser Anspruch, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

Wir sind keine großen Redner: wir sind Macher. We love to perform.
Mit unserem Wachstum bauen wir unsere Teams gezielt und nachhaltig aus und suchen Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und mit uns die Zukunft gestalten.

Dein neuer Traumjob

  • Du machst den Unterschied: Mit deiner Leistung trägst du direkt zur Umsatzsteigerung von Digistore24 und unseren VIP Kunden bei. Du befähigst Online-Unternehmer, ihre Infoprodukte mit unserer Software Millionen von Menschen zugänglich zu machen, und förderst so aktiv die Digitalisierung kleiner und mittlerer Unternehmen.
  • Langfristige Direkt-Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust einen festen Kundenstamm, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und führst mit jedem deiner Kunden regelmäßig Business-Reviews sowie Calls zur Leistungssteigerung.
  • Expertenstatus: Nach einer gründlichen Einarbeitungsphase bist du Spezialist für Online-Marketing und Software-Anwendungen. Du beantwortest eigenverantwortlich Fragen rund um unsere Features und deren Anwendungsgebiete ‒ schriftlich und telefonisch.
  • Wachstumschancen erkennst du sofort und berätst deine Kunden proaktiv zu unseren Features, um ihre Verkäufe zu steigern. Auf Basis von Sales-Trend-, Funnel- und Performance-Analysen gibst du Empfehlungen zur Optimierung ihres Business.
  • Alles im Blick: Dank regelmäßigem Monitoring registrierst du mögliche Umsatzrückgänge sofort, analysierst Hintergründe und findest Maßnahmen zur Lösung. Die Betreuung von Bug-Reports und Feature-Requests gehören ebenfalls in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Repräsentiere Digistore24: Ob bei internationalen VIP-Kunden-Events, einem Business-Lunch oder auf Messen ‒ du verstehst es, Kundenbeziehungen auch face to face zu pflegen.

PS: Es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine Vertriebsstelle

Unsere Werte

Bitte schau dir die WIRKLICH genau an. Bist du bereit diese zu leben?

Stellenanforderungen

Das sind deine Superkräfte

  • Starkes Auftreten: Du hast einen gefestigten Charakter, Spaß an Verantwortung und bist selbstsicher im Umgang mit Menschen aller Hierarchieebenen ‒ auch in Verhandlungssituationen.
  • Kommunikationsgeschick: Du kommunizierst präzise und empfängerfreundlich. Potenzielle Konflikte entschärfst du durch Feingefühl und Lösungsorientierung. Gegenüber Kunden und deinem Team triffst du ‒ auch unter Zeitdruck ‒ stets den richtigen Ton and you can seamlessly switch to English if necessary.
  • Account Management: Du besitzt mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management und hast mindestens ein Jahr in einem technischen Umfeld gearbeitet. Komplexe Sachverhalte vermittelst du schriftlich wie mündlich versiert. Nice to have sind Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS sowie Erfahrung im Online-Marketing.
  • Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und kannst eigenverantwortlich Prioritäten setzen. Dank deiner ausgezeichneten Planung behältst du auch in Stresssituationen stets den Überblick und arbeitest im Homeoffice oder in Coworking-Spaces effektiv.
  • Hohe Motivation: Unsere Branche entwickelt sich ständig weiter. Um deine Kunden als Experte optimal zu beraten, verfolgst du daher laufend aktuelle Trends und hast Spaß daran, dich immer wieder eigenverantwortlich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Dieser Job ist NICHT für dich geeignet, wenn du

  • … weniger als 2 Jahre Berufserfahrungim Account Management hast.
  • … dich schwertust mit der Planung und Priorisierung deiner Aufgaben.
  • … keinen Spaß daran hast, (technische) Probleme im Detail zu analysieren und zu lösen.
  • … lieber ausschließlich schriftlich mit Kunden kommunizierst statt (auch) telefonisch.
  • … lieber an kurzweiligen Kundenanfragen arbeitest, als Kundenlangfristig und mit Fokus auf Portfolio-Wachstum zu betreuen.
  • … nicht den Anspruch hast, dein Expertenwissen laufend auszubauen oder.
  • ... dich nicht mit unseren identifizierst
  • ...nicht fließend Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. B2) in Wort und Schrift beherrschst (beide Sprachen sind Voraussetzung für diese Rolle).

Deine Benefits bei Digistore24

Bei Digistore24 sind wir überzeugt: Großartige Menschen leisten ihre beste Arbeit, wenn sie echte Autonomie, klare Ziele und ein unterstützendes Umfeld haben. Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • 100 % Remote: Arbeite dauerhaft von zu Hause aus. Alles, was du brauchst, ist eine stabile Internetverbindung.
  • Du bist permanent außerhalb Deutschlands ansässig? Auch das ist in Festanstellung in vielen europäischen Ländern möglich.
  • Arbeite bis zu 170 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland (weitere Länder nach Absprache ggf. möglich).
  • Nutze bis zu 3 Tage pro Woche die Coworking-Spaces unseres Partners.
  • 30 Urlaubstage auf Vollzeitbasis.
  • Klare Strukturen: Arbeiteim Gleitzeitmodell und in Absprache mit deinem Team.
  • Keine starren Entwicklungspläne: Deine Weiterentwicklung richtet sich individuell nach deinen Stärken. On the job setzt du dich mit modernen und relevanten Themen auseinander.
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege: Die Stabilität eines extrem erfolgreichen deutschen Hightech-Unternehmens, das sich seinen Start-Up-Spirit über die Jahre bewahrt hat.
  • Unsere Founder sind Teil unseres Teams: wir agieren ohne externe Investoren aus eigener Kraft und reinvestieren alles, was wir erwirtschaften.
  • Selbstbestimmte, ergebnisorientierte Teams: Arbeite in einer Unternehmenskultur, die auf Eigenverantwortung, Autonomie und direktes Feedback setzt, statt auf Micromanagement.
  • Du erhältst von uns modernes Equipment für deine Arbeit.
  • Internationale, kollaborative Kultur: Arbeite mit einem internationalen Team aus engagierten, klugen Köpfen zusammen.
  • Team Lunches mit Lieferando-Guthaben.
  • Echte menschliche Verbindung: Erlebe spektakuläre Team-Events in ganz Europa und baue Beziehungen auf, die über Bildschirme hinausgehen.
  • Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Bei uns bist du kein Rädchen im System, sondern ein wichtiger Teil eines A-Player-Teams und wirst von der Teamleitung persönlich gefördert (und gechallenged!), unter anderem in monatlichen One-on-One-Gesprächen. .
  • Arbeite in deinem Team per du, ohne Dresscode und auf Augenhöhe.

So sieht dein typischer Tag aus

  • Struktur ist alles: Zum Start screenst du alle Nachrichten. Auf dieser Grundlage priorisierst und planst du deine heutigen Aufgaben.
  • High-Prio-Tasks zuerst: Einer deiner Kunden hat dich gebeten, seinen Funnel zu optimieren. Du analysierst alle Parts, von der Verkaufsseite bis zur Bestellbestätigungsseite. Dank deiner Kenntnisse aus Schulungen sowie der detaillierten Checkliste siehst du das Verbesserungspotenzial. Zur Sicherheit besprichst du dich kurz mit deinem Team, damit sie ihre Erfahrungen beitragen können. Anschließend stimmst du dich mit dem Kunden zu deinen Empfehlungen ab.
  • Nun sind deine Messenger dran. Technische Fragen zu APIs, Upsell-Flows und Split-Tests beantwortest du im Handumdrehen – solche Grundlagen hast du bereits im Onboarding gelernt.
  • Jetzt steht ein virtueller Kaffee-Call an: Die nächsten 15 Minuten sind für einen entspannten Austausch beim Kaffee mit einer Teamkollegin reserviert.
  • Dich schreibt spontan ein VIP-Kunde an und bittet dich um Unterstützung bei einem technischen Problem, das dir neu ist. Du überlegst dir Lösungsvorschläge und postest diese im Team-Chat. Deine Kollegin meldet sich prompt mit Feedback. Gut zu wissen, dass dein Team dir Rückendeckung gibt 🙂
  • In deiner Mittagspause triffst du Freunde bei deinem Lieblings-Italiener um die Ecke. Diese Freiheit kannst du dir nehmen, weil du remote arbeitest, und die Pause natürlich frei gestalten kannst.
  • Mit frischem Kopf zurück steht ein Business-Review-Call an. Du bist super vorbereitet, denn du hast am Vortag den Funnel des Kunden analysiert und dir dazu Notizen gemacht. Nun hörst du dem Kunden zu, um mehr über seine Business-Ziele zu erfahren und ihn entsprechend zu unterstützen.
  • Zeit für den Check-In Call mit einer Kundin: Dir ist aufgefallen, dass sie ein verkaufsförderndes Digistore24-Feature noch nicht nutzt. Du berätst sie zu ihrem Umsatzwachstum-Potenzial und hilfst ihr beim Set-up. Dafür folgt ihr dem Prozess in unserer Wissensdatenbank – easy!
  • Als nächstes rufst du einer VIP-Kundin an, eine Ärztin, die Health-Coachings anbietet, sie hat morgen einen großen Launch, doch für ihren Kurs von der Produktgenehmigung ein Änderungswunsch gemeldet. Obwohl die Coaching-Szene umstritten ist, kennst du deine Kunden persönlich und weißt, dass wir dank deiner Kolleginnen in der Produktprüfung ausschließlich seriöse Angebote auf unserer Plattform haben. Du prüfst den Freigabeprozess. Der Grund ist schnell klar: Die Preise auf der Produktseite und im Bestellformular stimmen nicht überein. Nach der Anpassung informierst du das Produktgenehmigungsteam. Das Produkt geht online, deine Kundin ist dankbar, und Tausende von Menschen kommen ihren Gesundheitszielen näher.
  • It's time to grow: Demnächst steht ein internationales Kunden-Event an, bei dem du aus deiner Komfortzone gelockt wirst. Du wirst unsere VIP-Kunden live begleiten. Herzklopfen? Keine Sorge! Du wirst glänzen, denn du nimmst du dir eh täglich 10 Minuten Zeit, um die Historie deiner Kunden zu kennen und ihre aktuellen Projekte auf Social Media zu verfolgen. Eine “echte Verbindung” zu deinen Kunden ist dir schließlich sehr wichtig.
  • Heute steht außerdem noch ein AI-Workshop an. Ein AI-Consultant erklärt die Nutzung eines Tools, das Kundengespräche aufzeichnet und Action-Items zusammengefasst. So bleibst du bei unson top der modernsten Technologie.
  • Mit einem guten Gefühl gehst du in den Feierabend: Heute hast du wieder Neues gelernt und konstruktives Feedback von Kunden und Kollegen bekommen. Es ist einfach super zu sehen, was du bewegen kannst.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Hours: Full-time, salaried (40hrs/week), Mon-Fri, 7:30am-9pm ET rotating shifts and rotating Saturdays 7:00am-5pm ET

The Opportunity:

As a BlinkRx Pharmacist, you are the clinical backbone of our closed-door facility. You will verify prescriptions with speed and precision, provide proactive phone-based patient counseling, and collaborate with prescribers to keep medications moving without compromising safety. This role is ideal for pharmacists who thrive in a structured, high-throughput environment and are passionate about improving patient outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities:

Prescription Verification and Dispensing

  • Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy
  • Validate prescription data entry performed by pharmacy technicians, ensuring transcription accuracy from provider orders and transfer records
  • Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a closed-door fulfillment environment, confirming accuracy of drug, dose, quantity, NDC, and labeling prior to release for shipment
  • Perform daily prospective drug utilization review (DUR) to identify and resolve clinical flags before fulfillment
  • Manage specialty medication handling requirements including cold-chain verification

Patient Care

All patient interaction at BlinkRx is conducted by phone or digital platforms. Our pharmacists are the primary clinical contact for patients and must deliver a high standard of care in every call.

  • Provide proactive outbound patient counseling calls for new prescriptions, addressing drug education, expected side effects, dosing instructions, storage requirements, and adherence strategies
  • Handle inbound clinical patient calls related to counseling and clinical inquiries, while directing non-clinical inquiries, such as refill status and delivery questions, to the patient support team.
  • Document all patient interactions thoroughly in the patient profile within the pharmacy management system
  • Support Spanish-speaking patients with bilingual counseling where applicable

Prescriber Collaboration and Clinical Outreach

  • Contact prescriber offices via phone and electronic messaging to clarify incomplete, ambiguous, or clinically inappropriate prescriptions prior to dispensing
  • Partner with prescribers on therapeutic substitutions, DAW overrides, and formulary alternatives to reduce dispensing delays

Pharmacy Technician Supervision and Workflow Management

  • Supervise pharmacy technicians across data entry, prescription processing, packaging, and fulfillment workflows in accordance with state board regulations and in collaboration with technician management
  • Conduct real-time quality checks on technician work product, providing immediate corrective feedback to maintain accuracy standards
  • Identify and escalate technician performance trends to pharmacy leadership; participate in coaching and training as directed

Compliance, Safety and Quality

  • Ensure strict compliance with HIPAA, state pharmacy practice acts, federal DEA regulations, and all BlinkRx corporate policies
  • Oversee proper handling, documentation, and destruction of PHI-containing records and materials in alignment with privacy protocols
  • Participate in quality assurance activities including internal audits, prescription error tracking, and near-miss reporting
  • Report adverse drug events and medication errors through established pharmacovigilance channels, when applicable
  • Maintain fulfillment area compliance standards, including proper storage of temperature-sensitive medications

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with pharmacy leadership, patient services, clinical, compliance, and technology teams to drive operational and clinical improvements
  • Coordinate with the shipping and fulfillment team to resolve packaging errors, return-to-sender issues, and delivery failures affecting patient medication access
  • Provide clinical input on technology enhancements, workflow tools, and software configurations that affect the pharmacist verification or patient counseling experience
  • Participate in team huddles, quality reviews, and department meetings to support continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

Required

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy
  • Active Pharmacy License in good standing with your state Board of Pharmacy AND Idaho Board of Pharmacy
  • Active Missouri Pharmacy License in good standing with the Missouri Board of Pharmacy
  • Strong command of the English language (written and verbal); bilingual Spanish preferred for phone-based patient counseling
  • Demonstrated ability to perform high-volume prescription verification with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn pharmacy management systems, verification platforms, and internal workflow tools

Preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in a mail order, specialty, retail or closed-door fulfillment pharmacy
  • Active pharmacy licensure required in home state; candidates must obtain licensure in 3 additional states from the list below within the first 9 months of hire (prior licensure in any of the following states is a plus):
    • AK, AL, AR, CA, ID, IL, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, VA, WV
  • Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or adverse drug event reporting protocols

What Success Looks Like:

  • Prescription verification queues are processed accurately and on time without sacrificing clinical quality
  • Every patient who receives a counseling call feels informed, supported, and confident in their therapy
  • Prescriber outreach is proactive and efficient, minimizing dispensing delays caused by incomplete or unclear orders
  • Compliance and quality standards are upheld without exception in a fast-paced environment
  • You are a trusted clinical partner within the BlinkRx team — shaping the patient experience from behind the scenes

At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

About the Role

This is one of the most consequential hires we'll make this year. Proposals are how we grow the business and how the market sees us — every response is a sample of how Machinify thinks, writes, and competes. Done well, it compounds: better wins, better content, better positioning the next time we're in front of a buyer.

You'll sit on the Marketing team and operate as the connective tissue across Legal, Product, Operations, Finance, Clinical, and our broader subject matter community. The work spans state and federal government procurements (Medicaid RAC, Employee/Retiree, MCO oversight, FFS recovery audit) and commercial health plan opportunities — and we need someone who can move fluently between the two.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to format templates. We need a builder — someone who treats every proposal as an opportunity to raise the bar on the next one, and who is genuinely excited about using AI to do that work better and faster than was possible a year ago.

What You'll Do

Own the full proposal lifecycle, across government and commercial. Lead RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and ITBs from intake through submission. Government healthcare procurements will be a meaningful share of the work, alongside commercial health plan opportunities. Move fluently between the two.

Build an AI-first content engine. Use Claude (including Claude Cowork for desktop file and task workflows) and other AI tooling as a core part of how you work — not as a novelty. Build a structured, retrievable content repository. Draft, compare, and pressure-test sections against requirements. Reuse strong language without losing the specificity that wins. If your AI workflow stops at ChatGPT prompts, this isn't the right seat.

Orchestrate cross-functional SMEs. Most of the substance comes from people who don't write proposals for a living — clinical leaders, product managers, audit ops, legal, finance, security. Pull the right input from the right person at the right moment. Synthesize. Close the loop. Lead with the ask when you write to executives.

Tell the story. Hold the bar. Compliance is table stakes. Winning proposals read like the team actually understands the buyer's problem. Bring an eye for narrative — what to lead with, what to cut, how to make a 200-page government response feel inevitable. Develop a point of view on what makes or breaks each win, and bring it to the team.

Manage the process. Manage, simplify and automate review cycles, hold deadlines, coordinate pricing and legal sign-off, navigate procurement portals, own the submission. Maintain the content (AI/Claude) library post-submission so the next proposal starts further down the field. Treat ethics, confidentiality and information security as non-negotiable throughout.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years of proposal writing experience, including government healthcare RFPs. Ideally a good working knowledge of how state Medicaid procurements, RAC programs, FFS vs. MCO structures, and encounter auditing actually work.
  • Direct experience with payment integrity, claims audit, or healthcare cost containment.
  • Experience contributing to commercial health plan RFPs in addition to government work.
  • Familiarity with proposal management tools and content library platforms.
  • Strong written communication — including the ability to translate technical and clinical content into persuasive narrative, and to write tight executive summaries that lead with what matters.
  • An eye for storytelling, even inside a 200-page government response. Instinct for what makes or breaks a win — and a willingness to argue for it.
  • Strong project management instincts: scheduling, resource coordination, milestone tracking, and the judgment to know when to escalate.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools meaningfully in your day-to-day work — and curiosity to push further. We'll ask you about this.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, or related field (equivalent experience considered).
  • Comfort working independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with shifting priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to travel at least quarterly for team offsites.

Who You Are

  • Builder mindset. You see the content library, the AI workflow, and the SME process as products to improve — not just inputs to a deadline.
  • Collaborative by default. You get energy from pulling smart people together to produce something none of them would have produced alone.
  • AI-curious, not AI-credulous. You use these tools because they make the output better, and you know when not to trust them.
  • Calm under deadline pressure. Two procurements landing the same week doesn't break you.
  • Team-first. We're a small group inside a growing company. Culture is built in small moments — pitching in on someone else's deadline, sharing what you learned on the last submission, flagging risk early.

What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US — Machinify is digital-first
  • Top medical, dental, and vision offerings
  • FSA / HSA
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match, and meaningful equity
  • Flexible time off and additional health and wellness benefits
  • A trusting environment where you'll feel empowered to do your best work
The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range.

Position: Video Editor — Healthcare & Social Content

Salary: Up to NZD2,500/month (depending on experience)

Working Hours & Condition: New Zealand business hours

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are looking for an experienced remote Video Editor to transform the company's raw footage into engaging, high-performing digital content. The on-site team handles all filming — this role begins once footage is received. You will cut recordings of up to 90 minutes into short-form social content, educational clips, and video sales letters. All content must follow the company’s clinical and compliance approval processes before publishing.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Short-Form Social Media Editing

  • Edit long-form recordings into short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok — strong hooks, platform-appropriate pacing, vertical reframing, and branded overlays.
  • Produce alternative hooks and edits for content testing; translate complex medical information into clear, accessible content without altering its meaning.

Long-Form & VSL Editing

  • Edit raw consultation, procedure, and educational recordings into structured, professional videos — removing repetition and unsuitable material while preserving clinical context.
  • Edit video sales letters for landing pages — structure footage into a clear narrative covering the patient’s concern, the service, and the next step; produce alternative versions for testing.
  • Apply colour correction, audio enhancement, and image stabilisation; add approved intros, calls to action, and branded elements.

Graphics, Captions & Brand Consistency

  • Add accurate captions, branded lower thirds, callouts, and supporting graphics; maintain visual consistency across fonts, colours, and transitions.
  • Maintain reusable templates for recurring formats; check clinical terminology, practitioner names, and locations for accuracy.

Healthcare Compliance & Approvals

  • Follow company’s internal approval processes — no content published before required sign-off; use only approved language for treatments and procedures.
  • Identify potentially sensitive or non-compliant content and escalate promptly; handle patient footage and personal details confidentially.

Workflow & Performance

  • Manage multiple videos, revisions, and deadlines; maintain clear version control throughout the approval process.
  • Review performance data (retention, engagement, conversions) to improve future edits and support creative testing.

Requirements

Tools & Systems (Non-Negotiable):

  • Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro
  • After Effects or comparable motion-graphics software
  • CapCut or similar short-form editing software
  • Professional captioning and transcription tools
  • Cloud-based file storage and digital asset management systems
  • Project management and content approval tools
  • Canva, Instagram, TikTok, and WordPress or comparable CMS

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of professional video editing or post-production experience
  • Portfolio demonstrating long-form and short-form editing capability
  • Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and audience retention
  • Experience editing for Instagram Reels and TikTok; ability to produce VSLs for landing pages
  • Strong audio cleanup, colour correction, captioning, and export skills
  • Ability to edit medical or technical content accurately within compliance frameworks
  • Excellent attention to detail, strong written and spoken English, and ability to manage multiple remote projects
  • Hardware capable of efficiently processing and exporting high-resolution video

Preferred Skills (Nice To Have):

  • Previous experience editing for healthcare, medical, or regulated businesses
  • Familiarity with New Zealand healthcare advertising requirements
  • Motion graphics and animation experience
  • Experience producing paid social media video assets
  • Evidence of content that improved audience growth, engagement, or conversion

Job Description:

Senior Director / Vice President, Autonomous Vehicle & Robotics Operations


About the Role

TaskUs partners with the world's most innovative technology companies to power the data, safety, and human-in-the-loop operations behind AI. As autonomous driving and robotics programs move from pilots to commercial scale, our clients need a delivery partner that can run safety-critical operations around the clock with the rigor of an AV operator and the scale and agility of a leading BPO.

We are seeking a senior operator to build and lead our AV and Robotics Operations business. You will own end-to-end delivery, from perception data labeling and scenario QA to remote assistance, teleoperation, fleet support, and incident response, for leading autonomous vehicle and robotics customers. You will set the operating model, build the leadership bench, and be accountable for client outcomes, quality, safety, and P&L.


What You Will Do

  • Own delivery and P&L. Lead multi-site, multi-client AV and robotics programs with full accountability for revenue growth, gross margin, utilization, and client satisfaction.
  • Build the operating model. Design scalable, 24/7 workflows for remote assistance, teleoperation, fleet and depot support, data collection, annotation, simulation and scenario review, and edge-case triage.
  • Drive safety and quality. Establish safety-case-aligned processes, incident management, root-cause analysis, and audit readiness (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF/ISO 21448, UL 4600, ISO 3691-4 and relevant ANSI/RIA standards as applicable).
  • Partner with customers. Act as executive sponsor for strategic AV and robotics accounts; run QBRs, shape roadmaps, and translate evolving ODD, model, and fleet requirements into staffing, tooling, and process plans.
  • Scale talent. Recruit, train, and certify remote operators, fleet technicians, annotators, QA leads, and program managers; define career paths, competency frameworks, and fatigue and wellness standards for safety-critical roles.
  • Lead through technology and AI. Embed automation, ML-assisted labeling, tooling, and analytics to improve cost per task, latency, and accuracy; collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Security on platforms and integrations.
  • Expand the business. Partner with Sales, Solutions, and Strategy to develop new offerings (e.g., teleoperation-as-a-service, robotics data collection, humanoid and warehouse robotics support), pricing models, and go-to-market plans.
  • Manage risk and compliance. Ensure data security, privacy, and regulatory compliance across jurisdictions; maintain business continuity and surge capacity plans.
  • Lead the organization. Manage a global team of directors, program leaders, and site leads across onshore, nearshore, and offshore locations.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of operations leadership (15+ for VP), including 5+ years in autonomous vehicles, robotics, mobility, logistics automation, or other safety-critical, technology-driven operations.
  • Direct experience running remote assistance, teleoperation, fleet operations, or AV/robotics data operations, ideally at an AV operator (robotaxi or trucking), robotics company, or technology-enabled BPO.
  • Proven record of scaling operations from pilot to commercial deployment, with measurable improvements in safety, quality, cost, and throughput.
  • P&L ownership of a business of $50M+ (more for VP), with strong command of pricing, workforce planning, and unit economics.
  • Experience leading large, distributed workforces (500+) across multiple sites and geographies, including 24/7 shift operations.
  • Working knowledge of safety frameworks, incident response, and regulatory environments for autonomous systems.
  • Executive presence with technical customers; ability to engage credibly with engineering, safety, and product leaders.
  • Data-driven leadership style with fluency in operational metrics, SLAs, and continuous improvement (Lean/Six Sigma a plus).
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AV and robotics data pipelines: sensor data (LiDAR, camera, radar), HD maps, scenario libraries, simulation, and labeling tools.
  • Experience with humanoid, warehouse, or last-mile delivery robotics operations.
  • Background in BPO or managed services, including client transitions, vendor management, and global delivery.
  • Experience with M&A integration or building a new business line inside a larger enterprise.
  • Preferred location San Antonio.

Success Measures (First 12–18 Months)

  • Operating model, governance, and safety framework defined and adopted across all AV and robotics programs.
  • Leadership team in place; critical roles staffed and certified ahead of client ramps.
  • Target SLA, quality, and safety KPIs achieved on strategic accounts, with strong client NPS.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

jobs.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We're hiring a Senior Developer with deep mobile expertise for a small, self-contained innovation group (Initial three-month contract, with opportunity for extension or move to full-time). Working alongside a Product Manager and a web-focused developer, you will take an ambiguous business problem, turn it into a testable product bet, and build the smallest end-to-end experience that can generate meaningful evidence, often in roughly one to two weeks. You will bring early versions back to customers and the market validation group, gather feedback, and rapidly iterate through V1, V2, V3, and beyond. Once the concept is validated, the group will shift from proving the idea to determining what must change for it to become secure, reliable, scalable, and ready for handoff.

The group operates like an entrepreneurial startup within the larger organization and owns the path from problem discovery through rapid prototyping, customer and market validation, iterative development, and a validated proof of concept. From there, it determines what is required to harden and scale the product before handing it to the core product and engineering team.

The operating principle is simple: build to learn first, then build to scale. During validation, speed comes from controlling scope and making deliberate, reversible technical choices—not from designing the final production architecture before the opportunity is proven. Security, privacy, and responsible data handling remain non-negotiable throughout. Once an idea demonstrates value, you will work with our Core team at key technical integration points to harden, refactor, or redesign what is needed for scale. That judgment lets us discard weak ideas cheaply and invest deeply in the ones that earn it.

This is a fit for someone with strong product and commercial instincts, sound technical judgment, and a high degree of ownership. You identify gaps, propose a path forward, and keep momentum without waiting for perfect requirements. You own outcomes, make clear trade-offs to meet timelines, and raise consequential risks early.

What you'll do:

  • Work with the Project Lead, Product Manager and Web Developer to turn ambiguous problems into unified driver-and-admin experiences
  • Build the smallest end-to-end prototype that can test the idea, often within one to two weeks
  • Bring prototypes to customers and the market validation group, then rapidly translate feedback into V2, V3, and beyond
  • Challenge assumptions, cut scope, and keep the group moving without waiting for perfect requirements
  • Make deliberate, reversible technical choices during validation while protecting security, privacy, and data integrity
  • Build within the shared codebase, behind feature flags and in isolated modules that can be removed cleanly
  • Integrate with our platform backend and third-party APIs using existing contracts and patterns
  • Once a concept is validated, identify and complete the work required to harden, scale, test, and release it
  • Prepare validated features and technical context for a clean handoff to the core product and engineering team

What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 6–8 years as a software engineer at a senior level, with a track record of product work at startups and in fast-paced environments
  • You've built from nothing, cut scope under time pressure, and shipped
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you can take an unfamiliar domain and an under-specified problem and make progress without waiting to be handed a spec
  • Strong product thinker who can connect driver and administrator needs, commercial value, and technical choices across mobile and web
  • Strong communicator who identifies gaps, proposes a path forward, and keeps the work moving
  • High ownership, sound judgment under time pressure, and a track record of delivering against commitments without hiding material trade-offs
  • Comfortable working in a small, autonomous group where priorities can change quickly as new evidence emerges

Technical

  • Very comfortable with React Native, plus native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) development
  • Familiar with the full mobile release process for both iOS and Android, including store submission and review
  • Solid integrating against REST / backend APIs and handling auth, tokens, and SSO on device
  • Comfortable collaborating across mobile, web, and backend boundaries to create one coherent product experience
  • You adopt the existing patterns and conventions of the mobile codebase rather than introducing your own
  • You know how to code and understand good software design. You are not strictly a "vibe coder": you can reason about architecture and trade-offs, not just prompt your way to output

AI-Native Mindset

  • You've adopted modern AI development workflows and use tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot as part of how you ship
  • You understand AI skills, agents, and code-spec workflows, and how to use them without losing engineering rigour
  • You lean on AI to move faster on prototypes and to hold quality up during hardening

Bonus (nice to have)

  • Ability to flex onto the Portal stack (TypeScript / Next.js / NestJS / PostgreSQL) when a bet calls for it

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)
  • Extended medical & dental benefits
  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.

Refers to a computerized encoding system, written coding aids and other reference materials to ensure accurate coding for billing.
  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, and the Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS); adheres to the Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, Coding Clinic guidelines and other regulatory guidelines as appropriate. Consults with the CDCI team to request appropriate physician or appropriate medical staff to clarify medical record information.

  • Review and respond to coding questions.

  • Perform random chart audits.
  • Provide continual coding updates.
  • Research coding issues that arise.
  • Codes diagnoses and procedures from the medical record using ICD-10-CM and CPT-4/HCPCS classification systems.
  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, Medicare, Medicaid, and other fiscal intermediary guidelines.
  • Reviews charts for documentation and signature.
  • Performs other duties as needed.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

Location: Remote

Rate: $90-110/hr The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

About the role

We’re seeking a senior lifecycle and CRM leader to build a coordinated customer-growth capability for a digital-presence services business serving entrepreneurs, small businesses, freelancers, and customers building and managing an online presence. The portfolio spans domain registration, website creation, web hosting, professional email, security, and digital marketing solutions.

The business is evolving from product- and campaign-led communications toward a more integrated lifecycle model. You will assess the current state, define the highest-value customer journeys, and establish a practical roadmap connecting customer and account data, setup and service signals, marketing technology, content, measurement, and cross-functional execution.

The work should help customers move from purchasing a domain or digital service to successfully establishing, activating, managing, protecting, and growing their online presence. It should strengthen service activation, time to value, complementary-service adoption, renewal readiness, retention, expansion, and win-back. You will serve as a senior advisor while remaining hands-on in shaping the first wave of journeys, tests, and operating practices.

What You’ll Do

  • Assess the end-to-end digital-presence lifecycle. Map the experience from domain search and purchase through account setup, website creation and launch, hosting and professional email activation, security adoption, ongoing management, renewal, cancellation or lapse, win-back, and expansion into relevant adjacent services.
  • Build the lifecycle strategy and roadmap. Define lifecycle stages, customer and business outcomes, journey priorities, and a sequenced plan balancing immediate improvements with longer-term data, technology, content, and operating-model needs.
  • Design high-value customer journeys. Develop coordinated programs for onboarding, service activation, website launch, customer education, renewal preparation, lapse prevention, retention, service recovery, win-back, and expansion into complementary digital-presence services.
  • Advance segmentation and trigger strategy. Define actionable audiences and triggers using customer profile, domain and service purchases, setup milestones, website launch status, account activity, billing and renewal status, support interactions, engagement, and service-portfolio signals.
  • Connect CRM, service, and channel data. Determine the data, identity, consent, automation, and integration capabilities required to coordinate experiences across email, web, account experiences, service interactions, and other available channels.
  • Improve personalization and next-best-action decisions. Deliver relevant setup guidance, website-launch support, education, security and renewal reminders, complementary-service recommendations, and re-engagement based on where customers are in building and managing their online presence.
  • Establish experimentation and measurement. Define baselines, test plans, controls, and reporting for setup completion, service activation, website launch, time to value, multi-service relationships, engagement, renewal, lapse prevention, retention, win-back, customer value, and incremental commercial impact.
  • Create the lifecycle operating model. Clarify decision rights, ownership, intake, prioritization, approvals, production, reporting, and optimization across marketing, product, ecommerce, customer care, data, analytics, creative, and technology.

jobs.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.
- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.
- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.
- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the role

Flex moves real money at a serious scale, and someone has to make sure it only moves for the right reasons. We're hiring our first Financial Crimes Analysts to be that someone, and to build the function around them.

This is a net-new role. You'll report directly to the Head of Financial Crimes and work side by side with the people who designed our financial crime program. Once a customer is through the door, you own what happens next: monitoring their activity, investigating what looks wrong, deciding what is suspicious, and writing the narrative that backs the decision.

Your first priority will be working through our alert and case backlog and keeping the queue moving, which means a lot of hands-on investigation from day one. Our processes are still being built, so you'll also notice what's clunky, document it, and help simplify it. As the backlog comes under control, you'll have more room for bigger improvements. The scope is broader than a typical analyst role because the function is still taking shape, and the people who join first will set its standards and its reputation with our partners.

This is a strong fit if you have a few years of hands-on financial crimes experience, enjoy digging into cases, and want to grow from running a process into helping design one, with a clear path into broader program responsibilities as the team grows.

What you'll own

You'll be a core part of financial crime detection and investigation at Flex.

  • Post-onboarding risk. Own the question "is this customer's activity legitimate?" from the moment an alert fires to the moment it is cleared, escalated, or filed.

  • The queue and the backlog. Your first priority is working through our alert backlog and keeping the queue current, with an eye on both quality and speed, so real risk gets the scrutiny it deserves and good customers aren't slowed down by noise.

  • The investigation standard. Help set the bar for what a strong case narrative looks like here: clear, well supported, and defensible to a regulator or bank partner without a follow-up call.

  • Detection coverage. Flag the typologies, patterns, and blind spots you see across cases and bring them to Risk, Operations, and Engineering, so they can become better rules and fewer false positives.

  • The process. Document what works and flag what's clunky as you go. As the backlog comes under control, you'll have room to take on bigger improvements.

  • Your voice. As one of the first official Financial Crimes Analysts at Flex, you'll see where the process works and where it doesn't, and you'll have a real voice in how the team grows.

What you'll do

Detect and decide

  • Review and disposition transaction monitoring alerts, applying BSA/AML typologies to separate genuinely suspicious activity from false positives

  • Investigate unusual activity across accounts, payments, and cards, including patterns that point to money laundering, fraud, account takeover, and other illicit behavior

  • Escalate higher-risk cases to supervisory review with a clear recommendation, not just a pile of facts

  • Support UAR and SAR filings, working alongside senior team members and building toward owning filings end to end

Investigate and document

  • Write case narratives so clear and well supported that a reviewer, examiner, or bank partner can follow your reasoning without a call

  • Conduct enhanced due diligence on existing customers whose activity raises concerns, and refresh customer risk profiles when behavior no longer matches what we were told at onboarding

  • Pick up cases handed over by our KYC team when a flagged account needs a deeper activity review, and hand back what you learn so onboarding decisions get sharper

  • Keep accurate, complete records in our case management system

Build the program

  • Help flag the patterns and process gaps behind noisy alerts or missed risk, and help turn them into better detection rules and simpler procedures

  • Partner with Risk, Operations, Support, and Engineering to close open requests and, over time, tune monitoring

  • Support quality assurance and file reviews, including for our bank partner program

  • Stay current on evolving AML typologies and regulatory guidance, and bring what you learn back to the team

What we're looking for

You're comfortable with ambiguity, you make sound calls with incomplete information, and you can work a high-volume queue without losing quality.

You have

  • 1–3 years in BSA/AML compliance, transaction monitoring, fraud operations, or a related financial crimes role

  • Hands-on experience dispositioning transaction monitoring alerts in a platform such as Sardine, Unit21, Actimize, or similar, with a working knowledge of AML typologies

  • Exposure to fintech, payments, card programs, or BaaS program compliance

  • Experience tuning detection rules or working with data and SQL to investigate patterns

  • Working knowledge of KYC/CDD requirements and BSA obligations

  • Exposure to suspicious activity reporting, including drafting narratives or supporting UAR/SAR filings

  • Strong written communication: you can explain why something is or isn’t suspicious in plain language and summarize complex findings concisely

  • High attention to detail, plus the ability to manage a queue and prioritize well

  • A self-driven, growth mindset: you don’t wait to be handed the next problem, and when you see a clunky step or a noisy rule, you fix it and write down the better way

Bonus points

  • CAMS or another AML certification, completed or in progress

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.
Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.
Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.
True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.
Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.
High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.
Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.
Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.

Governance & Reporting

Role: Actuarial Forecasting Lead

Duration: 12 months C2H

Location: Remote USA

Start Date: ASAP

Description:

12-15 years experienced Actuarial Forecasting Lead who understands claims behaviour, loss development and the financial performance of insurance and protection products. The person should be able to work closely with actuarial, finance and technology teams to strengthen claims projections, loss estimates and actuarial modelling capabilities.

Experience:

  • Strong experience in actuarial modelling, claims frequency and severity analysis, loss ratio projections and claims cost estimation.
  • Good understanding of extended warranty, device protection, service contracts or specialty insurance products.
  • Experience in claims reserving, loss development analysis and ultimate loss projections.
  • Hands on experience in building and reviewing actuarial models using historical claims experience, exposure data, product mix and cost assumptions.
  • Understanding of repair and replacement costs, claim incidence rates, product failure patterns and their impact on loss projections.
  • Experience with actuarial and analytical tools.
  • Exposure to statistical modelling, and AI ML techniques applied to claims and loss estimation.
  • Experience working with actuarial, claims, underwriting and finance teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Review existing actuarial forecasting models, methodologies and assumptions used to project warranty claims, device failures and replacement demand.
  • Analyse historical claims, failure rates, product behaviour, repair and replacement patterns to understand the factors influencing future claims volumes.
  • Assess the reliability of actuarial forecasts and identify gaps in modelling approaches, data quality and underlying assumptions.
  • Evaluate and recommend suitable statistical, actuarial and predictive modelling techniques to improve forecast accuracy.
  • Work with actuarial, supply chain, data science and engineering teams to improve forecasting models and ensure their outputs meet supply chain planning needs.
  • Validate forecast results through actual-versus-expected analysis, back-testing and scenario analysis.
  • Lead functional discussions, model validation, and business acceptance of the forecasting solution.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Professional actuarial qualifications or progress towards actuarial certification would be an added advantage, but are not mandatory.
  • Practical experience in actuarial modelling, claims forecasting and applying actuarial projections to business planning is essential

Job Description:

Data Governance Analyst

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Data Governance Analyst will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's data governance framework so that data is managed and protected as a strategic enterprise asset and to accelerate CMM modernization efforts. This role acts as a Data Standards Architect, defining and documenting data standards, definitions, and structures across systems, and works closely with legal, compliance, security, and business stakeholders to ensure data is handled in accordance with privacy, security, retention, classification, and regulatory requirements. This role also ensures alignment with Judiciary policies, practices, and the current Data Governance Roadmap, and fosters a data driven culture across the AO and local courts.

The Data Governance Analyst will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the CMM Data Governance framework, policies, standards, procedures, and operating models.
  • Serve as a Data Standards Architect, define, document, and maintain data standards, naming conventions, data definitions, data structures, reference data, and governance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain data governance standards aligned with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, records management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models.
  • Partner with Data Stewards, Data Owners, business stakeholders, security, privacy, legal, records management, and technology teams to operationalize governance requirements.
  • Ensure data assets are appropriately classified and managed based on sensitivity, criticality, and business value.
  • Support compliance with data privacy, security, retention, classification, records management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate policies and regulatory requirements into actionable data governance controls and procedures.
  • Identify governance gaps, risks, and areas of non-compliance and coordinate remediation activities.
  • Support data access, sharing, usage, and lifecycle governance processes.
  • Participate in governance councils, working groups, and data domain forums.
  • Develop governance documentation, standards, procedures, decision logs, and supporting artifacts.
  • Monitor adoption and effectiveness of governance policies and standards.
  • Support governance-related assessments, audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Contribute to the development of data governance roadmaps, maturity assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the data stewardship program by defining data ownership roles, responsibilities, and RACI models across business and technical teams.
  • Develop training materials and deliver awareness sessions on data governance policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Track, analyze, and report data governance program metrics, maturity, and compliance status to leadership and governance councils.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MA/MS degree with 5+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in supporting enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience translating governance policy into practical operational processes in delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of data quality management, metadata practices, and stewardship models.
  • Experience governing high-sensitivity or regulated data with clear compliance expectations.
  • Experience with data quality profiling and monitoring techniques and common tooling patterns.
  • Experience defining and governing enterprise data standards across multiple teams and delivery pods.
  • Strong background in data modeling, integration patterns, and change data capture concepts.
  • Experience with metadata and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, or Qlik.
  • Practical experience implementing glossary and lineage capabilities in modern data platforms.
  • Ability to translate technical metadata into business-friendly definitions and documentation.
  • Experience implementing data privacy controls in regulated or high-sensitivity environments.
  • Experience with access management and operationalizing privacy requirements.
  • Experience partnering with security, governance, and engineering teams to implement compliant data sharing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Federal Government or regulated environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models.
  • Data management certification.
