jobs.excerpt: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
jobs.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

Senior Quality Automation Engineer

About Authenticx
Authenticx is a fast-growing, venture-backed, enterprise AI company transforming healthcare through conversation intelligence. We help healthcare organizations uncover insights hidden in millions of customer interactions to improve patient, member, and business outcomes.

Role Summary
The Senior Quality Automation Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and integrating automated tests across Authenticx's healthcare conversation intelligence platform. You will translate customer workflows, product requirements, user personas, and healthcare realities into automated coverage that protects the experiences that matter most. You will own automation for critical product areas and prioritize coverage based on customer impact, product risk, release frequency, and business value.
You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to improve product quality, testability, and release confidence. We are looking for someone who brings strong technical judgment, product sense, curiosity, and ownership to quality engineering in a fast-paced startup environment.

What You'll Do
Build Automation Around Real Customer Use Cases
• Learn how Authenticx customers use the platform across healthcare quality, coaching, compliance, operations, analytics, and customer experience workflows.
• Translate workflows, acceptance criteria, production issues, and known risk areas into meaningful automated test scenarios.
• Determine what should be automated, which testing layer is most appropriate, and the level of coverage needed.
• Balance UI, API, integration, and data-level testing to create reliable and maintainable coverage.

Build and Maintain Automated Coverage
• Design, write, maintain, and troubleshoot automated tests for UI workflows, APIs, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, reporting, and AI-powered features.
• Build and maintain smoke, regression, acceptance, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
• Use Playwright to automate critical user journeys and product workflows.
• Use Bruno/Postman to validate APIs, payloads, integrations, authentication, error handling, and backend behavior.
• Use SQL to validate data accuracy, workflow integrity, processing outcomes, reporting outputs, and customer-facing analytics.
• Build reusable automation utilities, fixtures, helpers, and test data patterns.
• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide earlier and more reliable quality signals.
• Investigate flaky tests, environmental issues, timing problems, and test-data failures, and distinguish them from true product defects.
• Identify high-risk coverage gaps and build automation to address them.

Partner Cross-Functionally to Improve Quality
• Work with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to understand requirements, risks, and real-world usage.
• Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, logging, test data setup, and API contracts.
• Use logs, monitoring tools, database queries, API responses, and product data to investigate failures and validate system behavior.
• Communicate defects, automation gaps, and release risks clearly.
• Share automation patterns and testing practices that strengthen the broader quality engineering discipline.

Validate AI-Powered Product Experiences
• Build automated validation for classifications, model outputs, prompt and configuration changes, structured responses, extraction workflows, and downstream behavior.
• Develop repeatable test scenarios for deterministic and semi-deterministic AI behaviors.
• Validate expected outputs, required fields, edge cases, failure conditions, and downstream workflow impacts.
• Use representative test data and known expected outcomes to detect regressions.
• Partner with Data Science and Engineering to improve the testability and regression coverage of AI-powered features.

Required Qualifications
• 5+ years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering, with hands on ownership of automated suites
• Production level coding in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, or Python
• Playwright or equivalent modern UI automation on complex web applications
• REST API testing (Bruno, Postman, or code based), covering authentication, payload validation, and error handling
• SQL proficiency to validate data integrity and processing outcomes
• CI/CD integration, including failure triage, flaky test diagnosis, and test data management
• Ability to assess product risk and choose the right test layer (UI, API, or data) without having every case defined for you
• Experience validating asynchronous, multi service workflows

Preferred Qualifications

• C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, and Azure

  • Experience testing LLM or ML features using representative datasets, expected outcomes, and threshold based regression checks
    • Ingestion pipelines, event driven systems, and third party integrations
    • Healthcare, contact center, or regulated environment experience
    • AI assisted development tools for test creation and debugging

We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Procurement, you will serve as the quarterback for major commercial deals—structuring RFPs, negotiating complex equipment supply agreements, and orchestrating inputs across Development, Engineering, Construction, Project Finance, and Legal to bring bankable contracts across the finish line.


Success here hinges on decisive inter-departmental leadership, meticulous organization, and commercial composure under pressure.   • Maintain calmness and constructive focus under adversity, resolving commercial deadlocks, supply chain bottlenecks, and schedule pressures without sacrificing long-term partnership value.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of experience procuring major equipment (specifically gas generation equipment, turbines, transformers, BESS, wind, or solar) and negotiating EPC or equipment supply contracts for utility-scale power or data center projects.

  • Demonstrated transaction leadership with the ability to take complete ownership of a deal, manage complex task lists with accuracy and attention to detail, and guide cross-functional teams without formal authority.

  • Strong quantitative analysis and executive communication skills, with high proficiency in Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Excel, and Slack to model commercial scenarios and present clear recommendations.

jobs.title: Global Legal Associate: Fintech and Compliance
jobs.excerpt: RemoFirst is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams.
jobs.description:
RemoFirst is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.

We are a small but strong team of 200+ people (and growing) hyper-focused on delivering a world-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry-leading partnerships.

As Global Legal Associate, Fintech & Compliance, you'll be the legal partner to our Product, Engineering and Finance teams on everything that moves money: payroll funding, contractor payouts, cross-border payments, deposits and FX. You'll get involved early, turn regulation into clear product requirements and help us launch quickly without creating regulatory risk. You'll also help run the fintech compliance programme that keeps those products sound once they're live.

What you'll do

Product:

  • Work with Product and Engineering from discovery through launch on payments, payroll and payout features.
  • Assess how money flows should be structured, for example whether a flow triggers licensing requirements (money transmission, e-money or payment services) and how to meet or design around them.
  • Turn regulatory requirements into clear, practical product requirements.
  • Draft and maintain product terms, payment terms, disclosures and in-product legal text.
  • Draft, review and help negotiate agreements with partner banks, payment providers and FX partners.
  • Carry out legal reviews for launches in new markets and for new payment features.
  • Help make balanced risk calls and propose compliant alternatives rather than simply blocking work.

Fintech compliance:

  • Support the development and day-to-day running of the compliance framework for our payment activities, including AML/CTF, KYC/KYB and sanctions screening.
  • Help assess licensing and registration needs across markets and our obligations under partner bank and financial institutions arrangements.
  • Help draft and maintain policies, controls, transaction monitoring and regulatory reporting.
  • Support engagement with regulators, auditors, financial institutions and banks' compliance teams.
  • Keep track of regulatory change in payments, data protection and AI, and assess the impact on our products.
  • Train internal teams on compliance obligations and build a culture where risk is raised early.

Requirements

  • A law degree and qualification to practise in at least one jurisdiction.
  • 3-5 years of legal experience in payments or fintech, either in-house or at a law firm with a strong payments practice.
  • Hands-on experience advising product teams, including at least one product or market launch you supported from design to go-live.
  • Solid knowledge of payments regulation (e.g. PSD2/EMD in the EU and UK, US money transmission rules) and AML/CTF requirements.
  • Experience working with banks or payment providers and negotiating the related agreements.
  • The ability to explain complex rules in plain language and give clear, practical advice.
  • Good judgement on risk, and comfort making decisions with incomplete information in a fast-moving environment.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payroll, EOR, HR tech or global workforce platforms.
  • Experience with license applications or regulator engagement.
  • Knowledge of data protection (GDPR) and AI regulation as they apply to financial and HR products.
  • Experience building a compliance function from an early stage.

Benefits

  • Startup environment: RemoFirst is an early-stage startup. You have a voice that can influence, and grow rapidly. An opportunity to build a tech unicorn.
  • Growth opportunity: This is a chance to join an AI-forward company driving innovation through artificial intelligence.
  • Direct impact: Your work will be at the center of how we grow revenue, support customers, and differentiate in the market.
  • Autonomy and Accountability: We value autonomy and accountability — there’s no bureaucracy or lengthy approval process. We prioritize speed and results to keep moving forward effectively.
  • Work for a Market Leader: Scale a project that counts market-leading companies like Microsoft, Mastercard, and more as happy customers.
  • Leadership visibility: Reporting into the Senior Global Product Operations Manager which means your projects will be strategic and business-critical.
  • Compensation and perks are great: Competitive compensation. 100% remote work.
  • Culture: You will get to work with some of the best colleagues coming from top tech companies. We lead with respect, kindness, and the right to fail. We value hard yet smart work. Diversity and inclusion are part of our DNA. As we grow and evolve, we welcome your input to help us define our culture further.

jobs.title: Internal Medicine Physician - Remote Clinical Case Review
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-based physicians open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified with the issuing medical board);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not fit to medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $70/hr. Because payment is per approved task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

jobs.title: Hospital Inpatient Coder
jobs.excerpt: Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence.
jobs.description:
Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence. Cedars Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 years in a row for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We were also awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. This annual award recognizes hospitals and health systems nationwide that have outstanding levels of employee engagement. We offer an amazing benefits package that includes paid time off, health care and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News & World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.

What you will be doing in this role:

Working under the general direction of a coding supervisor, the Hospital Inpatient Coder is responsible for the assignment of ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes by reviewing all appropriate documentation in accordance with standard coding guidelines. The Facility Inpatient Coder identifies the principal diagnosis, comorbidities/complications, present on admission indicators, and determines sequencing of codes to calculate the most appropriate DRG representing the patient stay. The role maintains knowledge of both Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Groups (MS-DRG) and All Patient Refined Diagnosis Related Groups (APR-DRG) is required. Additionally, the incumbents maintain knowledge of appropriate capture of codes for statistical purposes such as Social Determinants of Health (SDOH), Hierarchical Conditions (HCC), and severity impacting conditions.

  • Reviews medical documentation/health information within various electronic medical/health system(s) and assigns applicable codes (ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS) within productivity and quality standard for area(s) of assignment/specialty (Facility or Professional).
  • Abstracts all required data elements for reporting and statistical capture in a timely and accurate manner into the applicable system using the applications appropriate to the work assignment. This may include but not limited to: EPIC (CS-Link), EPIC HB and PB modules, Solventum 360Encompass, Solventum Standalone Encoder, Select Coder, etc.
  • Applies basic knowledge of industry requirements of specific category coding and the impact (SDOH, PSI).
  • Resolves complex inpatient edits/alerts with consistent accuracy using current guidelines within area(s) of assignment/specialty
  • Communicates with Clinical Documentation Integrity Team members regarding complex clinical scenarios to ensure all relevant codes are assigned
  • Focuses learning on advanced level concepts
  • Translates medical records/health information including diagnoses, procedures and treatment and assigns standardized codes (International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-10-CM), International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, and Procedure Coding System (ICD-10-PCS) for patients receiving services within the Cedars Sinai Health System and its affiliates.
  • Communicates collaboratively with the Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) team to align both clinical and coding approaches to ensure a complete coding profile. References anatomy, physiology, and clinical practice to support code assignment and contribute to CDI discussions.
  • Abstracts data elements to satisfy statistical requests by the health system, medical staff, and enters all coded/abstracted information into the assigned system. Identifies opportunities for documentation improvement and seeks clarity by the physicians.

*Approved Remote States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, Texas*

  • Support auditability and implement approval checkpoints for automated financial actions.

  • Troubleshoot integration issues and support end-to-end testing.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

The Distributor Account Executive is responsible for driving sales growth across assigned distributor accounts while building and maintaining long-term strategic business relationships. This role serves as a primary point of contact for distributor partners, supporting product education, promotional initiatives, sales planning, customer satisfaction, and market development.


The Distributor Account Executive works closely with distributor management and sales teams, Neogen Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and other internal partners to increase product awareness, strengthen distributor engagement, expand market share, and achieve assigned revenue goals.

Distributor Relationship Management and Sales

  • Manage and develop relationships with assigned distributor accounts through telephone, email, virtual meetings, and in-person engagement.
  • Promote Neogen products and communicate product features, benefits, applications, and updates to distributor partners.
  • Develop and execute account and territory sales plans designed to increase revenue, market penetration, market share, and profitability.
  • Build relationships with distributor management, inside sales representatives, and outside sales representatives.
  • Maintain consistent communication with distributors to monitor customer satisfaction, identify opportunities, and resolve concerns.
  • Identify opportunities to expand product adoption within existing distributor accounts.
  • Quote approved pricing and support customers through the sales process.
  • Meet or exceed assigned sales and revenue objectives.
  • Support the sales efforts of other Neogen team members as needed.

Distributor Training and Enablement

  • Deliver product presentations and training to distributor inside and outside sales teams.
  • Educate distributor representatives on Neogen products, applications, promotions, and sales opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with distributor sales representatives using distributor rosters, directories, and CRM information.
  • Provide distributor teams with information and resources needed to effectively position and sell Neogen products.

  • Partner with distributor management to develop, secure commitment to, and execute marketing programs and promotional initiatives.

Customer and Market Insights

  • Document customer questions, product requests, feedback, and potential opportunities.
  • Review industry publications and market information to remain current on industry developments.

  • Complete applicable sales call reports, account documentation, and other required reporting.

Trade Shows and Industry Engagement

  • Experience developing or supporting sales plans, account strategies, or business-development activities.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience using a CRM system.
  • Ability to calculate discounts, markups, margins, commissions, percentages, proportions, and sales volume.
  • Ability to prepare business correspondence, sales reports, presentations, and customer communications.
  • Ability to communicate product, sales, and business information effectively to customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet applicable travel requirements.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25–30%, including overnight travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing distributor or channel partner relationships.
  • Experience working with distributor inside and outside sales teams.
  • Experience developing distributor promotions, sales campaigns, or joint business plans.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to develop and execute account and territory sales strategies.
  • Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to analyze sales performance, market information, and customer trends.
  • Strong presentation and training skills.
  • Ability to influence and engage distributor sales teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and initiatives simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with internal and external partners.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to use CRM and other business systems to document activity, manage opportunities, and support reporting requirements.

Sales Activity Expectations

This position requires consistent distributor and customer engagement. The Distributor Account Executive is expected to maintain documented sales activity, customer visits, and distributor engagement in accordance with established sales leadership expectations and business needs.


Travel and Work Location

This is a remote position requiring regular communication and collaboration with distributor partners, customers, and internal Neogen teams.

Approximately 25–30% overnight travel is required. Travel may include distributor locations, customer meetings, trade shows, industry events, training activities, and other business-related travel.


The position requires the ability to obtain rental transportation and any applicable vendor licenses or registrations required by regulatory or state agencies.


Physical Demands

The physical demands described are representative of those required to successfully perform the responsibilities of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.


The employee is regularly required to communicate, use a computer and other office equipment, and perform work from a seated or standing position. The role may occasionally require walking, bending, reaching, or other physical movement associated with travel, customer visits, trade shows, and business activities.


The employee must be able to occasionally lift, carry, push, or move items weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Neogen is a global company focused on protecting the world’s food supply. We provide products and solutions that support food safety, animal safety, and related industries, helping customers detect risks, improve quality, and protect both people and animals.


At Neogen, we believe that taking care of our employees allows them to do their best work. When you join our team, you'll enjoy competitive benefits and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference every day.

Freight Brokerage Sales Representative
Location:Remote, United States
Job Type:Full-Time, Direct Hire
Work Arrangement:Fully Remote

Position Overview

The Freight Brokerage Sales Representative is responsible for generating new business, developing shipper relationships, and building a profitable book of freight brokerage accounts.

This is a fully remote role for a proven sales hunter who can independently manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, pricing, proposal development, negotiation, account onboarding, and long-term relationship management.

The ideal candidate brings freight brokerage or transportation sales experience, strong outbound prospecting skills, and a demonstrated ability to build customer accounts from the ground up. An active or partially transferable book of business is strongly preferred but not required.

Key Responsibilities
  • Identify, prospect, and develop new shipper accounts across the United States
  • Build a consistent pipeline through cold calling, email outreach, networking, referrals, social selling, and industry relationships
  • Engage transportation, procurement, operations, logistics, and supply chain decision-makers
  • Conduct discovery calls to understand freight volumes, lanes, equipment needs, service challenges, and pricing expectations
  • Develop customized truckload and freight brokerage solutions based on customer requirements
  • Prepare pricing recommendations, lane analyses, proposals, and customer presentations
  • Negotiate rates and commercial terms while protecting company profitability
  • Manage customer relationships from initial outreach through shipment execution and account growth
  • Coordinate with operations, dispatch, carrier sales, safety, accounting, and leadership teams to onboard and support new accounts
  • Identify additional lanes, facilities, and transportation opportunities within existing accounts
  • Resolve service, scheduling, pricing, claims, documentation, and billing issues
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, sales activity, opportunities, forecasts, revenue, shipment volume, and gross profit
  • Monitor truckload capacity, fuel costs, carrier availability, seasonal trends, and lane-specific market conditions
  • Collaborate with asset-based operations to identify freight that aligns with available company equipment
  • Develop brokerage solutions for overflow freight, specialized equipment needs, out-of-network lanes, and customer capacity gaps
  • Follow company procedures related to carrier qualification, insurance, fraud prevention, credit approval, and customer onboarding

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of freight brokerage, transportation, third-party logistics, or supply chain sales experience
  • Proven success generating new business through outbound prospecting
  • Experience managing a complete business-to-business sales cycle
  • Strong understanding of truckload pricing, carrier capacity, lane markets, and shipment execution
  • Ability to build relationships with manufacturers, distributors, retailers, contractors, and other freight-shipping organizations
  • Strong cold-calling, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills
  • Ability to work independently and remain productive in a fully remote environment
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills
  • Experience using CRM and transportation management systems
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, virtual meeting platforms, email, and online prospecting tools
  • Strong professional communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
  • Active or partially transferable book of shipper business
  • Consistent history of producing monthly gross profit
  • Existing relationships with transportation and supply chain decision-makers
  • Experience selling flatbed, open-deck, dry van, specialized, bulk, project, or truckload freight
  • Background with an asset-based carrier, freight brokerage, or third-party logistics provider
  • Experience developing accounts from initial cold outreach through long-term customer growth
  • Knowledge of customer credit, carrier compliance, claims, and freight-market pricing
  • Experience selling transportation services nationwide

You tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex what you want, and it sets up the database, auth, functions, storage, realtime and deploys on Volcano without a trip through a dashboard. This role sits between engineering and the developers we build for. You'll build on Volcano constantly, show people what it can do, and bring back what you learn so the product gets better.

jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Position Summary:

At BMS, the Director, Real-World Data Strategy sits at the intersection of business strategy, data intelligence, and AI-driven innovation, serving as a key member of the enterprise Real-World Data (RWD) Strategy team. This is a business-first role powered by data and accelerated by artificial intelligence. The Director is responsible for translating BMS's most pressing business and R&D priorities into sharp, actionable RWD strategies, and for leading the team's adoption and application of AI to reshape how the organization identifies, evaluates, acquires, and deploys real-world data assets to drive evidence generation, competitive differentiation, and patient impact.


This role is expected to be the AI innovation driver on the enterprise RWD Strategy team, someone who brings a high AI IQ, actively identifies where AI unlocks new strategic value, and sets the standard for how AI thinking is embedded in the team's work and in service of BMS customers and partners.

As part of an enterprise-wide team, this Director will serve as a connector between the external RWD and AI landscape and BMS's internal needs, ensuring that every data and technology investment is grounded in clear business value and strategic alignment. Success in this role requires deep domain expertise, AI fluency and curiosity, executive presence, rigorous analytical thinking, and a relentless focus on outcomes for the business.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Leadership & Innovation:

  • Serve as the team's AI innovation lead, setting direction for how artificial intelligence and advanced analytics are integrated into RWD strategy, data evaluation, market intelligence, and evidence generation.
  • Proactively identify, evaluate, and champion AI-enabled data opportunities and emerging technologies that enhance RWD exploration, dataset assessment, and strategic decision-making at scale.
  • Translate the rapidly evolving AI and data science landscape into practical, high-impact applications aligned with BMS R&D priorities and pipeline needs.
  • Model AI-forward thinking across the team and for customers, building shared literacy, frameworks, and best practices that elevate the team's collective AI capability.
  • Align novel AI-driven research ideas with available RWD assets to accelerate exploratory use cases, enabling faster, smarter data-driven decisions across the enterprise.

Business-Driven Strategy & Prioritization:

  • Champion and communicate a forward-looking RWD exploration strategy that is anchored in BMS business priorities, translating R&D needs, pipeline goals, and evidence gaps into targeted data investment and exploration decisions.
  • Synthesize inputs from RWD users, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners to define and evolve strategic priorities, ensuring every data initiative is tied to measurable business value.
  • Develop and present clear, executive-ready business cases for RWD investments, acquisitions, and licensing decisions, balancing strategic ambition with budget realities and portfolio needs.

Data Landscaping & Opportunity Identification:

  • Monitor and interpret the global RWD ecosystem, including emerging datasets, vendors, technologies, AI platforms, partnerships, and market trends, through a business lens, connecting evolving research questions and R&D needs with differentiated data sources and novel use cases.
  • Lead rigorous evaluation and piloting of priority RWD sources, assessing fitness, quality, coverage, differentiation, and applicability, and translating findings into clear investment or adoption recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Establish scalable assessment frameworks, dashboards, and methodologies that enable consistent, repeatable evaluation and prioritization of RWD opportunities across the enterprise portfolio.

Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Collaboration:

  • Drive high-visibility engagement with senior leaders and cross-functional teams through a hub model of ongoing consultations, ensuring transparent, interactive strategy development processes that build trust and alignment.
  • Collaborate across Strategy, Acquisition, Data Product, Governance, Customer Success, and R&D stakeholder groups to convert exploration insights into actionable data, investment, partnership, and portfolio decisions.
  • Serve as a thought leader across the enterprise RWD Strategy team, contributing to shared capabilities, best practices, and strategic frameworks, with particular emphasis on AI integration, that elevate the team's collective impact.

Partner & Vendor Development:

  • Identify, assess, and engage RWD data providers and external partners to evaluate differentiated partnership opportunities that address emerging or unmet data needs, including AI-powered data and analytics platforms.
  • Lead assessment of RWD partners for comprehensive data development capabilities, ensuring partnerships create clear, lasting strategic advantage for BMS.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Advanced degree in health research, life sciences, data science, quantitative sciences, or a related field. PhD preferred but not required.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in real-world healthcare data, data strategy, market intelligence, life sciences, or consulting, with a demonstrated track record of translating complex business and scientific problems into data-driven strategies and outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI and advanced analytics in an RWD, life sciences, or data strategy context, including familiarity with generative AI, machine learning, or AI-enabled data tools.
  • Proven ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior leaders in a complex, matrixed life sciences organization.
  • Deep expertise in RWD sources, data evaluation approaches, research and analytic applications, and the evolving external RWD ecosystem.
  • Significant experience engaging with RWD vendors and data partners, including negotiating and shaping strategic relationships.

Skills & Competencies:

  • AI fluency and innovation mindset: Ability to identify, evaluate, and operationalize AI-driven opportunities that create tangible value for RWD strategy and enterprise customers. Expected to be a visible AI champion within the team.
  • Business acumen: Strong ability to frame data and AI opportunities in terms of business value, pipeline impact, and investment return.
  • Strategic thinking and executive communication: Ability to synthesize complex data, AI, and market intelligence into concise, compelling recommendations that influence senior decision-making.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience building evaluation frameworks and investment cases.
  • Familiarity with analytic platforms, federated environments, and AI/data science approaches relevant to RWD access and exploration.
  • Knowledge of RWD compliance requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.), including emerging considerations for AI use in healthcare data contexts.
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with comfort operating in a fast-changing, cross-functional enterprise environment.

You will protect both. On the legacy side, you will keep a Java, Oracle, and Red Hat environment hardened, patched, and compliant. Because work can shift between the two, we're looking for someone comfortable moving between sustaining an existing system and securing a new one.

This is a client-facing role. You will be the program's named security lead, working with the client's technical leads, our Project Manager, and the engineering team, and translating security requirements into practical decisions that keep delivery moving.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. Responsibilities:

Vulnerability Management & Security Operations

  • Run automated vulnerability scans of operating systems, databases, and web applications, and lead remediation and patching across Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Oracle, Apache/Tomcat, and Java application components.

  • Meet contractual remediation timelines for scan and penetration test findings (15 days for critical, 30 for high, 60 for medium, 120 for low), and document Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) when a timeline cannot be met.

  • Harden systems against GSA security benchmarks and CIS Level 1 guidelines.

  • Track end-of-life software, unsupported libraries, and known vulnerabilities, and raise risks early with a recommended path forward.

  • Support continuous monitoring, log review, and incident response in line with NIST SP 800-61.

  • Support continuity of operations (COOP) and disaster recovery planning and testing.

Compliance, Assessment & Authorization

  • Maintain the system's assessment and authorization (A&A) package under NIST SP 800-37 and SP 800-53 Rev. 5, including the System Security and Privacy Plan, contingency plan, business impact analysis, incident response plan, and contingency plan test report.

  • Maintain POA&Ms and support Government-led security assessments, control reviews, and penetration testing.

  • Support privacy compliance artifacts such as Privacy Threshold Assessments and Privacy Impact Assessments.

  • Keep security documentation current as legacy capabilities are replaced and retired.

Secure Development & Modernization

  • Perform threat modeling for new features, integrations, and architecture decisions.

  • Embed static and dynamic security testing (such as Snyk and OWASP ZAP) in CI/CD pipelines so every release meets OWASP ASVS with no unresolved medium or high findings.

  • Review releases for security impact before production, protecting availability.

  • Advise on secure architecture for the modernized platform, including federated identity, FIPS 140-validated encryption, Zero Trust principles, and software supply chain security.

  • Prepare security packages for prototype testing and position the new platform to receive an ATO at production deployment.

jobs.title: Amazon Brand Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, analytical, and detail-oriented professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Amazon Brand Manager opening.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, analytical, and detail-oriented professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Amazon Brand Manager opening.

As the Amazon Brand Manager, you will take full ownership of Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US, while expanding the company's presence across additional Amazon marketplaces, including Mexico, Brazil, and other markets, as well as key dropship retail partners. You will have full P&L accountability across all managed marketplaces and be responsible for driving revenue growth in alignment with company targets.

Your responsibilities will include ensuring accurate pricing and image mapping across listings, implementing evergreen listing strategies to improve conversion, maintaining account health, and monitoring competitors across all managed marketplaces. You will work closely with the in-house PPC manager, supply chain, and creative teams to support marketplace performance and expansion.

This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, organization, and a clear sense of ownership. You will be expected to take accountability for outcomes, prioritize effectively, and identify innovative approaches to marketplace challenges.

About the Company

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities

Own International Marketplace Operations

  • Take full operational ownership of Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US within the first 90 days, ensuring zero disruption to ongoing sales.
  • Manage marketplace operations and ensure accurate pricing and image mapping across all managed channels.
  • Maintain strong account health and address issues that could disrupt marketplace operations or ongoing sales.
  • Ensure listings and marketplace operations are maintained consistently across all managed channels.

Drive Marketplace Revenue and P&L Performance

  • Own full P&L performance across all managed primary and secondary marketplaces, aligning results with company targets.
  • Monitor marketplace performance and use data to identify opportunities for revenue growth and improved financial results.
  • Evaluate performance across managed channels and identify opportunities to improve results.
  • Support data-driven decision-making to ensure marketplace growth remains aligned with company objectives.

Optimize Listings and Improve Conversion

  • Implement evergreen listing strategies to improve conversion across Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US within the first six months.
  • Ensure accurate product listings, pricing, and image mapping across managed marketplaces.
  • Identify opportunities to improve listing performance and conversion.
  • Work closely with the creative team to support listing optimization and ensure accurate product imagery.
  • Collaborate with the in-house PPC manager to support marketplace performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Expand Secondary Marketplaces and Dropship Partnerships

  • Grow the company's presence across additional Amazon marketplaces, including Mexico, Brazil, and other relevant markets.
  • Contribute to the growth of secondary marketplaces and key dropship retail partners throughout the first year.
  • Support the development and expansion of retail partnerships, including HD Supply, Vitality Medical, Medical Shop, Sleepplay, and other relevant partners.
  • Ensure accurate pricing and image mapping across retail partner channels.
  • Identify opportunities to expand marketplace and retail partner presence in alignment with company growth targets.

Maintain Competitive Intelligence and Account Health

  • Maintain an ongoing competitive intelligence process across all managed marketplaces.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market developments to identify opportunities and potential risks.
  • Maintain vigilant account health across managed channels and address issues that could affect ongoing sales.
  • Use marketplace insights to inform decisions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Build Cross-Functional Relationships

  • Establish effective working relationships with the in-house PPC manager, supply chain, and creative teams within the first six months.
  • Coordinate marketplace activities with relevant teams to support listing performance and channel growth.
  • Communicate marketplace performance, opportunities, and issues clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Work collaboratively across functions to support the company's international expansion and marketplace objectives.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.
  • Experience with Walmart Marketplace is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to process data and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Ability to take ownership of marketplace operations and financial performance.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly regarding listing accuracy, pricing, and image mapping.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to prioritize work efficiently.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems proactively, and develop innovative approaches to challenges.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with PPC, supply chain, and creative teams.

Core Competencies & Values

  • Attention to Detail: Does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Consistency: Demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Ownership: Takes full accountability for outcomes, works proactively without needing to be told what to do, brings new ideas, thinks about the bigger picture, and operates with honesty and integrity.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical Skills: Able to structure and process qualitative or quantitative data and draw insightful conclusions from it.
  • Organization & Planning: Plans, organizes, schedules, and budgets efficiently and productively, focusing on key priorities.
  • Efficiency: Able to produce significant output with minimal wasted effort.
  • Communication: Speaks and writes clearly and articulately without being overly verbose or talkative, maintaining this standard in all forms of written communication, including email.
  • High Standards: Expects personal performance and work quality to be nothing short of the best.
  • Creativity / Innovation: Generates new and innovative approaches to problems.

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of international and alternative marketplace performance.
  • Full P&L accountability across managed marketplaces.
  • The opportunity to contribute to international expansion and the growth of additional sales channels.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Amazon Brand Manager who combines analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ownership with a strong focus on marketplace performance. If you are motivated by growing international sales channels, improving listing conversion, and making data-driven decisions that support financial results, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to a growing eCommerce business.

  • Experience conducting technical audits using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, or equivalent.

  • Experience optimizing page speed, improving site structure, and applying schema markup.

  • Working knowledge of generative/AI search behavior (e.g., how Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, ChatGPT search, and Perplexity source and cite web content) and how to optimize content for LLM-based retrieval, in addition to traditional SEO tools.

jobs.description:
Digital Workflow Specialist – BENELUX (f/m/d)

Location: Belgium, the Netherlands, or Luxembourg


About the Role

SprintRay Europe GmbH is a fast-growing, innovation-driven company operating across the EMEA region (Europe, Middle East & Africa). We specialize in cutting-edge 3D printing solutions for digital dentistry and are rapidly expanding our presence throughout Europe.

At SprintRay, collaboration, innovation, and entrepreneurial thinking are at the heart of everything we do. We empower our team members to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and help shape the future of digital dentistry.

To strengthen our commercial team, we are looking for a

Digital Workflow Specialist – BENELUX (f/m/d)

In this role, you will be responsible for expanding SprintRay's business across the Netherlands by working closely with distribution partners, Key Opinion Leaders, dental practices, and laboratories. You will combine strategic account development, outstanding organization, and engaging educational events to position SprintRay as the leading provider of digital dental workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the strategic development and growth of SprintRay's business throughout the Netherlands

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with dentists, orthodontists, dental laboratories, and Key Opinion Leaders

  • Work closely with our distribution partners through joint customer visits, product demonstrations, trainings, and events

  • Plan, organize, and execute customer events, workshops, and educational programs

  • Identify and develop strategic accounts and reference centers

  • Position SprintRay as the innovation and technology leader in digital dental workflows

  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations, hands-on trainings, and educational workshops

  • Represent SprintRay at trade shows, congresses, and industry events

  • Collaborate with technology partners across the digital workflow ecosystem, including intraoral scanner, implant, and CAD/CAM software manufacturers

  • Support new product launches in close collaboration with the Marketing and Education teams

  • Plan and manage your sales activities in a structured manner while maintaining accurate documentation in Salesforce CRM

Required Qualifications

  • Proven sales experience in the dental industry or a related medical field

  • Alternatively, a background in dental technology, dentistry, or business combined with

    relevant sales experience

  • Passion for digital technologies, CAD/CAM workflows, and innovative treatment concepts

  • Ideally, experience with digital dental workflows and/or 3D printing technologies

  • Strong ability to identify strategic business opportunities and develop high-value customer relationships

  • A proactive, self-driven mindset with the ambition to grow your territory independently

  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to coordinate customers, partners, events, and sales opportunities simultaneously

  • Entrepreneurial thinking and the ability to prioritize effectively

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

  • A structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working

  • Willingness to travel extensively within the Netherlands

  • Fluent Dutch and strong English language skills

  • Experience working with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and digital business tools

What we offer you

  • The opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing companies in digital dentistry

  • A high level of ownership and autonomy to shape your market and drive business success

  • Collaboration with an international team of technology, dental, marketing, and education experts

  • Direct access to leading Key Opinion Leaders and innovators in the dental industry

  • A dynamic environment where initiative, creativity, and entrepreneurial thinking are valued and encouraged

  • Competitive performance-based compensation

  • Ongoing professional development and the opportunity to work with some of the industry's most innovative digital technologies

  • A varied and challenging role in which you can help shape and implement your own ideas

  • Working in a dedicated team with open communication in a motivating work environment in a growing technology company

  • Our modern and open offices in Weiterstadt (near Darmstadt) are located in an attractive business park together with a restaurant, daycare center and close to the Loop 5 shopping center and other specialty markets

  • Independent work with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths and thus a wide range of development opportunities

  • Flexible working hours and models

  • 30 days vacation and birthday off

  • Adequate performance-related remuneration

  • Opportunities for further training and qualification

  • For your well-being: Complimentary snacks and a wide selection of hot and cold beverages – coffee, tea, and more

  • Extensive training and colleagues who are available to answer questions

About SprintRay

SprintRay is rewriting the rules of dentistry with technology that’s smart, fast, and designed to make life easier for dental professionals. Since 2014, we’ve been on a mission to deliver the most advanced 3D printing solutions in the industry—combining hardware, software, and materials into one seamless ecosystem.

But what really makes SprintRay different is our people. We’re a bold, global team of innovators, problem-solvers, and doers who thrive on pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo. Every product we create is driven by a simple goal: help dentists spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time changing patients’ lives.

Our culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and fueled by curiosity. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe the best ideas can come from anywhere. Whether we’re building next-generation AI tools, designing new materials, or supporting our customers on the front lines, we’re united by the same passion—transforming digital dentistry and having fun while we do it.

At SprintRay, the future of dentistry is being printed today. Want to be part of it?

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Director of DevSecOps to build, lead, and grow our DevSecOps practice in support of complex federal government engagements. This is a people-first leadership role: you will own DevSecOps strategy and technical direction across our portfolio while recruiting, mentoring, and growing a high-performing team. The ideal candidate is both a proven technical leader and a genuine people leader, someone who earns trust through servant leadership, builds team capability deliberately, and can represent Bixal's DevSecOps capabilities in business development efforts when called upon.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the United States, excluding its territories. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $165,000 – $195,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Team Leadership & Practice Growth

  • At least 3 years of working with federal government contracts and clients

  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end cloud architecture and delivery outcomes in complex environments

  • Deep experience with one or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD, containers/Kubernetes)

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Active participation in DevSecOps or cloud communities, with recent thought leadership

jobs.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

At FICO, we are always looking for exceptional talent to drive our ambitious growth strategy. While we may not have an immediate opening, this is a general posting for outstanding Key Account Managers who specialize in enterprise technology sales and client relationship management within the financial servicessector. If you’d like to learn more, we encourage you to introduce yourself so that we can begin a conversation and consider you for opportunities as they arise.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to take your sales career to the next level by leading one of FICO’s most critical client accounts? This role is your chance to lead a cornerstone account for a global leader in analytics and decisioning technology. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of a premier client’s business while achieving significant personal and professional growth. With over 60 years of consistent growth, FICO’s world-class solutions empower thousands of businesses worldwide to make smarter fraud, risk, and customer management decisions. As a senior member of our Sales organization, you will leverage your deep expertise, strategic acumen, and consultative-selling prowess to strengthen and expand a marquee client relationship. This is not just another sales role—it’s an opportunity to make a significant impact by partnering with a global financial institution to address their most urgent challenges with FICO’s advanced technologies. If you’re a results-driven, senior-level professional with a passion for delivering innovative solutions and driving exceptional outcomes, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Strategic Leadership: Build and nurture relationships with C-suite and senior client stakeholders to uncover and address their most critical business challenges, demonstrating the value of FICO’s solutions at every turn.

  • Solution Innovation: Collaborate with internal teams across sales, product, delivery, and marketing to design tailored, enterprise-grade solutions that align with client needs and long-term strategies.

  • Complex Deal Structuring: Lead high-stakes negotiations for multi-million-dollar contracts, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes that protect and expand FICO’s footprint within the account.

  • Client Advocacy: Serve as the voice of the client within FICO, influencing product roadmaps and solution strategies to address evolving market demands.

  • Business Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive business plans that drive account expansion and long-term profitability, while achieving quarterly and annual sales targets with significant upside potential.

  • Market Leadership: Represent FICO as a trusted advisor, staying ahead of industry trends and positioning the company as the go-to partner for advanced analytics and decisioning solutions.

What We’re Seeking

  • Proven Senior-Level Experience: Demonstrated success in building and managing strategic relationships with senior executives, particularly within large financial institutions.

  • Enterprise Solution Sales Expertise: A track record of structuring and closing complex, multi-million-dollar deals, including SaaS-based solutions that expand existing offerings or integrate into larger solution bundles.

  • Industry Knowledge: Deep familiarity with banking, credit risk, fraud prevention, account management, or consumer lending. Experience in applying technologies such as machine learning, AI, decision management, and optimization is highly desirable.

  • Strategic Vision and Execution: Ability to craft and execute joint business plans that align with client objectives and FICO’s strategic priorities.

  • Growth Mindset: A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.

  • Resiliency: Able to maintain focus and effectiveness under pressure, adaptable to change, and recover quickly from setbacks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: A team-oriented mindset that values collaboration and leverages the collective strengths of colleagues to deliver exceptional results.

  • Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 50% to maintain a close partnership with the client and foster meaningful, face-to-face interactions.

  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent commercial experience.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.

  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.

  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
