jobs.excerpt: A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH USWe're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others.
jobs.description:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • You'll lead, mentor, and grow a team of Client Success Managers, building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • You'll design and implement scalable success frameworks for our SmartSimple client portfolio, keeping the focus on consistent product adoption and outcomes that actually move their missions forward
  • You'll serve as the primary escalation point for your SmartSimple accounts, resolving complex issues with urgency — because how we show up when things go sideways matters as much as when things go smoothly
  • You'll build trusted-advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders, staying close enough to their goals to anticipate what they'll need before they ask
  • You'll collaborate closely with SmartSimple's implementation partners, aligning on account status, delivery timelines, and escalation handling to ensure a seamless client experience across partner-led and internally-led engagements
  • You'll identify expansion opportunities within your client portfolio — new modules, services, or scope — and facilitate a clean hand-off to SmartSimple Professional Services for scoping and delivery
  • You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Account Management — turning client feedback into roadmap input and supporting renewal and expansion conversations
  • You'll monitor retention, health-score, and adoption metrics, using the data to catch risk and opportunity early and drive proactive interventions
  • You'll set clear performance goals for your team and provide the regular coaching that helps each person do their best work
  • You'll ensure enterprise-level SLAs and contractual commitments are consistently met
  • Other duties as assigned
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 8+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, or a related field, including 3+ years leading teams that manage enterprise accounts
  • Demonstrated experience managing a client success portfolio within a platform/SaaS product, including surfacing expansion opportunities and transitioning them cleanly to a delivery or professional services team
  • Experience collaborating with third-party implementation or delivery partners in a SaaS or enterprise technology environment, including navigating shared accountability for client outcomes
  • Working proficiency with success metrics and reporting tools (e.g., health scoring, retention analytics, CRM/CS platforms)
  • Experience in SaaS or enterprise technology environments
  • Experience or working knowledge of the philanthropic sector is preferred, including its trends, challenges, and best practices for serving mission-driven organizations
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:

As a people leader at Foundant, you'll be assessed against our Leadership Competency Model:

Strategic Thinking

You'll translate our SmartSimple client success strategy into scalable frameworks and clear team goals, flexing the approach as it plays out across partner-led and internally-led engagements and evolving client needs.

Performance Advancement

You'll set a high bar for your team's adoption and retention outcomes, using health-score and engagement data to catch underperformance early and course-correct before it touches a client relationship.

Decision-Making

You'll make timely, values-aligned calls on complex enterprise escalations — weighing client impact, contractual obligations, and cross-functional trade-offs to resolve issues with urgency and care.

Collaboration and Learning

You'll build the kind of executive-level trust and communication with senior client stakeholders and internal partners, including SmartSimple's implementation partners, that turns feedback into real roadmap influence, because the best outcomes come from listening well across the table.

Staff Development

You'll coach your Client Success Managers with regular, specific feedback and clear growth paths, building a team people want to stay and grow on.

Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

jobs.excerpt: Job Description:DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.


People in Corporate Functions make DXC a well-run and high-functioning organization. Each team contributes to DXC's success and each individual delivers world class service and has opportunities to grow and learn


DXC Technology is looking for a Manager, Global Brand Media to help plan, manage and optimize the paid media supporting our global brand strategy and campaigns.

Working as part of the Global Brand team, this role will be DXC's day-to-day media lead, partnering closely with our Senior Manager, Brand Creative & Campaign Strategy, internal Creative Studio, digital and analytics teams, and external media agency.


About The Role:

The Media Manager will translate campaign objectives into effective media strategies across channels, audiences and markets, ensuring that DXC reaches the right enterprise decision-makers in the right environments and that our media investment is continuously measured and optimized.

This person will connect strategy to activation: managing agency plans, media budgets, audience and channel recommendations, creative media requirements, launch readiness, campaign performance and optimization.

The role requires someone who understands sophisticated B2B media but also enjoys the operational detail required to get campaigns into market successfully.


What You´ll Do

Media strategy & planning

  • Translate DXC brand and campaign objectives into integrated paid-media plans.
  • Support development of the annual and campaign-specific media strategy across global markets.
  • Recommend the appropriate channel mix across premium video/CTV, business media, digital publishing, programmatic/display, LinkedIn, YouTube, audio, partnerships and account-based media.
  • Help define the role of media across awareness, preference, consideration and account engagement.
  • Develop audience strategies across senior business decision-makers, technology leaders, priority industries and strategic accounts.
  • Connect broad brand media with vertical, ABM and retargeting activity to create a coherent audience journey.

Media agency management

  • Serve as the day-to-day lead for DXC's external media agency.
  • Develop clear agency briefs in partnership with the Brand team.
  • Review and challenge agency recommendations across audience, channel mix, geography, investment, reach, frequency and timing.
  • Manage weekly agency status, optimization and performance reviews.
  • Ensure clear ownership between agency-managed and DXC-managed media.
  • Track agency deliverables, media commitments and key campaign milestones.
  • Escalate investment, delivery or performance risks where appropriate.

Media investment & budget management

  • Maintain a clear view of media budgets, allocations and commitments.
  • Track investment by market, audience, channel, publisher and campaign.
  • Partner with the agency and internal teams to identify opportunities to reallocate investment based on performance.
  • Support evaluation of publisher partnerships and new media opportunities.
  • Ensure investment decisions can be clearly explained to Brand leadership.
  • Partner with Finance and Procurement on media-related budget and commercial processes.

Campaign activation & creative coordination


  • Translate approved media plans into clear creative requirements, formats, specifications and delivery deadlines.
  • Brief Lead and the Creative Studio on what media requires, while Lead retains ownership of the creative response.
  • Maintain visibility into media deadlines, asset readiness, trafficking and launch status.
  • Ensure the media agency has the correct approved assets and landing destinations.
  • Identify potential media or inventory risks early enough for the creative team to respond.
  • Coordinate campaign readiness checkpoints across media, creative, digital and agency teams.
  • Ensure media requirements inform creative development without allowing the media plan to dictate the creative idea.

Measurement, optimization & learning

  • Define media KPIs and learning agendas with Brand, Analytics and agency partners.
  • Monitor campaign performance across audiences, channels, publishers, markets and creative.
  • Lead the day-to-day optimization dialogue with the media agency.
  • Turn performance data into actionable recommendations on targeting, channel mix, investment and creative needs.
  • Work with Lead to identify where creative performance suggests a need for new messages, formats or executions.
  • Partner with Analytics to understand behavior beyond media delivery, including quality of traffic and on-site engagement.
  • Develop clear, concise media-performance reporting for Brand leadership.

Innovation & best practice

  • Stay current on B2B media trends, platforms, audience capabilities and measurement.
  • Bring forward new approaches appropriate for enterprise technology and C-suite audiences.
  • Help DXC continually improve its approach to programmatic, paid social, ABM and premium media partnerships.
  • Establish repeatable media planning, briefing, reporting and optimization practices within the Brand team.
  • Build stronger institutional media knowledge inside DXC rather than relying exclusively on agency expertise.

Who You Are

  • 5–7+ years of media planning, paid media or integrated marketing experience, ideally across B2B, enterprise technology or similarly complex categories.
  • Must be authorized to work in US without requiring any sponsorship now nor in the future

Your Day to Day

The Compliance Analyst sits within the Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team, reporting to the Director of GRC in the CISO org. You'll own audit coordination, control testing, and risk assessment work while actively improving how assurance gets done through technology and automation.


As a GRC Compliance Analyst, you'll be working on:

  • Coordinating audits across ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, NIS2, SOX, and C5, including managing auditor relationships, driving evidence collection, and tracking remediation activities to completion.
  • Performing control assessments and testing across technical and administrative domains, partnering with engineering and security teams to evaluate control design and effectiveness.
  • Collaborating with Engineering, Security, IT, and Product stakeholders to understand technical architectures and translate them into audit-ready control narratives.
  • Leveraging AI tools, automation, and emerging technologies to streamline evidence collection, control testing, and reporting activities.
  • Administering and enhancing GRC platforms while developing metrics and dashboards that provide visibility into compliance posture and control effectiveness.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in information security compliance, audit, or risk management within a technology environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture, IAM, infrastructure, and SDLC controls, enabling effective collaboration and communication with technical teams.
  • Experience working with one or more compliance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, NIST 800-53, or NIS2.
  • Strong audit communication skills: you know how to manage auditors, push back when evidence requests are out of scope, and defend a control position when you're right.
  • Active user of AI tools to improve your own productivity.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with platforms such as Thoropass, AuditBoard, or Drata.

  • Experience implementing continuous assurance capabilities.

  • Employee-led communities and programs, including Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), GoTo Gives, and charitable matching

We work hard to create an environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and able to contribute. Building a culture of belonging isn't just something we talk about - it's part of how we work every day.

At GoTo, you’ll find the flexibility, resources, and support you need to thrive—at work, at home, and everywhere in between. You’ll work towards a shared goal with an open-minded, cohesive team that’s greater than the sum of its parts. We’re committed to creating an inclusive space for everyone, because we know unique perspectives make us a stronger company and community. Job Overview

The Technical Project Manager will be responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology projects, working closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Infrastructure, QA, Security and business stakeholders.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical understanding and be able to challenge estimates, identify dependencies, manage risks, drive engineering teams and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

Project & Delivery Management

  • Own end-to-end delivery across multiple technical projects and workstreams.
  • Define project scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines and success criteria.
  • Create and maintain detailed project plans, delivery roadmaps and release plans.
  • Track progress against commitments and proactively manage delays.
  • Drive projects from requirements through development, UAT, deployment and production stabilization.
  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability across teams.

Technical Project Management

  • Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, QA and Security teams.
  • Understand technical requirements, architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure and deployment processes.
  • Review estimates and challenge assumptions where required.
  • Identify technical dependencies, risks and resource constraints early.
  • Coordinate resolution of technical blockers and cross-team dependencies.
  • Ensure technical decisions and requirements are properly documented.

Agile & Governance

  • Drive Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily tracking, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
  • Maintain project dashboards and delivery metrics.
  • Ensure accurate capacity planning and resource allocation.
  • Establish effective governance without creating unnecessary process overhead.
  • Maintain RAID logs, action trackers and decision logs.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary delivery interface between engineering teams, product/business stakeholders and leadership.
  • Provide clear and fact-based project status reporting.
  • Escalate risks and issues early with recommended actions.
  • Manage expectations around scope, timelines, resources and priorities.
  • Conduct regular stakeholder reviews and project governance meetings.

Resource Management

  • Plan resources based on actual capacity and project requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and provide data-backed recommendations.
  • Optimize utilization of existing engineering resources before requesting additional headcount.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across India and international locations.

Quality, UAT & Release Management

  • Establish UAT plans, acceptance criteria and release readiness.
  • Track defects and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.
  • Coordinate release and deployment activities with DevOps/Infrastructure teams.
  • Ensure production readiness and post-release stabilization.

Technical Exposure

Candidates should have working knowledge of several of the following:

  • Web applications and SaaS platforms
  • Frontend / Backend architecture
  • APIs and third-party integrations
  • Microservices
  • Databases and data platforms
  • Cloud platforms — AWS / Azure / GCP
  • DevOps and CI/CD
  • Docker / Kubernetes
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Security and authentication
  • AI/ML platforms and infrastructure
  • Monitoring, logging and observability
  • Performance and scalability
  • QA automation and testing frameworks

Required Skills

  • 8–12+ years of experience in technology/project/program delivery.
  • Strong experience managing software engineering projects.
  • Experience managing Frontend, Backend, QA, DevOps and Infrastructure teams.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong planning, estimation and dependency-management skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder and communication skills.
  • Experience working with distributed/global teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and escalation-management capability.
  • Experience with Jira, Tempo, Confluence or similar project management tools.
  • Ability to manage delivery based on capacity, priorities and measurable outcomes.

Preferred

  • PMP / PRINCE2 / Scrum certification.
  • Experience with SaaS / B2B technology platforms.
  • Experience in Ecommerce, cloud, AI, data projects.
  • Experience managing teams of 20+ engineers across multiple disciplines.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You are responsible for ensuring that projects are successfully completed on time and on budget. This includes project governance, budget and timeline development, build quality, testing and operational readiness, and the completed project’s readiness to go live.

How you will contribute

You will:

  • Drive consistency and quality in the execution of projects using the appropriate methodology and tools
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them to global leads and/ or the program manager when needed
  • Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports and monthly review meetings and leading stakeholder meetings
  • Lead budget management, resource planning and utilization
  • Confirm the completion and consistency of projects and their readiness to go live
  • Own the relationship with the external vendors including quality assurance in all phases of project delivery

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

  • Proven experience in project management methodology
  • Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
  • Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
  • Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
  • Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
  • Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
  • Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
  • Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

Sabemos do nosso papel como agentes de transformação para gerar uma mudança positiva, por isso, diversidade, equidade e inclusão são uma de nossas prioridades. Acreditamos na quebra de estereótipos e barreiras para garantir a representatividade da sociedade dentro da nossa empresa. E, para isso, temos um Comitê de Diversidade que atua em quatro frentes, Pessoas com deficiência (PCD), Étnico-Racial, Mulheres e LGBTQIAP+, além de fazer parte do MOVER - Movimento pela Equidade Racial.


Objetivo da Função

  • Atuar no suporte operacional ao Test Lead, garantindo que as atividades diárias de UAT (Teste de Aceitação do Usuário) permaneçam organizadas, que as ações sejam acompanhadas e que a execução se mantenha no ritmo.
  • O Coordenador de UAT foca em disciplina de execução, coordenação de SMEs (Subject Matter Experts) e acompanhamento de ponta a ponta (não é necessário conhecimento técnico nem tomada de decisão de negócio).

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar a execução diária e identificar testes atrasados, bloqueados, não iniciados ou aguardando ação.
  • Fazer follow-up diretamente com SMEs e testers sobre atividades pendentes, bloqueios e prazos.
  • Coordenar atribuições de testes, cronogramas e disponibilidade dos testers.
  • Rastrear ações, decisões, bloqueios e datas de entrega, e fazer follow-up com os responsáveis.
  • Monitorar evidências ausentes e registros de teste incompletos.
  • Coordenar atividades de reteste assim que as correções estiverem disponíveis.
  • Apoiar check-ins com SMEs e reuniões de UAT por meio de pautas, acompanhamento de ações e follow-ups.
  • Manter trackers de UAT, documentação e repositórios atualizados.
  • Apoiar a administração do qTest e a completude dos dados.
  • Sinalizar atrasos na execução, restrições de capacidade e riscos emergentes ao Test Lead.
  • Coordenar atividades operacionais entre regiões e manter a disciplina de execução.

Perfil / Competências

  • Aprendizado rápido com curto tempo de ramp-up: compreende rapidamente o projeto, o modelo operacional de UAT, a terminologia, os stakeholders e as formas de trabalho.
  • Alto senso de ownership e autonomia: identifica proativamente o que precisa de atenção, sem esperar direcionamento.
  • Presença confiante com stakeholders: confortável em interagir diretamente com SMEs e stakeholders experientes, fazendo perguntas, solicitando ações e questionando prazos quando necessário.
  • Credibilidade sem autoridade formal: capaz de construir confiança e influenciar stakeholders mesmo sem autoridade formal ou expertise técnica profunda.
  • Alta habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de síntese: compreende informações rapidamente e comunica status, riscos, ações e demandas de forma clara.
  • Excelente organização e acompanhamento: gerencia múltiplas atividades, responsáveis e prazos simultaneamente.
  • Bom julgamento e instinto de escalação: entende o que pode ser resolvido de forma independente e o que requer envolvimento do SME ou do Test Lead.
  • Confortável com ambiguidade e ritmo acelerado: opera com eficácia em um ambiente dinâmico, com prioridades em constante mudança.
  • Perfil hands-on e orientado à execução: disposto(a) a colocar a mão na massa e resolver problemas operacionais para manter o UAT em andamento.

Requisitos Indispensáveis

  • Inglês fluente.
  • Proficiência avançada em Excel e PowerPoint.
  • Experiência liderando projetos e UAT (User Acceptance Testing), com forte capacidade de mobilizar pessoas para concluir ações dentro do prazo.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar das 7h às 16h (horário de Brasília).
  • Graduação em Administração, Gestão de Projetos ou área correlata.

Por que considerar essa oportunidade?

  • Você irá adquirir xperiência prática coordenando uma iniciativa de UAT ampla e complexa.
  • Desenvolvimento de habilidades de coordenação de projetos e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Trabalho direto com equipes de diferentes regiões, funções e níveis hierárquicos.
  • Exposição a testes estruturados e governança de projetos.
  • Fortalecimento de competências em organização, priorização, influência e gestão de execução.
  • Visibilidade sobre como um grande projeto evolui do design para a implementação.
  • Experiência atuando com stakeholders seniores e influenciando sem autoridade formal.

A Mondelez International está atenta ao futuro do trabalho e valoriza o bem-estar de nossas pessoas, buscando proporcionar as melhores experiências. Sendo assim, algumas de nossas vagas administrativas são elegíveis ao modelo híbrido, possibilitando o trabalho remoto em alguns dias da semana.

No Relocation support available

Mondelēz Brasil is Mondelēz International’s fourth largest operation in the world, with approximately 7,500 employees proudly producing, selling and distributing some of the most beloved brands of chewing gum, candies, powdered beverages, cream cheeses, chocolates, cookies and desserts in Brazil. We make the Brazilians’ favorite products such as Bis, Lacta, Oreo, Club Social, Sonho de Valsa, Trakinas, Trident, Halls, Royal, Tang and many others. We are truly part of the lives of Brazilians: You can find our mouth-watering products in more than 700,000 points of sale and we are present in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão, in the state of Pernambuco, and Curitiba, in the state of Paraná. About the Orange Movement

Launched in 2022, the Orange Movement™ is a global initiative led by IIX Global to integrate gender equality and climate action into financial markets. At its core are Orange Bonds™ — the world's first gender-lens and climate-focused asset class — designed to.

  • Mobilize US$15 billion in capital markets by 2030
  • Positively impact 150 million women, girls, and gender minorities
  • Position women and gender minorities as leaders in climate resilience and adaptation

The Orange Movement advances this vision through capital mobilization, policy reform, global partnerships, training, and advocacy. With US$2 billion already mobilized and a new US$1 billion Orange Climate Fund anchoring a US$10 billion cooperation agreement with the Government of Indonesia, the Movement is entering a pivotal scale-up phase — with an active co-funder base, formalized governance infrastructure, and the Orange Forum as its flagship annual convening. IIX seeks a Senior Director who can build the Movement into an institution with the financial strength, governance maturity, and operating capability to stand on its own for the long termLaunched in 2022, the Orange Movement™ is a global initiative led by IIX Global to integrate gender equality and climate action into financial markets. At its core are Orange Bonds™ — the world's first gender-lens and climate-focused asset class — designed to:

  • Mobilize US$15 billion in capital markets by 2030

The Orange Movement advances this vision through capital mobilization, policy reform, global partnerships, training, and advocacy. IIX seeks a Senior Director who can build the Movement into an institution with the financial strength, governance maturity, and operating capability to stand on its own for the long term

Role Summary

The Senior Director of the Orange Movement will provide strategic vision, entrepreneurial drive, and organizational leadership to build the Movement into a durable, self-sustaining institution — expanding its reach, resources, and financial independence globally. This is a rare opportunity to take a coalition at the intersection of finance, gender, and climate from an IIX-incubated initiative to a mature institution with genuine systems-change potential.

This senior leadership role will:

  • Own and manage the Orange Movement program, working closely with IIX teams — including Sustainable Finance and the newly established Impact & ESG Advisory — as they execute Orange transactions and related projects.
  • Ensure the long-term financial sustainability of the Orange Movement through diversified, multi-year fundraising — spanning co-funders, grants, and catalytic capital.
  • Mature the coalition's governance infrastructure into a standard-setting model for stakeholder management, built to operate independently over time.
  • Spearhead co-funder cultivation, partnership pipeline development, and multi-year fundraising.

This position is ideal for a leader who combines deep networks across finance, philanthropy, and development with the entrepreneurial instincts to build lasting institutions — equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the hands-on work of standing up the operating backbone a growing coalition needs.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnerships & Global Alliances

  • Develop and execute a global strategy to expand the Orange Investor Alliance and Partner Coalition
  • Build and own a structured co-funder pipeline — from identification and cultivation through to close and stewardship
  • Engage institutional investors, DFIs, corporates, philanthropies, and governments as strategic allies and co-funders of the Orange Movement's mission
  • Build trust with policymakers, regulators, and multilaterals to embed Orange standards into financial systems
  • Use CRM systems and research tools to maintain a living, high-quality partnerships database
  • Engage the newly established Impact & ESG Advisory as a technical thought partner on measurement, standards, and reporting for Orange instruments

Fundraising & Financial Sustainability

  • Own and drive the Orange Movement's co-funder and fundraising strategy — from identification and cultivation through to closing institutional partnerships with foundations, DFIs, and impact investors
  • Mobilize grants and catalytic capital to scale the Movement, targeting US$2M+ in co-funder contributions in Year 1 and scaling year over year, securing multi-year funding commitments alongside IIX senior management
  • Build the Orange Movement's long-term financial sustainability model — including piloting fee-based membership and certification revenue streams — steadily reducing the Movement's reliance on IIX's core platform over time
  • Maintain best-in-class fundraising collateral, funder value propositions, and a structured partnerships pipeline across the co-funder lifecycle

Training & Market Building

  • Lead the Orange Capital Verifier Training program and similar certification tracks
  • Expand training offerings for investors, regulators, and issuers to build global confidence in Orange instruments — including blended/digital learning formats
  • Partner with universities, think tanks, and global institutions to mainstream Orange finance education
  • Own the roadmap for establishing the Orange Capital Principles, Orange Seal, and Orange Index as recognized, market-wide reference standards for gender-lens and climate-aligned finance

Coalition Governance & Institutional Development

  • Serve as Secretariat for the Steering Committee, Advisory Council, and Working Groups — driving formalisation, documentation, and distributed knowledge management
  • Build and own a structured onboarding process for incoming coalition members
  • Ensure inclusive, accountable, and transparent governance — supported by clear meeting cadences, action tracking, and member engagement protocols
  • Diagnose and address engagement gaps across working groups, including reviving or restructuring underperforming groups as needed
  • Evolve the coalition's governance bodies — Steering Committee, Advisory Council, Working Groups — into a mature structure capable of governing the Movement independently at scale

Advocacy, Convenings & Thought Leadership

  • Lead the flagship Orange Forum and other global convenings, owning the partnerships and stakeholder coordination layer
  • Curate high-impact campaigns that place Orange Financing at the center of global finance dialogues

We’re looking for a proactive, organized Executive Assistant to support the US-based co-founder of a growing leadership coaching and development firm. The firm helps founders and leadership teams at companies of 5 to 100 employees grow their people through one-on-one coaching, group leadership development programs, strategic planning and coach training. It also serves nonprofits and ministries, and is built around a values-driven, people-first approach to leadership.

The business has doubled its revenue this year and is now growing fast, and the founder is spending too much of his time on admin and coordination. You’ll take ownership of the operational backbone of the firm: scheduling, the coaching management system, client and coach communication, course administration and sales support. This is not a task-taker role. The founder wants someone who will own responsibilities, notice when something doesn’t make sense, and come to him with a proposed solution.

The firm is small and still evolving, so things won’t always be perfectly defined. You’ll help build and refine the processes as you go.

This is a part-time, remote position that requires strong written communication, organizational excellence, and accountability.

Location: Fully Remote

Job Type: Part-Time

What you'll do

Scheduling and coordination (Main Priority)

  • Manage the founder’s calendar and schedule calls, coordinating availability across clients, coaches and internal team members.
  • Handle the back-and-forth of aligning multiple people for meetings, sessions and programs so the founder doesn’t have to.

Coaching operations

  • Run administration in the firm’s coaching management system, including onboarding new clients, offboarding finished engagements, and keeping coach records up to date.
  • Keep clients, coaches and the internal team informed and aligned. For example, after the founder delivers a group coaching session, send a summary to all the coaches involved.
  • Own internal communication so updates go out on time, every time.

Course and program administration

  • Set up and manage the logistics for the founder’s coaching courses and group leadership programs.
  • Support students and participants so they stay on track and succeed.

Sales support

  • Prepare client proposals using the firm’s existing templates, and help improve those templates over time.
  • Build and format materials in Canva and Google Slides.

Process and partnership

  • Lead a weekly check-in meeting with the founder to review how things are going and agree on changes.

  • Spot gaps, inefficiencies and things that don’t add up, and propose practical fixes.

  3. Interview with our recruiting team
  4. Complete a work evaluation (including a short proposal or slide formatting task in Canva or Google Slides)

  • At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Virtual Assistant or in a similar support role.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Database Architect designs, implements, and optimizes the database architecture that powers Intelerad's medical imaging solutions. This strategic technical leader will be responsible for creating scalable, secure, and high-performance database systems that support our PACS, RIS, and enterprise imaging platforms serving healthcare providers and imaging centers globally. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in database design, data modeling, and performance optimization within large-scale, mission-critical environments where system reliability directly impacts patient care. This role requires balancing technical excellence with business needs, collaborating across engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to ensure our data architecture supports both current operations and future growth in the healthcare IT sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enterprise-wide database architectures for Intelerad's medical imaging platforms, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability to support healthcare providers' diagnostic workflows and patient care delivery across multiple deployment models including on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive data models, schemas, and database documentation that align with healthcare interoperability standards including DICOM, HL7, and FHIR, while optimizing storage strategies for large-scale medical imaging data and ensuring efficient retrieval for clinical workflows.
  • Establish and enforce database development standards, security protocols, and compliance frameworks to meet healthcare regulations including HIPAA, ensuring data integrity, confidentiality, and availability across all database systems while implementing robust backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies.
  • Lead database performance optimization initiatives through query tuning, indexing strategies, and capacity planning, proactively monitoring system health and implementing solutions that maintain sub-second response times critical for real-time diagnostic imaging access in clinical settings.
  • Collaborate with software engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to integrate database systems with application architecture, evaluate and recommend database technologies and platforms, and provide technical leadership on database migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives that support product innovation and operational excellence.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in database architecture, design, and administration with demonstrated expertise in both relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra), including hands-on experience with large-scale, high-availability database environments.
  • Proven expertise in data modeling, database design patterns, normalization techniques, and creating logical and physical data models that support complex business requirements and high-volume transactional systems.
  • Strong proficiency in database performance optimization, including query tuning, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and capacity planning for systems processing millions of transactions and managing petabyte-scale data storage.
  • Extensive experience with cloud database platforms and services on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including experience with database migration strategies, hybrid architectures, and cloud-native database solutions.
  • Deep understanding of database security best practices, encryption methodologies, access control mechanisms, and regulatory compliance requirements, with specific experience in healthcare data protection and HIPAA compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor development teams, and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering
  • Experience with medical imaging systems architecture including PACS, RIS, VNA, or enterprise imaging platforms, and understanding of healthcare data standards such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed database systems, data replication strategies, sharding, and multi-region database architectures that support global healthcare operations.
  • Proficiency with ETL processes, data integration tools, and experience designing data pipelines that support business intelligence, analytics, and reporting requirements.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation for database provisioning and management.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines for database deployments, including experience with automated database testing, schema version control, and migration automation.
  • Professional certifications such as AWS Certified Database Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Certified Professional, or TOGAF certification.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first organizational structure.

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.

Improving healthcare through innovative technology is at the core of Intelerad’s work. jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel FSP is seeking Clinical Laboratory Study Manager (CLSM) to join our team in Argentina!


Job Summary:

The Clinical Laboratory Study Manager (CLSM) works with Precision Medicine Strategy Lead as well as clinical study teams, data management (DM) team, Samples, Kits, Data, Logistics (SKDL) and Clinical Laboratory Project Management (CLPM) groups to ensure quality samples and data are delivered to support biomarker and non-biomarker evaluation and enable the translation of science to medicine. Responsibilities include oversight of clinical sample collection, usage per informed consent form, sample tracking (chain of custody), management of central laboratory and specialty vendors and sample destruction. Individual will work closely with internal and external groups/vendors to manage and support the generation of quality laboratory data. Will work closely with project managers (central and/or specialty labs) and lend expertise to clinical trial management (CTM) and CRO to ensure samples are collected per protocol and assist with resolving any sample related issues or queries. Additional responsibilities include overall project management in alignment with the core business strategy.


Key Accountabilities:


Study Team Support

  • Participates in cross-functional study team meetings and workstreams to support the delivery of the precision medicine strategy for the assigned studies
  • Supports clinical study teams as subject-matter expert for technical and operational matters related to sample management and testing, including anticipating challenges, managing risk across projects and responding queries from internal and external stakeholders
  • Works with clinical study teams on the development and review of sample-related sections of study-specific documents such as the clinical protocol, Informed Consent Forms (ICFs) and sample management guidelines.
  • Supports project management and study set-up teams in the creation and validation of specialty laboratory databases for data collection and sample kit tracking

Operational Support of Biomarker and Exploratory Analysis

  • Manages all activities related to biosample process planning and execution, including storage, shipping, and data transfer throughout the study lifecycle
  • Oversees the acquisition and testing of clinical trial samples designated for biomarker research (including human tissue, whole blood, plasma, serum, etc.), liaising with relevant stakeholders to assess biosample vendors, review proposals/bids, and define contractual scope.
  • Forecasts operational costs and timelines, and manages budgeting, invoicing and reporting for study-related operations

Data Acquisition and Management

  • Works closely with data management and biostatistics leads to determine how biomarker data will be captured, blinded, transferred and reported for clinical trials
  • Develops and reviews data transfer specifications and related documents

Human Sample Management Flow and Compliance

  • Provides guidance and training to clinical teams and investigative sites regarding collection, storage and shipment of biospecimens to ensure compliance with the clinical protocol.
  • Works closely with relevant stakeholders to ensure all transfers of human samples are documented, tracked, used and destroyed according to standard operating procedures and regulatory requirements

Clinical Trial Supplies and Logistics

  • May have a dedicated role as clinical trial supplies and logistics lead, accountable for samples, kits, data operations and processes/standards related to global logistics and specialty vendor management within precision medicine
  • Manage and oversee kit inventories, clinical sample collection, tracking and data query resolution, regulatory submission documents related to kits and samples, global import/export documentation and proforma invoices, maintenance of laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and tracking of function specific metrics
  • Support the creation, implementation, monitoring and improvement of clinical study logistics strategies focused on precision medicine deliverables, including evaluating emerging technologies and vendors

Samples, Kits and Laboratory Operations Programming

  • May have a dedicated role as programming lead for clinical supplies and laboratory operations, supporting the development of tools and dashboards for tracking biomarker samples, kits, logistics and lab data throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Use technical tools, systems and programming languages to systematically aggregate, extract, process and assess data, including confidential data, according to industry standards and function or study-specific guidelines
  • Assess laboratory databases, resolve queries for biomarker data and support data management leads in database lock activities.

Compliance with Parexel Standards

  • Complies with timely completion of required training curriculum
  • Completes timesheets accurately as required
  • Submits expense reports as required
  • Updates CV as required
  • Maintains effective relationships with other platform lines, Business Units/Research Units, and enabling lines that facilitate effective portfolio delivery

Skills:

  • Strong project management and organization skills in a matrix environment
  • Analytical and problem-solving experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with proven ability to build relationships internally and externally
  • Fluent in speaking/writing English
  • Travel not expected but may occur periodically
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including strong excel knowledge, as well as relevant role specific systems
  • Proficiency in Python, R, Perl, SQL or other programming languages, as well as familiarity with APIs and Linux/Unix environments, if acting as programming lead for supplies and laboratory operations

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Minimum of 6 years clinical research experience with academic, Contract Research Organization, pharmaceutical or biotech industry
  • Working knowledge of clinical drug development process and clinical databases, as well as ICH, GCP guidelines, and US FDA and/or local country regulations as applicable

Education:

  • Requires bachelor degree in life sciences or equivalent (i.e., science, technology, engineering, or mathematics) or relevant work experience. Biology or equivalent major preferred.

jobs.description:
Revenue Cycle Lead

B Above Services

About B Above Services

At B Above Services, we are committed to providing compassionate, individualized support to individuals with autism and their families. Our team works together to make accessing services as straightforward and supportive as possible.

We are looking for an experienced, organized, and proactive Revenue Cycle Lead to join our growing team. This role is essential to supporting the financial health and continued growth of B Above Services by overseeing revenue cycle operations, insurance billing, collections, provider credentialing, and payer enrollment.

The ideal candidate will bring strong healthcare revenue cycle experience, an understanding of Medicaid and commercial insurance requirements, and the leadership skills needed to improve processes, support team performance, and ensure accurate and timely reimbursement for the services we provide.

Position Summary

The Revenue Cycle Lead is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day revenue cycle operations of B Above Services, including claims management, payment posting, denials and appeals, accounts receivable, collections, provider credentialing, and insurance payer enrollment.

This position will work closely with clinical, operations, intake, and administrative teams to ensure accurate documentation, appropriate authorization and enrollment, billing compliance, and timely reimbursement. The Revenue Cycle Lead will also monitor performance metrics, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop scalable processes to support organizational growth, including new hires, locations, and market expansion.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Cycle & Billing Operations

  • Oversee the full revenue cycle, including claims submission, payment posting, denials management, appeals, and collections.
  • Monitor billing accuracy and ensure claims are submitted accurately and within payer deadlines.
  • Track accounts receivable (AR), identify aging claims, and coordinate timely follow-up and resolution.
  • Investigate and resolve claim denials, underpayments, billing discrepancies, and reimbursement delays.
  • Identify revenue leakage, billing inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve collections and financial performance.
  • Establish and maintain effective workflows for claims management, payment reconciliation, and outstanding balances.
  • Ensure billing practices align with payer requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulations.
  • Monitor reimbursement trends and recommend strategies to improve revenue cycle performance.

Provider Credentialing & Insurance Enrollment

  • Oversee provider credentialing, re-credentialing, and insurance payer enrollment for Medicaid and commercial insurance plans.
  • Coordinate credentialing and enrollment for new hires, existing providers, new locations, and market expansion.
  • Track credentialing applications, enrollment statuses, renewal deadlines, and outstanding documentation.
  • Ensure provider credentials, licenses, certifications, and payer enrollment records remain current and accurate.
  • Coordinate with insurance payers and credentialing entities to resolve enrollment issues and prevent unnecessary delays.
  • Maintain organized credentialing records and documentation in accordance with company policies and payer requirements.
  • Collaborate with clinical, HR, and operations teams to ensure providers meet credentialing requirements before delivering services when applicable.
  • Identify credentialing or enrollment issues that could affect billing eligibility or reimbursement and coordinate timely resolution.

Authorization, Compliance & Revenue Integrity

  • Monitor insurance authorizations, approved service hours, and service utilization to support accurate billing and reduce preventable revenue loss.
  • Collaborate with intake, clinical, and authorization teams to track authorization requirements, expiration dates, and outstanding items.
  • Help ensure billed services are supported by appropriate documentation and align with payer authorization requirements.
  • Identify discrepancies between authorized services, delivered services, clinical documentation, and submitted claims.
  • Support compliance with payer policies, Medicaid requirements, HIPAA, and applicable billing regulations.
  • Develop and maintain processes to improve billing accuracy, documentation completeness, and reimbursement compliance.
  • Communicate potential compliance concerns, recurring errors, and operational risks to leadership.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and support billing and credentialing staff, establishing clear responsibilities, accountability, and performance expectations.
  • Provide guidance, training, and ongoing support to help team members meet departmental goals.
  • Monitor team productivity, workload distribution, and completion of critical revenue cycle tasks.
  • Develop standardized procedures and workflows to promote consistency, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Identify training needs and opportunities to strengthen team knowledge of billing, credentialing, payer requirements, and internal processes.
  • Foster collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement across revenue cycle functions.

Reporting, Analytics & Process Improvement

  • Develop, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to claims, collections, accounts receivable, denials, credentialing, and reimbursement.
  • Provide regular updates and performance reports to leadership, highlighting trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Analyze revenue cycle data to identify recurring issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve financial outcomes.
  • Establish measurable goals and implement strategies to improve collections, reduce outstanding receivables, and minimize claim denials.
  • Create and refine processes that support consistency, accountability, and scalability as B Above Services continues to grow.
  • Evaluate existing workflows and recommend improvements to systems, reporting, and cross-departmental communication.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with clinical, intake, operations, HR, and administrative teams to support accurate billing and efficient revenue cycle operations.
  • Communicate payer requirements, billing issues, credentialing updates, and process changes to relevant team members.
  • Work with clinical and operations teams to address documentation gaps and other issues that may delay claims or reimbursement.
  • Support the financial and operational readiness of new providers, service locations, and market expansions.
  • Serve as a key resource for revenue cycle questions, problem resolution, and process improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Prior experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, medical billing, or a related healthcare financial operations role.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare claims submission, payment posting, denials, appeals, collections, and accounts receivable management.
  • Experience with provider credentialing, recredentialing, and insurance payer enrollment.
  • Working knowledge of Medicaid and commercial insurance billing and enrollment requirements.
  • Understanding of insurance authorization processes and how authorizations affect billing and reimbursement.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify billing discrepancies, resolve outstanding claims, and improve collection outcomes.
  • Experience developing, improving, or implementing operational processes and workflows.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to billing accuracy and documentation quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and ongoing operational responsibilities.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of results, and proactively address issues.
  • Strong computer skills and experience using billing, practice management, EMR, or related healthcare systems.
  • Understanding of HIPAA, confidentiality, and applicable healthcare billing compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in applied behavior analysis (ABA), behavioral health, or a related healthcare setting.
  • Two or more years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, billing operations, credentialing, or a related field.
  • Previous experience leading, supervising, or training billing or credentialing staff.
  • Experience working with Indiana Medicaid, other state Medicaid programs, and commercial insurance payers.
  • Familiarity with ABA-specific billing practices, CPT codes, authorization requirements, and payer documentation standards.
  • Experience monitoring KPIs, analyzing accounts receivable, and preparing reports for leadership.
  • Experience supporting provider enrollment and credentialing across multiple locations or states.
  • Experience implementing scalable workflows and improving revenue cycle performance during organizational growth.
  • Familiarity with healthcare practice management, billing, and electronic medical record systems.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented leader who understands both the day-to-day demands of revenue cycle operations and the bigger picture of building efficient, sustainable processes. They take ownership of results, are comfortable solving complex billing and credentialing challenges, and can balance hands-on operational responsibilities with team leadership and strategic process improvement.

This individual will play an important role in strengthening B Above Services' revenue cycle operations, supporting our providers and internal teams, and helping position the organization for continued growth.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Competitive Salary: $65,000–$85,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • PTO and Holiday Pay
  • Employee Referral Bonuses
  • Supportive and Collaborative Work Environment

Why Join B Above Services?

B Seen. B Supported. B Above.

As an Revenue Cycle you will play an important role in helping families access the care and support they need. Your work will directly impact a family's experience from their very first interaction with our organization.

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Senior Benefits Manager to design, run, and continuously improve the health, wellness, and financial benefits programs that support our growing, distributed workforce. About the Role

Home Health NY is looking for a friendly, confident, and results-driven Patient Outreach Representative to support its outreach and lead conversion efforts.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with people, is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls, and can turn conversations into meaningful opportunities. You will contact prospective clients or leads, explain relevant services, build rapport, address questions or objections, and encourage interested individuals to take the next step.

The successful candidate must have excellent spoken English, a warm and professional telephone manner, and the resilience to handle rejection while maintaining a positive attitude.

We are looking for someone who is motivated by results, takes initiative, and understands the importance of consistent outreach, accurate lead tracking, and professional communication.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Outbound Calling and Patient Outreach

  • Make a high volume of outbound calls to prospective clients and leads.
  • Introduce the organisation and communicate relevant service information clearly and professionally.
  • Build rapport with prospective clients through friendly, engaging conversations.
  • Identify interest, understand needs, and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Maintain a positive and professional attitude throughout every interaction.

2. Lead Engagement and Conversion

  • Follow up with leads to maintain engagement and encourage progression through the outreach process.
  • Handle objections, questions, and rejection confidently.
  • Identify opportunities to convert interested leads into booked appointments or qualified opportunities.
  • Work towards agreed outreach, booking, and conversion targets.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up practices to ensure promising leads are not overlooked.

3. Communication and Relationship Building

  • Demonstrate excellent spoken English and a clear, confident telephone presence.
  • Communicate with empathy, patience, and professionalism when speaking with prospective patients or their families.
  • Listen actively and respond appropriately to questions and concerns.
  • Represent Home Health NY positively in every interaction.
  • Escalate enquiries that require additional information or support.

4. Lead Tracking and Administration

  • Maintain accurate lead records, call logs, follow-up notes, and outcomes.
  • Use Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets to track outreach activity and lead progress.
  • Record bookings, conversions, unanswered calls, and follow-up requirements.
  • Ensure all lead information is updated promptly and accurately.
  • Provide regular updates on outreach activity and progress against targets.

5. Performance and Continuous Improvement

  • Meet agreed daily and weekly call activity expectations.
  • Work towards performance targets related to booked appointments and converted leads.
  • Learn from call feedback and continuously improve communication and objection-handling techniques.
  • Take ownership of assigned leads and follow through on outstanding actions.
  • Maintain consistent performance in a target-driven environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience in outbound sales, telemarketing, lead generation, appointment setting, customer outreach, or a similar role.
  • Strong spoken English with clear pronunciation and excellent conversational skills.
  • A friendly, warm, confident, and professional telephone manner.
  • Comfortable making high-volume outbound calls throughout the working day.
  • Ability to handle objections, rejection, and challenging conversations without losing motivation.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Healthcare sales, patient outreach, or medical appointment setting.
  • Home healthcare, home health services, or other healthcare-related customer engagement.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients or customers.
  • Experience working towards daily call targets, booking targets, or conversion KPIs.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, lead tracking, and sales pipelines.

Healthcare experience is advantageous but not essential if the candidate has strong outbound sales experience, excellent English communication, and the ability to learn the services being offered.

Key Skills and Competencies

  • Communication: Speaks clearly, confidently, and professionally.
  • Personability: Builds rapport and makes prospective clients feel comfortable.
  • Resilience: Handles rejection and objections without becoming discouraged.
  • Sales ability: Identifies opportunities and confidently guides conversations towards the next step.
  • Motivation: Is driven by targets, performance, and achieving results.
  • Organisation: Maintains accurate call logs and follows up consistently.
  • Reliability: Maintains consistent attendance, effort, and performance.
  • Coachability: Accepts feedback and applies it to improve results.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Outbound call volume and consistency.
  • Quality of conversations and professionalism.
  • Number of appointments booked or leads converted.
  • Lead follow-up and engagement rates.
  • Accuracy of call logs and lead tracking.
  • Ability to handle objections and maintain a positive attitude.
  • Achievement of agreed performance targets.

Compensation Structure

The compensation package consists of hourly pay plus performance-based bonuses tied to booked appointments or converted leads. Specific rates and targets will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is outgoing, hardworking, confident on the phone, and motivated by achieving results. They enjoy speaking with people, can build rapport quickly, and remain upbeat even when calls do not go as planned.

They are comfortable working towards targets, making repeated outbound calls, and taking ownership of their leads and follow-ups.

We are looking for someone who brings energy, professionalism, resilience, and a genuine desire to perform well in a healthcare outreach environment.

Summary

Are you passionate about building high-performing technology teams in a fast-moving, global environment? Join WTW as a Tech Recruiter, where you’ll partner with engineering leaders to identify, engage, and hire top-tier technical talent shaping the future of our technology organization.

This is a high-impact role where your expertise in talent strategy, market intelligence, and sourcing innovation will directly influence business outcomes.
