jobs.title: Senior Policy Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland • Travel is encouraged approximately once every 6 months to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland

  • Travel is encouraged approximately once every 6 months to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required. We expect these trips to include visits to prisons and parole offices.

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: $120,000

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Hires remotely in: United States

Experience: 5+ years of full-time, professional work experience

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Senior Policy Data Analyst to join our team! We’re a small, fast-moving group that works with complex criminal justice data from our state partners and develops analyses and tools that target the drivers of incarceration. That’s where you come in. We’re looking for someone who has creativity and inquisitiveness to identify and solve open-ended problems, clarity to think through complex and variable data, flexibility to adjust in a rapidly evolving environment, and above all else, a collaborative, kind nature to add to our culture.

About us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we’ve been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About the role

Recidiviz's policy team works with state DOC leaders who want to rewrite old policies or write new ones, grounded in evidence and analytics, to improve outcomes. We use administrative datasets to generate context-responsive insights that expand momentum for policy change. We answer questions like:

  • What earned sentence credit structure creates the strongest reward system given the distribution of sentence lengths and program availability?
  • How do the factors that drive parole board decisions align with the factors most quantitatively predictive of post-release outcomes? How would outcomes change if dynamic factors were weighted more heavily?
  • How will a new supervision contact standard affect the alignment between supervision officer bandwidth and high-need clients?

By translating policy concepts into concrete modeling, we help states make smarter and more ambitious changes.

Senior Policy Data Analysts are high-autonomy technical contributors. They own an end to end analytic process — breaking project objectives into analytical products, designing the approach, derisking the timeline, producing the findings, and preparing the materials that go in front of decision-makers. The core skill is decision-support: building analysis for a decision rather than for a research finding.

This role is as much about making judgment calls as it is about running analytical work. Most of our projects are first of their kind, which requires designing the approach as you go. Projects change mid-flight as our understanding of system dynamics develops and the needs of stakeholders shift. This role works closely with a Partnerships Lead, who coordinates with state partners to determine project objectives. The Senior Policy Data Analyst sets the analysis strategy to meet those objectives. Success is measured by the impact your interventions drive.

Core responsibilities

  • Building analysis from corrections and parole data. You'll use SQL and Python to wrangle administrative data to articulate how a system behaves. You ramp up on new data quickly, going deep where it changes the answer and making defensible simplifying assumptions where it doesn’t.
  • Modeling policy scenarios and quantifying tradeoffs. Apply statistical methods like regressions, time series, stock-and-flow modeling or distributional analysis to project how outcomes change under different policy designs, and assess what the data can and can't support. A core judgment is developing simple and elegant approaches that cut to the heart of the decision point.
  • Communicating findings to the people making the decision. You work backward from what information a stakeholder needs to advance decision-making in the room. You'll create the decks and memos that go to DOC leadership, find the frameworks that make a complicated tradeoff digestible, and take responsibility for tailoring your work to the audience to motivate action.
  • Running your projects end to end. You'll translate project objectives into an analysis strategy, set project roadmaps, and identify and address unknowns. You’ll adjust course as project objectives change, and rightsize analysis with impact.
  • Collaborating across Recidiviz. You'll collaborate across the organization to obtain state context, understand underlying data infrastructure, and support policy implementation.
  • Finding the next opportunity. You’ll go deeper on the states you work in — spotting where additional analysis could unlock a decision, and running the early exploration to assess whether it’s worth pursuing.

Wild success

A year from now:

  • You've driven impact. Your work has directly shaped several policy reforms across the country.
  • You’ve uncovered new opportunities. You spotted a new opportunity in your states that became new work for the team.
  • You've made your projects more effective. The people around you have less scramble, clearer ownership, and smoother handoffs, making it easier for everyone to focus on driving towards impact.
  • You've leveled up our analytical team. Approaches you designed, like a modeling pattern or a framework for a recurring question, are now being reused by teammates on other states.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5 or more years of practical experience exploring, analyzing, and processing complex datasets
  • Professional experience using SQL with large datasets, including high proficiency writing efficient queries for complex extraction and transformation
  • Professional experience with Python, particularly pandas, for statistical analysis and data visualization
  • Sufficient statistical background to reason about analysis design, examine results closely, and prepare analyses that hold up to scrutiny
  • Experience scoping and delivering analytical work — particularly balancing depth and speed when navigating short timelines and shifting priorities
  • Experience on teams where ownership is shared across functions, including proactively seeking context you're missing and flagging risks before they become blockers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience adapting quantitative methods to introduce intuitively meaningful metrics in ambiguous, unconstrained contexts
  • Experience working with large administrative datasets from the public sector, especially related to criminal justice
  • Familiarity with our data stack, which includes Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker, Jupyter notebooks, and Python/Pandas

Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The compensation for this role is: $120,000.

What we offer

  • Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
  • 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
  • Complimentary One Medical membership (depending on location)
  • Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
  • Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
  • Free mental health support via Talkspace
  • Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
  • An annual company offsite each spring and other ad-hoc gatherings
  • All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

More about Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we’ve built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator’s 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 20 state partners – big and small, red and blue – and covers more than 46% of the US incarcerated population. We have helped to get tens of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably, and saved states nearly $1 billion. In the next five years, Recidiviz plans to partner with 40 states and help 250,000 people who are stuck in the system to get out and stay out. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2025 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk.

An important note

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

nyra health builds the digital tools that make neurological rehabilitation work inside and outside clinic walls: myReha, the patient therapy app, and nyra insights, the clinician platform. 100+ clinics, 100K+ patients across DACH. €20M Series A. 3× MRR growth target for 2026, driven by a team of 50 Ownership, excellence and patients first: that is how we drive progress together.

Your role. You lead the team that brings myReha into therapy practices across Germany. Therapists use myReha as part of their daily work, bringing their patients onto the app so they can keep training at home between sessions, with the therapy funded by our insurance partners. Success here is not a signed contract but a change in habit: practices that make myReha a natural part of how they treat, and patients who stay active. You own the full loop, from bringing new practices on board to getting their first patients started and keeping them engaged over time. Think supply-side growth at a marketplace, not a classic sales role. You expand and lead a team, set the direction, and stay close to the work by joining calls yourself. Location: anywhere in Austria or Germany.

What you'll work on

  • Own the activation funnel: from practice sign-up to first onboarded patient to habitual use. You define the metrics, find where practices drop off, and fix it.

  • Acquire the right practices: build the motion that brings new practices and therapists on board across DACH, prioritised by who will actually activate, not just who will sign up.

  • Run experiments that teach us something: clear hypotheses, success criteria set up front, honest reviews. At our volumes much of the learning is qualitative, and you make it rigorous.

  • Lead as a player-coach: set the team's weekly programme on Monday, review on Friday, coach on calls, and take calls yourself.

  • Work with data and across teams: build your own segmentations and funnel analyses, and work closely with Marketing, Product, Insurance and Account Management.

Requirements

Must-have

  • You have moved an activation or adoption metric: you owned a number like activation rate, time to first use or retention (not just a pipeline or revenue quota), and you can tell us exactly how much you moved it.

  • Hands-on with data: you build your own segmentations and funnel analyses (HubSpot, Metabase, SQL or similar) instead of waiting for an analyst.

  • Experiment discipline: you define success criteria before you start, and you can walk us through experiments that failed and what changed as a result.

  • Player-coach leadership: 4–8 years of experience, including leading a small team on a weekly operating rhythm, while still getting on the phone yourself.

  • High-velocity background: marketplace supply growth, SMB inside sales or sales development, onboarding-focused customer success, or growth / RevOps at a scale-up.

  • Fluent German (C1+) and professional English: the channel is therapist-facing in DACH; English is our team language.

Nice to have

  • Health-tech or regulated-market experience, ideally an understanding of the German statutory-insurance environment.

  • Experience with a free or freemium-style motion where monetisation sits outside the immediate user.

  • You already use AI tools across your own workflow.

Job Description

**This is a regional position. Preference will go to applicants living in or near Norfolk, VA, Raleigh, NC or Charlotte, NC.**


The Senior Manager of Fleet Client Services will lead and provide direction for the scheduling team to optimize work volumes and staffing levels, ensuring operational efficiency and excellent customer service. Maintains positive relationships with all site/market customers and internal business leaders.


What You’ll Do:

The Senior Manager of Fleet Client Services is responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of Fleet Maintenance clients in a high-volume market, potentially encompassing multiple small to medium markets within an assigned geographic territory. The primary responsibilities include client retention and expansion, ultimately driving a continuous revenue stream resulting in high technician efficiency and client satisfaction. Acts as a manager-level escalation point for complex customer issues. This role is responsible for making decisions and managing accounts to ensure they achieve measurable results from the product, implementing a robust performance management process aligned with organizational expectations and utilizing tools for goal accomplishment.


Here’s more of what you can expect when you step up to the plate:

  • The Sr. Manager role involves a higher level of strategic leadership, oversight, and responsibility for the overall operation of the department. It includes a more significant focus on relationship management, strategic reporting, and advocating for team needs at a higher organizational level.
  • Responsible for meeting and exceeding revenue and customer churn goals for the assigned market(s).
  • Build and maintain client relationships and ensure exceptional customer experience.
  • Evaluate growth opportunities by client needs and market trends, assess business options to address those needs and make recommendations to leader.
  • Work effectively with the national and regional Sales teams to maximize opportunities to provide value to the client.
  • Responsible for annual sales targets and customer churn metrics.
  • Partner and communicate consistently with Field Operations as they are impacted by changes with client accounts.
  • Provide leadership and direction to scheduling team who will coordinate services to meet needs of the client(s).
  • Utilizing a deep understanding of the fleet maintenance business and clients’ business models, strategically align Cox Automotive’s suite of products and services to ensure client success.
  • Serves as the key point of contact for both internal and external clients, addressing escalations and inquiries. Cultivate and maintain positive working relationships with clients to ensure superior and positive client experience.
  • Monitor client, market and competitor activity and provide feedback to the team leaders on key changes and business needs.
  • To identify and work with ‘at risk’ clients, determining appropriate action plans to turnaround status/performance.
  • Using methods provided to closely monitor system ‘red flags’/emergencies with clients and take immediate action.
  • Attend customer meetings as a Cox management representative.
  • Strategically lead and maintain transparent communication by disseminating organization information effectively through comprehensive means, including department meetings, one-on-one sessions, targeted email communications, Teams chats, and regular interpersonal engagements. As a Senior Manager, ensure that communication practices align with the organization's overarching goals, fostering a culture of openness and collaboration across various channels.
  • Collaborates with other departments, physical sites, and leadership – ensuring ongoing communication, coordination of activities and a high quality of customer service both internally and externally.
  • Visibly demonstrate safety commitment by following all safety and health procedures and modeling the behaviors related to such. Work in cooperation with safety leadership in support of all safety activities aligned with Safety Excellence.
  • Perform any other duties assigned

Who you are:
Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and 8 years or more experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and 6 years or more experience; a Ph.D. and up to 3 years of experience; or 12 years or experience, or more, in a related field.
  • At least 3 years in a management/leadership role.
  • Travel required: up to 40% within outlined territory.
  • Safe drivers needed, valid driver’s license required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree in a related field strongly desired (sales, marketing, finance, business, etc.).
  • Experience in the fleet or automobile industry preferred.
  • Proven track record of successfully building relationships, consulting and selling value added service solutions.
  • Adaptable, results oriented and proven ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Consistency drives results through influencing with analytical support.
  • Skilled in developing and finalizing business case scenarios.
  • Ability to foster productive and professional internal and external business relationships required.
  • Ability to achieve business results through influence, executive presence, strategic thinking, and effective problem-solving skills.

Come join the Cox family of businesses and make your mark today!

Benefits

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

About Us

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. Benefits of working at Cox may include health care insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement planning (401(k)), and paid days off (sick leave, parental leave, flexible vacation/wellness days, and/or PTO). For more details on what benefits you may be offered, visit our benefits page. Cox is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer – All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to that individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law. Cox provides reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with disability, unless such accommodations would cause an undue hardship.EOE, including disability/vetsApplicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. jobs.description:
Admin Executive Assistant – Operations, Compliance & ITAD | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Admin Executive Assistant to support executive administration, operational coordination, compliance workflows, client onboarding, and documentation within an IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) environment.

This is more than a traditional administrative role. You’ll serve as an important operational control layer, ensuring information is accurate, documentation is complete, follow-ups happen on time, and critical details don’t get missed.

Because the business operates in a compliance-sensitive environment, precision, organization, confidentiality, and attention to detail are essential.

If you’re someone who catches inconsistencies others miss, enjoys creating order, and takes ownership of tasks through completion, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Executive & Administrative Support

  • Manage calendars, meetings, scheduling, and day-to-day administrative coordination
  • Support leadership with priorities, communication, and follow-ups
  • Coordinate across clients, leadership, and internal teams
  • Anticipate scheduling conflicts and operational needs before they become problems
  • Track outstanding action items and ensure timely completion
  • Help protect leadership bandwidth by keeping workflows organized
  • Maintain professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information

Compliance & Documentation Support

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation
  • Support compliance-sensitive processes within ITAD operations
  • Review documentation for missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information
  • Ensure records are properly organized, stored, and accessible
  • Maintain consistent documentation standards across operational systems
  • Track required documentation and follow up on missing items
  • Help ensure compliance-related records remain current and reliable

Client Onboarding & Operational Tracking

  • Track client onboarding from initiation through completion
  • Ensure required information and documentation are collected
  • Monitor outstanding tasks, follow-ups, and internal dependencies
  • Maintain clear visibility into onboarding status
  • Coordinate with clients and internal stakeholders throughout the process
  • Escalate missing information, blockers, or potential delays proactively
  • Ensure onboarding steps are completed accurately and on time

Quality Control & Accuracy

  • Review names, dates, numbers, schedules, records, and documentation before execution
  • Identify inconsistencies across systems and workflows
  • Catch potential errors before they create operational or financial issues
  • Track process and documentation changes accurately
  • Double-check critical information before submission or execution
  • Maintain strong quality-control standards across daily operations

Systems & Records Management

  • Maintain organized and accurate records across tools such as:
    • Google Workspace
    • Slack
    • Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Keep systems clean, searchable, and up to date
  • Maintain consistent naming and documentation practices
  • Ensure important information can be retrieved quickly when needed
  • Update CRM and internal systems as operational information changes
  • Maintain reliable records across administrative and compliance workflows

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations Support roles
  • Strong experience with Google Workspace
  • Experience using Slack
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities without sacrificing accuracy
  • Strong follow-through and organizational discipline
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems proactively
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality
  • Comfortable working in a process-driven environment
  • Ability to work during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience in IT Asset Disposition (ITAD)
  • Experience in compliance-heavy or highly regulated environments
  • Familiarity with audit preparation and compliance documentation
  • Experience supporting founders, executives, or leadership teams
  • Client onboarding experience
  • Operational tracking and workflow management experience
  • Experience maintaining structured records across multiple systems

Tools & Technology

Google Workspace | Gmail | Google Drive | Google Docs | Google Sheets | Google Calendar | Slack | Salesforce | CRM Systems | Documentation & Workflow Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Notice small inconsistencies quickly
  • Naturally double-check important information
  • Prefer structured and organized systems
  • Take ownership instead of waiting to be reminded
  • Follow tasks through until they are completely resolved
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Handle confidential information responsibly
  • Stay organized while managing multiple priorities
  • Proactively flag risks instead of waiting for problems to escalate
  • Understand that accuracy is just as important as speed

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing leadership calendars, outstanding action items, client onboarding progress, and documentation requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate meetings, review records for missing or incorrect information, follow up on operational tasks, update Salesforce and internal systems, and organize compliance documentation.

You’ll also coordinate communication between clients and internal teams, verify important dates and records, and proactively flag inconsistencies or risks before they create larger problems.

In short: you ensure the administrative and operational side of the business stays accurate, organized, compliant, and under control.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation
  • Zero critical operational or documentation errors
  • On-time completion of assigned tasks and follow-ups
  • Smooth and timely client onboarding
  • CRM and internal records accuracy
  • Audit-readiness of compliance documentation
  • Reduction in preventable operational issues
  • Consistency of administrative workflows
  • Leadership confidence in administrative and operational execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-trust role working closely with leadership
  • Direct impact on operational accuracy and compliance
  • Exposure to structured ITAD and compliance workflows
  • Strong ownership over administrative and operational processes
  • Opportunity to improve documentation and workflow consistency
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Operations Manager

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

Make an impact as a Senior CRA at Worldwide


As a Senior CRA, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted with the highest standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. Your expertise will help drive the successful execution of studies from site qualification through closeout, supporting the delivery of reliable data that advances clinical research.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, study teams, and sponsors, building strong relationships while providing leadership, guidance, and oversight across clinical trial activities. You’ll have the opportunity to influence study success through proactive monitoring, site management, and collaboration with global teams.

Your contributions will directly support high-quality study delivery by ensuring protocol adherence, regulatory compliance, timely data collection, and effective site performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.


Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across Czechia. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 6-8 days per month.


What You'll Do

  • Manage clinical research activities at investigative sites participating in Worldwide clinical studies.
  • Identify and assess potential research sites to support successful study execution.
  • Coordinate study start-up activities, including collection of regulatory documentation and support of contract and budget processes.
  • Conduct all types of monitoring visits: Pre-Site Selection Visits (PSSVs), Study Initiation Visits (SIVs),Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs) and Closeout Visits (COVs).
  • Train site personnel on protocol requirements, data collection processes, and safety reporting expectations.
  • Monitor site performance and provide ongoing support throughout study maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with informed consent requirements, safety reporting obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Partner with sites and study teams to drive data quality, participant safety, and overall study success.
  • Support site closeout activities and ensure study requirements are completed at the conclusion of the trial.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree or a Nursing Degree, along with 5+ years as a regional, traveling Clinical Research Associate.
  • Required experience monitoring clinical trials.
  • Requires travel within the specified region; 6 – 8 DOS monthly
  • Experience in full-service monitoring preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, site management, and regulatory requirements.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Healthcare Dispatch & Patient Coordination Specialist to support patient intake, appointment coordination, and technician dispatching for a healthcare service provider.

This role goes beyond answering calls. You will be responsible for accurately registering patients, coordinating appointments, managing technician schedules and routes, updating multiple systems, and ensuring that patients and internal teams receive timely and accurate information.

The ideal candidate has experience in healthcare administration, dispatching, scheduling, patient intake, or call-center coordination. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and routes can change throughout the day, requiring quick thinking, strong communication, and reliable follow-through.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Patient Intake & Registration

  • Handle incoming calls and assist patients with enquiries, registration, and intake procedures.
  • Capture patient information accurately and update records in the relevant healthcare systems.
  • Ensure patient details and required documentation are complete and up to date.
  • Communicate professionally and sensitively with patients, including those who may have limited English proficiency.
  • Provide clear instructions and direct patients to the appropriate team when further assistance is required.

Dispatching & Route Coordination

  • Coordinate and dispatch technicians based on appointment schedules, availability, locations, and service requirements.
  • Monitor technician schedules and routes, making adjustments when appointments change or unexpected issues arise.
  • Use routing platforms to coordinate daily activities and support efficient travel between appointments.
  • Communicate schedule changes and dispatch updates to technicians and relevant internal teams.
  • Track outstanding appointments, delays, and scheduling issues to ensure appropriate follow-up.

Scheduling & Administrative Support

  • Schedule, confirm, and update patient appointments.
  • Maintain accurate records across multiple platforms, ensuring information is consistent between systems.
  • Monitor pending tasks and follow up on outstanding administrative requirements.
  • Coordinate communication between patients, technicians, and internal teams.
  • Assist with the transition to an integrated routing platform as new systems and processes are introduced.
  • Follow established procedures for handling clinical information and escalating questions or concerns that require clinical input.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience in healthcare administration, patient coordination, medical intake, dispatching, scheduling, or call-center operations.
  • Strong telephone communication and customer service skills.
  • Excellent data-entry accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple appointments, technicians, and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt quickly when routes, schedules, or patient requirements change.
  • Comfortable working with multiple software platforms and learning new integrated systems.
  • Reliable follow-through and the ability to work independently.
  • Availability to work agreed shifts, including overnight hours and weekends.

Required Software & Tools

Experience with the following systems is preferred:

  • eClinicalWorks (ECW): For patient registration, healthcare records, and administrative workflows.
  • Proprietary Intake & Dispatch Platform: For managing patient intake and coordinating dispatch activities.
  • Onfleet or Similar Routing Software: For technician dispatching, route management, and scheduling updates.
  • Integrated Routing Platforms: Ability to adapt to new systems as they are implemented.
  • Communication Tools: Email, telephone, messaging platforms, and internal team communication systems.

Candidates with experience using similar healthcare, scheduling, or dispatch systems are encouraged to apply.

Essential Skills & Competencies

  • Communication: Clear, professional, and empathetic communication with patients and colleagues.
  • Accuracy: Fast and precise data capture, recordkeeping, and system updates.
  • Multitasking: Ability to manage calls, appointments, dispatch activities, and administrative follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Routing judgment: Confidence making scheduling adjustments and responding to changing operational priorities.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technology and working across several systems.
  • Problem-solving: Ability to identify scheduling conflicts, resolve routine issues, and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Reliability: Consistent follow-through and accountability for outstanding tasks.
  • Cultural sensitivity: Ability to communicate patiently and respectfully with patients from diverse backgrounds, including those with limited English proficiency.

Important Considerations

This position requires more than general call-center experience. The successful candidate must be comfortable with detailed administrative coordination, real-time scheduling changes, dispatch decisions, and accurate recordkeeping.

All clinical decisions and communication of clinical results must follow the client's approved procedures. The role does not involve making independent clinical judgments outside the candidate's authorized responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Patient information is captured accurately and records remain up to date.
  • Appointments and technician routes are coordinated efficiently.
  • Scheduling changes are communicated promptly to the relevant people.
  • Outstanding administrative tasks are followed up consistently.
  • Multiple systems are maintained accurately, with minimal errors.
  • Patients receive professional, respectful, and timely support.

If you are organized, adaptable, and enjoy coordinating people, schedules, and processes in a healthcare environment, we would love to hear from you.

Position Title: Cyber Security Analyst
Location: Remote (In the U.S)

POSITION SUMMARY

Sprezzatura is seeking a Cyber Security Analyst to join our team supporting (Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Enrollment System (VES). In this role you will be responsible for supporting the system's Authority to Operate (ATO), maintaining security authorization documentation, coordinating continuous monitoring activities, and ensuring compliance with FISMA, NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), and VA cybersecurity requirements. RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support security authorization and continuous monitoring activities in accordance with FISMA, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, and VA policies
  • Maintain and update security documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Configuration Management Plan (CMP), Privacy Threshold Analysis (PTA), Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA), and other required artifacts
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, security control assessments, and remediation activities

jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

  1. Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
  2. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  3. FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

﻿

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

﻿

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

﻿

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Singapore.

Requirements

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Tax Reviewer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, and committed to delivering high-quality tax compliance services. You should be eager to learn, possess strong attention to detail, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment while supporting clients with their tax reporting and compliance obligations.

Mission
As a Tax Reviewer, you will be responsible for preparing and managing tax filings, tax returns, and compliance-related matters for clients at the start ensuring all work is completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with applicable tax regulations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, maintain a high standard of client service, and contribute to the overall success of the business through accuracy and efficiency. For progression into a Reviewer role, you will first demonstrate consistent performance and strong technical competency in tax preparation and compliance before transitioning to reviewing and overseeing the work of other team members to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance.

Outcomes

  • Prepare and submit corporate income tax filings accurately and within statutory deadlines.
  • Deliver high-quality tax compliance services while maintaining excellent client satisfaction.
  • Utilise tax technology and internal systems effectively to ensure efficient and accurate tax computations and filings.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of tax regulations and compliance requirements, minimising errors and ensuring quality deliverables.
  • For senior or reviewer-level responsibilities, demonstrate the ability to review work, provide guidance to team members, and ensure accuracy and compliance across the team.

To do this, you will have:

  • At least 1 year of experience in Singapore Corporate Income Tax compliance and filing.
  • Strong understanding of Singapore tax regulations and tax return preparation.
  • Experience reviewing tax work and ensuring accuracy and compliance is an advantage.
  • Previous experience managing, mentoring, or guiding team members is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines effectively.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

TA Screen

A 30-minute video call with a member of our HR team to discuss your application, explore your career background, and understand your expectations for the role.

Technical Round

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager. They’ll discuss your last 1-2 roles to understand your experience in more detail.

Soft Skills Assessment

A ~45 minute chat with a leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Offer + reference interviews

We’ll make a non-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You will be required to work from the office at least 2–3 days per week if you are based in Singapore, UK, Hong Kong or Australia. For all other hiring locations, the role will be fully remote, with work from home five days a week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Additionally, you’ll be able to access our flexi benefits scheme for home office equipment or health and fitness expenditure. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.excerpt: About UsFlourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions.
jobs.description:
About Us

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Heath; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us – it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds – they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

The problem you will help solve

Public health agencies depend on reliable, secure technology to protect communities. When the systems health departments use to manage data, coordinate programs, and respond to crises go down, response slows, and communities lose ground. At Flourish and Thrive Labs, we build and operate PH360, a public health technology platform that helps local, state, territorial, tribal, and federal agencies work faster and smarter. You will keep that platform running, secure, and ready for the people who depend on it.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days, you will learn the PH360 platform architecture, meet your teammates on the System Team, get oriented in our AWS and Salesforce environments, and complete your first sandbox configuration task.

By 90 days, you will independently manage sandbox environments, own a defined set of CI/CD pipeline workflows in GitHub Actions, and actively contribute to SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance activities.

In your first year, you will have materially improved the reliability and synchronization of our development, staging, and production environments, reduced sandbox-related access issues, and contributed to a measurable improvement in deployment pipeline efficiency.

A typical week

Most of your time will be spent configuring and maintaining AWS and Salesforce environments across development, staging, and production, as well as keeping GitHub Actions workflows running smoothly. You will participate in Scaled Agile for Enterprise (SAFe) ceremonies as a member of the System Team supporting the Agile Release Train, including PI Planning. You will collaborate daily with fellow platform engineers and coordinate with System, Solution, and Enterprise Architects on platform decisions. You will monitor system health through Datadog and contribute to incident response when production issues arise.

How you will work with AI

F&T Labs uses AI tools to support engineering and operations work. You will be expected to use AI coding and productivity assistants as part of your workflow. Humans remain accountable for all infrastructure decisions, code reviews, security configurations, and any actions that affect protected health information. We will provide training and support for team members who are new to AI-native ways of working.

What you need to succeed on day one

If you have lived experience or community ties relevant to the populations our public health customers serve, we value that perspective alongside your technical skills.

Honest notes about the work

Hours: Core collaboration hours are 10 A.M. to 2 P.M. Central, Monday through Friday. We offer flexibility outside those hours, and we trust you to manage your time. Compliance work: This role actively contributes to SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance. That work involves careful documentation and attention to detail and is a valued part of how we protect our customers and their communities.

Growth

Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are comfortable working remotely while building strong partnerships across the organization. You possess exceptional leadership, technical, and operational expertise and can successfully bridge strategy, process, technology, and execution.

As the Assistant Director, Student Experience & Operations, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership, development, optimization, and execution of the student lifecycle and journey at ACE. You will oversee operational functions, lead process and technology transformation initiatives, and ensure alignment between business objectives, student needs, and institutional priorities. You will define and implement scalable solutions that enhance the student experience, improve operational efficiency, and increase student satisfaction and success. You will need to collaborate with all student facing teams and the IT department in tandem.

As the Assistant Director, Student Experience & Operations, you will provide strategic leadership for the student lifecycle, student operations, process improvement, and technology enablement across the institution. You will need to be expert in CRM and SIS processes and systems.

Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.

  • Develops strong partnerships and influences decision-making at all organizational levels.

Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership across the student lifecycle. Your

responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the institutional subject matter expert on all aspects of the student lifecycle.
  • Lead the strategy, design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end student

experience.

  • Direct student operations initiatives and establish operational standards that support student

success.

  • Partner with executive leadership, business leaders, Product Owners, and IT teams to define and

prioritize strategic enhancements.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve operational effectiveness, scalability, system

functionality, and student satisfaction.

  • Ensure all system changes, business processes, and operational workflows align with defined student

lifecycle objectives using agile methodologies.

  • Develop and implement policies, processes, procedures, and technology solutions that streamline the

student experience.

  • Promote the effective utilization of technology to support staff productivity and student success.
  • Partner with technology teams to implement and support enterprise solutions and process

enhancements.

  • Monitor performance metrics, operational effectiveness, and student experience outcomes, using

data-driven insights to drive continuous improvement.

  • Provide leadership and oversight for operational teams while fostering employee engagement,

accountability, and professional development.

  • Lead organizational change management efforts associated with process, technology, and

operational improvements.

  • Act as a champion for innovation, collaboration, and student-centered decision-making across the

institution.

  • Establish priorities, manage multiple initiatives, and ensure timely delivery of strategic and

operational objectives.

  • Serve as a role model in managing deadlines, deliverables, and cross-departmental collaboration.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Master's degree required, preferably in Higher Education, Business Administration, Organizational

Leadership, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related field.

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in higher education supporting the student lifecycle

through operational, technology, process improvement, or student services functions.

  • 5+ years of experience leading teams and managing people leaders.
  • Significant experience with Microsoft CRM, Anthology, Canvas, or similar enterprise platforms.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise-wide operational and technology transformation initiatives.
  • Strong project and program management expertise, including agile methodologies and technology

implementation frameworks.

  • Experience designing and optimizing business processes that support student success and

organizational scalability.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with executive leaders and cross-functional

stakeholders.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously in a remote environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using operational and student data to drive decisions.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6 consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition, being named a USA Top Workplace in 2022, 2023 and 2024. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following benefits:

• HSA and FSA options

• Paid volunteer time

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

  • Defect Analysis & Resolution: Investigate complex, cross-component issues using logs, data, and system diagnostics to isolate root causes. Partner with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent recurrence.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, test management tooling (e.g., qTest, Zephyr), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience testing within containerized or cloud-based environments (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Financial Analyst, Treasury

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst, Treasury to join our Controllership organization. The role is primarily focused on Treasury Operations and is ideal for a strong treasury professional who wants to broaden their corporate finance experience. The position is highly cross-functional, partnering with Accounting, Tax, AP, AR, Payroll and FP&A, with additional development opportunities across Consolidated FP&A, Lender Relations and Special Projects.

In this role, you will:

Treasury Operations

  • Support global cash and liquidity management across multiple legal entities, currencies and banking relationships. Own daily, weekly and monthly cash positioning and management reporting.
  • Be the day-to-day point-person for banking operations. Including bank accounts, payments, corporate credit cards, merchant accounts, etc.. Partner with the larger organization on IT projects, KYCs, internal controls, signatories, and other banking related initiatives.
  • Build, maintain and enhance the 13-week cash flow forecast; analyze receipts, disbursements, working capital drivers and forecast variances. Partner closely with AP, AR, Payroll, Tax and Accounting to coordinate legal entity funding requirements
  • Manage surplus cash and support the investment portfolio, balancing liquidity, capital preservation and returns; monitor market rates, maturities, portfolio liquidity and cash yield. Revamp and operationalize a corporate investment policy statement.
  • Administration of capital markets activity: interest elections, lender reporting, foreign exchange, ISDAs, liquidity analysis.
  • Maintain and enhance Treasury Management System processes. Use Excel, Power Query, Claude and Power BI to automate treasury forecasting, reporting and analytics; improve data flows, controls, processes and data quality. Build out balance sheet KPI dashboards.
  • Support a scalable finance organization; investigate new technologies, streamline processes, rationalize account structures and integrate new acquisitions.

Corporate Finance

  • Support consolidated actuals, budgets and forecasts, including P&L, balance sheet and cash flow analysis.
  • Build and maintain integrated three-statement financial models and perform variance, trend, scenario and sensitivity analysis.
  • Partner with Controllership and FP&A to bridge accounting results to management reporting and forecasts.
  • Participate in refinancings, M&A, and other corporate finance initiatives.
  • Operationalize senior management and Board reporting. Help build the narrative for board, lenders, credit agencies and other 3rd parties.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field; CPA or CFA designation, or meaningful progress towards either.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience with demonstrated corporate Treasury experience and a strong understanding of liquidity, cash forecasting, banking and treasury operations.
  • Familiarity with a fast-paced PE sponsored and/or publicly traded company. Knowledge of how a matrixed multinational finance org operates.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, including the ability to build or work with integrated three-statement models.
  • Strong systems aptitude with Power Query, Power BI or similar tools; TMS and NetSuite experience is an asset.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and cross-functional relationship skills with high attention to detail.

The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

We are looking for a Customer Success Consultant to support customer onboarding and ongoing success after go-live for our AI-driven Retail Planning and Pricing SaaS platform.   • Work with account managers and pre-sales colleagues on upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Track customer-specific time and effort accurately.

  • Experience working with visualisation tools like PowerBI, Tableau, Google Looker Studio

What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer you will design, build and operate the platforms behind software delivery, edge and L7 networking, platform access, and the application-facing parts of our observability stack. Alpaca is expanding fast and our needs grow with it, so we run a follow-the-sun model that keeps those systems covered around the clock. This role is the team's presence in its own region: supporting and owning that platform in your timezone.

While we are not looking for a specialist in a single tool, deep expertise in one of the tools we use alongside a broad skillset would be an advantage. What we care about most is judgement: thinking in terms of delivery and the request path, understanding business priorities and the pressure that comes with fast growth, and carrying a piece of work across quarters to a high standard without needing supervision. The engineers who do well here choose the simple solution over the easy one, even when the simple one takes longer to find.

Things You Get To Do

  • Help the engineers who build on our platform: troubleshoot problems across the stack, advise teams on how to use what we run, and take your share of the support rotation during your region's hours.
  • Participate in our Follow-The-Sun on-call model: watch and triage alerts, join and declare incidents, lead structured debugging and escalation, and drive blameless post-mortems and the post-actions that actually close the loop.
  • Own the path a change takes to production - GitHub Actions into Argo CD, with Helm underneath - and the release tooling that has to work across multiple clusters and regions.
  • Run high-traffic edge and API gateway infrastructure serving hundreds of millions of requests a day globally, where performance, availability and safe change all matter at once.
  • Operates the internal tooling the rest of engineering depends on - Grafana, Sentry, Teleport, Metabase, Atlantis and others - as production services with real users rather than one-off installations.
  • Advance Platform-as-a-Product: build self-serve capabilities and paved paths so engineers can get what they need through a golden path rather than a hand-off, measured by how quickly and safely the rest of engineering can ship.
  • Take improvement projects end to end, from a problem nobody has framed yet through to something running in production that other teams rely on.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years in a DevOps, Platform/Infrastructure, or SRE role, with a proven track record operating large-scale, high-availability, high-performance systems in production.
  • A track record of carrying multi-quarter platform work end to end in a complex environment running multiple Kubernetes clusters.
  • Deep production Kubernetes experience across multiple clusters - upgrades, debugging and day-to-day operational ownership - including packaging and deploying workloads with Helm.
  • Strong Infrastructure-as-Code skills with Terraform, structuring codebases across multiple environments, with GitOps as a first principle and least-privilege as a default mindset.
  • Proven experience building and owning CI/CD pipelines at scale, for example with GitHub Actions, including releases that deploy to multiple production locations rather than only promoting through environments.
  • GitOps continuous delivery with Argo CD, or a comparable tool you can transfer from.
  • Working production experience on Google Cloud, ideally GKE. You do not need to have designed landing zones or cloud topology, but you should be fluent operating on GCP day to day.
  • Solid L7 networking fundamentals - load balancing, DNS, TLS and HTTP routing - and comfort debugging the request path from edge to workload.
  • A Platform-as-a-Product mindset, treating what the team runs as products with real users rather than internal installations.
  • Able and willing to take part in a Follow-The-Sun on-call rotation from APAC or EMEA hours, and to work effectively in a distributed, async-first team with strong written communication.

Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)

You can succeed in this role without all of the below, but any of these will help you ramp faster:

  • Policy-as-code and IaC quality tooling (OPA/Conftest, Checkov, tflint, Atlantis, or similar).
  • Experience managing Terraform state, module registries and versioning at scale across many teams.
  • Running secret management at scale (HashiCorp Vault, OpenBao, or similar) as a service other teams depend on.
  • Internal PKI and certificate lifecycle management (private CAs, issuance and rotation, mTLS between services).
  • Experience building self-serve developer platforms and internal golden paths (e.g. with Backstage, Tilt, or similar).
  • Production experience on Azure alongside GCP.
  • Working proficiency in Go for automation and tooling.
  • Strong Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) and container (Docker/containerd) fundamentals.
  • Security and compliance experience in a regulated environment (SOC 2, audit logging).
  • Familiarity with trading, brokerage, or other regulated fintech domains.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Preferred Qualifications

Additional Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI.
