At Nscale, our Procurement and Supply Chain team plays a critical role in securing the equipment, capacity, and supplier commitments that make our data centre build-outs possible. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

The Senior Supply Chain Manager, Long-Lead Equipment, is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the end-to-end supply chain strategy for complex, long-lead materials and capital equipment across our AMERS data centre programs. This role ensures continuity of supply for critical items with extended lead times by driving rigorous forecasting, supplier collaboration, risk management, and cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Project Management, Finance, and Operations.

You will be the primary owner of long-lead equipment strategy, from early project scoping through delivery, installation, and commissioning, working within our Owner Furnished, Contractor Installed (OFCI) procurement model.

What You'll be Doing

Strategic Planning and Ownership

  • Develop and own the long-lead equipment strategy across assigned programs, including make-vs-buy, sourcing, and inventory strategies.
    - Partner with Project Management and Engineering to translate project timelines and specifications into material demand plans and procurement milestones.
    - Build multi-year plans for long-lead components and equipment, aligned with business growth, capacity expansion, and cost targets.

Demand Planning and Forecasting

  • Create and maintain detailed forecasts for long-lead items, incorporating project schedules, engineering changes, and historical consumption.
    - Run scenario and sensitivity analyses to understand the impact of delays, scope changes, and schedule shifts.
    - Collaborate with Finance to align spend forecasts and cash-flow impacts for major equipment purchases.

Supplier Management and Sourcing

  • Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers for long-lead equipment, including OEMs and key component manufacturers.
    - Lead sourcing events (RFI/RFQ/RFP), contract negotiations, and frame agreements that secure capacity, pricing, and lead-time commitments.
    - Develop supplier scorecards and conduct regular business reviews to drive performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Execution, Logistics, and Delivery

  • Own the full purchase-to-delivery lifecycle for long-lead equipment, ensuring on-time delivery to project sites and facilities.
    - Coordinate closely with Logistics, Site Operations, and Installation teams on shipping plans, customs requirements, staging, and sequencing.
    - Proactively monitor and manage purchase orders, exceptions, and changes, resolving issues before they impact project timelines.

Risk Management and Mitigation

  • Identify supply, schedule, quality, and capacity risks for long-lead items and develop mitigation plans, including alternate sources, safety stock, and dual-sourcing strategies.
    - Maintain and regularly update a risk register for critical equipment and components.
    - Escalate and resolve critical issues with suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and decision-making.

Process Improvement and Systems

  • Define and refine the processes, tools, and KPIs used to manage long-lead equipment across the organization.
    - Partner with IT and Systems teams to improve ERP/MRP, procurement, and tracking workflows for long-lead items.
    - Drive standardization of BOM structures, lead-time assumptions, and planning parameters to improve data quality and planning accuracy.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the primary point of contact for long-lead equipment topics across Project Management, Engineering, Construction, and Operations.
    - Lead cross-functional reviews to align on equipment priorities, trade-offs, and decisions.
    - Mentor and support junior supply chain and procurement team members.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
    - Experience in supply chain, procurement, or operations, with significant responsibility for long-lead materials or capital equipment.
    - Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects with tight deadlines and high business impact.
    - Strong experience with ERP/MRP systems and advanced planning tools.
    - Excellent negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship skills.
    - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into clear actions and recommendations.
    - Effective communicator, able to influence at multiple levels and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with complex capital projects in data centres, energy, construction, semiconductors, or advanced manufacturing.
    - Background managing global supplier bases and international logistics.
    - Experience implementing or improving long-lead planning processes and tools at scale.

Why this role matters

Long-lead equipment is often the critical path for bringing new AI capacity online. In this role, your work directly shapes how quickly and reliably Nscale can deliver infrastructure to customers. Success will be measured by:
- On-time delivery performance for long-lead equipment.
- Schedule adherence for critical project milestones that depend on long-lead items.
- Supplier performance across quality, lead time, and responsiveness.
- Forecast accuracy and a measurable reduction in supply-related schedule risk.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.
    - Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.
    - Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
    - Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
    - Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. jobs.excerpt: Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform.
jobs.description:
Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

About the role

    We’re hiring our first Senior Corporate Recruiter to build the recruiting playbook and hiring philosophy for some of our fastest growing teams, Sales & Partnerships and Operations. You’ll own full-cycle recruiting and pipeline generation, reporting to our Director of People Operations.

    You will be an advocate for our mission and one of our biggest champions. You’re the first person candidates talk to at Seven Starling, and the people you hire go on to be the first voice our OBGYN partners and patients hear. When someone finishes a call with you, we want them to think “I love what Seven Starling is doing, and I want to be part of it.”

    We’re looking for a warm, curious, mission-driven builder who is just as happy sourcing a candidate as creating the process behind it. You’ll partner with amazing hiring managers to build a process that is curated, sustainable, and ready to scale as we do. With Seven Starling’s headcount expected to double in the next year alone, we are looking for someone to support an exciting phase of growth to bring on talented, mission-driven folks to accomplish our lofty goals!

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: Learn the roles and needs of our hiring managers. Work with them to build a structured hiring profile and sourcing strategy for each repeat role to refine the search and pipeline building. Take over all open Sales and Operations pipelines in Lever.

  • By 60 days: Make your first few hires and use that success to further align on ideal candidate profiles. Run recruiting for all assigned job requisitions on your own. Have a clear opinion on what is working well and what needs to be refined in the hiring process, from outreach communications to interview setup to final offer.

  • By 90 days: Share pipeline data with the Director of People Operations and hiring managers. Use what you have learned to draft a repeatable, best-in-practice playbook for repeat roles.

What you'll do

  • Own the corporate recruiting strategy. Decide where and how we find talent for each Sales and Operations role: which companies, titles, and markets to go after and which hiring channels should be kept. Every search starts with a clear plan built by you.

  • Hit our hiring targets. Set a pipeline plan for each role, track it weekly, and flag early when we are off pace. We expect you to reach your hiring targets and know how you got there.

  • Be a champion for Seven Starling. Tell our story with real excitement, so candidates leave a conversation with you wanting to be part of our mission.

  • Own the hiring journey and experience. Primary focus on Sales and Operations hiring from intake through signed offers with a warm handoff for onboarding.

  • Guide decision-making with numbers. Track pipeline conversion, time to fill, and offer acceptance. Share what you see with the Director of People Operations and use it to improve each hiring stage.

  • Keep relationships warm and be curious with your search. Stay in touch with strong candidates who aren’t a fit yet. Build a network of future hires, and show up in the communities where great people already are. Let referrals, events, and past conversations feed your pipeline.

  • Partner with and learn from the team. Run screener meetings to agree on the candidate profile, timeline, and pipeline health, and keep hiring managers updated along the way.

  • Screen with care and a clear, consistent rubric. Send managers short summaries, handle scheduling, and prep interviewers so each round builds on the last.

  • Ensure candidates feel heard, even if they aren’t a fit right now. Write thoughtful offer, rejection, and update messages that are timely and kind, and keep records accurate in Lever.

  • Build, test, and refine. Turn what works into repeatable processes with the Director of People Operations. Keep improving the playbook as we learn.

  • Jump in when needed. Pick up one-off reqs in other departments.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting for primarily sales and metrics-driven positions, ideally high-volume, with a record of consistently hitting hiring targets. Bring real examples of how you did it.

  • A strong talent sourcer, comfortable with cold outreach. You can show how you have found candidates who weren’t actively looking and how you have built a candidate pipeline from nothing. Experience hiring sales or operations role (field sales, inside sales, or healthcare is a plus).

  • Genuinely warm and down to earth. Candidates and hiring managers should feel like you’re on their side, and you’re honest with them about the position.

  • A service mindset. You follow up, close the loop, and notice when someone has been waiting too long for an answer.

  • Excited to build from scratch. You’d rather improve a process than follow one, and you keep refining it.

  • Comfortable with targets and accountability, and proficient with ATS systems and recruiting tools.

  • A true believer in what we do. You can talk about our mission with conviction and get people excited, including people who aren’t looking right now.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Lever

  • Experience at a venture-backed startup

Details

  • Full-time; remote

  • The salary for this position is $105,000 to $115,000

  • Meaningful equity package with significant upside potential

Perks and benefits

  • Competitive paid time off

  • Competitive parental leave policy

elk Marketing · Full-time · Contractor

At elk Marketing, we’re looking for a Development Project Manager to own Shopify development projects from initial client conversations through launch.

You’ll sit at the intersection of our clients and a team of 10 developers, designers, and data contractors, translating business needs into clear scopes, actionable plans, and high-quality deliverables.

This isn’t a ticket-management role. You’ll work directly with clients to understand what they need, partner with technical teams to determine how to build it, and take ownership of timelines, quality, and delivery. You should be comfortable making decisions, solving problems without a predefined playbook, and keeping multiple projects moving at once.

WHAT YOU WOULD OWN

  • Project intake - talk with the client about design ideas, content and requirements. Everything from a single landing page to a full site rebuild. Then, carry what they need to the design team and bring the feedback back

  • Scopes + estimates - build project scopes and cost estimates off our existing templates

  • The custom stuff - some projects do not have a defined process. You figure out who needs to be in the room, define the problem, and build the plan

  • QA - review work from the dev team before it goes to the client. If it is not right, it does not go out

  • Client comms - email, Slack and live on calls. Requirements, feedback, approvals

WHAT IS ON OUR BOARD RIGHT NOW

  • Shopify theme upgrades

  • Custom Shopify app builds

  • Shopify site design + Liquid build

  • Shopify Hydrogen headless development

  • Ongoing Shopify updates for landing page builds and SEO work

  • Custom conversion tracking + reporting solutions

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO HAVE

  • Deep experience with enterprise-level Shopify projects. Themes, settings, the APP ecosystem, and how the whole thing fits together

  • Experience managing a team of developers and talking to clients directly, not through an account manager

  • Very comfortable in Asana. We run everything through it

Helpful, not required:

  • Product feeds. Building feed connections into Google Merchant Center and META Ads

  • Conversion tracking. Getting ecommerce and B2B tracking working again when it breaks

WHAT IS HARD ABOUT THIS JOB

In the spirit of transparency, I would rather tell you now than in week three.

  • You will be holding 8 to 13 projects at once. Context switching is the job, not a distraction from it

  • Some of the work has no playbook. A client asks for something nobody has built before and you go define it

  • Launch days are launch days. Things break, and you are the one the client is talking to

  • You sit between the dev team and the client, which means you are the person saying "this needs another week" to one side and "we can't release on the LIVE theme today" to the other

This is a pace job, not a sprint job. The projects that go well are the ones where somebody kept moving for eight weeks straight, not the ones that got rescued by a heroic weekend.

If that sounds like a good week, we should talk.

ABOUT elk MARKETING

elk Marketing is a digital growth agency founded in 2016, with more than 40 core team members. We partner with brands to drive growth through SEO, AI search, paid media, content, creative strategy, and web development.

Our clients range from growing ecommerce businesses to enterprise brands, including TaylorMade and HexClad. We bring strategy, creativity, and technical execution together to help our clients grow—and we’re looking for people who take pride in delivering meaningful results.

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.
  • Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.
  • Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.
  • Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.
  • Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.
  • Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use
  • Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation
  • Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling
  • A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team
  • Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling
  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents
  • Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python
  • Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer
  • Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption
  • Technical project management experience

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$163,000—$226,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

jobs.description:
Position title: Battery Simulation Engineer
Employment type: Full-time

Job description:

As a Battery Simulation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, validating, and applying electrical and thermal models of battery cells, modules, and full packs. Your work will directly support the development and integration of high-performance, safe, and reliable battery systems across various applications. This role requires a strong foundation in battery fundamentals, simulation techniques, high-voltage electrical circuits, and systems-level thinking. You will respond to technical requests using established tools and methodologies while also contributing to the development of new modeling approaches to address emerging challenges in battery safety and performance.

The responsibilities in this position include, but are not limited to:
- Develop and implement physics-based and empirical models for simulating the electrical, thermal, and degradation performance of lithium-ion battery systems.

  • Conduct 1D simulation studies to evaluate battery behavior under various electrical, thermal, and environmental conditions, including fast charging, thermal events, and aging.
  • Analyze laboratory test data to extract model parameters, validate simulation results, and improve model robustness.
  • Perform sensitivity studies, scenario simulation, and model-based evaluations to support design and engineering decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with cell, module, and pack design engineers, as well as test and control teams, to define requirements and optimize system performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and presentations summarizing modeling methodology and simulation outcomes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams and share progress and insights with stakeholders.

Basic qualifications:

  • Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Applied Physics from an ABET-accredited university.
    - Minimum of 2 years of experience using simulation tools for engineering applications.
    - Hands-on experience with 0D/1D battery simulation and analysis tools such as GT-SUITE, MATLAB/Simulink, Amesim, or equivalent.
    - Strong Understanding of lithium-ion battery fundamentals, including battery performance characteristics, thermal characteristics, and aging mechanisms.
  • Fundamental understanding of HV electrical circuits, busbar design, and Battery Disconnect Unit (BDU) functionality within a battery system.
  • Ability to analyze data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Experience with optimization methods (DOE, parameter estimation, control optimization).
    - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly present technical findings to cross-functional teams.
    - Proven teamwork, interpersonal skills, and the ability to solve complex technical problems using analytical and simulation-based approaches.

Preferred qualifications:
- Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with a focus on battery systems, electrochemistry, or thermal management.
- Hands-on experience with battery testing methods, aging studies, and performance evaluation.
- Proficiency in developing and applying 0D/1D/3D simulation models for battery systems.
- Background in embedded controls, Kalman filters, or estimator design for SOC/SOH/SOP.
- Good overall knowledge of battery performance and thermal management.
- Good skills in programming with commercial software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Visual C++).

jobs.title: Domain Expert, AI Evaluation Task Writer: Healthcare (Contract, Remote)
jobs.excerpt: About Patronus AIPatronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI.
jobs.description:
About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation likeFinanceBench, Lynx,SimpleSafetyTests,CopyrightCatcher,Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

At a glance

  • Engagement: Independent contractor, fully remote, asynchronous
  • Pay: $50-150/hr for task authoring, paid when the full task is submitted, plus a potential bonus for each accepted task. Strong performers move up within that range or onto productivity-based pay. The trial task is paid.
  • Commitment: 10+ hours per week
  • Start: Rolling, as soon as you pass the trial task
  • Location: Remote

The role

You'll design realistic healthcare tasks that a qualified professional could solve with the right knowledge and tools, and that today's AI models get wrong. Each task is built around a scenario we provide. You create the records someone in your role would actually work from, write the request, solve it yourself and define how the answer gets graded. Your work becomes evaluation and training data for frontier models.

You don't need an AI background. You do need to be the kind of clinician or healthcare professional who spots the detail in a chart that changes the plan.

Areas we're hiring for

  • Clinical practice: physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, registered nurses and pharmacists doing assessment, diagnosis, orders, medication management and care planning, from chart review and medication reconciliation through discharge instructions
  • Clinical documentation and coding: clinical documentation integrity and medical coding, including ICD-10-CM/PCS and CPT/HCPCS assignment, DRG and risk adjustment, provider queries and coding audits
  • Utilization management and care coordination: prior authorization and medical necessity review against InterQual or MCG criteria, level-of-care and length-of-stay decisions, clinical denials and peer-to-peer appeals, discharge and transition planning and case management
  • Revenue cycle and payer operations: eligibility and benefits verification, charge capture and claims, remittance and payment posting, billing-side denials and appeals, payer policy and contract terms, and patient financial services

What you'll do

  • Build realistic, fully fictional patient and operational records from a provided scenario: clinical notes and discharge summaries, lab and imaging reports, medication lists and care plans, coding worksheets and provider queries, prior authorization requests and medical necessity criteria, utilization review notes, claims, remittances and denial letters, payer policies and eligibility responses
  • Write clear task requests that state what the deliverable is and how uncertainty and justified assumptions should be handled
  • Solve each task end to end and document a reference solution with the clinical or operational reasoning behind every step
  • Write explicit scoring criteria that let two independent graders reach the same verdict, including acceptable alternative answers and anything that would make a response unsafe
  • Run tasks against current models, find where and why they fail, and adjust difficulty
  • Check your own and peers' tasks for clinical accuracy, ambiguity, answers exposed in the materials and shortcuts that skip the intended reasoning
  • Incorporate reviewer feedback within agreed turnaround times and flag guideline gaps or edge cases you run into

Who we're looking for

Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in one or more of the four areas above, as a physician (MD/DO), nurse practitioner, physician assistant, registered nurse or pharmacist, or in clinical documentation, medical coding, utilization review, care management, revenue cycle or payer operations. You need to have done the work yourself, not only supervised it.
  • Current or past licensure or certification in your field (for example MD/DO, NP, PA, RN, PharmD, CPC, CCS, CDIP, CCDS, CCM or CRCR)
  • Working knowledge of the guidelines, criteria and documentation standards that govern your area (for example clinical practice guidelines, ICD-10-CM/PCS and CPT coding rules, InterQual or MCG criteria, CMS and payer policies)
  • Careful reading, and the habit of citing the chart entry, code set or policy behind every conclusion
  • Clear, precise writing in professional English
  • Ability to work independently and asynchronously against deadlines

Nice to have

  • Board certification or credentials beyond the minimum for your role (for example a clinical specialty board, CPHQ, CRCR or CHFP)
  • Experience across settings (inpatient, outpatient, payer, pharmacy, post-acute)
  • Experience with the systems used in your area, such as Epic or Oracle Health, Solventum (formerly 3M) 360 Encompass, InterQual or MCG, Availity or a payer portal, and a claims clearinghouse
  • Teaching, precepting, board-question writing or clinical case development, or prior experience writing or reviewing AI evaluation tasks
  • Familiarity with how AI models fail (fabricated citations, outdated guidelines, missed contraindications, wrong codes, overconfident answers)

Our standards

  • All tasks, documents and solutions are human-authored. LLM-generated content is not permitted.
  • Tasks and solutions must be original. Nothing may be copied from published or easily searchable sources.
  • Never use real patient data or PHI, even de-identified. All patients and scenarios are fictional.
  • Quality is judged on accuracy, rubric validity, difficulty and reviewer agreement, not volume.

How hiring works

  1. Short AI interview and resume review
  2. One paid trial task, scored against a fixed quality checklist
  3. Onboarding and your first project

We aim to make a decision within two weeks of your application.

Patronus AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

We need a QA automation engineer who can build the testing harness, automated checks, synthetic data, test environments, and agent-driven QA workflows that keep up with agent-speed development .

Here is the test: can you build a test system, seed a real bug, prove the test catches it, and explain what is still unverified?

We are not looking for someone who signs off work because it “looks fine.” We are looking for someone who demands evidence.

Our AI-Native QA Vision

QA at Zenara is not a downstream gate. It is an engineering platform.

We are building toward a system where product requirements can become test plans, test data, automated browser and API checks, evidence reports, failure routing, and release confidence — with agents helping create and run the work, and engineers governing the quality.

You will help design and operate this QA system, including:

  • Browser and API test runners
  • Synthetic test data
  • Isolated test environments
  • Requirement-to-test workflows
  • Automated checks on every change
  • Agent-driven QA workflows
  • Evidence generation for releases
  • Flaky-test reduction
  • Failure routing and debugging
  • Quality metrics and release confidence

The goal is not to automate bad testing. The goal is to build a system that catches real defects before customers do.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the QA automation harness across browser, API, data, and workflow layers.
  • Create automated checks that run on every meaningful change.
  • Build synthetic test data and isolated test environments.
  • Own the UAT/QA automation pipeline from requirement to test plan to run to evidence.
  • Use AI agents to help generate, execute, improve, and debug tests.
  • Build independent agent-driven QA workflows that test the work of code-writing agents.
  • Prove tests work by reintroducing known bugs and showing they fail correctly.
  • Reduce flaky tests and distinguish real product failures from environment noise.
  • Produce reliable QA evidence for releases.
  • Work with engineering and product to define quality gates for critical user journeys.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong software engineering ability: you can design, write, debug, and maintain code.
  • Experience with test automation using Playwright, Cypress, API testing frameworks, or similar tools.
  • CI/CD experience and comfort wiring tests into build and release workflows.
  • Practical experience using AI agents to create or improve tests.
  • Strong judgment about whether a test actually proves anything.
  • Ability to seed a bug, run a test, and demonstrate that the test catches the failure.
  • Comfort debugging flaky tests, environment issues, and test data problems.
  • Skeptical, evidence-driven thinking.
  • Clear communication around risk, coverage, and release confidence.

Our Current Stack

  • TypeScript
  • Node.js, Hono
  • React
  • Prisma, PostgreSQL
  • Redis, BullMQ
  • Playwright
  • Azure AKS, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
  • Terraform, Helm, CI pipelines
  • Medplum / FHIR
  • Flowable
  • Claude Code, Codex
  • Dify-based AI workflows

What “AI-Native QA” Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

  • Use agents to generate test ideas, test code, and edge cases.
  • Review agent-created tests critically.
  • Build workflows where agents test independently from the agents that wrote the code.
  • Use AI to analyze failures and propose debugging paths.
  • Create repeatable quality gates that scale with development speed.
  • Measure whether AI-generated tests are actually useful.
  • Avoid false confidence from tests that pass without proving behavior.

The point is not to have more tests. The point is to have trustworthy evidence.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or regulated-software experience.
  • Experience testing AI-powered features, including output quality.
  • Experience building test environments and synthetic data.
  • Performance or load testing experience.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will map the current QA setup, agree the highest-risk user journeys, and deliver one automated end-to-end QA lane that runs on every change and catches a known bug .

Within your first 90 days, key journeys for Assess and Zenflow will be covered automatically, every release will have QA evidence, and flaky-test rate and run time will be measured and improving .

Over time, success means building a mature agentic QA platform where escaped defects are low and QA throughput keeps pace with agent-speed development .

Outside required collaboration, we care about output, reliability, and quality.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • The opportunity to build the QA function as an engineering platform from the ground up

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Thinks like an engineer, not a manual checklist executor.
  • Enjoys building tools, systems, and automation.
  • Is naturally skeptical and evidence-driven.
  • Cares about proving behavior, not just producing green checkmarks.
  • Wants to make QA scale with AI-native development.
  • Likes working in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments.

You may struggle if you only have manual testing experience, cannot code, sign off work without evidence, or write tests that pass regardless of whether the product is correct .

If you want to build the quality system for an AI-native software team, we would love to hear from you.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our Data Analytics team and help build and maintain the data foundation that supports reporting and decision-making across the organization.

This is a hands-on, early-to-mid-career role for someone with an excellent foundation in SQL, data modeling, and modern analytics engineering practices. The Analytics Engineer will work closely with analytics leadership to translate business requirements into reliable, scalable data models while developing deeper technical and business expertise.

Our current data stack includes Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Snowflake, and Power BI. Experience with our exact technology stack is not required. Strong technical fundamentals, sound data-modeling instincts, and the ability to learn quickly are more important than experience with a particular platform.

Data Modeling & Analytics Engineering

  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable SQL to transform raw business data into reliable, analytics-ready datasets
  • Develop and maintain staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, and reporting-layer data models
  • Translate business requirements and established architecture into production data models
  • Apply dimensional modeling concepts with a strong understanding of grain, relationships, and dependencies
  • Refactor and improve existing SQL and data models as business requirements evolve
  • Enhance existing data models for self-service and AI-powered analytics by improving metadata, descriptions, and semantic context for tools such as Snowflake Cortex AI
  • Build and maintain data-quality tests and documentation

Development & Version Control

  • Use Git and GitHub to manage analytics code through branches, commits, pull requests, code reviews, and deployment workflows
  • Develop and test changes before deploying them to production
  • Evaluate upstream and downstream dependencies before modifying existing models
  • Follow established SQL, dbt, documentation, and version-control standards

Data Quality & Troubleshooting

  • Investigate data-quality issues and discrepancies between reporting and source systems
  • Trace data through source, transformation, and reporting layers to identify root causes
  • Troubleshoot failed transformations and scheduled analytics jobs
  • Validate changes and develop sustainable solutions rather than relying on manual fixes or workarounds

Business Intelligence & Business Partnership

  • Support the data and semantic models used for business intelligence and self-service analytics
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and determine the appropriate underlying data structure

Excellent SQL skills are the most important technical qualifications for this position.

You should be comfortable working with complex SQL involving joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, conditional logic, and multi-step transformations. Candidates should also have:

  • Approximately 2-4 years of relevant experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of relational data and data modeling concepts
  • Experience transforming operational data into structured datasets used for analytics and reporting

  • Curiosity about how business processes generate and affect data

  • Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience
  • Position will be remote (residing anywhere in the United States and authorized to work in the U.S.)

Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:

  • dbt or another SQL-based data transformation framework
  • Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or another modern cloud data platform
  • Power BI, Sigma, Tableau, Looker, or another BI platform

  • Retail, e-commerce, wholesale, inventory, supply chain, or financial data
  • NetSuite, Shopify, Amazon, Klaviyo, or similar business platforms

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Starting salary range for this role is $105,000-$115,000. Starting offer within that range will factor in work location, skills, background and years of relevant experience

Why this role exists

The cost of going from idea to working prototype has collapsed. One person with taste, strong judgment, and AI tools can now do what used to take a team and a sprint cycle. Apollo is hiring for what comes next: Product Builders who combine product judgment, domain depth, and AI-native research and execution.

  • Define the KPI tree and learning loop for the product area, then use it to prioritize, measure, and iterate
  • Raise the bar for product clarity by writing crisp strategy docs, PRDs, launch plans, and tradeoff memos that make the next best action obvious

What we are looking for

  • Compliance fluent. You understand data privacy, GDPR and CCPA, consent, and licensing constraints well enough to design within them and partner effectively with Legal and Privacy
  • High agency. You create clarity in ambiguous environments and move work forward without waiting for perfect structure
  • Technical fluency across architecture, reliability, observability, APIs, data models, instrumentation, and edge cases

What We Offer

  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. We build and operate systems that support Grafana’s business operations and customer experience, working closely with product teams and internal business partners.

The Usage squad works on billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and cloud marketplace integrations. Our software helps customers understand their consumption and costs, and helps internal teams operate accurate, reliable billing processes.

We are looking for a Staff Fullstack Engineer with strong backend experience who enjoys making complex business systems reliable, understandable and easier to operate. You will help deliver new capabilities while improving existing services, reducing repetitive manual work and addressing edge cases that affect customers and internal stakeholders.

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role within the AppCore Usage squad. You will lead complex technical work, contribute directly to implementation and share ownership with the squad’s other Staff and Senior engineers. Your primary focus will be Usage’s systems and outcomes, collaborating with adjacent teams when the work requires it.

Our ownership includes application code, data stores, deployment configuration and the cloud infrastructure supporting our services. You should be comfortable following a problem across those boundaries and making improvements with the appropriate platform teams.

We are remote-first and global. For this role, we prefer candidates in NASA’s Eastern Time zone to provide more overlap with our EMEA colleagues.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your initial focus will be approximately 75% backend and 25% frontend. This balance will evolve with the squad’s priorities. You should be comfortable delivering across the stack, from business logic and APIs through to the interfaces customers and internal teams use.

  • Design, build and operate backend services and APIs supporting billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and marketplace workflows.
  • Build and maintain backend services primarily in Go, with Node.js also present in our stack, and contribute to TypeScript/React applications to deliver complete features.
  • Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery.
  • Identify recurring manual tasks and replace them with maintainable automation, clear operational workflows and appropriate controls.
  • Maintain and evolve the infrastructure supporting our services, including Kubernetes workloads, scheduled jobs, cloud resources and deployment configuration.
  • Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe across environments.
  • Investigate production issues across application code, databases and infrastructure, including resource exhaustion, failed jobs, slow queries and replication delays.
  • Plan and execute service deployments, database changes and infrastructure migrations, including validation, monitoring and recovery plans.
  • Build and maintain integrations with cloud marketplaces and external business systems where required by the squad’s work.
  • Deliver projects from understanding requirements and proposing an approach through implementation, testing, rollout and production support.
  • Make changes traceable and testable, supporting audit requirements and clear explanations of system behaviour.
  • Collaborate with product management, Support, DealOps, GTM, infrastructure teams and adjacent AppCore squads to clarify requirements and resolve dependencies.
  • Share technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring and practical improvements.
  • Participate in the squad’s on-call rotation after onboarding. Improve dashboards, alert quality, runbooks and recovery procedures, and follow through on incident findings.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You enjoy engineering work where correctness, reliability and business impact matter. You find value in improving an established system, removing a recurring operational problem or making a billing workflow easier to understand and support.

You take ownership from understanding the problem through delivery and production support. You can turn an ambiguous request into manageable increments, make sound trade-offs and follow through without needing each step prescribed. You ask useful questions, seek feedback and raise uncertainty or blockers early.

You adapt as priorities change, learn unfamiliar systems and technologies, and contribute where the squad needs you. You bring a strong backend specialty while remaining willing and able to work on frontend features and supporting infrastructure.

You reason about how a service behaves in production: how it is deployed, where its data lives, what happens when dependencies fail, and how the team detects and recovers from problems.

You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. In a distributed team, you make decisions, progress and risks visible so colleagues can contribute across time zones. You work independently while staying connected to the squad.

As a Staff engineer, you bring technical depth and sound judgment while remaining close to implementation. You collaborate constructively with other experienced engineers, welcome different perspectives and help the squad reach decisions and move forward.

We embrace thoughtful use of AI-assisted development. We value engineers who use these tools to support exploration, implementation, testing and documentation while taking responsibility for the quality and correctness of the result.

Requirements

  • Substantial experience designing, delivering and operating production backend systems, with the depth and judgment to lead complex work hands-on.
  • Strong experience building and operating production backend systems in Go, our primary backend language.
  • Professional experience contributing to frontend applications using TypeScript and React, or comparable technologies, and willingness to work across the stack as priorities change.
  • Experience reasoning about distributed systems, including partial failures, retries, consistency and interactions between services.
  • Experience with relational databases, including data modelling, schema migrations, query performance and safe production changes.
  • Practical experience deploying and troubleshooting containerised services and jobs in Kubernetes.
  • Experience managing cloud infrastructure through code and working with CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration and controlled rollouts.
  • Ability to investigate production problems using logs, metrics and traces, and turn findings into lasting improvements.
  • A record of delivering projects end to end, clarifying requirements, making trade-offs and following through after release.
  • Experience working remotely, with clear asynchronous communication and dependable collaboration across time zones.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar domains and technologies, adjust your approach as new information emerges, and take ownership beyond your main area of expertise.
  • Experience writing readable, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, maintain and operate.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call and take responsibility for the production behaviour of the systems you build.
  • Experience supporting colleagues through code reviews, mentoring and constructive technical discussions.

Bonus Points For

  • Usage metering, billing engines, pricing and rates, financial reconciliation or customer-facing cost management applications.
  • Reducing operational toil and automating workflows with recurring exceptions or manual interventions.
  • Systems with auditability, traceability or financial-control requirements.
  • MySQL operations, replication, database upgrades and performance tuning.
  • Terraform, Jsonnet and Kubernetes deployment configuration.
  • Argo Workflows or comparable deployment and job-orchestration tooling.
  • Cloud infrastructure involving managed databases, object storage, service accounts and access controls, particularly on GCP.
  • Data synchronisation pipelines and BigQuery integrations.
  • Cloud marketplace integrations across AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Integrations with business platforms such as NetSuite or Salesforce.
  • Observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or OpenTelemetry.

Overview

The Managed Services Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a strategic, client‑facing role responsible for leading the client-side implementation experience, driving adoption of the Managed Services operating model, and ensuring long‑term success for Managed Services clients. This role serves as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them maximize the value of their Managed Services investment through workflow optimization, enablement, standardization, and strategic partnership.

This role acts as the primary liaison between clients and internal teams throughout onboarding, implementation, and ongoing engagement. The Customer Success Manager leads client-facing implementation strategy, workflow alignment, change management, and user enablement while partnering closely with Project Managers and Portfolio Team Leads who retain responsibility for project execution, resource coordination, timelines, and delivery milestones.

The Customer Success Manager champions standardized Managed Services workflows, promotes client self-sufficiency, and helps clients realize measurable business value through scalable, efficient, and sustainable solutions. The role also partners with the Account Management teams to support client retention, account health, and identification of opportunities for expanded service adoption.

Role Alignment & Ownership

The Customer Success Manager owns:
  • Client engagement, partnership development, and stakeholder management.
  • Client-side implementation strategy and onboarding readiness.
  • Workflow consultation, adoption planning, and change management.
  • Training, enablement, and self-sufficiency initiatives.
  • Post-implementation success, value realization, and account health.
  • Documentation ownership and best-practice development.
The Customer Success Manager partners with:
  • Project Managers, who own project execution, schedules, scope management, resource coordination, and delivery milestones.
  • Portfolio and Delivery Leaders, who maintain operational ownership and delivery accountability.
  • Sales and Account teams, who maintain commercial ownership and account strategy.

The Customer Success Manager serves as the connective layer between these groups to ensure client objectives, workflow requirements, and business outcomes remain aligned throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Client Partnership & Success
  • Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact throughout implementation and post-implementation phases, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Own the post‑implementation relationship, ensuring ongoing clients adoption, engagement, and measurable value realization.
  • Provide regular reporting, status updates, and cost‑savings analyses in partnership with analysts.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by providing strategic guidance, facilitating QBRs, and translating client feedback into actionable recommendations.
Implementation Ownership & Workflow Optimization
  • Lead client-side implementation strategy, onboarding readiness, workflow alignment, and change management activities.
  • Analyze client processes and recommend workflow improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency, scalability, and user adoption.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Delivery Leaders to ensure implementation activities align with client objectives, Managed Services best practices, and successful onboarding outcomes.
Managed Services Adoption & Enablement
  • Drive adoption of standardized Managed Services workflows, operational best practices and service capabilities.
  • Promote client self-sufficiency through training, documentation, coaching, and workflow guidance.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities to improve workflow maturity, process standardization, and long-term client success.
Training & Workflow Subject Matter Expertise
  • Maintain expertise in supported eDiscovery platforms, emerging technologies, industry trends, and evolving data types.
  • Provide workflow consultation and practical platform guidance, and practical recommendations aligned with Managed Services best practices.
  • Deliver client training, demonstrations, and enablement programs while partnering internally to validate and programs that support adoption goals.
Documentation Leadership
  • Create, maintain, and enhance client-facing documentation, including implementation plans, workflow guides, user materials, playbooks, and best‑practice documentation.
  • Maintain the Managed Services Professional Services documentation library and ensure materials remain current as workflows, technologies, and service offerings evolve.
  • Drive consistency through standardized templates and knowledge sharing initiatives, partnering with Managed Services leadership to develop and deliver best practices across teams.
Account Health & Strategic Growth Support
  • Build a strong understanding of client priorities, utilization trends, and business objectives to support long-term account health.
  • Partner with Account and Sales teams to support client retention efforts and identify opportunities for expanded service adoption.
  • Contribute client insights, adoption metrics, and recommendations that support account planning and growth discussions.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Lead initiatives that improve client experience, workflow consistency, operational efficiency, and documentation quality.
  • Foster collaboration across Project Management, Managed Review, Data Analytics, Custom Solutions, and Account teams.
  • Influence without direct authority while promoting continuous improvement, consistency, and scalability across Managed Services client engagements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (JD or Master’s) preferred.
  • 5+ years in eDiscovery, litigation support, customer success, consulting, implementation management, or related client services roles.
  • Experience managing client-facing relationships in a technology-enabled services environment.
  • Strong technical aptitude with experience in eDiscovery platforms, including RelativityOne, Relativity Server, Everlaw, Reveal or comparable technologies. RCA strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead client-facing implementations, guide workflow strategy, drive adoption initiatives, and support long-term client success.
  • Experience delivering training programs, workshops, presentations, and executive-level communications.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across multiple teams and influence outcomes without direct managerial authority.

Skills & Attributes

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strategic, consultative, and customer-focused mindset.
  • Strong process improvement, workflow analysis, and documentation capabilities.
  • Effective problem solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in complex client environments.
  • Strong business acumen with a focus on value realization and client outcomes.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

Success Measures

  • Successful client onboarding, implementation, and adoption outcomes.

  • Increased adoption of standardized Managed Services best practices and standardized workflows.
  • Demonstrated client value realization and measurable business outcomes.
  • High-quality documentation and knowledge sharing contributions.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback and effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Contributions to client retention, growth opportunities, and long-tern partnership success.

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client ExperienceWe listen for the “why,” clearly define success, maintain accountability, and go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • CollaborationWe treat everyone with respect, welcome diverse views, partner across geographies, generations, and teams, and rally around final decisions.
  • InnovationWe are always curious. We challenge the status quo, experiment to fail forward, and build for the future.

jobs.excerpt: Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
jobs.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Business Title:Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing leads end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives across assigned categories, with a strong focus on technology (software, SaaS, IT services) and professional services. This role applies a disciplined 5–7 step strategic sourcing methodology to drive value from intake and requirements definition through supplier identification and award recommendation.


The role emphasizes fact-based sourcing and negotiation practices, leveraging market benchmarking, proposal and bid analysis, and white-sheeting / should-cost modeling to inform negotiation strategy and commercial decision-making. The Senior Manager partners closely with business leaders, Finance, Legal, and IT to ensure sourcing decisions deliver measurable savings, and optimized commercial outcomes, aligned to enterprise standards.


Essential Job Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing Execution

  • Lead end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives using a structured 5–7 step sourcing methodology, including timely engagement assessment at intake to clearly define requirements (deal summary as an output), conduct market assessment and/or internal benchmarking, sourcing strategy development, competitive event execution, negotiation, and award recommendation.
  • Develop and execute category sourcing strategies aligned with business priorities for assigned category/ies, spend profiles, financial objectives, aligned to enterprise procurement standards practices and policies.
  • Translate business requirements into sourcing strategies that balance cost, risk, speed, and value.

Market Analysis, Benchmarking & Cost Modeling

  • Conduct market analysis and/or internal benchmarking, and supplier landscape assessments to understand cost drivers, pricing models, market maturity, and leverage opportunities.
  • Perform benchmarking to assess pricing competitiveness, rate card and/or threshold standards, commercial terms, and total cost of ownership.
  • Develop and apply white-sheeting and should-cost models to:
    • Decompose supplier pricing and cost structures
    • Validate proposals and bids
    • Identify negotiation opportunities and cost reduction levers
  • Use benchmarks and cost models as key inputs to negotiation strategies and executive recommendations.

Competitive Bidding & Proposal Analysis

  • Design and manage competitive sourcing events, including RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs.
  • Lead proposal and bid analysis, including pricing comparisons, scenario analysis, and evaluation of commercial trade‑offs.
  • Ensure sourcing decisions are data driven, defensible, and aligned to sourcing objectives and documentable (as evidence-of).

Negotiation Strategy & Execution

  • Develop negotiation strategies and playbooks informed by market intelligence, benchmarks, should-cost analysis, and business priorities.
  • Lead and execute complex commercial and contractual negotiations in partnership with Legal and business stakeholders.
  • Drive consistent negotiation outcomes through structured preparation, leverage analysis, and scenario planning.

Financial Alignment & Value Realization

  • Partner with Finance to support ROI analysis, TCO impact modeling, and business case development for new investments, renewals, and recurring spend at required spend thresholds.
  • Quantify and track sourcing value, including savings, cost avoidance, and commercial improvements.
  • Prepare executive ready sourcing recommendations and deal engagement summaries supported by financial rationale, benchmarks, cost models, and risk considerations.

Standards & Continuous Improvement

  • Determine, with business stakeholders, when competitive sourcing is required, and manage approved exception scenarios using documented rationale and benchmarking.
  • Support audits and governance reviews by maintaining sourcing documentation, cost models, and negotiation artifacts.
  • Drive continuous improvement of sourcing methodologies, templates, analytical tools, and negotiation playbooks as a part of Sourcing Working Groups and/or other required initiatives.
  • Partner with procurement managers, associates, and analysts to drive sourcing rigor and best practices.

Expected Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Procurement, Finance, Business, or a related field (preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing and procurement, ideally within technology, and general professional services categories.
  • Demonstrated success leading high value sourcing initiatives, complex negotiations, and cost modeling exercises.
  • Strong financial, analytical, and commercial acumen.
  • Advanced knowledge of cost structures, pricing models, contracts, and category economics.
  • Experience with sourcing tools, procurement systems, and analytics platforms.
  • Deep expertise in strategic sourcing methodologies (5–7 step process)
  • Advanced capability in market benchmarking, white-sheeting, and should-cost modeling
  • Strong negotiation strategy development and execution skills
  • Excellence proficiency in proposal and bid analysis
  • Strong stakeholder management and leadership communication skills
  • Strong project management, analytical, problem solving and critical thinking skills

Expected Compensation

$113,000 - $193,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision:In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. As a Senior Shopify Developer in our Commerce Practice, you build and integrate the commerce experiences that sit at the heart of our clients' digital platforms — from solution design and development through QA and release. Your measure of success is simple: raving-fan clients, reliable storefronts and on-time, on-budget delivery.

We're looking for a hands-on engineer who has shipped Shopify and Shopify Plus solutions alongside enterprise CMS and DXP platforms such as Sitecore, Contentstack and Optimizely. You'll work within a blended team of front-end and back-end developers, partner closely with the Technology Lead, project management, strategy and UX/creative, and bring a pragmatic, AI-assisted approach to how we design, build and deliver.

What You'll Do

Commerce Development & Integration

  • Build Shopify storefronts: develop and customize Shopify and Shopify Plus stores, including Online Store 2.0 themes, Liquid templates, sections and blocks, metafields/metaobjects and checkout extensibility.
  • Deliver headless or non headless commerce: build headless storefronts using the Storefront API with Hydrogen or Next.js, hosted on Oxygen, Vercel or Netlify, with sound rendering and caching strategies (SSG/ISR/SSR). Develop Shopify experience using Liquid as well.
  • Integrate Shopify with CMS and DXP platforms: connect Shopify to Sitecore (including SitecoreAI / XM Cloud), Contentstack and Optimizely so that content and commerce work as one experience — product data in content pages, shoppable content, shared component libraries and unified search.
  • Build custom apps and extensions: develop Shopify apps, Functions, checkout and customer account UI extensions, and Flow automations using the Admin GraphQL API, webhooks and Shopify CLI.
  • Connect the back office: integrate Shopify with ERP, PIM, OMS, CRM, payment, tax, search and marketing platforms through APIs, middleware and event-driven patterns.
  • Contribute to solution design: support technical discovery, help define data models (products, variants, markets, pricing, catalogs), and provide input on estimates, technical specifications and risks.
  • Build with quality: write clean, tested, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and ensure solutions meet performance (Core Web Vitals), accessibility (WCAG), SEO and security standards.
  • Support QA and release: partner with QA on test plans and UAT, triage and resolve defects, and support deployments, store migrations and production releases.

Team & Collaboration

  • Partner across disciplines: work closely with the Technology Lead, Project Manager, UX/creative and client teams to translate business goals and designs into working commerce features.
  • Share knowledge: mentor junior developers, contribute to code reviews and help raise the team’s Shopify and integration expertise.
  • Champion AI-assisted engineering: use AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) responsibly to improve velocity and quality.

Practice & Growth

  • Support business development: contribute technical input to commerce proposals, estimates and solution demos as requested.
  • Strengthen the practice: contribute to internal standards, accelerators, reusable Shopify components and integration patterns, and stay current on Shopify, headless commerce and AI trends.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on Shopify development experience, including Shopify Plus implementations for mid-market or enterprise brands.
  • Proven experience integrating Shopify with CMS/DXP platforms: at least one of Sitecore, Contentstack or Optimizely, in headless or composable architectures.
  • Strong command of Liquid, Online Store 2.0 theme architecture, Shopify CLI and theme/app development workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify APIs (Storefront API, Admin GraphQL and REST), webhooks, Shopify Functions and checkout extensibility.
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, React and Next.js skills; Hydrogen/Remix experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with REST/GraphQL API integration, middleware and serverless/edge functions on platforms such as Vercel, Netlify or Oxygen.
  • Working knowledge of Git-based workflows, CI/CD and Agile/Scrum delivery, including estimation and sprint planning.
  • Solid grounding in accessibility, SEO, web performance and security best practices for commerce sites.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points For

  • Practical use of AI-based development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar) and familiarity with Shopify’s AI capabilities (e.g., Shopify Magic / Sidekick).
  • Experience with the broader composable stack: Sitecore Search, Contentstack Personalize, Optimizely Experimentation/Personalization, Algolia or similar search and personalization tools.
  • Replatforming experience migrating stores to Shopify from Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), Optimizely Commerce or similar.
  • Experience with Shopify Markets, B2B on Shopify and multi-store / international setups.
  • Shopify Partner certifications and/or Sitecore, Contentstack, Optimizely or Vercel certifications.
  • Agency or consulting experience.
