jobs.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱 WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯RYZE is a fast-growing DTC brand built on mushroom coffee, and most of our new customers come from paid social.
jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱


WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

RYZE is a fast-growing DTC brand built on mushroom coffee, and most of our new customers come from paid social. Each ad angle that wins gets its own landing page. Our ad team ships dozens of new ads every week — and that number is growing. The pages have to keep up.


You'll own both the copy and the strategy for those pages: listicles, advertorials, quiz funnels, and pages tailored to a single ad. Our in-house page tool handles layout, and AI handles first drafts. Your job is the judgment — you decide what a page has to say to turn a click from one specific ad into a customer, then you prove it worked in the numbers.


Responsibilities will include:


Landing Page Strategy

  • Decide which page format fits each ad angle and audience, what the page needs to say, and what to test next.
  • Take a winning ad's hook, promise, and audience, carry them above the fold, and keep the path to the offer short. One ad angle, one page — a headline swap doesn't count.
  • Build the playbook: winning pages become template rules. Write down what worked so the next page starts from a stronger place.

Copy & Production Volume

  • Ship 15+ live page variants per week, built in our page tool from approved sections and templates.
  • Use AI for drafts and your own judgment for the final edit.
  • Pages go from winning ad to live page in days, not weeks.

CRO & Optimization

  • Use heatmaps and section-reach data for every live page to find where readers drop off, close the open loops the ad created, and rewrite underperforming sections.
  • Run every page against a control. Read results on conversion rate, revenue per visitor, new-customer cost, and bundle take rate — then use them to decide what gets written next.
  • Judge your work on revenue, not aesthetics.

Legal & Compliance

  • Write in structure/function language — 'supports focus,' never 'treats anxiety.'
  • Send pages through legal and compliance review, act on redlines quickly, and keep the persuasive core of the page intact while doing it.
  • Maintain compliance with FTC and applicable regulatory standards for functional food marketing.

Professional Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct-response copywriting, with DTC brands as a substantial part — most of your work has been long-form pages for paid traffic (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, native).
  • Proven experience with advertorials, listicles, VSL scripts, or quiz funnels — brand sites and product pages alone won't be enough.
  • A portfolio with numbers: for at least two pages, you can name the metric, the control it beat, and why you think it won. Bring a page that lost too — and tell us what you learned.
  • Experience working with legal and compliance teams in a regulated category — supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or finance. You know the line between a strong benefit claim and one you can't make.
  • A system for volume — you've shipped many variants on short timelines without quality slipping, and AI is already part of how you work.
  • Comfort with numbers: you don't need to write SQL, but you need to look at a test readout and say what it means for the next page.
  • Strong written English at the level of a native writer for a US audience.

Core Competencies

  • Message match — Carries the ad's hook, promise, and audience into the page without breaking the thread. Understands that a headline swap is not a landing page.
  • Direct response judgment — Knows what a page has to say to convert a specific click from a specific ad. Makes strategic decisions, not just copy decisions.
  • Volume & systems — Ships 15+ variants a week without quality slipping. Has a repeatable process and uses AI effectively as part of it.
  • CRO literacy — Reads heatmaps, scroll data, and test results. Identifies where pages break and rewrites based on evidence, not instinct.
  • Revenue accountability — Evaluates their own work on conversion rate, RPV, new-customer cost, and bundle take rate. Not on how good the copy sounds.
  • Compliance writing — Writes persuasively within structure/function language. Takes redlines without the page going flat.
  • Playbook building — Extracts principles from winning pages and turns them into reusable rules so the next page starts stronger.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your portfolio with at least two pages and the results each one drove. Include one page that performed and one that didn't — and tell us what you learned from each. Pages without numbers won't make the shortlist.


WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

jobs.title: Principal Analytical QA Specialist, Drug Substance
jobs.excerpt: About LoyalLoyal is a clinical-stage veterinary medicine company developing longevity drugs for dogs.
jobs.description:
About Loyal

Loyal is a clinical-stage veterinary medicine company developing longevity drugs for dogs. Our mission is to help dogs live longer, healthier lives.

We're pioneering a new category of veterinary prescription drugs that proactively and preventatively target the underlying drivers of aging, delaying the onset of disease and preserving quality of life as dogs age. We've already made significant progress in our mission to develop the first FDA-approved drugs to extend canine lifespan: as of early 2026 we've completed two of three major FDA review sections for our lead program, LOY-002, and are targeting submission of the third and final section later this year.

Loyal is a well-funded startup with teams of scientists, veterinarians, engineers, operators, and creatives. You'll help us continue on our path of earning FDA approval for the first lifespan extension medicine for any species, and change what's possible for the dogs we love.

About the role

We’re seeking an experienced Principal Quality Assurance Specialist, External Manufacturing to provide Quality Assurance oversight of GMP manufacturing, release, stability, validation, and lifecycle management activities supporting the development and commercialization of Loyal's veterinary pharmaceutical products. Operating within Loyal's fully outsourced manufacturing network, the position supports batch disposition of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) / drug substance, drug product, packaging and labeling through review and approval of protocols, reports, analytical methods, and associated GMP documentation.

The role works collaboratively with Technical Operations and Analytical Development / Quality Control to ensure that the manufacture and laboratory analysis of drug substance, drug product, packaging & labeling of finished drug product conforms with cGMPs, VICH and global regulatory requirements. This position also partners with CMC Regulatory Affairs to ensure the translational accuracy and integrity of data incorporated into Module 3 sections of CTD regulatory submissions and written responses to regulatory authorities.

Your daily work will include

Manufacturing & Analytical Quality Oversight

  • Oversee all aspects of drug manufacture and testing through clinical development and into commercial phase.
  • Provide Quality oversight for analytical method development, qualification, validation, transfer, release testing, and stability programs supporting drug substance and drug product development.
  • Support establishment of phase-appropriate specifications, stability-indicating methods, and control strategies aligned with regulatory expectations.
  • Review and approve validation protocols, raw data, and reports (for test method, process, cleaning, etc.).

Batch Release / Disposition & Quality Systems

  • Manage the batch release program by reviewing executed documentation, raw data, quality events (change controls, deviations, CAPAs, OOS/OOT investigations, risk assessments) and product disposition decisions.
  • Review and approve master and executed batch records, analytical raw data, stability protocols, reports and data, and other documents to enable drug substance and final drug product release and on-going evaluation ensuring batches are compliant with cGMP requirements.
  • Lead or support quality event resolution investigations (e.g., OOS/OOT results, deviations), ensuring root cause analysis, CAPA development, and timely closure.
  • Support inspection readiness, audit programs, risk management, quality metrics reporting, Annual Product Review (APR) and product quality processes, Field Alert Report (FAR), product withdrawal, and product recall process.

Regulatory & Cross-Functional Support

  • Perform data integrity and compliance assessments including review against source documentation for regulatory submissions.
  • Maintain effective communication with Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) and Contract Testing Laboratories (CTLs) to ensure Quality objectives are achieved in accordance with project timelines.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving veterinary pharmaceutical regulations and ensure compliance strategies are updated accordingly

About you

  • B.S./M.S. degree in in a scientific discipline (Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Veterinary Science, or related field)
  • Minimum 12 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, with at least 6 years in GxP QA roles.
  • Strong knowledge of FDA CVM regulations, cGMP, and VICH guidelines applicable to veterinary products
  • In-depth working knowledge of drug substance development and manufacturing, analytical method development, validation, release testing, stability programs, and quality systems.
  • Experience managing CDMOs and collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Capable of working successfully in a team/matrix environment and independently, as required.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, demonstrate efficient and effective use of time, and handle multiple assignments simultaneously.
  • Ability to convey both written and verbal information effectively and efficiently.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow procedures and perform assignments with a high degree of accuracy and careful attention to detail.
  • Willingness to travel (10%).

Core Competencies:

  • Strong technical judgment and problem-solving
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and external partners
  • Effective project and time management
  • Collaborative mindset with a continuous improvement focus

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Other Compliance or Regulatory certifications (e.g., RAC, ASQ) a plus.
  • Experience auditing suppliers, CDMOs, and CTLs.
  • Experience with Google Workspace applications (e.g., Sheets, Slides, etc.) and electronic Quality Management Systems.
  • Experience in small molecule pharmaceutical development, routine analytical testing for solid oral dosage forms, and/or veterinary drug products preferred.
  • Experience with international regulatory environments (EU, Canada, etc.) a plus

Salary Range: $150,000 - $190,000

Loyal benefits

  • Full-coverage health insurance — medical, dental and vision — for you and your dependents
  • $1,000 home office equipment stipend
  • $1,200/year learning budget for books, courses, etc.
  • $250/month wellness budget for gym, cleaners, spa, food, etc.
  • All 3-day weekends are turned into 4-day weekends 🎉
  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
  • Paw-ternity leave — adopt a dog and get a day off with your new family member 🐶
  • Competitive salary
  • Company equity options grant for new hires

Loyal is founded and led by a first-gen female CEO and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

Our values

Moonshots, derisked methodically

Bringing the first longevity drug to market is an extremely difficult technical and social pursuit. To achieve this we must take bigger bets than the field has historically made, paired with the technical rigor to de-risk them step by step. We plan on both short and extremely long timescales, and we have the conviction to see our vision through to success or failure.

Opportunity is at the intersection

We lean into combining disciplines, expertise, and perspectives not normally adjacent. We design our organization to facilitate cross-pollination and cross-collaboration. We reject silos.

Expertise without ego

Titles do not determine who has a voice. We push back on each other, ask questions instead of issuing orders, and try to prove ourselves wrong. We are emotionally attached to the outcome, not our personal hypotheses, and welcome being challenged instead of treating it as a threat.

High agency, high humility

Most of what we're doing has never been done before, so we can't rely on established precedents to guide our way. We move forward to generate clarity, build strategies resilient to the fact that we don't know what we don't know, and design small experiments where we can fail safely, without jeopardizing the bigger mission.

Lead with transparency and context

We proactively and consistently share the why behind our strategy - not just the what - because we believe sharing context enables great people to make great decisions.

Empathy and respect for all life

Our patients are not just numbers. We deeply respect the value of every life, large and small and take our ethical responsibility to the families we treat extremely seriously.

jobs.description:
Data Scientist (Senior Staff, Staff, & Senior roles available)

About the company

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

We are hiring a Data Scientists to help accelerate our mission.

About the position

In this role, you will build predictive models and apply a wide range of scientific computing, statistical, and physics-based methods to find places where there is evidence of ore-forming processes at work and to predict the locations of ore-grade mineralization in 2D and 3D. You will help build a worldwide dataset that underlies our exploration program, with careful attention to identifying and quantifying uncertainty in the data and in our predictions. You will create models and develop software to accelerate discovery of critical battery metals.

You will join an outstanding team of data scientists and engineers and will work closely with KoBold’s world-renowned geoscientists to incorporate our best understanding of the chemical and physical processes that create ore deposits. Working with your geoscience colleagues, you will create 2D and 3D geologic predictions, identify exploration targets, design field programs to collect data, and use that data to reduce the uncertainty in our predictions and guide the next phase of field work.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by building data tools to solve scientific problems. As one of the early members of this team, you will help build these tools from the ground up.

Responsibilities

The Data Scientist will:

  • Help develop KoBold’s proprietary software exploration tools.
  • Find and curate geophysical, geochemical, geologic, and geographic data and integrate it into KoBold’s proprietary data system.
  • Build models to make statistically valid predictions about the locations of compositional anomalies within the Earth’s crust.
  • Create effective visualizations for evaluating model performance and enabling rapid interaction with the underlying data and key features.
  • Develop and apply data processing, statistical, and physics-based techniques to geoscientific data — from computer vision to geophysical inversions — and use the results to guide our targeting efforts and inform our acquisition and exploration decisions.
  • Present to and collaborate with our external partners and stakeholders.

Qualifications

A great Data Scientist candidate will have:

Technical skills, including extensive experience with:

  • Python’s data science packages and general software engineering practices.
  • Collaborative software development (git), and familiarity with software engineering best practices like unit test / integration test suites, and CICD pipelines.
  • Cloud computing resources.
  • Building predictive models, applying them to different problems, and evaluating and interpreting the results.
  • Data from a variety of physical systems.
  • Geospatial analyses and visualizations.

Technical knowledge:

  • Broad skills in and knowledge of applied statistics and Bayesian inference
  • Substantial understanding of machine learning algorithms

Training and work experience:

  • An advanced degree in the physical sciences, engineering, computer science, or mathematics.
  • A minimum work experience of 4 years post PhD or 8 years post MS, ideally as a data scientist or data engineer.
  • Experience leading technical teams to apply novel scientific approaches to core business problems

Work practices and motivation:

  • Ability to take ownership and responsibility of large projects.
  • Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts.
  • Communicates well on a collaborative, cross-functional team.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on a range of responsibilities.
  • Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain.
  • Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
  • A valid passport and willingness to travel to observe our work at Mingomba or at an exploration site around the world.

It is also helpful but not required to have experience with:

  • Creating machine learning models on geospatial data
  • Geostatistics
  • Image processing or computer vision
  • Distributed computing applications for machine learning and other computations

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

Location: KoBold is a remote-first workplace. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in one of the following countries: United States, Canada, Australia, South Africa, United Kingdom, Zambia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Namibia, Finland, Sweden, or Botswana.

jobs.title: Inventory Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our client, a rapidly growing Amazon FBM (Fulfilled by Merchant) business sourcing a wide range of products from China, is looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Inventory Manager to support the companys focus on fast fulfillment, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making.
jobs.description:
Our client, a rapidly growing Amazon FBM (Fulfilled by Merchant) business sourcing a wide range of products from China, is looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Inventory Manager to support the companys focus on fast fulfillment, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making. In this role, they will be responsible for overseeing all inventory operations, from procurement and inbound logistics to spare parts control and returns processing. A major part of the position involves building and maintaining advanced data systems and dashboards in Google Sheets, ensuring accurate stock visibility and operational efficiency across all channels.

About the company:

The company is an e-commerce brand built around movement, energy, and family fun. Best known for its high-quality outdoor products - especially trampolines designed for safety and joy - it is growing fast across global marketplaces. The company values initiative, quality, and people who take ownership of their work. If youre passionate about e-commerce and want to play a key role in building something meaningful, you might be a great fit.

Key responsibilities:

Inventory & Stock Control

  • Maintain accurate and real-time stock levels for all SKUs across Amazon FBM channels and internal databases.
  • Develop and maintain Google Sheets dashboards to track inventory, shipments, returns, and reorder points.
  • Monitor spare parts inventory, ensuring correct allocation and timely replenishment.
  • Forecast inventory needs based on sales trends and product lifecycle data.
  • Prevent stockouts and overstock through precise data-driven planning.

Procurement & Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate purchase orders and shipping schedules with suppliers in China.
  • Track inbound shipments and lead times using structured data sheets.
  • Follow up with suppliers and freight forwarders on delays, discrepancies, or quality issues.
  • Support cost analysis and order optimization using spreadsheet models.

Returns & Reverse Logistics

  • Manage returns and spare parts processing, including inspection, refurbishment, restocking, or disposal.
  • Update stock and status in Google Sheets and inventory systems in real time.
  • Optimize workflows for handling returned goods efficiently.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Build automated reports in Google Sheets with formulas, pivot tables, charts, and scripts (e.g., Apps Script or integrations).
  • Track KPIs such as stock accuracy, turnover rates, aging inventory, and reorder performance.
  • Identify inefficiencies and propose data-backed improvements.
  • Collaborate with other departments to provide clear inventory visibility and forecasts.

Process & System Optimization

  • Integrate data between Google Sheets, Amazon Seller Central, and warehouse systems.
  • Standardize inventory tracking templates and ensure all team members follow consistent data procedures.
  • Support automation initiatives to reduce manual work.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as an Inventory Manager, Supply Chain Manager, or similar role in Amazon FBM and FBA.
  • Expert-level Google Sheets skills: Data visualization and reporting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Experience managing spare parts, returns, or similar technical products.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central and FBM workflows.
  • Experience working with Chinese suppliers and freight forwarders.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience integrating Google Sheets with other tools (e.g., Zapier, APIs, or ERP systems).
  • Knowledge of 3PL operations and warehouse management.
  • Understanding of international shipping and import processes
  • Strong process mindset and ability to build SOPs.

What We Offer:

  • Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities
  • Supportive work environment.
  • Friendly International start-up environment.
  • Self-development trainings and courses.
  • Be a part of something bigger, where you can have autonomy over your work.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Incident Response Lead to join our cybersecurity team. This individual will serve as the operational backbone of how Strada handles incidents and ensures Strada is prepared to respond effectively to cybersecurity incidents. This is an individual contributor leadership role with significant cross-functional influence. When things go wrong, you are the person who makes sure the right people are in the room, the right information is flowing, and nothing falls through the cracks. The right person for this role brings structure and rigor to complex situations, drives timely decisions, and helps restore services safely and quickly without waiting for a playbook to be handed to them. This role will strengthen Strada’s incident response readiness by maturing processes, playbooks, escalation paths, exercises, and cross-functional operating mechanisms. The role will partner closely with the SOC Leads, who own monitoring operations, detection engineering, alert triage processes, SIEM management, and SOC team performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead Cybersecurity Incident Response

  • Act as incident lead for major cybersecurity incidents, establishing severity, objectives, workstreams, decision rights, communication cadence, and escalation paths.
  • Direct the end-to-end response through validation and scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and closure, maintaining a clear record of timelines, decisions, actions, and owners.
  • Coordinate security, infrastructure, cloud, identity, network, application, vendor, and business teams to restore affected services safely and validate operational stability and residual risk.
  • Provide concise, timely situation reports and decision recommendations to executives and stakeholders, translating technical findings into business impact and required actions.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Communications, Human Resources, Business Continuity, and customer-facing teams to meet regulatory, contractual, insurance, notification, and crisis communication obligations.

Build readiness for incidents

  • Own and mature incident response by establishing processes, enhancing tooling, and defining operational standards for handling incidents at scale
  • Continually improve the incident response framework, major-incident plans, escalation criteria, call trees, and response and recovery playbooks, including clear handoffs with other teams.
  • Design and facilitate tabletop exercises and simulations to test technical readiness, decision-making, communications, and recovery arrangements.
  • Perform incident readiness activities, and support additional cybersecurity initiatives as needed in a dynamic global corporate environment

Coach and enable the organization

  • Provide expert guidance on complex incidents and mentor responders, analysts, and technical stakeholders in effective incident management practices.
  • Lead post-incident reviews, assign and track corrective actions, and ensure lessons learned improve controls, architecture, detections, response capability, and operational resilience.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in incident management, with direct experience leading high-severity cybersecurity incidents in complex, global, or distributed environments.

  • Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and urgency, with the ability to operate independently and make sound decisions under pressure without waiting for direction
  • Are comfortable working in unprecedented situations where processes are still being defined and guidance may be incomplete or conflicting, leaving things better than you found them
  • Have a track record of effective cross-functional collaboration, particularly with technology, product, security, legal, communications, and executive leadership
  • Have experience with cloud infrastructure incidents and enough technical depth across the stack to engage meaningfully with technology teams during response, including comfort navigating distributed systems, monitoring tools, and logs
  • Are analytically minded, with experience using data (incident metrics, queries, trend analysis) to inform decisions during response and to drive operational improvements over time
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly and calmly under pressure, both in real-time coordination and in post-incident written communications
  • A strong record as a self-starter: you anticipate needs, identify gaps, set priorities, and drive work to completion with limited direction.
  • Strong process-design and documentation skills, including process mapping, runbook development, workflow design, and translating lessons into repeatable operating practices.
  • Proven coaching, facilitation, and change-enablement skills, with the ability to raise the capability and confidence of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of incident response methodologies and frameworks, including NIST SP 800-61, the SANS incident response lifecycle, and MITRE ATT&CK.

jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

In 2022 we launched a new lower-priced, ad-supported tier, and we are building an in-house, world-class ad-tech ecosystem to give our members more choice and to offer advertisers a premium, better-than-linear-TV experience. We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix.

The Identity & Signals team builds the identity foundation of the Netflix ads business — the graph and matching systems that let us recognize the same person or household across signals, devices, and partner data sources, and that determine which signals we can responsibly and accurately use for targeting, measurement, and reporting. We build and maintain the identity graph, run and evaluate entity-matching and resolution pipelines, and manage relationships with identity providers so that advertisers and internal teams can trust the signals underneath every campaign.

This is a foundational role on a small, high-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction — designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time. You'll work end-to-end: from raw signal ingestion, through matching logic and graph construction, to the dashboards and data products that make identity health visible and actionable across the company.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support identity graph construction, entity matching, and identity resolution across first-party and third-party signals.
  • Partner with data engineering and software engineering to productionize matching logic, ensuring pipelines are scalable, well-tested, and monitored for data quality and drift.
  • Build metrics, dashboards, and analytics that quantify match rate, match quality, coverage, and graph stability, and that surface anomalies before they affect downstream campaigns.
  • Work closely with data science to evaluate and improve matching algorithms, providing the clean, well-documented data and features needed to test and iterate on models.
  • Manage and evaluate the analytics relationship with external identity providers (e.g., Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp), including onboarding new sources, validating match performance, and monitoring ongoing data quality.
  • Translate identity graph and matching concepts — nodes, edges, match confidence, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching — into clear, actionable insights for product, sales, and other non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to define identity requirements, evaluate trade-offs (accuracy vs. coverage vs. privacy), and prioritize roadmap work.
  • Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the company.

We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role working with large-scale data.
  • Experience working with graph data structures and graph-based data models (e.g., property graphs, graph databases, or graph analytics on top of relational/columnar stores).
  • Familiarity with entity matching / identity resolution concepts — deterministic and probabilistic matching, fuzzy matching, blocking/candidate generation, and match quality evaluation.
  • Knowledge of, or direct experience working with, identity providers such as Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp, or similar data/identity partners.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Experience designing data models, metrics, and dashboards that make complex technical systems understandable to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely across data engineering, software engineering, data science, and product teams.
  • Ability to work independently, drive your own projects, and make compelling cases for prioritization.
  • Embodies the Netflix values while bringing a new perspective to continue improving our culture.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with ad-tech identity concepts — cross-device identity, household graphs, cookie/ID deprecation, or media measurement.
  • Experience with graph databases or graph-processing frameworks (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune, GraphFrames, or similar).
  • Familiarity with our ML/data stack (Metaflow) or comparable large-scale data tooling.
  • Experience working with privacy-sensitive data and an understanding of relevant data governance and privacy considerations for identity data.
  • Experience applying GenAI to boost developer/analytics productivity.

You will use these platforms, enterprise integrations, and approved AI tools to remove manual effort and improve how employees and teams get work done.

You will work directly with business users to understand friction and build solutions through configuration, scripting, APIs, automation, and governed agents. You will carry solutions from discovery through production and adoption, and keep the portfolio secure, reliable, and cost effective while advancing it beyond traditional application administration.

This role owns technical design, implementation, and service quality. Business and product owners retain accountability for priorities, policies, and process decisions. You will influence those decisions with evidence and engineering judgment, partnering with Digital Workplace and enterprise AI teams on shared capabilities.

Outcomes and Activities


  • This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member.
  • Find friction and simplify before automating. Partner with product owners, service teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize opportunities. Eliminate unnecessary steps and favor platform-native capabilities over customization.
  • Build and ship productivity solutions. Configure platform workflows, write scripts, expose supported APIs, and use approved low-code tools to automate recurring work. Deliver production solutions with clear ownership and support.
  • Engineer AI-powered self-service. Engineer conversational experiences, knowledge, workflows, and agent capabilities, applying deterministic automation where appropriate and bounded AI reasoning where it adds value.
  • Create reusable, trustworthy capabilities. Build documented actions, integrations, and templates that serve multiple teams, favoring supported native capabilities over one-off custom solutions. Connect portfolio applications with enterprise systems using supported APIs and secure data exchange, with validation, monitoring, retries, and exception handling.
  • Engineer trusted enterprise context for AI. Improve knowledge quality with content owners and implement permissions-aware retrieval grounded in authoritative information.
  • Protect access and sensitive data. Configure least-privilege roles, integration identities, and secrets management. Support access reviews and audit evidence with application owners and Security, preserving segregation of duties, especially for HR and payroll processes.
  • Evaluate and govern AI before release. Test workflow correctness, response quality, permissions, and failure scenarios before release, and monitor quality and adoption in production without exposing sensitive data in logs or test datasets. Build in human approval for sensitive actions, audit trails, and the ability to suspend faulty automation.
  • Measure productivity outcomes. Establish a baseline with business owners, then measure cycle time, hours released, adoption, and rework. Distinguish capacity released from realized savings.
  • Operate and release dependable capabilities. Own production reliability for platform capabilities and integrations. Use logs, alerts, and root-cause analysis to reduce recurring failures. Monitor task completion, self-service resolution, and latency. Automate regression testing, maintain source control, and document runbooks. Participate in the on-call rotation.
  • Improve the application portfolio. Maintain application inventory, dependencies, license usage, and renewal dates. Recommend consolidation or retirement based on usage, cost, and business value, coordinating with owners, Finance, Procurement, and vendors.
  • Raise engineering quality and enable adoption. Mentor peers, review technical designs, and establish reusable standards for testing, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows. Use approved AI tools in engineering and review generated output. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and recommend roadmap improvements based on business value. Provide user guidance and knowledge transfer.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of experience administering and engineering enterprise business applications, with a demonstrated record of shipping automation and improving business workflows.
  • Hands-on Atlassian administration and automation experience, including Jira and Confluence, plus ADP or a comparable payroll or HR platform.
  • Scripting and integration experience using Python, PL/SQL, JavaScript, REST APIs, or webhooks, including supporting integrations in production.
  • Practical experience applying generative AI or agent tools to business workflows, including evaluation, data access controls, and human oversight.
  • Experience building secure, compliant applications, including access controls and sensitive data handling for HR, payroll, and financial processes; familiarity with standards such as SOC 2.
  • Experience with incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and technical documentation for enterprise applications.
  • Practical expertise in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC), including Agile/SCRUM practices, testing, release management and DevOps practices.
  • Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring to other engineers.

Preferred

  • Atlassian or ADP certifications.
  • Experience with enterprise low-code automation, knowledge and search quality, approved AI assistants, or reusable agent tools and actions.
  • Experience exposing enterprise actions to external AI agents through governed APIs or standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), and with AI evaluation datasets.
  • Experience with license optimization, application consolidation, and integrating workforce applications with ServiceNow, identity, or collaboration platforms.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Problem Solving: Diagnose and debug complex systems.
  • Learning Agility: Learn and engineer across a varied application portfolio.
  • Business Partnership: Clarify problems, explain tradeoffs, and deliver usable solutions with measurable outcomes.
  • Communication: Explain complex technical information, verbally and in writing, to all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Influence and Leadership: Mentor engineers, challenge the status quo, and influence stakeholders toward innovative solutions.
  • Emerging Technology: Understand AI, agentic systems, and automation, and embed continuous learning and experimentation into day-to-day engineering.

Competencies

  • Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
  • Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
  • One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
  • Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.

Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $104,583.15 - $153,388.63. This position is eligible for an annual variable cash bonus, between 7.5 - 15%. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications.

jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager – DCPDS


Leidos is seeking an accomplished Senior Program Manager (PM) to lead the operation, sustainment, modernization, and lifecycle management of the Defense Civilian Personnel Data System (DCPDS), a mission-critical enterprise human resources platform supporting Department of Defense and non-DoD organizations. The DCPDS program provides operational support, maintenance, versioning, upgrades, modernization, and continuous improvement across a complex suite of enterprise HR applications and supporting environments. The program supports DoD Components including the Air Force, Army, Navy, Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS), Defense Logistics Agency (DLA), and National Guard, as well as non-DoD customers including the Executive Office of the President (EOP) and the United States Agency for Global Media (USAGM).


The environment includes DCPDS production, SQT environments and on production environments as well as Reduced Sign-On (RSO), MyBiz+, MyPerformance, Corporate Management Information System (CMIS), Current Record Mart (CRM/NDCRM), SAP Business Intelligence/Business Objects (BOBJ), External Interface Transfer System (EXITS), and associated interfaces, databases, infrastructure, cybersecurity, test, and support capabilities.


Success requires more than traditional program management. The DCPDS PM must be a mission-focused, technically credible leader who can integrate operations, application sustainment, infrastructure, cybersecurity, testing, modernization, contractual, and financial priorities while maintaining strong customer confidence and positioning the program for continued growth and future modernization.


***WORK LOCATION: Remote but MUST be in driving distance of the Mark Center in Alexandria***


Primary Responsibilities & Measures of Success

Lead Overall DCPDS Program Performance


Provide leadership and accountability for all aspects of DCPDS program execution, including application operations and sustainment, infrastructure, cybersecurity, development, testing, modernization, contractual performance, financial performance, workforce management, schedule, quality, and customer satisfaction.

Organize, direct, and manage multiple complex and interrelated technical and operational workstreams performed across contractor, subcontractor, Government, and partner organizations. Establish clear priorities, accountability, performance expectations, and decision authority across the program.

Ensure program activities, task plans, deliverables, staffing, schedules, and costs remain aligned to contractual requirements and customer mission priorities.


Success looks like: DCPDS operational, technical, contractual, financial, and schedule commitments are consistently achieved; ownership is clear across the organization; and emerging risks are addressed before they materially affect mission delivery or customer confidence.


Serve as the Accountable customer and Contract Interface

Serve as Leidos' senior program authority and primary interface with Government program leadership, contracting officials, and key mission stakeholders.

Maintain trusted relationships with senior customer leadership through transparency, consistent communication, technical credibility, and delivery of commitments. Provide accurate, decision-ready information and early visibility into risks, issues, tradeoffs, dependencies, and emerging requirements.

Translate complex technical and operational issues into understandable mission, schedule, financial, contractual, and risk implications for senior decision-makers.


Success looks like: Government leadership understands where the program stands, receives timely and actionable recommendations, and experiences with no avoidable surprises.


Integrate DCPDS Operations, Sustainment and Modernization

Lead the lifecycle management of DCPDS and its supporting applications, infrastructure, databases, interfaces, test environments, and cybersecurity capabilities.

Ensure effective integration across application sustainment, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, database administration, interfaces, testing, release management, cybersecurity, help desk, and modernization initiatives.

Balance modernization and improvement activities with the need to maintain the stability, availability, security, and performance of ongoing production operations.

Drive continuous improvement through adoption of industry best practices, automation, DevSecOps, improved testing, technical debt reduction, operational efficiencies, and modernization of legacy capabilities.


Success looks like: Sustainment and modernization activities are executed without compromising operational stability, security, or customer mission needs, and DCPDS continues to evolve while maintaining reliable service delivery.


Drive Disciplined Execution, Risk Management and Governance

Establish and maintain a disciplined program operating model that creates visibility, predictability, and accountability across all functional areas.

Manage integrated schedules, program metrics, staffing, actions, decisions, risks, issues, financial performance, contractual deliverables, and executive reporting.

Identify and mitigate technical, operational, cybersecurity, financial, contractual, schedule, workforce, and organizational risks. Escalate significant concerns early and drive cross-functional decisions to resolution.

Ensure program leadership and functional leads clearly understand responsibilities, dependencies, priorities, and expected outcomes.


Success looks like: Risks are surfaced early, decisions are timely, commitments are measurable, and the program minimizes avoidable rework, cost growth, schedule impacts, production disruptions, and customer escalations.


Own Financial, Contractual Performance, and Workforce Performance

Maintain accountability for program financial performance, staffing, labor utilization, subcontractor execution, funding, scope, schedule, and contractual obligations.

Develop and maintain technical, financial, and performance reporting that clearly communicates program health to Leidos and Government leadership.

Monitor scope and emerging requirements to identify potential out-of-scope work, contract changes, staffing impacts, and funding requirements before execution risk is introduced.

Ensure staffing levels, skill mix, organizational structure, and leadership are aligned to operational needs and future program objectives.


Success looks like: The program operates within funded and contractual parameters, maintains disciplined cost and scope management, achieves financial objectives, and has the right workforce aligned to mission requirements.


Lead, Develop and Motivate DCPDS Team

Lead a high-performing, cross-functional workforce supporting a complex enterprise mission.

Establish clear expectations and accountability, develop future leaders, remove organizational barriers, and create an environment where teams surface problems early and work collaboratively across functional boundaries.

Shape the DCPDS Strategic Roadmap and Follow-on Opportunity

Develop and communicate a strategic roadmap that balances sustainment, operational improvement, modernization, technology refresh, automation, cybersecurity, interface modernization, data capabilities, and integration with future HR solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Own the corporate actions product lifecycle at a rapidly scaling self-clearing broker-dealer.

Your mission is to build and operate the systems, vendor relationships, and processes that keep Alpaca accurate, compliant, and on time across every corporate action, from announcement ingestion and entitlement calculation through processing, reconciliation, and client credit. You will ensure that corporate action operations scale reliably as Alpaca adds new event types, asset classes, international markets, and partner institutions.

Over time, you will have the opportunity to grow into broader ownership across clearing and post-trade infrastructure: security master, ledger integrity, multi-market readiness, and the platform foundations that keep brokerage, custody, and books and records in sync.

  • Vendor & Data Quality: Own relationships with corporate action data providers. Build announcement review workflows and establish trustworthy announcement data as a prerequisite for automation.

  • Operations & Observability: Deliver entitlement worksheets, partial processing (process selected accounts or correspondents while excluding problematic ones), and dashboards for processing time, load, progress, and credited amounts..
  • Global & Partner Readiness: DCoordinate the corporate-action work required for newly launched international markets.
  • Upstream Data Governance: Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to prevent conflicts across Security Master, brokerage, and ledger systems.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • Corporate Actions Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of brokerage corporate action processing — announcement sources, record/ex/pay dates, entitlements, mandatory vs. voluntary events. You have lived through high-volume event seasons at a broker-dealer, clearing firm, or custody/post-trade platform.
  • Product Management Experience: Proven track record in Product Management or technical program management at a fintech, brokerage, or financial infrastructure company. You know how to create a roadmap, manage a backlog, and ship under hard operational deadlines.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional ability to coordinate across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Legal. You can translate complex business needs into clear engineering requirements and defend prioritization decisions.

About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:

The Fraud Intelligence team is the analytical core behind Extend’s post-purchase protection platform. We turn signals and transactions from hundreds of millions of users into the insights that decide what we catch, what we stop, and what we let through.

We love uncovering patterns in messy data to catch bad actors, and fraud doesn't stand still. The work moves quickly: a new tactic shows up, you find it in the data, and you help shut it down. You'll work on the front line of how AI is changing fraud review, alongside Fraud Ops and our Machine Learning team, so your analysis turns into material changes, not just a slide.

If you're data-obsessed, impact-driven, and excited by problems at the intersection of analytics and fraud prevention, you'll thrive here. This is a high-ownership role. Your analysis directly protects retailers, builds customer trust, and moves the company's bottom line. You'll also help raise the bar for the team by reviewing code and mentoring junior analysts.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Analyze large-scale behavioral, transactional, and interaction data to uncover signals indicative of fraud and abuse
  • Apply strong business acumen to rapidly identify actionable insights, analyze fraud patterns, and validate hypotheses

Job Title: SAP GRC Specialist
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $150K - $185K
Experience: 5+ years

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP GRC Specialist to design, implement, and operate security and access-control frameworks for complex SAP landscapes, including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, and SuccessFactors. In this role you will be responsible for SAP role design, user provisioning, segregation-of-duties analysis, audit support, and the technical operation of SAP GRC suites. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in SAP authorization concepts with strong hands-on experience operating SAP GRC Access Control and Process Control, and will partner closely with audit, compliance, and business teams to deliver a secure, auditable SAP environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and maintain SAP authorization concepts and role structures aligned with business processes and least-privilege principles.
  • Build and maintain master, derived, composite, and business roles for S/4HANA, ECC, and Fiori applications.
  • Configure and operate SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM), including ruleset management, mitigating controls, and emergency access management.
  • Perform segregation-of-duties analysis and remediation in collaboration with business process owners and internal audit.
  • Configure user provisioning workflows in SAP GRC ARM, including request types, approval paths, and integration with IDM/IAM platforms.
  • Operate SAP GRC Process Control for continuous controls monitoring and policy management.
  • Implement security for Fiori applications, including catalogs, groups, and front-end authorizations.
  • Configure and operate security for SAP BTP and cloud applications using XSUAA, IAS, and IPS.
  • Support SAP audits (SOX, GxP, PCI) and respond to audit findings with documented remediation plans.
  • Implement transport security, table logging, and audit logging in line with internal security policies.
  • Monitor and remediate SAP Security Notes in coordination with Basis and DBA teams.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior team members and support knowledge transfer across the security team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP Security / GRC experience in enterprise landscapes.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP authorization concepts and role design.
  • Deep experience operating SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM).
  • Experience supporting SAP audits and remediation activities.
  • Hands-on experience securing Fiori, BTP, and cloud SAP applications.
  • Familiarity with SAP IDM or third-party IGA tooling.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Process Control.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GxP, and PCI.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP-certified Security or GRC credentials.
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity services (IAS, IPS) and SCIM-based integrations.
  • Familiarity with HANA security and analytic privileges.
  • Experience with continuous controls monitoring frameworks.
  • Exposure to SAP RISE / Grow security operating models.

jobs.description:
BridgePhase is a mission-focused technology company that designs, builds, secures, and operates modern digital solutions that drive national security, government efficiency, and mission success across the Federal Government. We empower agencies to achieve meaningful outcomes through high-performing software engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and platform modernization solutions delivered by collaborative teams focused on innovation, adaptability, and operational excellence. As a trusted partner, BridgePhase helps Federal organizations modernize critical systems, accelerate delivery, and achieve lasting mission impact.

Position Overview:

BridgePhase is seeking an experienced, self-driven DevOps Engineer to support the operation, security, and continued optimization of enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform services within a FedRAMP-authorized Federal environment. This individual will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and compliance of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services while supporting platform governance, incident management, system upgrades, and ongoing operational improvements.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with SAP BTP or comparable large-scale enterprise cloud platforms, along with a solid understanding of cloud-native technologies, platform security, and service lifecycle management. This role requires a proactive technical leader who can take ownership of complex platform environments, troubleshoot critical issues, collaborate across engineering and security teams, and drive operational excellence in a highly regulated environment.

This position requires candidates to be U.S. citizens who hold no additional citizenship. This is a fully remote role with the potential for conversion to a permanent position after one year. The interview process includes an initial Microsoft Teams interview followed by an onsite interview in Herndon, VA. Participation in an on-call rotation to support production services is required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the day-to-day operations, reliability, availability, and performance of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services across multiple environments within a FedRAMP-authorized cloud infrastructure.
  • Serve as a primary technical resource and escalation point for platform operations, ensuring service continuity, security, and compliance with federal requirements.
  • Maintain comprehensive visibility into BTP services, subaccounts, directories, entitlements, global account configurations, and platform dependencies.
  • Establish and enforce operational standards, configuration baselines, change management procedures, and governance policies aligned with federal security and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor platform health, service availability, performance metrics, integration throughput, and error rates using approved monitoring and observability tools.
  • Manage service-level agreements (SLAs), proactively identify operational risks, and implement solutions to maintain platform reliability and minimize service disruptions.
  • Lead incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for platform outages, service degradations, and complex integration issues, coordinating remediation efforts across technical teams.
  • Develop, maintain, and regularly validate business continuity and disaster recovery plans, operational runbooks, and incident response procedures for critical platform services.
  • Plan, coordinate, test, and execute platform upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities in alignment with SAP release schedules and federal change control requirements.
  • Evaluate SAP security advisories, release notes, and patch updates to identify vulnerabilities, prioritize remediation, and ensure platform configurations remain secure and compliant.
  • Coordinate pre-production validation, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities to minimize operational risks associated with platform changes.
  • Operate and maintain platform extensions, ensuring proper configuration, access controls, monitoring, performance, and compliance with approved security baselines.
  • Support cloud-native platform services and integrations involving Cloud Foundry, Kubernetes, APIs, identity management, and enterprise service dependencies.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), Compliance, Engineering, and Business teams to align platform operations with technical and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in change advisory boards, incident reviews, and operational governance activities while communicating service health, technical risks, upcoming upgrades, and compliance status to stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and best practices while providing guidance and mentorship to other platform engineers.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support production services, respond to critical incidents, and ensure timely resolution of operational issues.

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience operating SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) across multiple service categories and environments, or comparable large-scale enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting cloud infrastructure and platform services within a FedRAMP-authorized or equivalent federally secured environment.
  • Experience managing highly scalable, enterprise-level, multi-tenant, microservices-based platforms and services.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, including Cloud Foundry, Kubernetes fundamentals, and enterprise platform operations.
  • Experience managing platform security, identity and access management, configuration baselines, and compliance documentation.
  • Knowledge of SAP BTP security and identity services, including XSUAA, Identity Authentication Service (IAS), role collections, trust configurations, and access reviews.
  • Experience with enterprise IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including incident management, change management, problem management, and change advisory board procedures.
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or comparable enterprise service management tools.
  • Proven experience owning production services, managing service-level agreements, monitoring platform performance, and leading incident response and resolution activities.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts, including API routing, service endpoints, encryption in transit, and cloud connectivity.
  • Understanding of identity federation, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and zero-trust security principles within cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native service operations, API governance, event-driven architectures, and service dependency management.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to support platform availability and operational performance.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills with the ability to independently investigate complex platform configurations, service failures, and integration issues.
  • Experience supporting platform upgrades, patch management, release coordination, and production change control processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop clear technical documentation, operational runbooks, and status reports.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, respond effectively to critical incidents, and work independently in a fast-paced technical environment.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation supporting production platform services.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and hold only U.S. citizenship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP BTP certifications, such as SAP Certified Associate in SAP Business Technology Platform or SAP Integration Suite.
  • Previous experience serving as a technical service owner, platform lead, or senior engineer with responsibility for enterprise platform operations.
  • Advanced experience administering and governing SAP BTP services within complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting regulated Federal Government or national security environments with strict security and compliance requirements.
  • Strong understanding of federal cloud security frameworks, compliance controls, and operational governance practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor technical team members, lead operational improvements, and establish scalable platform management practices.

As with any dynamic technical environment, responsibilities will evolve based on customer and mission needs. We are looking for individuals who are adaptable, proactive, and eager to take ownership of new challenges as they arise.

About Our Company:

BridgePhase was built around one simple belief: People who love where they work build better solutions. We bring top-tier engineering talent to the Government to support the nation's most critical work. Our people are not only technically exceptional, they're energized to deliver the engineering excellence, culture, and accountability our Government deserves. We thrive on building modern, secure, resilient solutions that accelerate mission outcomes, eliminate legacy barriers, and enable Government organizations to deliver faster and adapt smarter to meet today's demands and tomorrow's mission – without compromise.

This role leads the Personal Lines underwriting rules and technology portfolio, translating underwriting strategy into scalable capabilities that improve decision quality, speed, consistency, customer and agent experience, and profitability. Provide business leadership across rules, risk filters, models, and related technology solutions while partnering with Underwriting, Experience, Product, Pricing, Business Insights, Technology, Operations, and Distribution.


Key responsibilities

  • Underwriting rules: Lead the strategic development, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of underwriting rules, guidelines, and related control gaps.
  • Risk filters: Own risk-filter management end to end, including new and changed filters, testing, vendor coordination, monitoring, issue resolution, and controls.
  • Underwriting modeling: Oversee model implementation, KPI measurement, performance analysis, recalibration impact analysis, and follow-up actions.
  • Technology strategy: Prioritization, roadmap, and modernization opportunities. Accountability with delivery partners in managing related scope and budget.
  • Solution delivery: Partner with Product, Pricing, Technology, Business Insights, Experience, field underwriting, and other stakeholders to design and implement underwriting solutions; coordinate UAT, post-production validation, and stabilization.
  • Partnership: Build strong partnerships and feedback loops to ensure solutions improve usability, adoption, workflow effectiveness, and customer, agent, and field-underwriting outcomes.
  • Efficiency and enablement: Identify automation and emerging-technology opportunities that improve underwriting speed, accuracy, consistency, and profitability.
  • People and enterprise leadership: Lead and develop a specialized team while setting priorities, resolving dependencies, managing delivery risk, and influencing senior stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization.

Strategic priorities

The leader will focus on four connected outcomes:

  • Make underwriting strategy executable: Strengthen business-enabled rules, guidelines, and risk filters so strategy is translated into consistent, well-governed decisions with connected consideration. Monitor, measure, and adjust.
  • Improve decision performance: Enhance Auto and Property model implementation, KPI measurement, monitoring, recalibration, and use in profitable risk selection.
  • Improve experiences and new business activation: Partner with Experience and field underwriting to reduce friction and support an efficient journey from quote through policy issuance.
  • Build scalable future capabilities: Set the technology roadmap and identify modernization, automation, and emerging-technology opportunities, including the potential development or adoption of a new underwriting rules engine. Deliver on countermeasures from activation kaizen.

Experience and capabilities

We welcome candidates with different combinations of experience.

  • Personal Lines underwriting knowledge and the ability to connect strategy to day-to-day decisions.
  • Experience across Auto, Property and other lines of business.
  • Experience leading underwriting rules, risk filters, models, decisioning capabilities, or technology-enabled underwriting change.
  • Experience with model performance, KPI analysis, recalibration, or impact assessment.
  • Experience leading delivery through design, UAT, implementation, validation, and stabilization.
  • Ability to build productive partnerships with Experience, field underwriting, Product, Pricing, Technology, Business Insights, Operations, and Distribution.
  • People leadership, talent development, strategic planning, roadmap, budgeting, prioritization, risk management, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience with underwriting decision platforms, rules engines, decision management, workflow technology, third-party data or vendors, or modernization initiatives is helpful.
  • Familiarity with automation, analytics, AI, or other emerging technologies in underwriting

Developing the underwriting strategy and ensuring it meets our risk appetite is essential to Nationwide's profitability and overall success. Our team utilizes our analysis and problem solving skills to enable solutions that drive underwriting efficiency and streamlined approaches. If you are a creative problem solver, have strategic agility, and are an excellent communicator, we want to know more about you!

As a Director, you'll provide oversight and management of commercial or personal line product(s) staff function. We'll count on you to develop and recommend underwriting or product policies, procedures and standards and ensure coordination between corporate office and field operations.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assists in the development of strategy and direction for the assigned product(s). Participates in key initiatives to address the product strategy and profitability objectives. Reinforces understanding, communication and execution of product/underwriting strategy.

  • Provides technical assistance and support to state/regional underwriting and services leadership. Maintains relationships with new entities, access points and distribution channels that need the support and expertise of product/underwriting staff operations.

  • Leads projects for assigned profitability initiatives. Ensures that each area within the function is following the formal project management process for those projects designated as high priority.

  • Serves on various committees, project teams and industry boards as assigned.

  • Ensures various support functions, including product functional audits, training, vendor selection and management, employee career enhancement, competitive monitoring, systems and acting as a liaison to other business units.

  • Manages associates, including performance management, salary planning and administration, training and development, workflow and organizational planning, hiring and placement and disciplinary actions.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Staff Vice President or Officer. Leads a team of six or more Underwriting professionals and support staff.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor's degree or post-graduate studies preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU highly desirable.

Experience: Typically, 10 years of property and casualty (personal and/or commercial) lines underwriting, including at least five years of management experience. Exposure to both field and staff office operations preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Requires proven knowledge of property/casualty products, insurance company operations, field and staff functions, industry trends, and project management. Demonstrated decision-making and strategic abilities. Ability to drive for results, deal with ambiguity, communicate with upper management, and conceptualize strategic objectives. Ability to lead staff, committees and project participants in all aspects of product/underwriting activities.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

This is a high-impact opportunity to stand at the center of QualityOne’s growth. QualityOne is Veeva’s cloud-based Quality Management platform designed for enterprise organizations across regulated industries such as consumer-packaged goods, food and beverage, and chemical.     • General Operations & Leadership Alignment

  • Cross-Functional Accountability: Drive operating alignment across Strategy, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams, advancing priority initiatives and keeping them on schedule.

  • Strategic Projects: Lead high-priority, cross-departmental special projects on behalf of the CEO to address emerging business needs.
