You'll enable an Agile delivery teams by defining features, prioritizing the backlog, and partnering with SMEs on story creation, while working on problems of moderate to substantial complexity with minimal supervision and considerable independent judgment.

Unlike a traditional business Product Owner, this role requires genuine technical fluency — you should be comfortable in architecture discussions about microservices, CI/CD gating logic, and data pipelines, because you'll be prioritizing technical debt reduction, pipeline orchestration, and platform modernization work alongside developer-facing features. We are specifically looking for someone with a software engineering background who has transitioned into product ownership — not a pure business PO learning tech on the job. This is a delivery-focused role: we need someone who doesn't just manage a backlog, but drives features and roadmap items to done, quarter over quarter. The Product Owner maximizes value of product created by Agile team. Liaises with stakeholders and the development team ensuring the right product is being built, in the right order, within budget and by the deadline. Serves as the primary source for backlog prioritization and refinement then drives action. Partners with Product Manager to ensure backlog items advance capability objectives and deliver measurable outcomes within the Product Security service catalog. Advises senior leadership to develop functional strategies (often segment specific) on matters of significance. Exercises independent judgment and decision making on complex issues regarding job duties and related tasks, and works under minimal supervision, uses independent judgment requiring analysis of variable factors and determining the best course of action. Must reside in Louisville KY, Dallas TX, Florida (Ft. Lauderdale/Tampa), or Nashville; office visits required

The Senior Technical Product Owner serves as the voice of the developer community and IT customer within our DevSecOps Engineering team, ensuring backlog priorities trace to initiative goals and program-level security outcomes. Unlike a traditional business Product Owner, this role requires genuine technical fluency — you should be comfortable in architecture discussions about microservices, CI/CD gating logic, and data pipelines, because you'll be prioritizing technical debt reduction, pipeline orchestration, and platform modernization work alongside developer-facing features. We are specifically looking for someone with a software engineering background who has transitioned into product ownership — not a pure business PO learning tech on the job. This is a delivery-focused role: we need someone who doesn't just manage a backlog, but drives features and roadmap items to done, quarter over quarter.

Job Description

Job titleSenior Software EngineerDepartmentEngineeringReports toDirector of EngineeringLocationRemote (US); ClassificationFull-timeExperience level8+ years professional software engineering

Position summary

The Senior Software Engineer builds, maintains, and improves the backend services, APIs, and third-party integrations that power SureCost’s pharmacy purchasing and inventory platform, which over 1,600 pharmacies use every day. The role writes production software with fully agentic AI development workflows. AI agents (Claude Code or equivalent) are the main environment for writing, testing, and running code. The work is backend focused and centered on .NET, within a full-stack ownership model. The engineer owns features end to end: the API contract, the service logic, the data layer, any external integrations, the supporting UI where needed, deployment, and production support. They work in a cross-functional pod with other senior engineers and QA.

Essential duties and responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in C# / .NET ( Core) on the company’s current and next-generation platforms.
  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems, such as accounting platforms, ERP, EDI, and vendor APIs. This covers authentication (OAuth 2.0), data mapping and sync, webhooks, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, and error reconciliation.
  • Design data models and write efficient, well-tested data access against relational databases (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL), including schema migrations and query performance tuning.
  • Direct agentic AI development workflows to write, test, refactor, and document code. Review agent output and confirm it passes the company’s blocking quality gates before release.
  • Own delivered work end-to-end: design, implementation, automated tests, deployment, monitoring, and fixing production issues that arise from that work.
  • Build and maintain automated test coverage (unit, integration, and contract tests), including AI-authored test suites, as a condition of feature completion.
  • Work with the pod on API contracts. Build or modify React / TypeScript front-end code when needed to finish a feature without handoffs at team boundaries.
  • Take part in sprint planning, estimation, code review, and the pod’s operational cadence. Report status and blockers clearly and early.
  • Contribute to shared libraries, integration patterns, and platform foundations.

Required qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial production backend work in C# / .NET.
  • Hands-on experience building and supporting production integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping production code through fully agentic AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor agent mode, or equivalent). This means using agents to write, test, and operate substantial production code, not only code completion.
  • Strong proficiency in Core, RESTful API design, asynchronous programming, and dependency injection, plus an ORM such as Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper.
  • Solid relational database skills (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL): schema design, query optimization, and migrations.
  • Working proficiency in React and TypeScript, enough to build and modify front-end features as part of full-stack delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving skills: able to read unfamiliar codebases quickly, debug across layers (API, data, external systems, UI), and make sound technical decisions under time pressure.
  • Working fluency in at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure acceptable), including messaging and queuing (e.g., SQS/SNS), and the ability to learn new stacks quickly.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of production software, including post-release support.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with additional accounting, ERP, or financial integrations (e.g., Xero, NetSuite, Sage) or EDI (X12 850/855/810).
  • Event-driven and asynchronous architectures: background workers, message queues, and reliable sync / reconciliation patterns.
  • Containerized deployment (Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform).
  • Observability tooling (e.g., Datadog) for tracing, logging, and alerting on integration health.
  • React PWA, React Native / React Native Web, or design-system experience.
  • Data-dense B2B application experience (purchasing, invoicing, ERP-style workflows).

Success measures (first 6 months)

  • Independently delivers the pod’s committed backend and integration work through the release gate, sprint over sprint.
  • Uses the team’s agentic development pipelines fluently, and agent-authored test coverage ships with every feature.
  • Owns at least one production service or integration surface with no unresolved escaped defects attributable to delivered work.

Working relationships

Reports to the Director of Engineering (career line) and takes technical direction from the pod lead. Works daily with pod engineers, QA, the product owner, and contractor teammates.

Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart. 

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Position Summary

Voyage is seeking a highly skilled mid to senior level DevOps Engineer with an active Secret clearance. The ideal candidate defines and owns the enterprise source control and release engineering strategy, enabling development and engineering teams' organization-wide to build, test, and release software through standardized, secure, and auditable workflows.

This role leads the consolidation of fragmented Git platforms and repository practices across the organization into a single, governed source control and automation foundation, and sets the CI/CD standards that teams build against. The ideal candidate is hands-on with enterprise Git platform administration, fluent in modern CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices, and comfortable operating as the enterprise authority on source control standards.

The role also owns the organization-wide platform services that build and release pipelines depend on - a shared container registry, object storage, and centralized secrets management - replacing team-specific instances with Voyager-standard, enterprise-supported services.

Key Responsibilities

Git Platform Strategy & Consolidation

  • Define and own the enterprise Git platform strategy, including platform standards, architecture, and long-term roadmap.
  • Lead the consolidation of source control tooling across the organization, migrating and standardizing repositories from legacy and fragmented platforms onto an approved enterprise standard.
  • Administer enterprise Git platforms (self-hosted and cloud-hosted), including repository structure, access controls, and branch protection policies.
  • Integrate enterprise Git platforms with identity and access management for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning.
  • Define and enforce branching strategies, code review workflows, and repository governance standards across engineering teams.
  • Manage platform licensing, seat allocation, organizational structure, and version upgrades.

CI/CD Pipeline Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines across the organization's build and release tooling.
  • Implement automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Build reusable pipeline templates and shared workflow libraries to standardize CI/CD practices across teams.
  • Integrate artifact repositories and container registries into pipeline workflows.
  • Monitor and optimize pipeline performance, reliability, and compute cost across the organization's CI/CD platforms.

Platform Services: Container Registry, Object Storage & Secrets Management

  • Deploy and operate an organization-wide container registry (e.g., Harbor or equivalent) to host, scan, and manage container images across engineering and manufacturing teams, consolidating existing team-specific registries onto a single Voyager-standard service.
  • Deploy and operate organization-wide object storage (e.g., MinIO or equivalent S3-compatible storage) for build artifacts, test data, and engineering file storage.
  • Own centralized secrets management infrastructure (e.g., HashiCorp Vault or equivalent) as a shared platform service supporting CI/CD pipelines, applications, and infrastructure automation enterprise-wide, replacing ad hoc or team-local secrets handling.
  • Define access control, retention, backup, and disaster recovery policies for the registry, object storage, and secrets management platforms.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation for Git platform, CI/CD, and platform services infrastructure.
  • Write automation scripts in Python, PowerShell, and Bash to support platform operations, developer tooling, and workflow automation.
  • Containerize build and deployment workflows using Docker; support Kubernetes-based deployment pipelines.

Security, Compliance & Observability

  • Partner with cybersecurity and compliance teams to ensure Git platform configurations meet data handling and access control requirements.
  • Implement audit logging, access reviews, and compliance reporting for source control and CI/CD systems.
  • Integrate static and dynamic application security testing and dependency scanning into pipeline workflows.
  • Monitor platform health, pipeline failures, and security events; implement proactive alerting and self-healing mechanisms where possible.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Partner with engineering, data, and platform teams to translate development workflow needs into Git and CI/CD solutions.
  • Create and maintain documentation for Git standards, pipeline templates, and platform runbooks.
  • Serve as the technical resource and escalation point for Git and CI/CD issues across the organization.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and cross-functional planning for engineering tooling and platform roadmap.

Technical Skills

Git Platforms

  • GitLab - self-hosted and SaaS administration, group/project structure, permissions, CI/CD configuration
  • GitHub - Enterprise Cloud and Enterprise Server administration, organization and repository management
  • Git branching strategies - trunk-based development, GitFlow, repository governance and code review workflows

CI/CD & Pipeline Tools

  • GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps Pipelines
  • Jenkins or equivalent legacy CI tooling, a plus for migration work
  • Artifact management and container registries (GitHub Packages, GitLab Container Registry, or equivalent)

Cloud Platforms

  • AWS (commercial and GovCloud)
  • Microsoft Azure

Infrastructure as Code & Containers

  • Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible
  • Docker, Kubernetes basics for containerized build and deployment workloads

Scripting & Programming (Required)

  • Python - automation, API integrations, tooling development
  • PowerShell - Windows and Azure environment scripting
  • Bash - Linux automation and pipeline scripting

Container Registry, Object Storage & Secrets

  • Container registry - Harbor (or equivalent) deployment, administration, and image scanning
  • Object storage - MinIO (or equivalent S3-compatible storage) deployment and administration
  • Secrets management - HashiCorp Vault (or cloud-native equivalent) deployment and administration as a platform service

Identity, Security & Observability

  • Okta - SSO and SCIM integration, Active Directory
  • SAST/DAST and dependency scanning tooling
  • Monitoring and observability - Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent

Qualifications

  • Must hold and maintain an active Secret clearance upon hire

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 10-12 years of DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience administering both GitLab and GitHub at enterprise scale.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating CI/CD pipelines across multiple teams and environments.
  • Experience leading or significantly supporting a large-scale Git platform migration or consolidation effort strongly preferred.
  • Experience deploying and operating container registries and object storage (Harbor, MinIO, or equivalent) and centralized secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or equivalent) as shared platform services preferred.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communicator across engineering, security, and leadership audiences.
  • Self-directed and comfortable owning enterprise-wide tooling and governance decisions.
  • Detail-oriented; treats pipeline configurations and platform settings as production-grade, auditable artifacts.
  • Collaborative - experienced working across IT, security, and engineering teams.

Preferred Certifications

  • GitHub Actions Certification
  • GitHub Administration Certification
  • GitLab Certified CI/CD Associate
  • GitLab Certified Git Associate
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional
  • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), a plus

Working Conditions

  • Fully remote position; no geographical preference.
  • Occasional after-hours availability for platform maintenance, migrations, and incident response.
  • Active participation in sprint-based delivery against a defined platform roadmap.
  • Must comply with all applicable data handling and access control policies.

The good faith base salary rangefor this role is$160,000–$180,000at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees
  • Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security
  • Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being
  • Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources
  • The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. 

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120–130) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) (15 CFR Parts 730–774), applicants for this position must be a U.S. Person: a US Citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). Applicants must be eligible to obtain any required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or the U.S. Department of Commerce.

jobs.title: Python & Java Full Stack Developer (AI-Assisted)
jobs.excerpt: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?


  • As the Python & Java Full Stack Developer, you will build AI-assisted platforms for manufacturing tests and debug automation software with direct, real-world consequences on the factory floor.
  • You will own end-to-end features across event-driven platforms, from cloud infrastructure and backend microservices, up through an agentic LLM pipeline, out to a modern web frontend.
  • LLMs are a core building block of what we build, and AI coding agents are a core part of how we build it but we treat them as power tools operated by strong engineers, not autopilots.
  • This role requires someone who can define work with precision, critically evaluate agent-generated output, and write code themselves when needed.
  • As the Python & Java Full Stack Developer (AI-Capabilities), you are equally comfortable writing a Python Lambda handler, designing an agent tool, building a Java microservice, defining infrastructure as code, tuning a message-bus consumer, and building an Angular component with an AI agent working alongside you.

How We Work with AI


  • We use AI coding agents Claude, Kiro, and similar agentic IDEs/CLIs (we use Kiro) but as power tools in the hands of engineers who could do the work without them.
  • We are seeking a passionate developer who has experienced building without AI, understands its capabilities and limitations, and knows when to rely on AI versus writing code themselves.
  • The challenge isn’t generating code. It’s defining requirements precisely and rigorously validating the output.

Engineering Fundamentals

  • You can read, debug, and correct generated code as readily as you can produce it, and you can justify an architectural decision independent of what any tool suggested.

Spec-Driven Development

  • Decompose features into clear requirements, design, and task breakdowns that both humans and agents execute against, treating the spec as the source of truth and iterating on it.

Skills and Powers

  • Author and use reusable agent capabilities (skills, steering docs, custom tools/MCP integrations, project conventions) to encode team standards and make agents productive in a large codebase.

Prompt and Context Engineering

  • Give agents the right context (conventions, contracts, constraints) and validate their output rather than trusting it blindly.

Correctness Discipline

  • Pair agent velocity with strong testing, review, and observability so fast-moving changes stay safe in production.

What will you do?


  • Design, build, and ship feature end-to-end across the full stack AWS infrastructure, Python and Java backend services, agentic LLM workflows, and the Angular frontend for a system serving manufacturing across multiple sites.
  • Build and evolve agentic AI workflows on Amazon Bedrock.

(LLM reasoning + embeddings):

    • tool/function calling, RAG,
    • prompts,
    • validation loops, and
    • fallback strategies that stay correct and observable under production load
  • Own backend services across two ecosystems
    • Python serverless (Lambda, event-driven) and
    • Java microservices (Spring Boot/Quarkus) with REST and event-driven APIs, persistence, async pipelines, and message-bus integrations
    • Care for idempotency, retries, and dead-letter handling throughout
  • Define and evolve infrastructure as code (AWS CDK) across multi-stack deployments with cross-stack references.
  • Treat published API surfaces as backwards-compatibility contracts, using shared interface/schema libraries consumed across services and clients.
  • Develop retrieval and scoring logic:
    • log chunking, embeddings, vector/semantic search in OpenSearch, and relevance ranking
  • Instrument with CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, tracing, structured diagnostic events and own CI/CD on Azure DevOps with gated, reversible rollouts.
  • Contribute to shared foundational code with wide blast radius, keeping changes narrow and well-tested.

How will you get here?


Python

  • Modern typing, async patterns, data validation (e.g., Pydantic), clean error handling, and a codebase-scale sense of structure.

Backend Engineering in Java

  • Deep experience with Spring Boot and/or Quarkus, clean architecture, and idiomatic use of the type system.
  • Production AWS serverless and cloud experience across the stack:

Compute

  • Lambda
  • ECS Fargate

Data & Messaging

  • DynamoDB
  • S3
  • SQS
  • OpenSearch

Networking

  • VPC
  • VPC Endpoints
  • API Gateway (Private)

Eventing & Scheduling

  • EventBridge

Security & Identity

  • IAM
  • IAM Roles Anywhere (trust anchor, cross-environment access)

AI

  • Amazon Bedrock

Ops & Config

  • CloudWatch (alarms + dashboards)
  • SSM Parameter Store
  • ECR assets

Persistence Expertise

  • JPA / Hibernate
  • JDBC
  • transaction management
  • NoSQL data modeling (DynamoDB access patterns),
  • and relational database design, management, and query optimization

API Design

  • Production REST services; comfortable with versioning and backwards-compatibility.

Modern Concurrency

  • Java virtual threads (Project Loom) and reasoning clearly about concurrency correctness.

Microservices & Event-Driven Architecture

  • Designing and operating microservices with a message bus (NATS.io, Kafka, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, retries, and failure handling.

Hands-on LLM/agent Development

  • Building applications with LLMs (function calling, prompt design, RAG, embeddings) and evaluating output quality. You understand that specifying and validating agent behavior is the hard part.

AI-assisted development Practice

  • Daily, judicious use of AI coding agents (Claude, Kiro, etc.), spec-driven workflows, and reusable agent skills/powers, paired with the fundamentals to review their output critically.

Frontend Development in Angular

  • Building and maintaining a modern web UI (Angular/TypeScript) that consumes these APIs.

Testing Discipline

  • Unit, integration, and mocking as a first-class part of shipping.

Containerization & Orchestration

  • Docker and Docker Swarm
  • Kubernetes

Cloud-Native Workflow

  • Git
  • Azure DevOps pipelines
  • and code review in a sizable multi-repo codebase

Deployment Strategies

  • Blue/green, canary, gated rollout, and rollback

Observability, Security & Analytics

  • Structured logging, tracing, metrics; secure coding and auth fundamentals; and building/consuming analytics on operational data.

Education:

  • BS degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field
  • MS preferred

Experience:

  • 10+ years’ experience in a software development capacity with enterprise server, storage or networking products.

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
  • 401K Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Annual Merit Increases
  • Community Volunteer Opportunities
The pay range for this role is $100,100 - $180,200. jobs.excerpt: The application window is expected to close on: 11/02/2026Meet the TeamThe Cloud Capacity Planning team makes sure Cisco's cloud platforms have the compute, storage and network capacity customers need, in the right region at the right time.
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/02/2026

Meet the Team

The Cloud Capacity Planning team makes sure Cisco's cloud platforms have the compute, storage and network capacity customers need, in the right region at the right time. We turn demand from sales, product and engineering into confirmed supply with our cloud service providers (CSPs), which keeps customer launches, migrations and maintenance windows on track while managing cloud spend responsibly. We're a supportive team of 7 and analysts across the US and Canada who share what we know, learn from each other and celebrate wins together. What makes this team exciting is timing: we're bringing AI-powered forecasting into how Cisco plans for the future of cloud!


Your Impact

Build and maintain a rolling capacity forecast by CSP, region, workload and resource type to help leaders make confident investment and growth decisions worldwide. Compare demand from sales pipeline, bookings and product roadmaps against available supply, then work with CSPs on reservations so customers get capacity on time without wasted spend. Collaborate with sales on realistic lead times, with engineering on protecting capacity during maintenance windows and with FinOps on reconciling reservations to keep costs healthy. Mentor fellow capacity planners and introduce AI-enabled tools to make planning faster and more accurate across every region. Measure your success by sharper forecasts, on-time deliveries and a clear owner and plan for every capacity gap.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, engineering, supply chain, data analytics or a related field; and 8+ years of related experience, or a master's degree and 6+ years of related experience
  • Experience in cloud or infrastructure capacity planning with AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud, including quotas and reservations
  • Experience building demand forecasts and scenario models
  • Experience building reports and dashboards
  • Experience working with FinOps or finance teams on cloud cost management, reservation coverage or budgets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience using AI or machine learning tools to automate forecasting and reporting
  • Knowledge of how geopolitical, regulatory and data sovereignty factors affect regional capacity and hardware supply chains
  • Clear communicator who enjoys explaining trade-offs to stakeholders at every level
  • Passion for mentoring teammates and building processes that make everyone's work easier

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.excerpt: What’s in it for you?  Ready to make a serious impact?
jobs.description:
What’s in it for you?

Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we’re still in the midst of exciting product growth — it’s a fantastic time to join us. Everything you’ll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you’ve ever worked with, then we hope you’ll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

About the team & opportunity

Millions of people use Calendly to book meetings, and most of that happens on public booking pages where anyone with a link can schedule time. That openness is what makes Calendly easy to use, and it’s also what makes it a target. The Trust & Safety team keeps Calendly safe without slowing anyone down.

We protect everyone who interacts with Calendly: the hosts who share their links, the invitees who book with them, and the email and SMS providers and partners who rely on us to send responsibly. Our work covers three areas: preventing and responding to abuse, protecting the deliverability and compliance of the messages Calendly sends, and keeping messaging costs predictable as the platform grows.

Most of our problems are adversarial. We often can’t rely on knowing who someone is, so we judge behavior, patterns, and content instead. Attackers change tactics all the time, so we build signals that last from one attack to the next. And we take false positives seriously, because blocking a real customer costs more than letting a spammer through. Engineers work closely with our Trust & Safety Operations team, who see abuse first and shape what we build.

In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager for the Trust & Safety team.

A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly

On a typical day, you will be working on:

  • Building and improving the systems that detect and stop abuse across sign-up, booking, and messaging, such as spam, phishing, bots, and fraudulent SMS traffic.
  • Improving the reliability, deliverability, and compliance of the email and SMS notifications Calendly sends.
  • Shipping new detection carefully: measuring how it performs on real traffic before it acts on accounts, and weighing false positives against false negatives.
  • Responding to active abuse, including during on-call, by stopping the damage fast, then replacing quick fixes with durable ones.
  • Building tools that help our Trust & Safety Operations team review accounts faster and understand why the system took each action.
  • Partnering with Product, Operations, and Data to define requirements and measure the impact of what we ship.
  • Working with other product teams to add protections to the flows they own.
  • Reviewing implementation plans and pull requests, and sharing what you learn with the team.

What do we need from you?

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, including building and running production systems.
  • Strong backend skills: building services, APIs, and data-heavy workflows in a service-oriented architecture.
  • Experience with Rails, Node/TypeScript, Go, or a comparable language or framework, and a willingness to work across more than one.
  • Comfort with relational databases and SQL, and with using data to check whether a change actually worked.
  • An analytical, curious mindset: you think about how a system could be misused, not only how it’s supposed to be used.
  • Good judgment about trade-offs, such as stopping bad actors without adding friction for real customers.
  • A commitment to clean, reliable, maintainable code, thoughtful testing, and shipping in small increments.
  • Clear communication with engineers and non-engineers alike, including Operations and Support partners.
  • Comfort and skill with AI tools in your engineering work, including reviewing their output critically.
  • Availability to take part in an on-call rotation for critical services.
  • Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time.

Nice to have

  • Experience in trust and safety, fraud, spam, or abuse prevention.
  • Experience with email or SMS delivery, such as deliverability, sender reputation, or messaging compliance.
  • Experience with bot protection, rate limiting, or third-party risk and verification services.
  • Experience building rules engines, risk scoring, or ML-backed decisions in production.
  • Experience using LLMs to classify or moderate user-generated content.
  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, or Redis.

Base salary is just one component of Calendly’s total rewards package. All full-time (30 hours/week) employees are also eligible for equity awards, and competitive benefits. Eligible Sales employees also qualify for a Sales Incentive program.

jobs.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – AWS

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually (based on experience)
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – AWS with 10+ years of professional IT and cloud engineering experience, including extensive expertise designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale AWS environments. This is a hands-on senior engineering role responsible for cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), platform automation, security, observability, governance, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of AWS services, Kubernetes, DevOps, cloud security, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) while providing technical leadership across mission-critical cloud initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available AWS cloud environments supporting enterprise production workloads.
  • Design multi-account AWS Organizations, landing zones, Service Control Policies (SCPs), centralized logging, governance frameworks, and shared services architectures.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK, following enterprise DevOps and GitOps best practices.
  • Design resilient AWS networking architectures, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, Route 53, Network Load Balancer, and Application Load Balancer.
  • Implement enterprise identity and access management using IAM, AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS SSO), permission boundaries, least-privilege access, and secrets management.
  • Design, deploy, and operate container platforms using Amazon EKS, ECS, and AWS Fargate, integrating Kubernetes, service mesh technologies, and cloud-native networking.
  • Manage AWS data platforms including Amazon RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR, and Kinesis, ensuring scalability, resilience, and performance.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI to automate infrastructure and application deployments.
  • Implement enterprise observability solutions using Amazon CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing.
  • Drive cloud optimization initiatives focused on performance, availability, security, automation, and FinOps-based cost management.
  • Design disaster recovery, backup, failover, and business continuity strategies across multi-region AWS deployments.
  • Strengthen cloud security using AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, Config, CloudTrail, AWS KMS, and encryption best practices.
  • Develop automation tools and operational scripts using Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell to improve operational efficiency and incident response.
  • Lead architecture reviews, mentor cloud engineers, establish engineering standards, and provide technical leadership across cloud platform initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional IT and cloud engineering experience, including 5+ years designing and operating enterprise AWS environments.
  • Expert knowledge of AWS core services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, Route 53, API Gateway, and CloudFormation.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Strong experience designing and operating production-scale Amazon EKS, ECS, or Kubernetes environments.
  • Proven expertise building CI/CD pipelines and implementing DevOps, GitOps, and Infrastructure Automation practices.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and preferably Go or PowerShell.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, key management, compliance, and Zero Trust architecture.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, observability, logging, alerting, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional, or equivalent advanced AWS certifications.
  • Experience managing AWS Organizations, Control Tower, enterprise landing zones, and cloud governance at scale.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd), eBPF-based observability, and modern Zero Trust networking principles.
  • Experience implementing FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and AWS Well-Architected Framework best practices.
  • Experience supporting regulated environments such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments integrating AWS with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

jobs.description:
About Egen:

Egen is a fast-growing and entrepreneurial company with a data-first mindset. We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. We are committed to being a place where the best people choose to work so they can apply their engineering and technology expertise to envision what is next for how data and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving tough problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If this describes you, we want you on our team.
Want to learn more about life at Egen? Check out these resources in addition to the job description.
Meet Egen
Life at Egen
Culture and Values at Egen
Career Development at Egen
Benefits at Egen

About the opportunity

We're looking for an engineer who is equally at home running a GPU training platform and the large-scale model training that runs on it. You'll be embedded with a healthcare and life-sciences AI client that trains foundation models on a large GKE-based H200 and GB200 cluster. The client is reorganizing so that its foundation-model platform and its agent platform teams work more closely together.

The role centres on the training stack and the scientists who use it. Solid infrastructure knowledge and experience are required, but the client already has strong SRE and infrastructure capacity, so running the cluster isn't the focus: you'll partner with that team and understand the training workloads well enough to tune, benchmark, and debug them end to end. You'll work alongside other Egen engineers and client scientists, and you'll own your area outright.

What You Will Do:

    Training platform

  • Work with the client's infrastructure team on the GKE training platform (GPU node pools, job queueing and scheduling, quota and capacity) from the training workload's side.
  • Diagnose and fix platform failures at the root (for example a controller that keeps running out of memory) rather than restarting them.
  • Tune multi-node GPU networking (RDMA/GPUDirect, NCCL) for training throughput.

    • Distributed training

  • Run, scale and debug multi-node distributed training with PyTorch (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron or NeMo-style) and Ray Train.
  • Profile jobs and remove bottlenecks across compute, memory, input pipelines and interconnect.

    • Benchmarking and evals

  • Design and run performance benchmarks for the cluster and training stack: throughput, scaling efficiency, cost per run.
  • Build and maintain model evaluation harnesses so changes to the platform or training recipes are measured, not assumed.
  • Instrument training and the platform with telemetry and monitoring, and keep end-to-end pipeline tests running against what users actually run.

    • Ownership on the client team

  • Treat the platform as your own: proactively find issues, plug gaps and propose solutions before anyone asks, keep the team informed of status and risks, and look after the scientists who use it.
  • Explain and defend your design decisions to client engineers and scientists in detail.
  • Stay effective while the client's priorities and team structure change.

Your Technical Toolkit:

  • Core Languages: Mastery of Python and shell scripting

  • AI/LLM Ecosystem: Extensive experience with Google Gemini, GPT-4, or LLaMA; deep knowledge of Prompt Engineering and Fine-tuning

  • Data & Search: Expertise in Vector Databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, etc.) and implementing Semantic Search

  • Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI) and building scalable software architectures

  • Frameworks: Proficiency in LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration layers

  • Mindset: A strong software engineering foundation—you write clean, maintainable code and understand the full SDLC

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience, with recent hands-on work on GPU training infrastructure and large-scale training.

  • Strong Python software engineering: production-quality code, tests and code review. Coding is central to this role, not an afterthought.

  • GKE and GPU scheduling: Kubernetes on Google Cloud with GPU node pools, job queueing (Kueue or similar), and capacity and quota management.

  • Distributed PyTorch and Ray Train: has personally run and debugged multi-node training jobs.

  • RDMA and GPU networking: GPUDirect/RDMA, NCCL tuning, multi-node GB200 (or H200) topology.

  • Benchmarking and evals: has designed performance benchmarks and model evaluations, and used them to make decisions.

  • Deep enough understanding to explain how and why a system works, without leaning on AI coding tools to carry the reasoning.

  • A track record of visible ownership: present, communicative, and accountable on a demanding team.

Personal Attributes:

    Nice to have

  • Healthcare or life-sciences data (genomics, clinical, biomedical), and working under HIPAA.

  • Observability and telemetry for training platforms: metrics, tracing, alerting, end-to-end pipeline testing.

Compensation & Benefits:

This role is eligible for our competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being:
- Comprehensive Health Insurance
- Paid Leave (Vacation/PTO)
- Paid Holidays
- Sick Leave
- Parental Leave
- Bereavement Leave
- 401 (k) Employer Match
- Employee Referral Bonuses
Check out our complete list of benefits here - >

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Egen will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Egen welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities.
